व: व The twenty-ninth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, or more properly the semivowel V; it is often confounded.  with the labial consonant or ब, with which it is also optionally interchangeable.

व m. (-वः) 1 Air, wind. 2 The arm. 3 A name of VARUṆA. 4 Addressing. 5 Auspiciousness. 6 Strong, powerful. 7 A dwelling. 8 The residence of VARUṆA. 9 The ocean. 10 Water. 11 Shaving. 12 Like, as. f. (वा) 1 Going. 2 Hurting, injury. 3 An arrow. 4 Weaving. 5 A weaver. n. (वं) A sort of incantation or Mantra, of which the object is the deity VARUṆA. E. वा to go, to injure, &c., aff. ड.
वंश: वंश m. (-शः) 1 Race, lineage, family. 2 Assemblage, multitude. 3 A bambu. 4 The back-bone, the spine. mf. (-शः-शी) 1 A pipe, a fife, a flute. 2 Bambu manna. E. वंश to shine, घ aff., and नुम् augment; or वन् to sound, to serve, aff. श.
वंशक: वंशक m. (-कः) 1 A small fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.) 2 A large kind of sugar-cane. nf. (-शकं-शिका) Aloe wood. f. (-का) A kind of pipe or flute. E. कन् added to the preceding.
वंशकफ: वंशकफ n. (-फं) Flocks of cotton or cottony pods floating in the air. E. वंश a bambu, and कफ phlegm.
वंशकर: वंशकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Making or perpetuating a family. E. वंश, and कर what makes.
वंशकीर्ति: वंशकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. E. वंश, and कीर्त्ति fame.
वंशकीर्त्ति: वंशकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. E. वंश, and कीर्त्ति fame.
वंशक्षय: वंशक्षय m. (-यः) Decay of a family. E. वंश, and क्षय decline.
वंशक्षीरी: वंशक्षीरी f. (-री) The manna of the bambu. E. वंश the bambu, and क्षीर milk; being of a milky colour.
वंशचरित्र: वंशचरित्र n. (-त्रं) A genealogical table or list, the history of a race or dynasty, &c. E. वंश, and चरित्र an account.
वंशज: वंशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Sprung from a good family. 2 Produced by the bambu. nf. (-जं-जा) Bambu manna. E. वंश a bambu, lineage, &c., and ज born, produced.
वंशधर: वंशधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Who or what supports a family. 2 Carrying or holding a bambu, &c. E. वंश, and धर what holds.
वंशनालिका: वंशनालिका f. (-का) A pipe, a reed or flute. E. वंश a bambu, नाल a tube, कन् aff. fem. form.
वंशपत्रक: वंशपत्रक n. (-कं) Yellow orpiment. m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.) E. वंश a bambu, and पत्र a leaf, the shape of the fish resembling that of the leaf.
वंशपत्रपतित: वंशपत्रपतित n. (-तं) A species of the Atyaṣṭī metre.
वंशपरम्परा: वंशपरम्परा f. (-रा) Family, lineage, descent. E. वंश, and परम्पर successive.
वंशभोज्य: वंशभोज्य n. (-ज्यं) Hereditary estate. E. वंश, and भोज्य to be possessed.
वंशरोचना: वंशरोचना f. (-ना) An earthy concretion of a milk-white colour, formed in the hollow of the bambu, and known by the name of bambu manna. E. वंश the bambu, रुच to shine, aff. युच्; also र being changed to ल, वंशलोचना.
वंशलोचना: वंशलोचना f. (-ना) The manna of the bambu: see the last.
वंशवर्द्धन: वंशवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Increasing or exalting a family. E. वंश, and वर्द्धन augmenting.
वंशवितति: वंशवितति f. (-तिः) 1 A clump of bambus. 2 Family, descent. E. वंश, and वितति extent.
वंशविशुद्ध: वंशविशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Of a good family. 2 Of a good bambu, (made, constructed.) E. वंश, and विशुद्ध pure.
वंशवृद्धि: वंशवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Prosperity of a family. E. वंश, and वृद्धि increase.
वंशशलाका: वंशशलाका f. (-का) 1 The bambu pipe that forms the body of the Vīṇā or lute. 2 Any small bambu pin or stake, as the bar of a cage, &c. E. वंश a bambu, and शलाका a pin or bolt.
वंशसमाचार: वंशसमाचार m. (-रः) Family usage. E. वंश, and समाचार practice.
वंशस्थविल: वंशस्थविल n. (-लं) A species of the Jagatī metre.
वंशहीन: वंशहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having no kindred or family. E. वंश, and हीन deprived of.
वंशाग्र: वंशाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The shoot of a bambu. E. वंश, and अग्र point.
वंशाङ्कुर: वंशाङ्कुर m. (-रः) The shoot of a bambu. E. वंश, and अङ्कुर a shoot.
वंशावली: वंशावली f. (-ली) A pedigree, a genealogy. E. वंश, and आवली a line.
वंशानुचरित: वंशानुचरित n. (-तं) A pedigree, a genealogical list, or history. E. वंश a family, अनु implying succession, and चरित proceeded.
वंशिक: वंशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a family, a bambu, &c. nf. (-कं-का) Aloe wood. E. वंश a bambu, and ठक् aff.
वंशीधर: वंशीधर m. (-रः) 1 A piper. 2 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. वंशी, and धर who holds.
वंश्य: वंश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Of a good family. 2 Of the same family. m. (-श्यः) 1 A son. 2 A pupil, a scholar. 3 A kinsman, from seven generations above and seven below. E. वंश a family, and यत् aff.
वंहिष्ठ: वंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Most, very much or great. E. वंह substituted for वृन्दारक great, and इष्ठन् aff.
वंहीयस्: वंहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very much or very large. E. वंह for वृन्दारक, and ईयसुन् aff.
वक: वक(इ)वकि r. 1st cl. (वंकते) 1 To be crooked, (literally or figuratively;) to be curved or bent, to be depraved or wicked. 2 To bend, to make crooked. 3 To go.

वक m. (-कः) 1 A crane, (Ardea nivea.) 2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 3 KUVERA. 4 The name of a demon. 5 A small apparatus for calcining or subliming metals or minerals, consisting of two crucibles, one inverted over the other, luted together and placed over a fire. E. वच to speak, or वकि to be crooked, aff. घञ् or अच्; in the latter case the nasal augment is not inserted.
वकचिञ्चिका: वकचिञ्चिका f. (-का) A sort of fish.
वकजित्: वकजित् n. (-जित्) A name of BHĪMA. E. वक a demon, and जित् the conqueror.
वकधूप: वकधूप m. (-पः) Compound perfume: see वृकधूप.
वकनिसूदन: वकनिसूदन m. (-नः) BHĪMA. E. वक the demon, and निसूदन destroyer.
वकपुष्प: वकपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.) E. वक curving, from वकि to be crooked, and पुष्प a flower.
वकवृत्ति: वकवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A false or hypocritical devotee: see वकव्रतिन्. E. वक, and वृत्ति livelihood.
वकवैरिन्: वकवैरिन् m. (-री) BHĪMA. E. वक the demon, and वैरिन् a foe.
वकव्रतिन्: वकव्रतिन् m. (-ती) A false devotee, a religious hypocrite, or one who assumes the appearance of devotion or meditation, for interested purposes. E. वक a crane, व्रत observance, and इनि aff.; compared to the crane, who stands by a pool demure and sly, and apparently absorbed in contemplation, till he sees a fish on which to dart; also with ठक्, aff. वकव्रतिक, and derived from वक, and चर who goes, वकचर or वकव्रतचर m. (-रः) &c.; see वैडालव्रतिक.
वकाची: वकाची f. (-ची) A sort of fish.
वकुल: वकुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) f. (-ली) A sort of drug, commonly Kākolī. E. वक to be crooked, aff. उलच्.
वकेरुका: वकेरुका f. (-का) 1 A small crane. 2 The branch of a tree bent by the wind. E. वक a crane, or crooked, ईर to go or be, aff. उकन्.
वकोट: वकोट m. (-टः) A crane. E. वक to be crooked. ओटच् aff.
वक्तव्य: वक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Fit or proper to be said or spoken, to be spoken or uttered. 2 Vile, bad, reprehensible. 3 Subject, dependant. 4 Low, base. n. (-व्यं) 1 A rule, a dictum, a sentence. 2 Speech. E. वच to speak, and तव्य aff., of the future participle.
वक्तव्यता: वक्तव्यता f. (-ता) 1 Blame, reprehension. 2 The nature or property of what is to be said, or the occasion for it. E. तल् added to the last.
वक्तुकाम: वक्तुकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desirous of speaking. E. वक्तु for वक्तुम् to speak, काम desire.
वक्तृ: वक्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 1 Speaking, a speaker. 2 Loquacious, talkative. 3 Speaking well or sensibly, eloquent. 4 Wise, learned. 5 Speaking truly or truth, honest, sincere. m. (-क्ता) 1 An expounder, a teacher. 2 An orator, a speaker. E. वच् to speak, तृच् participial aff.
वक्त्र: वक्त्र n. (-क्त्रं) 1 The mouth or face. 2 A sort of garment. 3 Metre, verse, especially of the Vedas., 4 A plant: see तगरसूल. E. वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. त्र.
वक्त्रखुर: वक्त्रखुर m. (-रः) A tooth. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and खुर a hoof.
वक्त्रज: वक्त्रज m. (-जः) A Brahman. E. वक्त्र the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) ज born.
वक्त्रताल: वक्त्रताल mn. (-लः-लं) A musical instrument, played on with the mouth. E. वक्त्र the mouth, ताल tune; it may also signify, making a noise with the mouth, by striking it with the hand at the moment of uttering sound.
वक्त्रतुण्ड: वक्त्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. वक्त्र, and तुण्ड beak or nose, having the proboscis of an elephant.
वक्त्रपट्ट: वक्त्रपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A bag containing corn tied round a horse's head. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and पट्ट a cloth.
वक्त्रभेदिन्: वक्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) Pungency, pungent or acrid flavour. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and भेदिन् what cuts.
वक्त्रशोधिन्: वक्त्रशोधिन् m. (-धी) A lime. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and शोधिन् what cleanses; also वक्त्रशोधन m. (-नः.)
वक्त्रासव: वक्त्रासव m. (-वः) Saliva. E. वक्त्र the mouth, and आसव wine.
वक्र: वक्र mfn. (-क्रः-क्रा-क्रं) 1 Crooked, curved, bowed or bent. 2 Cruel, malignant. 3 Dishonest, fraudulent. 4 Indirect, evasive. n. (-क्रं) The winding course of a river or water-fall, the arm or bend of a stream. 2 A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre. m. (-क्रः) 1 A name of SATURN. 2 The planet MARS. 3 RUDRA or ŚIVA. 4 The demon TRIPURA. E. वकि to go crookedly, रक् Uṇādi aff.
वक्रखड्ग: वक्रखड्ग m. (-ड्गः) A sabre or scimitar. E. वक्र crooked, and खड्ग a sword; also वक्रखड्गकः.
वक्रगामिन्: वक्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिणी-मि) 1 Who or what goes tortuously. 2 Fraudulent, dishonest. E. वक्र, and गामिन् who goes.
वक्रग्रीव: वक्रग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel. E. वक्र crooked, ग्रीवा the neck.
वक्रचञ्चु: वक्रचञ्चु m. (-ञ्चुः) A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, and चञ्चु the beak.
वक्रता: वक्रता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness. 2 Wickedness. 3 Craft, cunning. 4 Evasive or indirect speech. E. वक्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, वक्रत्वं.
वक्रतुण्ड: वक्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, तुण्ड a face.
वक्रदंष्ट्र: वक्रदंष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A hog. E. वक्र crooked, and दंष्ट्र a tusk.
वक्रनक्र: वक्रनक्र m. (-क्रः) A low or depraved man. 2 A parrot. E. वक्र crooked, and नक्र the nose, &c.
वक्रनासिक: वक्रनासिक m. (-कः) An owl. E. वक्र crooked, and नासिका the nose.
वक्रपुच्छ: वक्रपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A dog. E. वक्र crooked, and पुच्छ a tail; also वक्रपुच्छिक.
वक्रपुष्प: वक्रपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. वक्र crooked, and पुष्प the flower.
वक्रबालधि: वक्रबालधि m. (-धिः) A dog. E. वक्र crooked, बालधि a tail.
वक्रभणित: वक्रभणित n. (-तं) Indirect speech, equivoque, evasion. E. वक्र crooked, and भणित spoken.
वक्रम: वक्रम m. (-मः) Flight, retreat. E. अव reverse, क्रम to go, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected.
वक्रवक्त्र: वक्रवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) A hog. E. वक्र crooked, and वक्त्र a face.
वक्राग्र: वक्राग्र n. (-ग्रं) A plant, commonly Betu.
वक्राङ्ग: वक्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A goose. 2 The ruddy goose. E. वक्र bending, अङ्ग body.
वक्रि: वक्रि mfn. (-क्रिः-क्रिः-क्रि) Speaking falsely, uttering untruths, prevaricating, lying. E. वक्र to be crooked, (metaph.) क्रिन् aff.
वक्रिन्: वक्रिन् mfn. (-क्री-क्रिणी-क्रि) 1 Crooked. 2 Dishonest, fraudulent. m. (-क्री) A Jaina or Bauddha. E. वक्र crooked, fraudulent, इनि aff.
वक्रिम: वक्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Bent, curved. E. वकि to go crookedly, क्रिमच् aff.
वक्रिमन्: वक्रिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Crookedness, curvature. 2 Craftiness, cunning. E. बक्र, and इमनिच् aff.
वक्रीकरण: वक्रीकरण n. (-णं) Curving, bending, distorting. E. वक्र, and करण making, च्चि augment.
वक्रीकृत: वक्रीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, made crooked. E. वक्र, and कृत made, च्चि aug.
वक्रीभाव: वक्रीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Curvature, curve. 2 Fraudulent or dishonest disposition. E. वक्री, and भाव property, च्चि aug.
वक्रीभूत: वक्रीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, crooked. 2 Dishonest. E. वक्र, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
वक्रोक्ति: वक्रोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Equivoque, evasion, pun, the covert expression of something else than the words used naturally imply, either from the manner in which they are uttered, or some other sense of which they are susceptible. 2 Hint, insinuation. 3 Sarcasm. E. वक्र crooked, dishonest, and उक्ति speech.
वक्रोष्ठिका: वक्रोष्ठिका f. (-का) A gentle smile, one in which the teeth are not shewn. E. वक्र crooked, ओष्ठ the lip, and कन् aff., fem. form; also वक्रोष्टिः.
वक्ष: वक्ष r. 1st cl. (वक्षति) 1 To be angry. 2 To accumulate.
वक्षःसम्मर्द्धिनी: वक्षःसम्मर्द्धिनी f. (-नी) Wife of the bosom. E. वक्षस्, and सम्मर्द्दिनी who rubs.
वक्षण: वक्षण n. (-णं) The breast: see वक्षस्.
वक्षस्: वक्षस् n. (-क्षः) The breast, the bosom, the chest. m. (-क्षाः) An ox, (confined to the Vedas.) E. वच to speak, or वक्ष to accumulate, aff. असुन्, in the first case सुट् is inserted; again वह to bear, असुन् aff., सुट् augment, and the deriv. irr.
वक्षस्स्थल: वक्षस्स्थल n. (-लं) The breast, the heart. E. वक्षस्, and स्थल place.
वक्षोज: वक्षोज n. (-जं) The female breast. E. वक्षस् the breast or chest, and ज born.
वक्षोरुह: वक्षोरुह m. (-हः) The female breast. E. वक्षस् the chest, and रुह what rises.
वक्ष्यमाण: वक्ष्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being to be said or described. E. वच् to say, desid. pass. v., शानच् aff.
वख: वख r. 1st cl. (वखति) (इ) वखि (वंखति) To go or move.
वग: वग(इ)वगि r. 1st cl. (वंगति) 1 To go. 2 To go lamely, to limp.
वगाह: वगाह m. (-हः) Bathing, ablution. E. अव before गाह to agitate, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected; also अवगाह.
वग्नु: वग्नु m. (-ग्नुः) A speaker. E. वच to speak, नु Uṇādi aff., and च changed to ग.
वघ: वघ(इ)वघि r. 1st cl. (वंघते) 1 To go. 2 To blame or censure. 3 To begin. 4 To begin moving. 5 To move swiftly.
वङ्क: वङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 The bend or elbow of a river, the winding course of a stream. 2 Crookedness. f. (-ङ्का) The pummel of a saddle. E. वकि to curve or bend, aff. अच्.
वङ्किल: वङ्किल m. (-लः) A thorn. E. वङ्क crookedness, and इलच् aff.
वङ्क्य: वङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) Crooked, curved. E. वञ्च to go, ण्यत् aff., and च changed to क.
वङ्क्रि: वङ्क्रि m. (-ङ्क्रिः) 1 A rib. 2 The wood of a thatch. 3 A particular musical instrument. E. वकि to be crooked, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
वङ्क्षण: वङ्क्षण n. (-णं) The groin, the public and iliac regions. E. वाञ्छि to desire, ल्युट् aff., and the form irr., or वक्ष to accumulate, ल्युट् aff., and नुम् augment.
वङ्क्षु: वङ्क्षु f. (-ङ्क्षुः) A small arm or branch of the Ganges. E. वङ्क्ष to accumulate, aff. उ.
वङ्ग: वङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Lead. 2 Tin. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Bengal, or the eastern parts of the modern province. 2 Cotton. 3 The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वगि to go, युच् aff.
वङ्गन: वङ्गन m. (-नः) The egg-plant. E. वगि to go, युच् aff.
वङ्गशुल्वज: वङ्गशुल्वज n. (-जं) Brass. E. वङ्ग tin, शुल्व copper, and ज produced; an alloy of tin and copper.
वङ्गसेन: वङ्गसेन m. (-नः) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. वङ्ग Bengal, सि to sew, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, वङ्गसेनक.
वङ्गारि: वङ्गारि m. (-रिः) Yellow orpiment. E. वङ्ग lead, and अरि a foe.
वङ्गुला: वङ्गुला f. (-ला) A mode of music.
वच: वच(औ)औवच r. 1st cl. (वचति) 2nd cl. (वक्ति) and 10th cl. (वाचयति) 1 To speak, to tell. 2 To inform. 3 To read, to expound: (the second cl. is the most usual form of the root, in which its inflections however are very irregular.) With प्र, To begin to speak.
वच m. (-चः) A parrot. f. (-चा) 1 Orris root, (Acorus calamus; also Zinziber Zedoaria.) 2 The Sārikā, (Turdus Salica.) E. वच to speak, अच् aff.
वचक्नु: वचक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Talkative, loquacious, eloquent. m. (-क्नुः) A Brahman. E. वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. अक्नुच्.
वचन: वचन n. (-नं) 1 Speech, speaking. 2 A sentence, a text, a dictum, an aphorism, a rule. E. वच to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
वचनकर: वचनकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Obedient. 2 Speaking. m. (-रः) The author or enunciator of a precept. E. वचन्, and कर who makes.
वचनक्रम: वचनक्रम m. (-मः) Discourse, order of words. E. वचन, and क्रम order.
वचनग्राहिन्: वचनग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Compliant, conformable, submissive, humble. E. वचन speech, ग्राहिन् taking, obeying.
वचनविरुद्ध: वचनविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to a text or precept. E. वचन, and विरुद्ध opposed.
वचनविरोध: वचनविरोध m. (-धः) Incongruity, contradiction, inconsistency of texts. E. वचन, and विरोध opposition.
वचनव्यक्ति: वचनव्यक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Distinctness or perspicuity of a text. E. वचन, and व्यक्ति plainness.
वचनीय: वचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be spoken or said. 2 Censurable, to be noticed or reproved. E. वच to speak, अनीयर् aff.
वचनीयता: वचनीयता f. (-ता) 1 Rumour, report, especially ill report, detraction, scandal. 2 Blame, reprehension. E. वचनीव to be censured, तल् aff.; also with त्व aff., वचनीयत्वं.
वचनमात्र: वचनमात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere words, assertion unsupported by facts. E. वचन, and मात्र only.
वचनशत: वचनशत n. (-तं) Repeated speech or declaration. E. वचन, and शत a hundred.
वचनेस्थित: वचनेस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Compliant, conformable, obedient. E. वचने in the word, and स्थित who stays.
वचलु: वचलु m. (-लुः) Offence, fault. E. वच to speak, अलुच् aff.
वचस्: वचस् n. (-चः) 1 Speech, voice. 2 Words, a speech. E. वच to speak, असुन् aff.
वचस्कर: वचस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Obedient, compliant. E. वचस्, and कर who does.
वज: वज r. 1st cl. (बजति) To go. r. 10th cl. (वाजयति) 1 To go. 2 To prepare, to make. 3 To prepare the way. 4 To trim or feather an arrow.
वज्र: वज्र mfn. (-ज्रः-ज्रा-ज्रं) 1 Hard, impenetrable, adamantine. 2 Cross, forked. mn. (-ज्रः-ज्रं) 1 A thunder-bolt in general, or the thunder-bolt of INDRA. 2 The diamond, (the gem being considered analogous in hardness to the thunder-bolt, or in fact to be the same substance.) 3 A diagram, the figure of which is supposed to be that of the thunder-bolt. 4 A child or pupil. 5 Emblic myrobalan. 6 Sour gruel. 7 The blossom of the sesamum. 8 Harsh language. m. (-ज्रः) 1 One of the astronomical Yogas. 2 Kuśa grass. f. (-ज्रा-ज्री) A species of Euphorbia. f. (-ज्रा) 1 A plant: see गुडुची. 2 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. वज to go, रक् aff.
वज्रक: वज्रक n. (-कं) A sort of salt, an impure carbonate of soda. E. कन् added to the last.
वज्रकङ्कट: वज्रकङ्कट m. (-टः) Hanumān, the monkey demigod. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and कङ्कट armour.
वज्रकण्टक: वज्रकण्टक m. (-कः) Euphorbia. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, and कण्टक a thorn.
वज्रकपालिन्: वज्रकपालिन् m. (-ली) One of the Bauddha saints.
वज्रक्षार: वज्रक्षार n. (-रं) An alkaline earth, an impure carbonate of soda. E. वज्र diamond, and क्षार alkali.
वज्रजित्: वज्रजित् m. (जित्) A name of GARUḌA. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and जित् who conquers; being invulnerable to repeated shocks of INDRA'S bolt.
वज्रज्वाला: वज्रज्वाला f. (-ला) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and ज्वाला flame.
वज्रटीक: वज्रटीक m. (-कः) A Jaina deified saint.
वज्रतुण्ड: वज्रतुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The deity GAṆEŚA. 2 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 3 A vulture. 4 A gnat, a musquito. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and तुण्ड face or beak, as hard.
वज्रदन्त: वज्रदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A hog. 2 A rat. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and दन्त a tooth.
वज्रदशन: वज्रदशन m. (-नः) A rat. E. वज्र, and दशन a tooth: see the last.
वज्रद्रु: वज्रद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia of various species. E. वज्र thunderbolt, (as hard,) and द्रु a tree; also वज्रद्रुम.
वज्रद्रुम: वज्रद्रुम m. (-मः) Euphorbia: see the last.
वज्रधर: वज्रधर m. (-रः) 1 INDRA, as the JUPITER Tonans of the Hindus. 2 A Bauddha saint. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and धर who has or holds.
वज्रनिर्घोष: वज्रनिर्घोष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and निर्घोष sound.
वज्रनिष्पेष: वज्रनिष्पेष m. (-षः) A clap of thunder. E. वज्र the bolt, and निष्पेष here meaning the sound produced by friction or concussion, from निर् forth, पिष to grind, aff. घञ्.
वज्रपाणि: वज्रपाणि m. (-णिः) INDRA. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and पाणि the hand: see वज्रधर.
वज्रपात: वज्रपात m. (-तः) A thunder-bolt, a stroke of lightning. E. वज्र, and पात fall.
वज्रपुष्प: वज्रपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) The blossom of the sesamum. E. वज्र a diamond, and पुष्प flower.
वज्रबध: वज्रबध m. (-धः) 1 Death by lightning. 2 Cross multiplication. E. वज्र, and बय killing, or multiplying.
वज्रमय: वज्रमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Hard, adamantine. 2 Hard-hearted. E. वज्र, and मयट् aff.
वज्ररद: वज्ररद m. (-दः) A hog. E. वज्र a thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and रद a tooth.
वज्रवल्ली: वज्रवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A species of sun-flower, (Heliotropium.) E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and वल्ली a creeper.
वज्रवाराही: वज्रवाराही f. (-ही) A female personification of Māyā or unreality, amongst the Bauddhas.
वज्रशृङ्खला: वज्रशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A female deification peculiar to the Jainas, and one of their sixteen Vidyā-Devīs. E. वज्र a diamond, and शृङ्खला a chain.
वज्राङ्ग: वज्राङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A snake. f. (-ङ्गी) A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.) E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, (as hard,) and अङ्ग body or substance.
वज्राघात: वज्राघात m. (-तः) 1 A thunder-bolt or stroke. 2 A sudden calamity. E. वज्र, and आघात blow.
वज्राभ: वज्राभ m. (-भः) Precious Opal. E. वज्र the diamond, (in hardness perhaps,) आभ resembling.
वज्राभ्यास: वज्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Cross multiplication. E. वज्र, and अभ्यास practising.
वज्रिन्: वज्रिन् m. (-ज्री) 1 INDRA. 2 A Jaina deified saint. 3 A buffalo. E. वज्र the thunder-bolt, and इनि aff.
वञ्च: वञ्च(उ)वञ्च r. 1st cl. (वञ्चति) To go. r. 1st and 10th cls. (वञ्चते वञ्चयते) To delude, to cheat, to trick or deceive.
वञ्चक: वञ्चक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fraudulent, crafty. m. (-कः) 1 A jackal or Shakal. 2 A tame or house ichneumon. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A low or vile man. E. वञ्च to cheat, ण्वुल् aff.
वञ्चथ: वञ्चथ m. (-थः) A rogue, a knave, a cheat. E. वञ्च to cheat, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
वञ्चन: वञ्चन n. (-नं) Cheating, fraud. E. वञ्च to cheat, ल्युट् aff.
वञ्चनीय: वञ्चनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be tricked or cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, अनीयर् aff.
वञ्चयित्वा: वञ्चयित्वा ind. Having cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, क्त्वाच् aff.
वञ्चित: वञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tricked, deceived, cheated. E. वञ्च to cheat, aff. क्त्र.
वञ्चुक: वञ्चुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Crafty, fraudulent, dishonest. E. वञ्च to cheat, aff. उकन्.
वञ्च्य: वञ्च्य mfn. (-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्या-ञ्च्यं) 1 To be gone. 2 To be cheated. E. वञ्च to go, यत् aff.
वञ्जुल: वञ्जुल m. (-लः) 1 A tree, (Dalbergia Ougeinensis.) 2 Another tree, (Jonesia Asoca.) 3 Common cane, (Calamus rotang.) 4 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) 5 A sort of bird. f. (-ला) A cow that yields abundance of milk. E. वञ्च to go, aff. उलच्, and च changed to ज.
वट: वट r. 1st and 10th cls. (वटति वटयति) 1 To surround or encompass. 2 To tie or string, to connect. 3 To partition, to divide. r. 1st cl. causal form (वटयति) To speak. (इ) वटि r. 4th and 10th cls. (वण्ट्यति वण्टयति) To partition, to separate or divide.

वट subst. mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) A string, a rope, a tie. m. (-टः) 1 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 A round figure, a circle, a cypher, a ball or globe. 3 Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. 4 A small shell, a cowrie. 5 Equality in shape or dimension. E. वट to surround, to tie, aff. अच्.
वटक: वटक m. (-कः) 1 Pulse ground and fried in oil or butter. 2 A weight of eight Māṣas. f. (-टिका) A pill, a bolus. E. वट to surround, aff. वुन्.
वटपत्रा: वटपत्रा f. (-त्रा) A plant, from the fibrous leaves of which bowstrings, &c. are made, (Aletris hyacinthoides: Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox.'s Cata.) E. वट a string, पत्र a leaf.
वटर: वटर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wicked, villainous. 2 Slippery, unsteady. m. (-रः) 1 A cock. 2 A thief. 3 A cloth worn round the head, a turban. 4 A mat. 5 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 6 A churning stick. E. वट to surround, अरच् aff.
वटवासिन्: वटवासिन् mf. (-सी-सिनी) A sort of demigod, male and female; a YAKṢA or YAKṢIṆĪ, KUVERA'S special attendants. E. वट the Indian fig in which these spirits are supposed to be fond of abiding, वास abode, and इनि aff.
वटाकर: वटाकर m. (-रः) A cord, a rope, a string. E. वट surrounding, आकर what makes, from कृ to make, with आङ् prefix, टच् aff.
वटावीक: वटावीक m. (-कः) A notorious thief, a dakoit, a robber.
वटि: वटि m. (-टिः) A sort of tick or body louse. E. वट to surround, aff. इन्.
वटिन्: वटिन् mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि) 1 Stringed, having a string. 2 Circular, globular. E. वट, and इनि aff.
वटु: वटु m. (-टुः) 1 The Brahmacārī or religious student, after his investiture with the sacred thread. 2 A lad, a youth in general. 3 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) E. वट to surround, (with the string, &c.) or to speak, उ Uṇādi aff.
वटुक: वटुक m. (-कः) 1 A lad, a young man in general, or one fit to receive the sacrificial thread. 2 A religious student. 3 A stupid fellow, a blockhead. E. कन् added to the preceding.
वटूकरण: वटूकरण n. (-णं) Investiture with the sacred and characteristic thread. E. वटु a lad after investiture, कृ to make, aff. ल्युट्. and the vowel of वटु made long or technically, च्चि augment.
वठ: वठ r. 1st cl. (वठति) To be large, powerful or able; also वट (इ) वठि (वंठते) To move alone or unaccompanied.
वठर: वठर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Vile, wicked, abandoned. 2 Stupid, slow, dull. m. (-रः) 1 A blockhead, a fool. 2 A physician. 3 A waterpot. E. वच to speak, अरच् aff., and च changed to ठ.
वड: वड(इ)वडि r. 1st cl. (वण्डते) 1 To partition, to share or divide. 2 To surround or encompass. 3 To cover: in the first sense it is sometimes read as a root of the 10th cl. (वंडयति.)
वडभि: वडभि f. (-भिः or भी) 1 The wooden frame of a thatch. 2 A temporary building or awning on the top of a palace, or a room or turret so situated. E. वल to cover, अभच् aff., इन् added, and again optionally ङीष्, ल changed to ड; otherwise वलभि and वलभी.
वडा: वडा f. (-डा) Pulse ground and fried with oil or butter. E. वल to cover, अच् and टाप् aff., and ल changed to its congener ड.
वडिश: वडिश nf. (-शं-शा or -शी) A fish-hook. E. वटिन् having a string, a bait, शो to destroy, and ड aff.; the radical ट changed to ड.
वड्र: वड्र mfn. (-ड्रः-ड्रा-ड्रं) Large, great. E. वल to cover, रक् aff., ल changed to ड.
वण: वण(ऋ)वणृ r. 1st cl. (वणति) To sound; also वन.
वण्ट: वण्ट r. 10th cl. (वण्टयति) To partition, to separate or divide; also वटि.
वण्ट m. (-ण्टः) 1 A part, a portion. 2 A man unmarried. 3 The handle of a sickle. E. वटि to divide, aff. घञ्.
वण्टक: वण्टक m. (-कः) A part, a portion, a share. E. वटि to divide, घञ् and कन् aff.
वण्टन: वण्टन n. (-नं) Portioning, partitioning, dividing. E. वटि to divide, ल्युट् aff.
वण्टनीय: वण्टनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divisible, to be divided. E. वटि to divide, अनीयर् aff.
वण्ठ: वण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 An unmarried man. 2 A dwarf. 3 A javelin. E. वठि to go alone, aff. घञ्.
वण्ठर: वण्ठर m. (-रः) 1 The new shoot of the Tāla or palm tree. 2 The sheath that envelopes the young bambu. 3 A rope for tying a goat, &c. 4 A breast. 5 A dog's tail 6 A dog. 7 A cloud. E. वठि to go alone, aff. अरच्.
वण्ड: वण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) 1 Maimed, defective, crippled, but especially in the hands. 2 Impotent, emasculated. m. (-ण्डः) 1 A man who is circumcised or has no prepuce. 2 An ox without his tail. f. (-ण्डः) An unchaste woman. E. वण to sound, &c., aff. ड.
वण्डर: वण्डर m. (-रः) 1 A niggard, a miser. 2 A eunuch or attendant on the woman's apartments.
वण्डाल: वण्डाल m. (-लः) 1 A description of conflict, the contest of heroes. 2 A boat. 3 A spade, a hoe. E. वडि to divide, आलच् aff.
वत्: वत् ind. As, like, similar: this is more generally considered as an affix to words, termed technically वति, as ब्राह्मणवत् like a Brahman, &c.
वत: वत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Uttered, sounded, spoken. 2 Asked, begged ind. 1 A particle analogous to ah, oh, &c. expressing sorrow. 2 Compassion. 3 Pleasure. 4 Oh, ho, a vocative particle. E. वन to ask or beg, &c., aff. क्त.
वतंस: वतंस m. (-सः) 1 An ear-ring. 2 A crest. E. अव before तसि to adorn, and अच् aff., the initial rejected; also अवतंस.
वतण्ड: वतण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The name of a Muni. E. अव before वडि to beat, aff. अच्, and अ rejected.
वतोका: वतोका f. (-का) A cow miscarrying from accident. E. अव before तोक offspring, and अ rejected; also अवतोका.
वत्स: वत्स n. (-त्सं) The breast, the chest. m. (-त्सः) 1 A calf. 2 A year. mf. (-त्सः-त्सा) A term of endearment, used to children, scholars, &c. E. वद to speak, kindly to, Uṇādi aff. स.
वत्सक: वत्सक m. (-कः) 1 A calf. 2 A child. 3 A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. वत्स, and कन् added.
वत्सकाम: वत्सकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Fond of or anxious about a child. f. (-मा) A cow anxious after her calf, a mother anxious after her child, &c. E. वत्स a calf, and काम to desire, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
वत्सगुरु: वत्सगुरु m. (-रुः) A master. E. वत्स, and गुरु teacher.
वत्सतर: वत्सतर m. (-रः) A steer. E. वत्स a calf, and तरप् aff. of excess; more than a calf.
वत्सतन्त्री: वत्सतन्त्री f. (-न्त्री) The rope that ties a calf. E. वत्स, and तन्त्री a string.
वत्सनाभ: वत्सनाभ m. (-भः) An active poison; also called Mīthā Zeher, the root of the Aconite ferox brought from Nepal. E. वत्स a calf, and नभ to injure, अण् aff.; the root is sometimes compared to the nipple of a cow, whence perhaps this etymology.
वत्सपत्तन: वत्सपत्तन n. (-नं) The name of a city in the north of India; one place to which it is applied is now a village in the district of Gorakhpur. E. वत्स a calf, and पत्तन a city.
वत्सर: वत्सर m. (-रः) A year. E. वद to abide, and सरन् Uṇādi aff.
वत्सरान्तक: वत्सरान्तक m. (-कः) Name of a month, Phalguna. E. वत्सर, and अन्तक destroyer.
वत्सल: वत्सल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Affectionate, kind. n. (-लं) Affection, fondness. f. (-ला) A cow anxious for her calf. E. वत्स a child, and लच् aff.
वत्सलता: वत्सलता f. (-ता) Tenderness, affection. E. वत्सल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वत्सलत्वं.
वत्साक्षी: वत्साक्षी f. (-क्षी) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
वत्सादनी: वत्सादनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. वत्स a calf, &c., अदन food.
वत्सीय: वत्सीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Proper or fit for a calf. m. (-यः) A cowherd. E. वत्स a calf, &c., and छ aff.
वद: वद r. 1st and 10th cls. (वदति-ते वदयति-ते) 1 To inform, to speak to or tell, to declare. 2 To speak articulately. 3 To abide. With अनु, (अनुवदते) To speak similarly or subsequent. With अप prefixed, (अपवदति-ते) To reprove, to censure. With अभि, To salute respectfully or by name. With उप, (उपवदते) To explain. With निर्, To speak out or With परि, (परिवदति) To speak against. With प्र, To rumour, to slander. With प्रति, (प्रतिवदति) To reply to or answer. With वि, (विवदते) To dispute. With वि and प्र, (विप्रवदति or -ते) To wrangle or dispute together. With वि and सं, To break a promise. With सम and प्र, (सष्प्रवदते) To speak articulately in concert; (सष्प्रवदति) To utter or articulate sounds together. (इ,) वदि (वंदते) 1 To salute with reverence or respect. 2 To praise, to eulogize.
वद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, able to speak, speaking well or sensibly. E. वद to speak, अच् aff.
वदत्: वदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Speaking, saying. E. वद to speak, शतृ aff.
वदन: वदन n. (-नं) 1 The mouth, the face. 2 The summit or apex of a triangle. E. वद to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
वदनसरोज: वदनसरोज n. (-जं) The face of a mistress. E. वदन, and सरोज a lotus; also similar compounds, as वदनाम्बुरुह, वदनारविन्द, &c.
वदनासव: वदनासव m. (-वः) Saliva, the moisture of the lips. E. वदन the mouth, and आसव spirituous liquor.
वदनेन्दु: वदनेन्दु m. (-न्दुः) The face. E. वदन, and इन्दु the moon; also similar compounds, as वदनत्रन्द्र, &c.
वदन्ति: वदन्ति f. (-न्तिः-न्ती) Speech, discourse, talk. E. वद to say or speak, झिच् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
वदन्य: वदन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, bountiful. E. वद to speak, aff. अन्य; also वदान्य.
वदमान: वदमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Saying, calling. 2 Glorifying, boasting. E. वद to speak, शानच् aff.
वदरिक: वदरिक m. (-कः) The jujube: see वदरि.
वदान्य: वदान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Liberal, munificent. 2 Speaking kindly or agreeably. 3 Eloquent. E. वद to speak, आन्य Uṇādi aff.
वदाल: वदाल m. (-लः) A sheat-fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.) E. वद to speak, aff. आलच्; also with कन् added, वदालक. m. (-कः.)
वदावद: वदावद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Speaking, a speaker, able to speak, able to speak well, eloquent. E. वद to speak, aff. अच्, the root repeated, and आ inserted.
वधु: वधु f. (-धुः) 1 A son's wife. 2 A wife in general. E. वह to bear, उ aff., more commonly वधू.
वधुका: वधुका f. (-का) A wife. E. वधु for वधू, and कन् added.
वधुटी: वधुटी f. (-टी) A daughter-in-law: see वधूटी.
वधू: वधू f. (-धूः) 1 Woman in general, a female. 2 A wife. 3 A young wife, one recently married, a bride. 4 A son's wife. 5 A sort of bulbous root, (Curcuma reclinata.) 6 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata:) see पृक्का. 7 A plant, (Echites frutescens.) E. वह to bear, उ aff., and ह changed to ध; also derived from षध to bind, in which case it is written वधू.
वधूजन: वधूजन m. (-नः) A woman. E. वधू a female, and जन person.
वधूटी: वधूटी f. (-टी) 1 A son's wife. 2 A young woman living in her father's house, whether married or unmarried. E. वह to bear, कूटट् aff., and ह changed to घ.
वधूशयन: वधूशयन n. (-नं) A lattice, a loop-hole.
वन: वन r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति) 1 To sound. 2 To serve, to honour. 3 To help. 4 To be distressed. (उ) वनु r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति) 1 To act, to transact business. 2 To injure; also r. 8th cl. (वनुते) To ask or beg.
वन nf. (-नं-नी) A forest, a wood, a grove. n. (-नं) 1 Water. 2 A residence, a dwelling or abode. 3 A house. 4 A cascade or fountain. E. वन to sound, to serve, to seek, &c., aff. घञ्.
वनकचु: वनकचु m. (-चुः) A species of Arum, (A. colocasia.) E. वन, and कचु the same.
वनकरिन्: वनकरिन् m. (-री) A wild elephant. E. वन, and करिन् an elephant.
वनकार्पासी: वनकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.) E. वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
वनकार्प्पासी: वनकार्प्पासी f. (-सी) Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.) E. वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.
वनकुक्कुट: वनकुक्कुट m. (-टः) Wild fowl. E. वन, and कुक्कुट a cock.
वनगज: वनगज m. (-जः) A wild elephant. E. वन, and गज an elephant.
वनगहन: वनगहन n. (-नं) A thicket. E. वन, and गहन the same.
वनगुप्त: वनगुप्त m. (-प्तः) A spy, an emissary. E. वन a wood, and गुप्त concealed.
वनगो: वनगो f. (-गौः) The Gāyal, (Bos gavæus.) E. वन wood, and गो a cow; also वनगव m. (-वः)
वनगोचर: वनगोचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frequenting forests. m. (-रः) A hunter, a forester. n. (-रं) A forest. E. वन, and गोचर an object, &c.
वनचन्दन: वनचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 Aloe wood or Agallochum. 2 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. वन a wood, and चन्दन Sandal.
वनचारिन्: वनचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Forest, forester, savage. E. वन, and चारिन् who goes.
वनच्छाग: वनछाग m. (-गः) 1 A wild goat. 2 A hog. E. वन a wood, and छाग a goat.
वनछाग: वनछाग m. (-गः) 1 A wild goat. 2 A hog. E. वन a wood, and छाग a goat.
वनच्छिद्: वनछिद् m. (-ट्) A wood-cutter. E. वन, and छिट् who cuts.
वनछिद्: वनछिद् m. (-ट्) A wood-cutter. E. वन, and छिट् who cuts.
वनच्छेद: वनच्छेद m. (-दः) Cutting timber. E. वन, and छेद who cuts.
वनज: वनज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Wild, forest, born or produced in a wood. n. (-जं) A lotus. m. (-जः) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 2 An elephant. f. (-जा) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. वन wood, and ज born.
वनजीविन्: वनजीविन् m. (-वी) A wood-man, a forester. E. वन, and जीविन who lives.
वनतिक्त: वनतिक्त m. (-क्तः) A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. वन wood, तिक्त bitter.
वनतिक्तिका: वनतिक्तिका f. (-का) A climbing plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. कन् in the fem. form added to the preceding.
वनद: वनद m. (-दः) A cloud. E. वन water, and द what yields.
वनदीप: वनदीप m. (-पः) The Champak, (Michelia Champaca.) E. वन a wood, and दीप a lamp or illuminator.
वनपल्लव: वनपल्लव n. (-वः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga, &c.) E. वन a wood, and पल्लव a shoot.
वनपांशुल: वनपांशुल m. (-लः) A hunter, a deer-killer. E. वन a wood, and पांशुल a low man.
वनपादप: वनपादप m. (-पः) A forest tree. E. वन, and पादप a tree.
वनप्रवेश: वनप्रवेश m. (-शः) Entering a forest, commencing to live as a hermit. E. वन, and प्रवेश entry.
वनप्रिय: वनप्रिय m. (-यः) The Kökila or Indian cuckoo. E. वन a wood, and प्रिय fond of.
वनभुज्: वनभुज् m. (-भुक्) A medicinal root, commonly Ṛṣabha. E. वन a wood, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.
वनमल्ली: वनमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Wild jasmine. E. वन a wood, मल्ली Jasmine.
वनमाक्षिका: वनमाक्षिका f. (-का) A gad fly. E. वन a wood, and माक्षिका fly.
वनमाला: वनमाला f. (-ला) The chaplet or garland worn by KṚṢṆA. E. वन a wood, and माला necklace.
वनमालिन्: वनमालिन् m. (-ली) KṚṢṆA. f. (-नी) 1 Dvāraka the capital of KṚṢṆA. 2 A female energy of KṚṢṆA. E. वनमाला as above, इनि and ङीष् aff.
वनमुच्: वनमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. वन water, and मुच् to let loose, क्विप् aff.
वनमुद्ग: वनमुद्ग m. (-द्गः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. वन a wood, and मुद्ग kidney-bean.
वनमूत: वनमूत m. (-तः) A cloud. E. वन water, and मूत sprinkled.
वनर: वनर m. (-रः) A monkey. E. वन a wood, रम to play, aff. ड; also वानर.
वनराज: वनराज m. (-जः) A lion. E. वन a wood, and राजन् a sovereign.
वनराजि: वनराजि mfn. (-जिः-जिः-जी-जि) Embellishing or beautifying a forest. E. वन, राजृ to shine, इन् aff.
वनवर्तिन्: वनवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Residing in the woods. E. वन, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
वनवर्त्तिन्: वनवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति) Residing in the woods. E. वन, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
वनवह्नि: वनवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) A wood on fire. E. वन a forest, and वह्नि fire.
वनवास: वनवास m. (-सः) Living in the woods, as a hermit, &c. E. वन, and वास abode.
वनवासन: वनवासन m. (-नः) A civet or pole cat. E. वन a wood, वस to dwell, aff. युच्.
वनवासिन्: वनवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wild, forest, who or what dwells in woods. m. (-सी) 1 An anchoret, a hermit. 2 A forester. E. वन forest, वास abode, aff. इनि.
वनविडाल: वनविडाल m. (-लः) A sort of wild cat, (Felis caracal.) E. वन, and विडाल a cat.
वनव्रीहि: वनव्रीहि m. (-हिः) Rice growing wild in pools or swamps, and considered by botanists, as the parent stock of all the varieties cultivated in India. E. वन wood or water, and व्रीहि rice.
वनशृङ्गाट: वनशृङ्गाट m. (-टः) A plant, (Ruellia longifolia:) see गोक्षुर. E. वन a wood, and शृङ्गाट the same plant.
वनशोभन: वनशोभन n. (-नं) A lotus. E. वन water, and शोभन adorning.
वनश्वन्: वनश्वन् m. (-श्वा) 1 A jackal. 2 A tiger. 3 A civet or pole cat. E. वन a wood, and श्वन् a dog.
वनसङ्कट: वनसङ्कट m. (-टः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum hirsutum.) E. वन a wood, and सङ्कट what contracts.
वनसमूह: वनसमूह m. (-हः) A multitude of groves or forests. E. वन, and समूह a collection.
वनसरोजिनी: वनसरोजिनी f. (-नी) Wild cotton. E. वन wild, and सरोजिनी Hibiscus.
वनस्थ: वनस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Wild, savage, forest or grove-abiding, &c. m. (-स्थः) 1 A deer. 2 A hermit, an ascetic. E. वन (in) a wood, and स्थ what stays.
वनस्थायिन्: वनस्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Being or abiding in a wood. m. (-यी) A hermit, an anchoret. E. वन, and स्थायिन् who stays.
वनस्थित: वनस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Situate or being in a forest. E. वन, and स्थित् what stays.
वनस्पति: वनस्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A tree that bears fruit but no apparent blossoms, as several species of the fig, the jack, &c. 2 A tree in general. 3 An ascetic. E. वन forest, and पति lord, सुट् augment.
वनहास: वनहास m. (-सः) A sort of tall grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. वन wood, and हास a smile, from हस to laugh, with घञ् aff.; also with कन् added, वनहासक.
वनाकम्प: वनाकम्प m. (-म्पः) Shaking of the trees of a wood by the wind. E. वन, and आकम्प trembling.
वनाखु: वनाखु m. (-खुः) A hare. E. वन a wood, and आखु a rat.
वनाखुक: वनाखुक m. (-कः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Moong.)
वनाज: वनाज m. (-जः) A wild goat. E. वन a wood, and अज a goat.
वनाटु: वनाटु m. (-टुः) A blue fly. E. वन a thicket, अट to go, कु aff.
वनान्त: वनान्त n. (-न्तं) The skirts of a wood. E. वन, and अन्त end.
वनाभिलाव: वनाभिलाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Wood-destroying. E. वन, and अभिलाव destruction.
वनामल: वनामल m. (-लः) A fruit, (Carissa carondas.) E. वन wood, and आमल for आमलक myrobalan.
वनायु: वनायु m. (-युः) A country distinguished for its breed of horses; also वानायु.
वनायुज: वनायुज m. (-जः) A horse of the Vanāyu breed. E. वनायु a country, and ज born.
वनार्चक: वनार्च्चक m. (-कः) A flower-gatherer. E. वन a wood, अर्च्च to go, वुन् aff.
वनार्च्चक: वनार्च्चक m. (-कः) A flower-gatherer. E. वन a wood, अर्च्च to go, वुन् aff.
वनालिका: वनालिका f. (-का) A sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. वन a wood, अल to adorn, aff. वुन्, and fem. form.
वनाश्रय: वनाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Forest, forester, who or what is in a forest. m. (-यः) 1 A raven, or perhaps more properly a sort of crow. 2 Dwelling in a forest. E. वन a wood, and आश्रय abode.
वनाश्रित: वनाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Leading the life of a hermit, &c. E. वन, and आश्रित repaired to.
वनि: वनि m. (-निः) Fire or its deity. E. वन to worship, Uṇādi aff. इ.
वनिका: वनिका f. (-का) A woody place, a grove. E. वनी, and कन् added.
वनित: वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Solicited, begged. 2 Served. f. (-ता) 1 A woman in general. 2 A beloved woman, a wife, a mistress. E. वन to ask, aff. क्त.
वनिष्ठु: वनिष्ठु m. (-ष्ठुः) The entrails of an animal offered in sacrifice. E. वन to worship, इष्ठुच् Uṇādi aff.
वनीक: वनीक m. (-कः) A beggar; also वनीयक.
वनीयक: वनीयक n. (-कः) A beggar, a mendicant. E. वन to ask, इन् aff.; क्यच् and वुन् added; also य being changed to प, वनीपक.
वनेक्षुद्रा: वनेक्षुद्रा f. (-द्रा) A tree, commonly Karanja. E. वने in a wood, क्षुद्रा small.
वनेचर: वनेचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what inhabits a wood, forest, forester. m. (-रः) 1 A forester, one of a savage tribe inhabiting woods, a sylvan, a satyr. 2 An imp, a demon. E. वने in a forest, and चर who goes.
वनेचराग्र्य: वनेचराग्र्य m. (-ग्र्यः) An ascetic, an anchorite, a sage. E. वनेचर, and अग्र्य chief.
वनेशय: वनेशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in the woods. E. वने, शी to sleep, श aff.
वनैकदेश: वनैकदेश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket. E. वन, and एकदेश a part.
वनोत्साह: वनोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros. E. वन a wood, and उत्साह effort.
वनोद्देश: वनोद्देश m. (-शः) A part of a thicket. E. वन, and उद्देश direction.
वनोद्भव: वनोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in a forest. f. (-वा) Wild cotton. E. वन a wood, and उद्भव produced.
वनौकस्: वनौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A forester. 2 A monkey, an ape. E. वन wood, and ओकस् dwelling.
वन्दका: वन्दका f. (-का) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा the same, कन् aff.
वन्दथ: वन्दथ m. (-थः) 1 A panegyrist, a eulogist, a bard. 2 One deserving praise or eulogium. E. वन्द to praise, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
वन्दन: वन्दन n. (-नं) 1 The face or mouth. 2 Obeisance to a Brahman or superior by touching the feet, &c. f. (-नी) 1 Reverence, worship, adoring. 2 Begging, soliciting, asking. 3 The hip (?) 4 A drug for reviving the dead. f. (-ना) Praise, praising, especially the gods or great men. E. वदि to praise, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, fem. aff. ङीष् or टाप्.
वन्दनमाला: वन्दनमाला f. (-ला) The ornamented arch of a gate-way. E. वन्दन praising, and माला a garland; being hung with flowers on marriages and festival occasions.
वन्दनमालिका: वन्दनमालिका f. (-का) The ornamented arch of a gate-way. E. वन्दन praising, माला a garland, कन् aff. in the fem. form.
वन्दनीय: वन्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Praise-worthy, to be eulogised or praised. f. (-या) A yellow substance used as a pigment, said in the Tantras to be procured from the head of a cow: see रोचना. E. वदि to praise, अनीयर् aff.
वन्दा: वन्दा f. (-न्दा) 1 A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tessellatum, &c.) 2 Any parasite plant. 3 A female beggar. E. वदि to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
वन्दाका: वन्दाका f. (-का) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा, and कन् added.
वन्दार: वन्दार m. (-रः) A parasite plant. E. वन्दा the same, ऋ to go or be, aff. अच्.
वन्दारु: वन्दारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) 1 Civil, complimentary, polite. 2 Praising, celebrating. m. (-रुः) A panegyrist, a bard. E. वदि to praise, आरु aff.
वन्दि: वन्दि f. (-न्दिः-न्दी) 1 A captive, a prisoner, a man or beast confined. 2 A ladder or stairs. E. वदि to praise, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added.
वन्दिग्राह: वन्दिग्राह m. (-हः) A house-breaker, especially one who breaks into the place in which the sacred fire is preserved, into an armoury, or a temple. E. वन्दि captive, (what is confined or shut up,) and ग्राह who seizes; also वन्दिचौर, &c.
वन्दिचौर: वन्दिचौर m. (-रः) A thief, a house-breaker. E. वन्दि, and चौर thief; see the last.
वन्दिन्: वन्दिन् m. (-न्दी) 1 A panegyrist, a bard, a herald, a servant whose duty it is to proclaim the titles of a great man as he passes along, or a poet, who sings the praises of a prince in his presence, or accompanies an army, to chaunt martial songs: considered as one of a distinct tribe, he is the son of a Kṣatriya by a Śūdra female. 2 A praiser, a flatterer. E. वदि to praise, aff. इन्.
वन्दिपाठ: वन्दिपाठ m. (-ठः) A complimentary stanza, a panegyric, a eulogium, often improvisatore, recited by a bard, &c. E. वन्दि a bard, and पाठ reading.
वन्दीकार: वन्दीकार m. (-रः) A thief, a house-breaker.
वन्द्य: वन्द्य mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं) To be praised, commendable, laudable. f. (-न्द्या) A parasite plant. E. वदि to praise, यत् aff., or यक् Uṇādi aff.
वन्द्र: वन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A worshipper, a votary, a follower. E. वदि to praise, aff. रक.
वन्य: वन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Forest, savage, wild, produced in a wood, &c. f. (-न्या) 1 A multitude of groves. 2 A quantity of water, a flood, a deluge. 3 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. वन a wood, &c., यत् aff.
वन्र: वन्र m. (-त्रः) A copartner, a coheir, &c. E. वत to ask, and रन Uṇādi aff.
वप: वप(डु)डुवप r. 1st cl. (वपति) 1 To sow seed. 2 To procreate. 3 To shave. 4 To weave.

वप m. (-पः) 1 Shaving. 2 Sowing seed. 3 Weaving. f. (-पा) 1 The mucous or glutinous secretion of the flesh or bones; according to some, also the marrow of the bones. 2 Any hole or cavity. E. वप to sow seed, &c., aff. अच्.
वपन: वपन n. (-नं) 1 Sowing seed. 2 Shaving. 3 Semen virile. f. (-नी) A barber's shop. E. वप to shave, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
वपाकृत्: वपाकृत् m. (-कृत्) Marrow. E. वपा, and कृत what makes.
वपिल: वपिल m. (-लः) A father. E. वप to sow seed, (figuratively,) and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
वपुन: वपुन m. (-नः) A deity. n. (-नं) Knowledge. E. वप to sow, उवन् aff.
वपुष्मात्: वपुष्मात् mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) Having a body, corporeal, incarnate. E. वपुस्, and मतुप् aff.
वपुस्: वपुस् n. (-पुः) 1 The body. 2 A handsome form or figure. E. वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. उसि.
वप्तव्य: वप्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be sown. 2 To be given, conferred, implanted, &c. 3 To be immitted seminally, to be impregnated or begotten. E. वप to sow, तव्य aff.; also वपनीय, &c.
वप्तृ: वप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्ती-प्तृ) A sower, a planter, &c. m. (-प्ता) 1 A father, a progenitor. 2 A poet, a sage. E. वप to sow, aff. तृच्.
वप्र: वप्र mn. (-प्रः-प्रं) 1 A field. 2 A rampart, a mud wall, earth taken from the ditch of a town and raised as a wall or buttress, or as the foundation of a wall of masonry, &c. 3 The foundation of any building. 4 The gate of a fortified city. 5 A shore or bank. 6 Dust, earth. 7 A mound, a hillock. m. (-प्रः) A father. n. (-प्रं) Lead. f. (-प्री) A hillock, an ant-hill. E. वरु to sow, रन् Uṇādi aff.
वप्रक्रीडा: वप्रक्रीडा f. (-डा) Butting, as of an elephant or bull, &c. E. वप्र a mound, and कीडा sport.
वप्रानत: वप्रानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed or stooping to butt at a wall or bank. E. वप्र, and आनत bent.
वप्रान्तर: वप्रान्तर ind. In or between banks, mounds, &c. E. वप्र, and आन्तर् within.
वप्राभिघात: वप्राभिघात m. (-तः) Butting at a bank or mound. E. वप्र, and अभिघात striking.
वप्राम्भस्: वप्राम्भस् n. (-म्भः) The water near or along the bank. E. वप्र, and अम्भस water.
वप्रि: वप्रि m. (-प्रिः) A field. E. वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. क्रिन्.
वभ्र: वभ्र r. 1st cl. (-वभ्रति) To go; also वभ्र.
वम: वम(टु उ)टुवमु r. 1st cl. (वमति) To vomit, to eject from the mouth.
वम mf. (-मः-मी) Vomiting. E. वम to vomit, aff. अच्; also वमन and वमि.
वमथु: वमथु m. (-थुः) 1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth. 2 Water ejected from an elephant's trunk. E. वम to vomit, aff. अथुच्.
वमन: वमन n. (-नं) 1 Vomiting, ejecting any thing from the mouth. 2 Causing vomiting, an emetic. 3 Pain. 4 Offering oblations to fire. E. वम to vomit, aff. ल्युट्.
वमि: वमि f. (-मिः) 1 Vomiting, sickness. 2 An emetic. m. (-मिः) 1 A name of fire. 2 A rogue, a cheat. E. वम to vomit, aff. इन्.
वमित: वमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sickened, made to vomit. E. वम to be sick, causal v., क्त aff.
वमित्वा: वमित्वा ind. Having vomited or been sick. E. वम to be sick, क्त्वा aff.
वमिन्: वमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Vomiting, sick. E. वम to vomit, इनि aff.
वम्री: वम्री f. (-म्री) A small ant burrowing in trees; also वम्रा.
वम्रीकूट: वम्रीकूट n. (-टं) An ant-hill, a hillock. E. वम्री a sort of ant, कूट a heap.
वय: वय r. 1st cl. (वयते) To go or move.
वयःस्थ: वयःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Middle-aged, young, &c.: see वयस्थ.
वयस्: वयस् n. (-यः) 1 A bird. 2 Age, time of life. 3 Youth. E. वय to go, असुन् aff., or वी as substituted for अज to go, with the same aff.
वयस्क: वयस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Relating to age, aged. E. वयस्, and कन् aff.
वयस्थ: वयस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Young, in the prime of life. 2 Mature, middle-aged, past childhood, or from sixteen to seventy. m. (-स्थः) A friend, an associate, a cotemporary. f. (-स्था) 1 The moon plant, (Asclepias acida) 2 Emblic myrobalan, (Phyllanthus emblica.) 3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 4 Small cardamoms. 5 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 6 A medicinal root, commonly Kākolī. 7 A woman's female friend or companion, a confidante. 8 The silk-cotton tree. E. वयस् life, स्था to be or stay, aff. क, fem. aff. टाप्, the final of the former changed to Visarga, and that optionally rejected; hence, also वयःस्थ.
वयस्य: वयस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Aged, relating to age. m. (-स्यः) A friend, a cotemporary, an associate or companion. f. (-स्या) A woman's female friend or confidante. E. वयस् life, यत् aff.
वयुन: वयुन n. (-नं) A temple. E. वी substituted for अज to go, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
वयोगत: वयोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Aged, very old. E. वयस्, and गत gone.
वयोधस्: वयोधस् m. (-धाः) A young or middle-aged man. E. वयस् youth or manhood, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असि.
वयोधिक: वयोधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Very old. E. वयस्, and अधिक exceeding.
वर: वर r. 10th cl. (वरयति) To desire, to obtain, to covet or ask.

वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Eldest. m. (-रः) 1 A boon, a blessing, especially in the gift of a Brahman or deity. 2 Engaging, selecting, appointing. 3 Requesting, soliciting, especially prevailing on a person by intreaty to undertake any business. 4 Surrounding, encompassing. 5 A husband, a bridegroom. 6 A son-in-law. 7 A catamite. 8 A drug: see गुग्गुल. 9 Wish, desire. 10 A sparrow. n. adv. (वरं) or ind. (वरम) Better, preferable. n. (-रं) Saffron. f. (-रा) 1 The three myrobalans. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇuka. 3 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) f. (-री) 1 Asparagus racemosus. 2 A name of CHĀYĀ, wife of the sun. E. वृ to select, to cover, &c., aff. अप् or अच्; it is also derived from वृ, and is then written with an initial consonant: see वर; also वर to desire, aff. अच्.
वरक: वरक n. (-कं) 1 The cover or awning of a boat. 2 A wild kidneybean. 3 A towel, a wiper. E. वृ to cover, aff. वुन्.
वरक्रतु: वरक्रतु m. (-तुः) INDRA. E. वर best, क्रतु sacrifice.
वरचन्दन: वरचन्दन n. (-नं) 1 A dark sort of Sandal or Agallochum. 2 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.) E. वर best, चन्दन Sandal.
वरट: वरट m. (-टः) 1 A gander. 2 A man of a barbarous or foreign race. n. (-टं) Many-flowered jasmine. f. (-टः-टी) 1 A goose. 2 A wasp, &c. E. वृ to choose, aff. अटन्; fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
वरण: वरण n. (-णं) 1 Appointing, selecting, choosing. 2 Surrounding, inclosing. 3 Screening, covering. 4 Nourishing, supporting. m. (-णः) 1 An outer building, an enclosure, a wall of masonry, &c. raised on a mound of earth. 2 A causeway, a bridge. 3 A camel. 4 A tree, (Capparis trifoliata.) 5 Any tree. f. (-णा) A rivulet, running past the north of Benares, into the Ganges, now called the Berṇā. E. वृ to choose or appoint, aff. चयु.
वरणसी: वरणसी f. (-सी) The city Benares, more usually वाराणसी. E. वरणा a rivulet as above, and असि another running on the south of the city, deriv. irr.
वरणीय: वरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be applied to or solicited for a boon, &c. 2 To be selected. E. वर to ask as a boon, or वृ to choose, अनीयर् aff.
वरण्ड: वरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A portico. 2 Pimples on the face. 3 A multitude. 4 A heap of grass. 5 The string of a fish-hook. 6 A packet, a package. n. (-ण्डा) A small bird, (Turdus.) E. वृञ् to cover, &c., Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्.
वरण्डक: वरण्डक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Fearful, terrified. 2 Large, great. 3 Miserly, a miser. m. (-कः) 1 A howdah, a chair or canopy on the back of an elephant. 2 A wall. 3 Eruption or pimples on the face. 4 A ball, a globe. E. वरण्ड as above, and कन् added.
वरण्डालु: वरण्डालु m. (-लुः) The castor oil tree, (Ricinus communis.)
वरतनु: वरतनु f. (-नुः) An elegant woman. E. वर, and तनु body.
वरत्करी: वरत्करी f. (-री) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
वरत्रा: वरत्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 An elephant's or horse's leather girth. 2 A thong, a strip of leather. E. वृञ् to cover or surround, Uṇādi aff. अत्रन.
वरत्वच: वरत्वच m. (-चः) The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.) E. वर best, and त्वच् skin, the final vowel added.
वरद: वरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Granting a prayer, conferring a boon. 2 Propitious, favourable. m. (-दः) 1 A benefactor. 2 Fire for burnt-offerings of a propitiatory character. f. (-दा) A girl, a virgin. E. वर a blessing, &c., and द who gives.
वरदान: वरदान n. (-नं) 1 Granting a boon. 2 A place of pilgrimage. E. वर a blessing, and दान giving.
वरपर्णाख्य: वरपर्णाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
वरप्रद: वरप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring a boon. f. (-दा) The wife of the saint AGASTYA. E. वर a boon, and प्रद who gives.
वरप्रदान: वरप्रदान n. (-नं) Conferring a boon. E. वर, and प्रदान giving.
वरफल: वरफल m. (-लः) The cocoa-nut tree. E. वर best, and फल fruit.
वरमुखी: वरमुखी f. (-खी) Reṇukā, a sort of perfume.
वरम्: वरम् ind. Better, sooner, rather, preferable: see वर.
वरम्बरा: वरम्बरा f. (-रा) The nux vomica plant.
वरयितृ: वरयितृ m. (-ता) A husband. E. वर to choose, in the causal form, aff. तृच्.
वररुचि: वररुचि m. (-चिः) A poet and philosopher, one of the ornaments of the court of Bhoja, or one of the nine gems usually ascribed to VIKRAMĀDITYA'S court. E. वर pre-eminent, better, रुचि light or renown.
वरल: वरल mf. (-लः-ला or -ली) A wasp. f. (-ला) A goose. E. वर, and ला to take, aff. क.
वरवत्सला: वरवत्सला f. (-ला) The wife of a father-in-law. E. वर a bridegroom, and वत्सल affectionate.
वरवर्णिनी: वरवर्णिनी f. (-नी) 1 An excellent woman. 2 A virtuous woman. 3 A woman in general. 4 Turmeric. 5 Lāc. 6 A brownish yellow pigment; also रोचना and गोरोहना. 7 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 8 A name of GAURĪ. 9 SARASVATĪ. 10 LAKṢMĪ. E. वर best, बर्ण class or colour, aff. इनि and ङीष्.
वरवारण: वरवारण m. (-णः) A fine elephant. E. वर, and वारण an elephant.
वरवाह्लीक: वरवाह्लीक n. (-कं) Saffron. E. वर, and वाह्लीक the same.
वरवृद्ध: वरवृद्ध m. (-द्धः) ŚIVA. E. वर better, and वृद्ध old.
वराक: वराक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Low, vile, impure. 2 Poor, pitiable. m. (-कः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 War. E. वृ to cover, &c., षाकन् aff.
वराङ्ग: वराङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 The head. 2 A privity, a private part, male or female. 3 Cassia bark. 4 An elegant form or body. m. (-ङ्गः) An elephant. E. वर best, excellent, अङ्ग body or member.
वराङ्गक: वराङ्गक m. (-कः) Woody Cassia. E. कन् added to the preceding.
वराङ्गना: वराङ्गना f. (-ना) A lovely woman. E. वर best, अङ्गना a woman.
वराङ्गरूपोपेत: वराङ्गरूपोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Handsome and well-shaped. E. वराङ्ग excellent body, रूप form, and उपेत invested, possessing.
वराट: वराट n. (-टः) 1 A cord, a rope. 2 A Cowri: see the next.
वराटक: वराटक mfn. subst. (-टकः-टिका-टकं) 1 A rope, a cord, a string. 2 The small shell, called a Cowri, and used as a coin. 3 The seed-vessel of the lotus. m. (-टिका) The Nagesara plant. E. वृञ् to surround, aff. अटच्, and कन् added.
वराटकरजस्: वराटकरजस् m. (-जाः) A plant, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea).
वराण: वराण m. (-णः) 1 INDRA. 2 A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. वर best, and णी to obtain, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.
वराणसी: वराणसी f. (-सी) Benares. E. वर best, अनस् water, ङीप् aff., i. e. the Ganges, on whose bank the city is situated; also वाराणसी and वरणसी.
वरादन: वरादन n. (-नं) A sort of Mimusops, (M. Kauki, Rox.) E. वर best, अदन eating.
वराम्र: वराम्र m. (-म्रः) An acid fruit, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वर best, अम्र acid.
वरारक: वरारक n. (-कं) The diamond. E. वर best, ऋ to go or be, ण्वुल् aff.
वरारोह: वरारोह m. (-हः) 1 An elephant-driver. 2 Mounting, riding. 3 A rider on an elephant or horse. f. (-हा) 1 A handsome or elegant woman. 2 The hip or flank. E. वर excellent, आरोह mounting, &c.
वरालक: वरालक m. (-कः) The Caronda fruit, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वर best, अल to be equal to, वुन् aff.
वरालि: वरालि m. (-लिः) 1 The moon. 2 A division of music.
वरालिका: वरालिका f. (-का) A name of DURGĀ. E. वर best, supreme, आलि a female friend, कन् added.
वराशि: वराशि m. (-शिः) Coarse cloth. E. वर covering, अश to pervade, aff. इन्; also वरासि.
वरासन: वरासन n. (-नं) 1 A cistern, a reservoir. 2 The China rose. m. (-नः) 1 A whoremonger. 2 A door-keeper. E. वर best, &c., आसन seat.
वरासि: वरासि m. (-सिः) 1 Coarse cloth. 2 A swordsman. f. (-सी) Dirty clothes. E. वर covering, अस to be, aff. इन् and ङीप्.
वराह: वराह m. (-हः) 1 A hog. 2 A name of VIṢṆU in the third Avatāra or descent, in which he assumed the shape of a boar. 3 A mountain. 4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 5 A sort of measure. 6 One of the eighteen smaller Dvīpas or divisions of the universe. E. वर best, हन to injure, with आङ् prefix, and ड aff.
वराहकान्ता: वराहकान्ता f. (-न्ता) A sort of yam. E. वराह a hog, and कान्ता beloved; also वराही.
वराहक्रान्ता: वराहक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A plant, a sort of sensitive plant according to some authorities, but to others, a kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.:) it is also considered sometimes, but erroneously, as synonymous with वराही Dioscorea. E. वराह a hog, and क्रान्त passing.
वराहनामन्: वराहनामन् m. (-मा) An esculent root: see वाराही. E. वराह a hog, and नामन् a name.
वरिवसित: वरिवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, honoured, adored, as a deity or spiritual teacher. E. वरिवस्या service, इतच् aff., and य optionally rejected.
वरिवस्या: वरिवस्या f. (-स्या) Service, honour, especially such devoted obedience as a pupil pays his spiritual preceptor. E. वरिवस indeclinable, here said to imply veneration, and क्याच् aff.
वरिवस्यित: वरिवस्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Served, adored. E. वरिवस्या as above, and इतच् aff.
वरिशी: वरिशी f. (-शी) A fish-hook. E. see वडिशी, ड, and र being interchanged.
वरिष: वरिष n. (-षं) A year. m. plu. (-षाः) The rains or rainy season. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. इषन्.
वरिषाप्रिय: वरिषाप्रिय m. (-यः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वरिषा the rainy season, and प्रिय fond of; being supposed to drink rain water only.
वरिष्ठ: वरिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Largest, greatest, most large. 2 Heaviest, mightiest. 3 Best, dearest, most preferable or beloved. n. (-ष्ठं) 1 Copper. 2 Pepper. m. (-ष्ठः) The Francoline partridge. E. वर् substituted for उरु large, or वरु best, and इष्ठन्. affix of the irr. superlative.
वरीयस्: वरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Very large, largest, most large. 2 Best, most preferable or excellent. 3 Extremely young, tender, infantine. m. (-यान्) The eighteenth of the astronomical periods called Yogas. E. वर best, or substituted for उरु, and इयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
वरीवर्द: वरीवर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) An ox or bull. E. see वलीवर्द्द, ब and ल being changed to व and र; also वलीवर्द्द.
वरीवर्द्द: वरीवर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) An ox or bull. E. see वलीवर्द्द, ब and ल being changed to व and र; also वलीवर्द्द.
वरीषु: वरीषु m. (-षुः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. वृ to choose, ईषुन् aff.
वरुण: वरुण m. (-णः) 1 VARUṆA, the deity of the waters and regent of the west. 2 Water or the ocean. 3 A tree, (Tapia cratoeva, or Capparis trifoliata.) 4 A name of the sun, or rather of one of the twelve forms of that luminary, or Ādityas. E. वृ to enclose (the earth), or वृ to select or prefer, being chosen by the gods for his office, and उनन् Uṇādi aff.
वरुणात्मजा: वरुणात्मजा f. (-जा) Spirituous liquor. E. वरुण VARUṆA or the ocean personified, and आत्मजा daughter; being amongst the precious things produced at the churning of the ocean.
वरुणानी: वरुणानी f. (-नी) The wife of VARUṆA. E. वरुण, with ङीप् aff. and आनुक् augment.
वरुत्र: वरुत्र n. (-त्रं) An upper and outer garment. E. वृ to cover, उत्र Uṇādi aff.
वरूथ: वरूथ m. (-थः) A sort of wooden fender or ledge round a carriage, as a defence from the effects of collision. n. (-थं) 1 Armour, mail. 2 Leather, skin. 3 A house or dwelling. E. वृ to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊथन्.
वरूथिन्: वरूथिन् m. (-थी) 1 A guard, a defender. 2 A car. f. (-नी) An army. E. वरूथ part of a car, इनि and ङीप् affs.
वरेण्य: वरेण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Chief, principal, pre-eminent. E. वृ to select, Uṇādi aff. एण्य.
वरेन्द्र: वरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A chief, a sovereign. 2 INDRA. f. (-न्द्री) Ancient Gaur, the capital and district so named. E. वर best, इन्द्र chief, and with ङीप् aff.; the favorite country of the deity, &c.
वरेश्वर: वरेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. E. वर best, principal, ईश्वर lord.
वरोट: वरोट m. (-टः) A plant, commonly Marüa.
वरोल: वरोल mf. (-लः-ली) A wasp. E. वृ to cover, ओलच् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्; the fem. form may also mean, a smaller kind of wasp.
वर्कर: वर्कर mf. (-रः-री) Any young animal. m. (-रः) 1 A lamb. 2 A goat. 3 Pleasure, pastime, sport, mirth, festivity. E. वृक to take, aff. अरन्.
वर्कराट: वर्कराट m. (-टः) 1 A side glance, a wink, a leer. 2 The rays of the meridian sun. mn. (-टः-टं) The marks of a lover's finger nails on the bosom of a woman. E. वर्कर a young animal, अट to be or resemble, aff. अच्.
वर्कुट: वर्कुट m. (-टः) A pin, a bolt.
वर्ग: वर्ग n. (-र्गः) A class, a tribe, a multitude of similar things, whether animate or inanimate; as Ka-verga, the class of guttural letters; Tri-verga, a class of three (objects, as love, duty, and wealth); the Śūdra-varga, the Śūdra tribe. 2 A chapter, a book, a section. 3 A square number, (in arithmetic.) E. वृज to quit, to except (any thing else), aff. घञ्.
वर्गघन: वर्गघन n. (-नं) The square of a cube. E. वर्ग, and घन a cube.
वर्गमूल: वर्गमूल n. (-लं) A square root. E. वर्ग, and मूल a root.
वर्गीय: वर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to a class, a tribe, &c. E. वर्ग, and छ aff.
वर्च: वर्च्च r. 1st cl. (वर्च्चते) To shine. r. 10th cl. (वर्च्चयति) 1 To cut. 2 To fill.
वर्च्च: वर्च्च r. 1st cl. (वर्च्चते) To shine. r. 10th cl. (वर्च्चयति) 1 To cut. 2 To fill.
वर्चटी: वर्च्चटी f. (-टी) 1 A kind of rice. 2 A harlot.
वर्च्चटी: वर्च्चटी f. (-टी) 1 A kind of rice. 2 A harlot.
वर्चस्: वर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) 1 Form, figure, shape. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Ordure, fæces. m. (-र्च्चाः) The son of CANDRA. E. वर्च्च to shine, असुन् aff.
वर्च्चस्: वर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) 1 Form, figure, shape. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Ordure, fæces. m. (-र्च्चाः) The son of CANDRA. E. वर्च्च to shine, असुन् aff.
वर्चस्क: वर्च्चस्क mn. (-स्कः-स्कं) Fæces, excrement. E. वर्च to shine, असुन् aff., and कन् depreciative aff. added.
वर्च्चस्क: वर्च्चस्क mn. (-स्कः-स्कं) Fæces, excrement. E. वर्च to shine, असुन् aff., and कन् depreciative aff. added.
वर्चस्विन्: वर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Bright, glorious. E. वर्च्चस, and विन् aff.
वर्च्चस्विन्: वर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) Bright, glorious. E. वर्च्चस, and विन् aff.
वर्ज: वर्ज्ज mfn. (-र्ज्जः-र्ज्जा-र्ज्जं) 1 Free from, devoid of. 2 Excepted. m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 2 Excepting. E. वृज to abandon, aff. अच्.
वर्ज्ज: वर्ज्ज mfn. (-र्ज्जः-र्ज्जा-र्ज्जं) 1 Free from, devoid of. 2 Excepted. m. (-र्ज्जः) 1 Leaving, abandoning. 2 Excepting. E. वृज to abandon, aff. अच्.
वर्जक: वर्ज्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what leaves, shuns, excepts, &c. E. वृज to quit, ण्वुल् aff.
वर्ज्जक: वर्ज्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what leaves, shuns, excepts, &c. E. वृज to quit, ण्वुल् aff.
वर्जन: वर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, abandonment, shunning, avoiding. 2 Injury, hurting. 3 Killing. E. वृज to abandon, aff. ल्युट्.
वर्ज्जन: वर्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Quitting, abandonment, shunning, avoiding. 2 Injury, hurting. 3 Killing. E. वृज to abandon, aff. ल्युट्.
वर्जयित्वा: वर्ज्जयित्वा ind. 1 Having shunned or avoided. 2 Having omitted, excepting, leaving out. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त्वा.
वर्ज्जयित्वा: वर्ज्जयित्वा ind. 1 Having shunned or avoided. 2 Having omitted, excepting, leaving out. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त्वा.
वर्जित: वर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abandoned, avoided. 2 Given. 3 Excluded, excepted. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त.
वर्ज्जित: वर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abandoned, avoided. 2 Given. 3 Excluded, excepted. E. वृज to quit, aff. क्त.
वर्जनीय: वर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Improper, censurable, wicked, proper to be avoided. 2 Irregular, to be excepted. E. वृज to quit, and अनीयर् aff. of the future participle.
वर्ज्जनीय: वर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Improper, censurable, wicked, proper to be avoided. 2 Irregular, to be excepted. E. वृज to quit, and अनीयर् aff. of the future participle.
वर्ज्ज्य: वर्ज्ज्य mfn. (-र्ज्ज्यः-र्ज्ज्या-र्ज्ज्यं) 1 To be shunned. 2 To be excepted, excluded, left out. n. (-र्ज्ज्यं) A point in each lunar mansion during the passage of the moon, in which no business should be begun. E. वृज to quit, यत् aff.
वर्ण: वर्ण r. 10th cl. (वर्णयति) 1 To colour, to paint, to dye. 2 To send or cast, to direct, to order. 3 To praise, to extol, to proclaim qualities. 4 To describe. 5 To spread or extend. 6 To grind or pound. 7 To make exertions. 8 To shine.

वर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A tribe, a class, a caste, an order. 2 Colour, hue, tint. 3 Coloured cloth thrown over the back of an elephant, an elephant's housings. 4 Quality, property. 5 Fame, celebrity. 6 Praise. 7 Gold. 8 Religious observance. 9 The order or arrangement of a song or poem. 10 A musical mode. 11 Staining the body with coloured unguents. 12 Beauty, lustre. 13 Theatrical dress or embellishment. mn. (-र्णः-र्णं) 1 Perfume for the person. 2 A letter of the alphabet. 3 Form, figure. 4 Sort, kind. 5 Touch, the purity of gold, as ascertained by its streak on the touch-stone. 6 In arithmetic, a co-efficient. n. (-र्णं) Saffron. f. (-र्णा) A leguminous shrub, (Cytisus cajan.) E. वर्ण to paint, &c., aff. अच् or घञ्, or वृ to cover or screen, Uṇādi aff. नक्.
वर्णक: वर्णक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 Perfume for the person, especially pounded or ground. 2 Sandal. mf. (-कः-का) A paint, a pigment, as indigo, orpiment, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A panegyrist, a bard, a poetical encomiast, by tribe and profession. 2 A circle, an orb. f. (-का) Touch, standard, fineness or purity of gold. E. वण to colour, &c., ण्वुल् aff., or वर्ण as above, कन् added.
वर्णकवि: वर्णकवि m. (-विः) The son of KUVERA. E. वर्ण praise, and कवि a bard.
वर्णकूपिका: वर्णकूपिका f. (-का) An ink-stand. E. वर्ण a letter, and कूप a well, कन् aff. of comparison, in the fem. form.
वर्णक्रम: वर्णक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Order of caste or tribe. 2 Alphabetical arrangement, the alphabet. E. वर्ण, and क्रम course.
वर्णगत: वर्णगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Coloured. 2 Described. 3 Algebraic. E. वर्ण, and गत gone to.
वर्णचारक: वर्णचारक m. (-कः) A painter. E. वर्ण colour, चर to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
वर्णज्येष्ठ: वर्णज्येष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman. E. वर्ण caste, ज्येष्ठ elder.
वर्णतस्: वर्णतस् ind. By or with colour, &c. E. वर्ण colour, and तसि aff.
वर्णतूलि: वर्णतूलि mf. (-लिः-ली) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, and तूलि a brush; also with कन् added, वर्णतूलिका f. (-का.)
वर्णद: वर्णद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Dying, colouring. 2 Giving tribe, &c. m. (-दः) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. वर्ण, and द who or what gives.
वर्णदातृ: वर्णदातृ m. (-ता) Turmeric. E. वर्ण, and दातृ what gives.
वर्णदूत: वर्णदूत m. (-त) A letter, an epistle. E. वर्ण a letter of the alphabet, &c., and टूत sent.
वर्णदूषक: वर्णदूषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Disturbing or violating the distinctions of caste. E. वर्ण, and टूषक what violates.
वर्णधर्म: वर्णधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The particular occupation or duty of each caste or tribe. E. वर्ण a tribe, धर्म्म virtue, moral merit.
वर्णधर्म्म: वर्णधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The particular occupation or duty of each caste or tribe. E. वर्ण a tribe, धर्म्म virtue, moral merit.
वर्णन: वर्णन n. (-नं) Describing, expatiating, explaining, pointing out qualities or excellencies, &c. 2 Colouring, painting, writing. f. (-ना) Praise, panegyric. E. वर्ण to colour, युच् and टाप् aff.
वर्णनीय: वर्णनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be described, delineated, praised, &c. E. वर्ण to colour, अनीयर् aff.
वर्णपत्र: वर्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) A pallet, a leaf, &c. on which a painter mixes his colours. E. वर्ण a colour, and पत्र a leaf.
वर्णमातृ: वर्णमातृ f. (-ता) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, and मातृ mother.
वर्णमातृका: वर्णमातृका f. (-का) SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech and eloquence. E. वर्ण a letter, and मातृका divine parent.
वर्णमाला: वर्णमाला f. (-ला) The alphabet. E. वर्ण a letter, माला a garland.
वर्णरेखा: वर्णरेखा f. (-खा) A white aluminous fossil often confounded with chalk, of which it is considered a species. E. वर्ण colour, रेखा a line.
वर्णलेखा: वर्णलेखा f. (-खा) Chalk. E. वर्ण colour, लेखा a line.
वर्णवत्: वर्णवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having tribe, colour, &c. f. (-वती) Turmeric. E. वर्ण colour, मतुप् aff.
वर्णविलोडक: वर्णविलोडक m. (-कः) 1 A plagiarist. 2 A house-breaker. E. वर्ण praise, and वि before लोड to be mad, aff. ण्वुल्.
वर्णवृत्त: वर्णवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Metre regulated by the number of syllables. E. वर्ण, and वृत्त metre.
वर्णश्रेष्ठ: वर्णश्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Of a good tribe, caste, kind, &c. m. (-ष्ठः) A Brahman. E. वर्ण, and श्रेष्ठ best.
वर्णसंहार: वर्णसंहार m. (-रः) An assemblage or mixture of the four tribes. E. वर्ण, and संहार assemblage.
वर्णसङ्कर: वर्णसङ्कर m. (-रः) 1 Mixture or confusion of castes. 2 A man or tribe of mixed origin, or from a father and mother of different castes. E. वर्ण, and सङ्कर mixture.
वर्णसङ्घाट: वर्णसङ्घाट m. (-टः) An alphabet or assemblage of letters. E. वर्ण, हन to kill, with सम् prefixed, and घञ् aff., and घट substituted for the radical letters; also with घत, वर्णसङ्घात.
वर्णसङ्घात: वर्णसङ्घात m. (-तः) The alphabet: see the last.
वर्णसि: वर्णसि m. (-सिः) Water. E. वृ to surround, असि Uṇādi aff., and नुक् augment.
वर्णहीन: वर्णहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Outcaste. E. वर्ण, and हीन void of.
वर्णाङ्का: वर्णाङ्का f. (-ङ्का) A pen. E. वर्ण a letter, अकि to go, aff. अच्.
वर्णाट: वर्णाट m. (-टः) 1 A singer. 2 A painter. 3 An actor, a mime. E. वर्ण colour, &c., अट to go or be, aff. अच्.
वर्णात्मन्: वर्णात्मन् m. (-त्मा) A word. E. वर्ण a letter, and आत्मन् the soul or essence.
वर्णापसद: वर्णापसद m. (-दः) An outcaste. E. वर्ण, and अपसद who is or goes out from.
वर्णापेत: वर्णापेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Degraded, outcaste. E. वर्ण, and अपेत devoid of.
वर्णाश्रम: वर्णाश्रम n. (-मं) The class and state of a person. E. वर्ण, and आश्रम order.
वर्णाश्रमधर्म: वर्णाश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duties of tribe and order. E. वर्णाश्रम, and धर्म्म duty.
वर्णाश्रमधर्म्म: वर्णाश्रमधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duties of tribe and order. E. वर्णाश्रम, and धर्म्म duty.
वर्णि: वर्णि n. (-र्णि) Gold. E. वर्ण to colour, &c., Uṇādi aff. इन्.
वर्णिक: वर्णिक m. (-कः) A writer, a scribe, a secretary, &c. f. (-का) 1 A pen. 2 Ink. E. वर्ण a letter, aff. ठक्.
वर्णित: वर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Praised, eulogised, extolled. 2 Described, explained. 3 Painted. E. वर्ण to praise, aff. क्त.
वर्णितवत्: वर्णितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Relating, describing, was relating or related, &c. E. वर्ण to describe, क्तवतु aff.
वर्णिन्: वर्णिन् mfn. (-र्णी-र्णिनी-र्णि) Belonging to a caste or tribe, of that caste, &c. m. (-र्णी) 1 A painter. 2 A scribe, a writer. 3 A religious student. 4 A man of either of the four regular castes. f. (-र्णिनी) 1 A woman, a wife. 2 Turmeric. E. वर्ण colour, &c., इनि aff.
वर्णिबध: वर्णिबध m. (-धः) Killing or occasioning the death of a man of either of four castes. E. वर्णिन्, and बध killing.
वर्णिलिङ्गिन्: वर्णिलिङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) An ascetic, or one wearing the marks of a religious student. E. वर्णिन्, and लिङ्गिन् having a mark.
वर्णु: वर्णु m. (-र्णुः) The name of a river and district. E. वृ to surround, Uṇādi aff. णु.
वर्णोपेत: वर्णोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having caste, tribe, &c. E. वर्ण, and उपेत possessed of.
वर्तक: वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who is or abides, exists, lives, &c. mf. (-कः-का) 1 A sort of quail, (Perdix olivacea.) 2 A horse's hoof. n. (-कं) A sort of mixed or bell-metal, commonly Vidri. E. वृत to be, वुन् aff.
वर्त्तक: वर्त्तक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who is or abides, exists, lives, &c. mf. (-कः-का) 1 A sort of quail, (Perdix olivacea.) 2 A horse's hoof. n. (-कं) A sort of mixed or bell-metal, commonly Vidri. E. वृत to be, वुन् aff.
वर्तजन्मन्: वर्त्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A cloud. E. वृत to be, aff. घञ्, वर्त्त abiding, and जन्मन् birth.
वर्त्तजन्मन्: वर्त्तजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A cloud. E. वृत to be, aff. घञ्, वर्त्त abiding, and जन्मन् birth.
वर्तन: वर्त्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fixed, stationary, stable. nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Staying, abiding, being, the property of a fixed presence. 2 A road, a way. 3 A ball at one end of a spindle to assist its rotatory motion. 4 Grinding. n. (-नं) 1 Livelihood, subsistence. 2 Occupation, profession. 3 Salary, hire, wages. 4 A ball of cotton from which the threads are spun. 5 A ball, a globe. 6 Appointing. 7 Turning. m. (-नः) A dwarf. E. वृत to be, to be fixed, &c, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
वर्त्तन: वर्त्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fixed, stationary, stable. nf. (-नं-नी) 1 Staying, abiding, being, the property of a fixed presence. 2 A road, a way. 3 A ball at one end of a spindle to assist its rotatory motion. 4 Grinding. n. (-नं) 1 Livelihood, subsistence. 2 Occupation, profession. 3 Salary, hire, wages. 4 A ball of cotton from which the threads are spun. 5 A ball, a globe. 6 Appointing. 7 Turning. m. (-नः) A dwarf. E. वृत to be, to be fixed, &c, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

वर्षाघोष: वर्षाघोष m. (-षः) A frog. E. mfn. वर्षा, and घोष sound.
वर्षाप्रभञ्जन: वर्षाप्रभञ्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Rain-scattering. m. (-नः) A high wind, a gale. E. वर्षा, and प्रभञ्जन scattering.
वर्षाभू: वर्षाभू m. (-भूः) A frog. f. (-भ्वी) 1 Hog-weed. 2 An earth-worm, (Iulus.) 3 A she frog or any small frog. E. वर्षा the rains, भू to be, aff. क्विप्.
वर्षामद: वर्षामद m. (-दः) A peacock. E. वर्ष the rains, आमद who rejoices.
वर्षाम्भःपारणाव्रत: वर्षाम्भःपारणाव्रत m. (-तः) A Cātaka. E. वर्षाम्भस् rain water, पारणा attention, and व्रत observance.
वर्षायुत: वर्षायुत n. (-तं) Ten thousand years. E. वर्ष, and अयुत ten thousand.
वर्षारात्र: वर्षारात्र m. (-त्रः) A rainy night. E. वर्षा, and रात्रि night.
वर्षार्चिस्: वर्षार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet MARS. E. वर्षा the rains, अर्च्चिस् light, visible in the rainy season.
वर्षार्च्चिस्: वर्षार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet MARS. E. वर्षा the rains, अर्च्चिस् light, visible in the rainy season.
वर्षालङ्कायिका: वर्षालङ्कायिका f. (-का) A plant: see पृक्का. E. वर्ष, and लङ्कायिक synonymous; conjoined.
वर्षावसान: वर्षावसान m. (-नः) Autumn, the autumnal season. E. वर्षा the rains, and अवसान end.
वर्षिक: वर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Raining, rainy, relating or belonging to the rains. 2 Shedding, showering, pouring down. n. (-कं) Aloe wood or Agallochum. E. वर्ष, and ठक् aff.
वर्षिन्: वर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 1 Raining. 2 Sprinkling. E. वृष to sprinkle, घिनुण् aff.
वर्षिष्ठ: वर्षिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Oldest, very old. E. वर्ष substituted for वृद्घ old, and इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
वर्षीयस्: वर्षीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very aged, or old. E. वर्ष substituted for वृद्ध old, and इयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
वर्षुक: वर्षुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Rainy, watery. E. वृष to sprinkle, and उकञ् aff.
वर्षुकाब्द: वर्षुकाब्द m. (-ब्दः) A rainy cloud. E. वर्षुक rainy, and अब्द a cloud.
वर्षेज: वर्षेज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced in the rains. E. वर्षे in the rains, and ज born.
वर्षैक: वर्षैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Yearly, annual. E. वर्ष, and एक one.
वर्षोपल: वर्षोपल m. (-लः) Hail. E. वर्ष rain, and उपल a stone.
वर्ष्म: वर्ष्म n. (-र्ष्मं) The body: see the next.
वर्ष्मन्: वर्ष्मन् n. (-र्ष्म) 1 The body. 2 Measure. 3 Height, elevation. 4 A handsome form. E. वृष to sprinkle, aff. मनिन्; also with a final vowel वर्ष्म.
वर्ष्य: वर्ष्य mfn. (-र्ष्यः-र्ष्या-र्ष्यं) 1 To be rained or showered. 2 To be sprinkled. E. वृष to sprinkle, ण्यत् aff.
वर्ह: वर्ह r. 1st cl. (वर्हते) r. 10th cl. (वर्हयति) 1 To speak or tell. 2 To kill or hurt. r. 1st cl. (वर्हते) 1 To cover. 2 To be excellent or pre-eminent: in this sense it is more properly वर्ह. r. 10th cl. (वर्हयति) To shine.

वर्ह n. (-र्हं) 1 A peacock's tail. 2 A leaf. 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. 4 Train, retinue. E. वृह to increase, aff. अच्; also वर्ह or बर्ह to cover, &c. aff. अच्; in the latter case it is written बर्ह.
वर्हण: वर्हण n. (-णं) A leaf. E. वृह to grow, aff. ल्युट्.
वर्हभार: वर्हभार m. (-रः) A tuft of peacock's feathers at the shaft of a lance or handle of a club. E. वर्ह, and भार load.
वर्हिःपुष्प: वर्हिःपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Ganṭhiāla, a sort of vegetable perfume. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and पुष्प flower, having a similar blossom.
वर्हिःशुष्मन्: वर्हिःशुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) A name of fire or AGNI. E. वर्हिम् Kuśa grass, शुष to dry, aff. मनिन्.
वर्हिःष्ठ: वर्हिःष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A perfume, commonly Bāla. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and स्था to be, aff. क, growing in the same places: the Visarga of वर्हिस् optionally retained; also वर्हिष्ठ.
वर्हिण: वर्हिण m. (-णः) A peacock. E. वर्ह a peacock's tail, and इनच् aff.
वर्हिणवाहन: वर्हिणवाहन m. (-नः) The deity Kārttikeya. E. वर्हिण a peacock, and वाहन a vehicle; mounted on that bird.
वर्हिध्वजा: वर्हिध्वजा f. (-जा) A name of the goddess CAṆḌĪ. E. वर्हि for वर्ही a peacock, and ध्वज an emblem.
वर्हिन्: वर्हिन् m. (-र्ही) A peacock. E. वर्ह a peacock's tail, and इनि possessive aff.
वर्हिपुष्प: वर्हिपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) A vegetable perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. E. वर्हि a peacock, and पुष्प flower; also वर्हिःपुष्प.
वर्हिर्ज्योतिस्: वर्हिर्ज्योतिस् m. (-तिः) A name of fire. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and ज्योतिस् light.
वर्हिर्मुख: वर्हिर्मुख m. (-खः) A deity, a divinity. E. वर्हिस् fire, and मुख mouth; most offerings passing through fire.
वर्हिश्शुष्मन्: वर्हिश्शुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Fire. E. वर्हिस् an oblation, शुष्मन् who dries up.
वर्हिषट्: वर्हिषट् m. (-षत् or -षट्) A Pitṛ or progenitor of a particular class. E. वर्हिष् Kuśa grass, अट् to eat, क्विप् aff.
वर्हिष्केश: वर्हिष्केश m. (-शः) AGNI or fire. E. वर्हिम् light, and केश hair.
वर्हिष्ठ: वर्हिष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) 1 A perfume, commonly Bāla, perhaps a species of Andropogon. 2 The resin of the Pinus longifolia. E. वर्हिस् Kuśa grass, and स्था to stay, aff. क, the final of वर्हिस् changed to Visarga, and optionally rejected; see वर्हिःष्ठ.
वर्हिष्मत्: वर्हिष्मत् mfn. (-ष्मन्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्) 1 Having Kuśa or sacrificial grass. 2 Having fire or light, blazing, shining. E. वर्हिस्, and मतुप् aff.
वर्हिस्: वर्हिस् m. (-र्हिः) 1 Fire. 2 Light, lustre, splendour. mn. (-हिः) 1 Sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.) 2 Sacrifice, oblation. 2 Ganṭhiāla, a vegetable perfume. E. वृह to increase, aff. इसि, or वर्ह to excel, &c., with the same aff.; in the latter case this word and its corresponding ones are written with an initial consonant बर्हिस्, &c.
वल: वल r. 1st cl. (वलते) 1 To cover. 2 To move. 3 To surround or enclose. r. 10th cl. (वालयति) To cherish or maintain.
वल n. (-लं) An army, forces. E. वल to surround, aff. अच्; see बल.
वलक्ष: वलक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) White. m. (-क्षः) White, the colour. E. वल to go, aff. क्विप्; वल् going, अक्ष to pervade, aff. अच्; also बलक्ष, and अवलक्ष.
वलक्षगु: वलक्षगु m. (-गुः) The moon. E. वलक्ष white, गौ a ray of light, the final vowel changed.
वलग्न: वलग्न mn. (-ग्नः-ग्नं) The middle; also अवलग्न.
वलभि: वलभि mf. (-भिः-भी) 1 The wooden frame of a thatch. 2 A turret or temporary building on the roof of a house. E. वल to cover, अभस् aff., इन् and ङीष् added; also वडभि.
वलम्ब: वलम्ब m. (-म्बः) A perpendicular. E. अव, and लवि to depend, घञ् aff., the initial rejected; also अवलम्ब.
वलय: वलय mn. (-यः-यं) A bracelet, an armlet. m. (-यः) 1 Sore throat, inflammation of the larynx, &c. 2 A boundary, an inclosure. E. वल to surround, कयन् Uṇādi aff.
वलयित: वलयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, encompassed. E. वलय an inclosure, aff. इतच्.
वलाका: वलाका f. (-का-की) A small kind of crane. E. वल to surround, aff. आकन्; also बलाका.
वलासक: वलासक m. (-कः) The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 2 A frog.
वलाहक: वलाहक m. (-कः) 1 A cloud. 2 A mountain. 3 A Daitya, a demon. 4 One of the Nāgas. 5 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA'S car. E. वलाका a crane, हा to go, aff. नु, deriv. irr.
वलि: वलि f. (-लिः) 1 A line or streak made with fragrant unguents on the person. 2 Natural line or folds of skin, a wrinkle. 3 Offerings to the spirits of air. E. वल to surround, aff. इन्; see बलि.
वलिक: वलिक mn. (-कः-कं) The edge of a thatch. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. इकक्.
वलिक्रिया: वलिक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Making lines on the person. 2 Making offerrings to all beings. E. वलि, and क्रिया act; see बलि, &c.
वलित: वलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Moved, constrained. 2 Surrounded. E. वल to go, क्त aff.
वलिश: वलिश nf. (-शं-शिः or -शी) A fish-hook. E. वटिन् a bait, शो to destroy, aff. ड, ट changed to ड, and ड again interchangeable with ल.
वलूक: वलूक n. (-कं) The root of the lotus. m. (-कः) A bird. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. ऊक.
