वल्क: वल्क n. (-ल्कं) 1 The bark of a tree. 2 The scales of a fish. E. वल to surround, कक् Uṇādi aff.
वल्कल: वल्कल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 The bark of a tree. 2 A garment made of bark. E. वल to surround, कलच् aff.
वल्कवत्: वल्कवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having scales or bark, wearing a dress made of the bark of trees, &c. m. (-वान्) A fish. E. वल्क a scale, &c., मतुप् possess. aff.
वल्किल: वल्किल m. (-लः) A thorn. E. वल्क bark, इलच् aff.
वल्कुत: वल्कुत n. (-तं) Bark, rind. E. वल to surround, कुतच् aff.
वल्ग: वल्ग r. 1st cl. (वल्गति) 1 To go or move. 2 To go by leaps, to jump.
वल्गत्: वल्गत् mfn. (-ल्गन्-ल्गान्ती-ल्गत्) 1 Going. 2 Jumping. E. वल्ग to go, शतृ aff.
वल्गा: वल्गा f. (-ल्गा) A bridle, a rein. E. वल्ग to go, aff. अच्.
वल्गित: वल्गित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Leaped, jumped, gone by bounds or leaps. n. (-तं) 1 Running. 2 A horse's gallop. E. वल्ग to go by jumps, aff. क्त.
वल्गु: वल्गु mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) Handsome, beautiful. m. (-ल्गुः) A goat. E. वल to surround, Uṇādi aff. उ, and गुक् augment.
वल्गुक: वल्गुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Handsome, beautiful. n. (-कं) 1 Sandal. 2 A wood. 3 Price. E. कन् added to the preceding.
वल्गुपत्र: वल्गुपत्र m. (-त्रः) A wild sort of pulse; see वनमुद्र.
वल्गुल: वल्गुल m. (-लः) The flying fox. f. (-ला) A sort of bird.
वल्गूयत्: वल्गूयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Become handsome or beautiful. E. वल्गु used as a verb, शतृ aff.
वल्भन: वल्भन n. (-नं) 1 Eating. 2 Food. E. वल्भ to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
वल्भित: वल्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Eaten. E. वल्भ to eat, aff. क्त.
वल्मिक: वल्मिक m. (-कः) An ant-hill; also वल्भीक.
वल्मिकि: वल्मिकि m. (-किः) An ant-hill; also वल्भीकि.
वल्मीक: वल्मीक mn. (-कः-कं) A hillock, ground thrown up by moles, &c., but especially the large accumulations of soil, sometimes made by the white ant. m. (-कः) 1 The poet VĀLMĪKI. 2 Elephantiasis, or swellings of the neck, chest, hands and feet, which break and discharge ichor in many places. E. बल to cover, or बल to live, कीकच् Uṇādi aff., and मुम् augment; in the latter case this word and the corresponding ones are written बल्भीक, &c.; also वल्मिक, वल्मीकि.
वल्युल: वल्युल and वल्यूल r. 10th cl. (वल्यूलयति) 1 To cut 2 To purify.
वल्ल: वल्ल r. 1st cl. (वल्लते) 1 To cover. 2 To move.
वल्ल m. (-ल्लः) 1 Winnowing corn. 2 A Māṣa of silver. 3 A weight of three Rattis. 4 Prohibiting, prohibition. 5 Covering. E. वल्ल to move, &c., अच् aff.
वल्लकी: वल्लकी f. (-की) The Vīṇā, or Indian lute. E. वल्ल to cover, aff. क्वुन्.
वल्लभ: वल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Beloved, desired, dear. 2 Supreme, superintending. m. (-भः) 1 A lover, a husband, a friend. 2 A horse with good marks. 3 A superintendant, an overseer. 4 The chief herdsman. f. (-भा) A mistress, a wife. E. वल्ल to cover, अभच् Uṇādi aff.
वल्लभपालक: वल्लभपालक m. (-कः) A groom, a horse-keeper. E. वल्लभ a good horse, and पालक who cherishes.
वल्लरि: वल्लरि f. (-रिः or -री) 1 A compound pedicle. 2 A creeping or twining plant. E. वल्ल to cover, अरन् aff.
वल्लव: वल्लव m. (-वः) 1 A cook. 2 A herdsman. 3 A name of BHĪMASENA. f. (-वी) A cowherdess. E. वल्ल covering, and व aff.
वल्लि: वल्लि f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली) 1 A creeper, a climbing or creeping plant. f. (-ल्लिः) The earth. f. (-ल्ली) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.) E. वल्ल to cover, इन् aff., and ङीप् occasionally added.
वल्लीज: वल्लीज n. (-जं) Pepper. E. वल्ली a creeper, and ज born.
वल्लुर: वल्लुर n. (-रं) 1 An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creeping plants. 2 An uncultivated field or place overrun with wild grass. 3 A sand, a desart, a place destitute of water. 4 A field. 5 A compound pedicle. 6 A solitude, a wild. 7 A thicket, a wood. E. वल्ल to cover, उर aff.; also बल्लूर.
वल्लूर: वल्लूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं). 1 Dried flesh. 2 Hog's flesh, the flesh of the wild hog. n. (-रं) 1 An uncultivated field, or one overrun with grass. 2 A thicket. 3 A desart. E. वल्ल to cover, ऊर Uṇādi aff.
वल्ल्या: वल्ल्या f. (-ल्ल्या) Emblic myrobalan. E. वल्ल to cover, यत् aff.
वल्वज: वल्वज m. (-जः) A sort of coarse grass, (Eleusine Indica.) E. वल्ल to cover, deriv. irr.
वल्ह: वल्ह r. 1st cl. (वल्हते) r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति) To speak or tell. r. 1st cl. (वल्हते) 1 To kill or hurt. 2 To cover. 3 To be preeminent; in which sense it is more properly बल्ह. r. 10th cl. (वल्हयति) To shine.
वश: वश r. 2nd cl. (वष्टि) To desire, to will, to wish.

वश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Humbled, subdued, tamed, overpowered. 2 Enthralled, subdued by charms and incantations, fascinated, charmed, enchanted. mn. (-शः-शं) Wish, desire. n. (-शं) 1 Authority, supremacy, mastership. 2 Subjection, submission, the state of being completely tamed and over-powered. 3 Birth. m. (-शः) The residence of harlots. f. (-शा) 1 A woman. 2 A wife. 3 A daughter. 4 A cow. 5 A barren cow. 6 A female elephant. 7 A husband's sister. E. वश to desire, aff. अप्, fem. aff. टाप्.
वशका: वशका f. (-का) An obedient and docile wife. E. वश subject, कन् added.
वशक्रिया: वशक्रिया f. (-या) Subduing or overpowering by drugs, gems, charms, or incantations. 2 The drugs, &c. so used. E. वश subjection, क्रिया business or agency.
वशग: वशग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Obedient, subject. f. (-गा) An obedient wife. E. वश subject, and ग who goes or is.
वशङ्गत: वशङ्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subject, obedient. E. वश, and गत gone.
वशम्बद: वशम्बद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Submissive, acknowledging obedience or subjection. E. वश subjection, वद to speak, खच् aff.
वशवर्तिन्: वशवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Obsequious, acting under subjection, or according to the pleasure of another. E. वश, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
वशवर्त्तिन्: वशवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) Obsequious, acting under subjection, or according to the pleasure of another. E. वश, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
वशाद्यक: वशाद्यक m. (-कः) A porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise.
वशानुग: वशानुग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Obedient, submissive. E. वश, and अनुग who pursues.
वशापायिन्: वशापायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. वशा subjection, पा to preserve, इनि aff., and युक् augment.
वशि: वशि m. (-शिः) Subjugating, fascinating, bewitching, holding others in magical or mysterious submission to one's will. E. वश to desire (supremacy), and इन् affix; also with तल् and त्व affs. वशिता and वशित्वं.
वशिक: वशिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Void, empty. f. (-का) Aloe wood. E. वश to desire, इन् aff., and कन् added.
वशिता: वशिता f. (-ता) 1 Fascinating, bewitching. 2 Subjection, holding in order or subjugation; also वशित्वं. E. वशिन्, and तल् or त्व aff.
वशिन्: वशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Subdued, subjugated, in subjection. m. (-शी) A sage with subdued passions. f. (-नी) 1 The Śami tree, (Mimosa Sama, Rox.) 2 A parasite plant. E. वश, इनि, and ङीप् affixed.
वशिर: वशिर n. (-रं) Sea salt. m. (-रः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A sort of long pepper. 3 Orris root. E. वश to desire, इरन् aff.
वशिष्ठ: वशिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) VAŚIṢṬHA, a Ṛṣi or divine sage of the first order; he is also a Brahmādika, a Prajāpati, and one of the seven stars of Ursa Major. E. अव before शास to govern, to instruct, (the other saints,) aff. क्त, the first vowel of the prefix rejected; also written वशिष्ट and वसिष्ठ.
वशीकरण: वशीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Subduing or overcoming by drugs, charms, &c., enchanting, charming. 2 Subduing in general. E. वश subduing, and करण making, च्चि augment, leaving ई.
वशीकृत: वशीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bewitched, fascinated, subjected to another's will. E. वशी, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
वशीभूत: वशीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subjugated, subject to another's will. E. वशी, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
वशीर: वशीर m. (-रः) A pungent fruit resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis); also वशिर.
वश्य: वश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Docile, tame, humble, governable. 2 To be tamed or humbled. m. (-श्यः) A dependant, a slave. f. (-श्या) A docile and obedient wife. n. (-श्यं) Cloves. E. वश subjection, यत् aff.
वश्यका: वश्यका f. (-का) An obedient wife. E. वश्या, and कन् added.
वश्यता: वश्यता f. (-ता) Humility, subjugation, disposition to, or fitness for subjection. E. वश्य, and तल् aff.; also वश्यत्वं.
वश्यात्मन्: वश्यात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Of subdued mind. E. वशी, and आत्मन् spirit.
वष: वष r. 1st cl. (बषति) To kill or hurt.
वषट्: वषट् ind. An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire. E. वह to bear or convey, aff. डषट्.
वषट्कर्तृ: वषट्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice. E. वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.
वषट्कर्त्तृ: वषट्कर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice. E. वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.
वषट्कार: वषट्कार m. (-रः) Burnt-offering, oblation with fire. E. वषट् the exclamation used on this occasion, and कार making.
वषट्कृत: वषट्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Offered or sacrificed with fire. E. वषट् as above, कृत made.
वष्क: वष्क r. 1st cl. (वष्कते) r. 10th cl. (वष्कयति) 1 To see. 2 To go.
वष्कय: वष्कय m. (-यः) A one year old calf. E. वष्क to go, अयन् aff.
वष्कयणी: वष्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves. E. वष्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीष्; also वष्कय, with इनि and ङीप् aff., वष्कयिणी.
वस: वस(औ)औवस r. 1st and 10th cls. (वसति वसयति) To dwell or inhabit. r. 2nd cl. (वस्ते) To cover with dress, to wear as clothes. r. 10th cl. (वासयति) 1 To be affectionate, to love. 2 To cut or divide. 3 To kill. 4 To accept. (इर, उ) इरवसु r. 4th cl. (वस्यति) To be straight, to be unbending; literally or figuratively. With अधि prefixed, To sit upon, to occupy. With उप, To fast. With नि, 1 To dwell in or inhabit. 2 To dress. With प्र, To dwell abroad. With सम्, To cohabit.
वसत्: वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्) 1 Dwelling, inhabiting. 2 Wearing, as clothes. E. वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
वसति: वसति f. (-तिः or -ती) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 Abiding, abode, residence. 3 Night. E. वस to dwell, अति Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.
वसन: वसन n. (-नं) 1 Cloth or clothes. 2 Covering, clothing. 3 A dwelling, a house. 4 An ornament worn by women round the loins. E. वस to be clothed, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
वसनसद्मन्: वसनसद्मन् n. (-द्म) A tent. E. वसन, and सद्मन् a dwelling.
वसन्त: वसन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Vasanta, the season of spring, or its deified personification. 2 Dysentery, diarrhoea. 3 Small-pox. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. झच्, as applied to the season, when love is especially present on earth.
वसन्तकुसुम: वसन्तकुसुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cordia myxa and latifolia.) E. वसन्त spring, and कुसुम a flower; blossoming in the spring.
वसन्तघोषिन्: वसन्तघोषिन् m. (-षी) The Indian cuckoo or Koïl. E. वसन्त spring, and घोषिन who sings.
वसन्तज: वसन्तज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the spring. f. (-जा) A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra. E. वसन्त, and ज born.
वसन्तदूत: वसन्तदूत m. (-तः) 1 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 2 The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 3 The fifth Rāga or musical mode, called also Hindola. 4 The mango tree. f. (-ती) 1 The trumpet flower. 2 A large and beautiful creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. वसन्त spring, and दूत the messenger.
वसन्तद्रु: वसन्तद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.) E. वसन्त spring, and द्रु a tree, or वसन्तद्रुम; the mango blossoms in March or April, and is then an object of great beauty.
वसन्तसख: वसन्तसख m. (-खः) KĀMADEVA or CUPID. E. वसन्त spring, and सखि the friend.
वसन्तोत्सव: वसन्तोत्सव n. (-वं) The celebration of the return of spring, formerly held on the full moon of Chaitra, but now on the full moon of Phālguna, being identified with the Dola yātra or Holi. E. वसन्त, and उत्सव a festival.
वसा: वसा f. (-सा) 1 The serum or marrow of the flesh, considered by some authorities as distinct from the marrow of the bones, though regarded by others as the same substance. 2 Adeps, fat, suet. E. वस to divide (in the body), अङ् and टाप् affs.
वसाद्य: वसाद्य m. (-द्यः) The Gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus Gangeticus;) also वसाद्यक and वशाद्यक, the last perhaps incorrectly.
वसान: वसान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearing, putting on, (as clothes.) E. वस to clothe, शानच् aff.
वसापायिन्: वसापायिन् m. (-यी) A dog. E. वसा, and पायिन् who drinks.
वसि: वसि m. (-सिः) 1 Dwelling, abode. 2 A dwelling. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
वसित: वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stored, (as grain.) 2 Dwelling, inhabiting. 3 Put on, worn. n. (-तं) Abiding, residence. f. (-ता) The power of subduing all things: see वशिता. E. वस to dwell, &c., aff. क्त, or वशिता as above, and श changed to स.
वसितृ: वसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what wears. E. वस to put on, तृच् aff.
वसित्वा: वसित्वा ind. Having put on (as clothes), wearing. E. वस to wear, क्त्वा aff.
वसिर: वसिर n. (-रं) Sea salt. m. (-रः) A pungent fruit, considered as a sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) E. वस to abide (in the sea), इरन् aff.; also, as derived from वश to desire, वशिर, &c.
वसिष्ठ: वसिष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A celebrated Muni. E. वस to abide (in the practice of religious austerities), aff. णिनि, वसिन् superlative aff., इष्टन् added, pre-eminent amongst the ascetics; also वशिष्ठ, &c.
वसु: वसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) 1 Sweet, sweet-flavoured. 2 Dry, dried. n. (-सु) 1 Wealth, thing, substance. 2 A gem, a jewel. 3 A medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi. 4 Water. 5 Gold. 6 A yellow kind of kidney-bean. 7 A sort of salt. 8 The number eight, i. e. the eight Vasus. m. (-सुः) 1 A kind of demigod, of whom eight are enumerated, viz. DHAVA, DHRUVA, SOMA or the moon, VIṢṆU, ANILA or wind, ANALA or fire, PRABHŪṢA and PRABHĀVA. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. 3 A ray of light. 4 The tie of a yoke. 5 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) 6 The name of a king. 7 A name of KUVERA. 8 A tree in general. 9 A lake, a pool. 10 A rein, a halter. 11 A plant, (Trophis aspera.) 12 ŚIVA. 13 The sun. 14 A kind of fish. E. वस to abide or dwell, Uṇādi aff. उ.
वसुक: वसुक n. (-कं) A fossil salt, brought from a district in Ajmere, Sāmbher salt. m. (-कः) 1 A shrub, (Gigantic Asclepias.) 2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.) E. कन् added to the preceding, or वसु wealth, कै to sound, aff. ड.
वसुकीट: वसुकीट m. (-टः) A supplicant, a beggar, a petitioner. E. वसु wealth, कीट a worm.
वसुदा: वसुदा f. (-दा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, and दा who gives.
वसुदेव: वसुदेव m. (-वः) VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA. E. वसु a Vasu, a deity, the incarnation of one of the Vasus; or वसु wealth दिव to shine, aff. अच्.
वसुदेवता: वसुदेवता f. (-ता) The constellation Dhaniṣṭha. E. वसु the Vasus, and देवता divinity; presiding over the asterism.
वसुदेवभू: वसुदेवभू m. (-भूः) KṚṢṆA. E. वसुदेव, and भू born.
वसुदेव्या: वसुदेव्या f. (-व्या) 1 The asterism Dhaniṣṭha. 2 The ninth day of the fortnight.
वसुधा: वसुधा f. (-धा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, धा to have or contain, aff. क and टाप्.
वसुधाधर: वसुधाधर m. (-रः) A mountain. E. वसुधा, and घर what holds.
वसुधाधिप: वसुधाधिप m. (-पः) A king. E. वसुधा, and अधिप sovereign.
वसुधानगर: वसुधानगर n. (-रं) The capital of VARUṆA in the western ocean.
वसुधारा: वसुधारा f. (-रा) 1 A female Śakti peculiar to the Jainas. 2 The capital of KUVERA. E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, aff. घञ् and टाप्; some authorities read वसुभारा for KUVERA'S capital.
वसुन्धरा: वसुन्धरा f. (-रा) The earth. E. वसु wealth, धृ to have, खच् aff.
वसुप्राण: वसुप्राण m. (-णः) Fire or its deity, AGNI. E. वसु a Vasu, and प्राण life.
वसुमत्: वसुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Wealthy, rich. f. (-ती) The earth. E. वसु wealth, and मतुप् aff.
वसुरोचिस्: वसुरोचिस् n. (-चिः) A religious ceremony in which the demigods called Vasus especially are worshipped. E. वसु as above, रुच to shine, इसि Uṇādi aff.
वसुल: वसुल m. (-लः) A deity, a divinity. E. वसु wealth, ला to have, aff. क.
वसुषेण: वसुषेण m. (-णः) A name of KARṆA, the illegitimate brother of the PĀṆḌU princes. E. वसु wealth, and सेना an army; surrounded by hosts of beggars for his wealth, of which he was liberal.
वसुस्थली: वसुस्थली f. (-ली) The city of KUVERA. E. वसु wealth, स्थल place or site, aff. ङीष्.
वसुहट्ट: वसुहट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The Vakapushpa, (Sesbana grandiflora;) also वसुहट्टक.
वसूक: वसूक n. (-कं) 1 Sāmbher salt. 2 The Sesbana grandiflora. E. see वसुक; the उ of वसुक optionally long.
वसूरा: वसूरा f. (-रा) A whore, a harlot.
वस्क: वस्क m. (-स्कः) 1 Application, perseverance. 2 Going, motion. E. वस्क to go, aff. अच्.
वस्कय: वस्कय m. (-यः) A calf of one year, a yearling. E. वस्क to go, अयन् aff.; also वष्कय, &c.
वस्कयणी: वस्कयणी f. (-णी) A cow bearing many calves. E. वस्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीप्; also वष्कयणी, &c.
वस्त: वस्त r. 10th cl. (वस्तयते) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To go or move. 3 To ask, to beg, to solicit.
वस्त m. (-स्तः) A goat. n. (-स्तं) A house. E. वस्त to kill, aff. अच्.
वस्तमोदा: वस्तमोदा f. (-दा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen:) see अजमोदा.
वस्तव्य: वस्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be dwelt in, or inhabited, resided, remained at, &c. E. वस to dwell, तव्य aff.
वस्तान्त्री: वस्तान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) 1 Benzoin or storax. 2 A plant, commonly Ajaśṛṅgī. E. वस्त a goat, and अन्त्र entrail.
वस्ति: वस्ति mf. (-स्तिः) 1 The lower belly, hypogastric or pubic region. 2 The bladder. 3 A glyster, syringe, or bag made of bladder or gut, with a wooden or metallic nozzle. 4 Abiding, dwelling, staying. plur. only (-स्तयः) The ends of a cloth. E. वस to wear as clothes, Uṇādi aff. ति, or वस to abide, क्तिन् aff.
वस्तिकर्म्माद्य: वस्तिकर्म्माद्य m. (-द्यः) The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.) E. वस्ति the ends of cloth, कर्म्म business, and आद्य principal; used in washing.
वस्तिमल: वस्तिमल n. (-लं) Urine, piss. E. वस्ति the belly, and मल excretion.
वस्तिशिरस्: वस्तिशिरस् n. (-रः) 1 The neck of the bladder. 2 The pipe of the glyster bag. E. वस्ति, and शिरस् head.
वस्तिशोधन: वस्तिशोधन n. (-नं) A diuretic. E. वस्ति, and शोधन cleansing.
वस्तु: वस्तु n. (-स्तु) 1 Thing, matter, substance. 2 Natural disposition, essential property, nature, essence. 3 The pith or substance of any thing. 4 The main plot or subject of a poem or play. E. वस to abide, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.
वस्तुक: वस्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. वस to abide (in the ground), उकञ् aff., and तुट् augment; also वास्तुक, वास्तूक, &c.
वस्तुतस्: वस्तुतस् ind. In fine, in fact, essentially, substantially. E. वस्तु, and तसि aff.
वस्तुमात्र: वस्तुमात्र n. (-त्रं) Outline of any subject, skeleton of a discourse. E. वस्तु, and मात्र only.
वस्तुहानि: वस्तुहानि f. (-निः) Loss of substance or property. E. बस्तु, and हानि abandonment.
वस्तूत्थापन: वस्तूत्थापन n. (-नं) Producing any change or incident in a play by magic. E. वस्तु, and उत्थापन raising.
वस्त्वन्तर: वस्त्वन्तर n. (-रं) Another thing or subject. E. वस्तु, and अन्तर other.
वस्त्वभाव: वस्त्वभाव m. (-वः) 1 Insubstantial existence. 2 Loss or destruction of property. E. वस्तु, and अभाव non-existence.
वस्त्य: वस्त्य n. (-स्त्यं) A house. E. वस to abide, ति aff., and यत् added; this word has many etymologies; it is also read पस्त्य.
वस्त्र: वस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 Cloth, clothes, raiment. 2 Covering, a cover. E. वस to wear as clothes, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
वस्त्रकुट्टिम: वस्त्रकुट्टिम n. (-मं) An umbrella. E. वस्त्र cloth, and कुद्दिभ a hut.
वस्त्रगृह: वस्त्रगृह n. (-हं) A tent. E. वस्त्र cloth, and गृह a house.
वस्त्रग्रन्थि: वस्त्रग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) The string or twist by which the lower garments are fastened above the hips. E. वस्त्र cloth, and ग्रन्थि knot.
वस्त्रनिर्णेजक: वस्त्रनिर्णेजक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. वस्त्र, and निर्णेजक who washes.
वस्त्रपुत्त्रिका: वस्त्रपुत्त्रिका f. (-का) A doll, a puppet. E. वस्त्र cloth, पुत्त्री infant (as it were), कन् aff.
वस्त्रभेदक: वस्त्रभेदक m. (-कः) A tailor. E. वस्त्र cloth, clothes, भेदक who pierces or cuts.
वस्त्रभेदिन्: वस्त्रभेदिन् m. (-दी) A tailor. E. वस्त्र cloth, and भेदिन् who pierces.
वस्त्रयुग्म: वस्त्रयुग्म n. (-ग्मं) A pair of cloths. E. वस्त्र, and युग्म a pair.
वस्त्रयोनि: वस्त्रयोनि f. (-निः) The basis or material of cloth, as cotton, silk, wool, &c. E. वस्त्र cloth, and योनि place of production.
वस्त्राञ्चल: वस्त्राञ्चल n. (-लं) The end or hem of a garment. E. वस्त्र, and अञ्चल the same.
वस्त्रापहारक: वस्त्रापहारक m. (-कः) A stealer of clothes. E. वस्त्र, and अपहारक who carries off; also वस्त्रापहारिन्.
वस्न: वस्न m. (-लः) Price. n. (-लं) 1 Wages, hire. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 Wealth. 4 Death. 5 Abiding, dwelling. 6 Thing, substance. 7 Skin. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. न.
वस्नन: वस्नन n. (-नं) An ornament for a woman's loins, a zone, a girdle.
वस्नसा: वस्नसा f. (-सा) A tendon, a nerve, a fibre, described as a hollow tube resembling a string, attached to the bones, and supposed to be for the passage of the vital air. E. वस्न skin, षो to destroy, aff. क.
वस्निक: वस्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Hireling, mercenary. 2 Purchasable. 3 Relating to hire, wages, price, &c. E. वस्त hire, &c., and ठन् aff.
वस्वौकसारा: वस्वौकसारा f. (-रा) 1 The capital of INDRA. 2 Alakā, the residence of KUVERA. 3 A lake attached to Alakā or Amaravati, and belonging to either deity. E. वसु the Vasus, ओकस् a residence, रा to contain, with आङ् prefixed, and क and टाप् affs., the favorite haunts of these demigods.
वह: वह r. 1st cl. (वहति) To bear, to carry, to convey or transport. (वहते) To flow as a stream. (इ) वहि r. 10th cl. (वंहयति) To shine. r. 1st cl. (वंहते) To grow or increase; this last root is more properly बहि q. v.

वह m. (-हः) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Any vehicle or means of conveyance, as a horse, a car, &c. 3 The shoulder of an ox. 4 Air, wind. 5 A road, a way. 6 Any male river. 7 A measure of four Droṇas. f. (-हा) A river in general. E. वह to bear, aff. घ.
वहंलिह: वहंलिह m. (-हः) An ox. E. वह the shoulder, लिह to lick, खश् aff.
वहत्: वहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Assuming, taking. 3 Wearing. 4 Having, possessing. E. वह to bear, शतृ aff.
वहत: वहत m. (-तः) 1 An ox. 2 A traveller. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अत.
वहति: वहति m. (-तिः) 1 An ox. 2 A friend, a counsellor. 3 Air, wind. f. (-ती) A river. E. वह to bear, अति Uṇādi aff.
वहतु: वहतु m. (-तुः) 1 An ox. 2 A traveller. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. अतु.
वहन: वहन n. (-नं) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Flowing, as a stream. 3 Any vehicle. 4 A raft, a float, a boat. E. वह to bear, ल्युट् aff.
वहनीय: वहनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be carried or borne. E. वह to bear, अनीयर् aff.
वहन्त: वहन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 An infant. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. झच्.
वहमान: वहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Bearing, conveying. 2 Having, possessing. 3 Flowing. E. वह to bear, शानच् aff.
वहल: वहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Hard, firm, compact. n. (-लं) A raft, a float. E. वह to bear, aff. कलच्.
वहलचक्षुस्: वहलचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A climbing and milky plant, (Asclepias geminata.)
वहिःकुटीचर: वहिःकुटीचर m. (-रः) A crab. E. वहिस् externally, कुटी crookedly, चर what goes.
वहिःस्थ: वहिःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) External, outer. E. वहिर्, and स्था to stay, ड aff.; also वहिःस्थित, वहिःस्थायिन्, &c.
वहित: वहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, celebrated. 2 Borne, conveyed. 3 Obtained. E. वह to bear, aff. क्त.
वहित्र: वहित्र n. (-त्रं) A raft, a float, a boat, a vessel. E. वह to bear, Uṇādi aff. इत्र; also with कन् added, वहित्रक n. (-कं.)
वहिन्: वहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Bearing, conveying. f. (-नी) A boat, a vessel. E. वह to bear, णिनि aff.
वहिरङ्ग: वहिरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An outer or external part, limb, member, property, &c. 2 A stranger, an indifferent person. E. वहिस्, and अङ्ग a limb.
वहिरिन्द्रिय: वहिरिन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of sense or perception, an organ of action, as the eye, hand, &c. E. वहिर्, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
वहिर्गत: वहिर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or forth. E. वहिर्, and गत gone.
वहिर्गमन: वहिर्गमन n. (-नं) Going forth or out. E. वहिर्, and गमन going.
वहिर्देश: वहिर्देश m. (-शः) 1 A foreign country. 2 A place without a town or village. E. वहिर्, and देश place.
वहिर्द्वार: वहिर्द्वार n. (-रं) An outer gate. E. वहिर् for वहिस् outer, and द्वार door.
वहिर्द्वारप्रकोष्ठक: वहिर्द्वारप्रकोष्ठक n. (-कं) A portico, a covered terrace before the door of a house. E. वहिर्द्वार an outer door, प्रकोष्ठ an elbow, aff. कन्.
वहिर्भव: वहिर्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced externally. E. वहिस् outwardly, and भव born.
वहिर्भूत: वहिर्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being out or without, expelled, excluded. E. वहिस्, and भूत being.
वहिर्लम्ब: वहिर्लम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Obtuse-angular. E. वहिस्, and लम्ब a perpendicular.
वहिश्चर: वहिश्चर m. (-रः) A crab. E. वहिस् externally, and चर what goes.
वहिष्करण: वहिष्करण n. (-णं) Expelling, excluding, excepting. E. वहिस् out, and करण making.
वहिष्कृत: वहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, excluded, excepted. E. वहिस्, and कृत made.
वहिस्: वहिस् ind. Out, outwards, external. E. वह to bear, aff. इस्.
वहीरु: वहीरु m. (-रुः) A tendon, a nerve, a muscle.
वह्नि: वह्नि m. (-ह्निः) 1 Fire, or its deity AGNI. 2 Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica.) 3 Marking-nut plant. 4 Appetite, digestion, the metaphorical fire of the stomach. E. वह to bear, (the oblations presented to the gods,) and नि Uṇādi aff.
वह्निकर: वह्निकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Making fire, lighting. 2 Stomachic, giving appetite. f. (-री) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. वह्नि fire, (appetite,) कृ to make, aff. अच् or ट, and टाप् or ङीप्.
वह्निगन्ध: वह्निगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Incense or resin. E. वह्नि fire, and गन्ध smell.
वह्निगर्भ: वह्निगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A bambu. f. (-र्भा) A sort of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.) E. वह्नि fire, and गर्भ embryo; taking or producing fire by friction.
वह्निदीपक: वह्निदीपक m. (-कः) Safflower. E. वह्नि fire, and दीपक what shines like or resembles.
वह्निनामन्: वह्निनामन् m. (-मा) 1 Marking-nut plant. 2 Lead wort. E. वह्नि fire, and नामन् appellation; the synonyms of fire being equally applicable to those plants.
वह्निभोग्य: वह्निभोग्य n. (-ग्यं) Ghee or clarified butter. E. वह्नि fire, भोग्य to be consumed or enjoyed.
वह्निमन्थ: वह्निमन्थ m. (-न्थः) A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa.) E. वह्नि fire, and मन्थ churning.
वह्निमारक: वह्निमारक n. (-कं) Water. E. वह्नि fire, and मारक destroyer.
वह्निमित्र: वह्निमित्र m. (-त्रः) Air, wind. E. वह्नि fire, and मित्र the friend.
वह्निरेतस्: वह्निरेतस् m. (-ताः) ŚIVA. E. वह्नि fire, and रेतस् semen.
वह्निलोह: वह्निलोह n. (-हं) Copper. E. वह्नि, and लोह iron.
वह्निवधू: वह्निवधू f. (-धूः) The wife of AGNI or fire. E. वह्नि, and वधू the wife.
वह्निवर्ण: वह्निवर्ण n. (-र्णं) The red water-lily. E. वह्नि fire, and वर्ण colour.
वह्निवल्लभ: वह्निवल्लभ m. (-भः) Resin. E. वह्नि fire, and वल्लभ friend.
वह्निवीज: वह्निवीज n. (-जं) 1 Gold. 2 A particle, to be repeated as the peculiar prayer of fire in the Tantra system: the syllable Ran रं. E. वह्नि fire, वीज seed.
वह्निशिख: वह्निशिख n. (-खं) 1 Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) 2 Saffron. f. (-खा) A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) E. वह्नि fire, and शिखा crest; also अग्निशिस्वा.
वह्निशिखर: वह्निशिखर m. (-रः) A flower, coxcomb, (Celosia cristata.) E. वह्नि fire, and शिखर a crest.
वह्य: वह्य n. (-ह्यं) 1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any sort. 2 A cart. f. (-ह्या) The wife of a Muni or saint. E. वह to bear, aff. यत्.
वा: वा r. 2nd cl. (वाति) 1 To go or move. 2 To blow as the wind. With निर् prefixed, To blow out, to extinguish. 3 To hurt, to injure.

वा ind. A particle of, 1 Comparison, (as, like, so;) 2 Alternative or option, (or, either, else, sometimes;) 3 Doubt and consideration, (or, whether;) 4 Exception, (only, no other;) 5 Asseveration or confirmation, (indeed, even, very;) 6 A conjunction, (and.) 7 An expletive. E. वा to go, aff. क्विप्, the व is sometimes changed to ब, and the word is read बा.
वांश: वांश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bambu, of or belonging to, made from a bambu, &c. f. (-शी) The manna of the bambu. E. वंश a bambu, and अण् aff.
वांशिक: वांशिक m. (-कः) 1 A flute-player, a piper, a fifer. 2 A bambu-cutter, &c. E. वंश a pipe, aff. ठक् or ठन्.
वाःकिटि: वाःकिटि m. (-टिः) A porpoise. E. वार् water, and किटि a hog.
वाःपुष्प: वाःपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Cloves. E. वार् water, and पुष्प flower.
वाःसदन: वाःसदन n. (-नं) A large water-jar. E. वार् water, सदन abode.
वाक: वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to a crane. n. (-कं) A flight of cranes. E. वक, and अण् or अञ् aff.
वाकुची: वाकुची f. (-ची) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. वा wind, and कुच् to contract, क aff., form irr.
वाक्कलह: वाक्कलह n. (-हं) Quarrel, dispute. E. वाच्, and कलह disturbance.
वाक्कीर: वाक्कीर m. (-रः) A wife's brother. E. वाच् a speech, a phrase, and कीर parrot: having giving rise to a proverb; as a cock parrot is, so is the hen; i. e. of the same breed and disposition.
वाक्चपल: वाक्चपल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frivolous, inconsistent, (in speech.) E. वाक्, and चपल changeable.
वाक्चापल्य: वाक्चापल्य n. (-ल्यं) Gossipping, chattering, idle or improper talk. E. वाक् speech, चापल्य unsteadiness.
वाक्छल: वाक्छल n. (-लं) Prevarication, equivocation. E. वाक् speech, छल disguise, fraud.
वाक्छलान्वित: वाक्छलान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Equivocating, evasive. E. वाक्छल, and अन्वित possessed of.
वाक्पटु: वाक्पटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Eloquent, able in speech. E. वाक्, and पटु skilful.
वाक्पटुता: वाक्पटुता f. (-ता) Eloquence. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वाकपटुत्वं.
वाक्पति: वाक्पति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Eloquent. m. (-तिः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. वाक् speech, and पति master.
वाक्पथ: वाक्पथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Suitable or seasonable for discourse. E. वाक्, and पथ path.
वाक्पारुष्य: वाक्पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Abuse, scurrility, defamation, wordy violence or assault. E. वाक् speech, पारुष्य violence.
वाक्य: वाक्य n. (-क्यं) 1 A sentence. 2 A rule or aphorism. 3 Speech. 4 (In astronomy,) The solar process for all astronomical computations. E. वच to speak, ण्यत् aff.
वाक्यखण्डन: वाक्यखण्डन n. (-नं) Refuting or criticising an assertion. E. वाक्य, and खण्डन breaking.
वाक्यप्रयोग: वाक्यप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employment or application of speech or language. E. वाक्य, and प्रयोग application.
वाक्यविन्यास: वाक्यविन्यास m. (-सः) Syntax, order, or arrangement of a sentence. E. वाक्य, and विन्यास disposition.
वाक्यविशारद: वाक्यविशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Eloquent. E. वाक्य, and विशारद skilful.
वाक्यस्थ: वाक्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Contained in a sentence. 2 Obedient, attentive. E. वाक्य, and स्थ what stays; also वाक्यस्थित, &c.
वागपहारक: वागपहारक m. (-कः) 1 A stealer of books. 2 A reader of prohibited works or passages. E. वाक् speech, अपहारक seizer, stealer.
वागर: वागर m. (-रः) 1 A sage, a holy man, one desirous of final emancipation. 2 A scholar, a Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman. 3 A hero, a brave man, one who is intrepid or fearless. 4 Certainty, ascertainment. 5 A whetstone. 6 An obstacle, an impediment, or cause of obstruction. 7 Submarine fire. 8 A wolf. E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.
वागसि: वागसि f. (-सिः) Sharp or searching speech. E. वाच्, and असि a sword, piercing men's thoughts.
वागारु: वागारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Breaking promise or faith, disappointing, a disappointer or deceiver. E. वाक् speech, ऋ to go, उण् aff.
वागीश: वागीश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Eloquent, well spoken. m. (-शः) 1 An author, an orator, a poet, &c. 2 BRAHMĀ. E. वाक् speech, ईश master.
वागीश्वर: वागीश्वर m. (-रः) 1 An orator, a learned man. 2 A Bauddha deified sage; also MAÑJUGHOṢA. 2 BRAHMĀ. f. (-री) SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, ईश्वर lord.
वागुजी: वागुजी f. (-जी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. वाच् speech, गुज to sound inarticulately, aff. क, form irr.
वागुण: वागुण m. (-णः) An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)
वागुरा: वागुरा f. (-रा) A net, a snare, a noose. E. वा to hurt, उर Uṇādi aff., and गन् augment.
वागुरावृत्ति: वागुरावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Catching wild animals. E. वागुरा a snare, and वृत्ति practice.
वागुरिक: वागुरिक m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-catcher. E. वागुरा a net, aff. ठक्.
वागृषभ: वागृषभ m. (-भः) A learned or eloquent man. E. वाच्, and ऋषभ best.
वागृषभत्व: वागृषभत्व n. (-त्वं) Eloquence, learning, erudition. E. वागृषभ, and त्व aff.
वाग्गुद: वाग्गुद m. (-दः) A sort of bird. E. वाक् speech, गुद to sport, aff. क.
वाग्गुलि: वाग्गुलि m. (-लिः) The betel-bearer, an officer or servant whose business it is to have the box of Pān ready for his prince or master. E. वाक् speech, (command,) गुर to obey, कि aff., and र changed to ल, or गृ to swallow, deriv. irr.
वाग्गुलिक: वाग्गुलिक m. (-कः) A betel-bearer. E. ठक् pleonasm, added to the preceding.
वाग्डम्बर: वाग्डम्बर m. (-रः) Graceful or eloquent language.
वाग्दण्ड: वाग्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 Reproof, reprimand. 2 Restraint or controul of speech. E. वाक्, and दण्ड punishment.
वाग्दत्त: वाग्दत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Promised. f. (-त्ता) A virgin betrothed. E. वाच्, and दत्त given.
वाग्दरिद्र: वाग्दरिद्र mf. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Of few words, speaking little and humbly or guardedly. E. वाक् speech, दरिद्र poor.
वाग्दल: वाग्दल n. (-लं) A lip. E. वाक् speech, दल a leaf.
वाग्दुष्ट: वाग्दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Abusive, ill-spoken, speaking ill, either morally or grammatically. m. (-ष्टः) A Brahman who has past the proper time of life, without receiving the initiatory Mantra, the investiture of the thread, &c. E. वाक् speech, दुष्ट bad, faulty.
वाग्देवता: वाग्देवता f. (-ता) 1 VṚHASPATI. 2 An eloquent man or writer. E. वाच्, and देवता divinity.
वाग्देवी: वाग्देवी f. (-वी) A name of SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, and देवी goddess, the goddess of eloquence.
वाग्दोष: वाग्दोष m. (-षः) 1 Speaking ill, defamation, abuse. 2 Ungrammatical speech. 3 Uttering a disagreeable sound. E. वाक्, and दोष fault.
वाग्बन्धन: वाग्बन्धन n. (-नं) Silencing, stopping any one's speech. E. वाक्, and वन्धन obstructing.
वाग्मिन्: वाग्मिन् mfn. (-ग्मी-ग्मिनी-ग्मि) 1 Loquacious, talkative, speaking much. 2 Speaking well, eloquent. m. (-ग्मी) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. वाच् speech, ग्मिनि aff.; hence also वागिमन्.
वाग्मूल: वाग्मूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having root or origin in speech. E. वाच्, and मूल root.
वाग्मात्र: वाग्मात्र n. (-त्रं) Mere speech, words alone. E. वाच्, and मात्र only.
वाग्य: वाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) 1 Speaking little, and cautiously or humbly. 2 Speaking truly. m. (-ग्यः) 1 Humility, self-disparagement. 2 Doubt, alternative (?) E. वाच् speech, यत् aff.
वाग्यत: वाग्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reserved in speech, taciturn, silent. E. वाक्, and यत restrained.
वाग्यतस्: वाग्यतस् ind. Silently. E. वाग्य speaking little, तसि aff.
वाग्याम: वाग्याम m. (-मः) A dumb man, one silent from necessity. E. वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
वाग्विनिःसृत: वाग्विनिःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Emitted or put forth by speech. E. वाच्, and विनिःसृत issued.
वाग्विलास: वाग्विलास m. (-सः) Graceful or elegant speech. E. वाक्, and विलास sport.
वाग्व्यापार: वाग्व्यापार m. (-रः) 1 Manner, style or habit of speaking. 2 Customary phraseology. E. वाक्, and व्यापार usual practice.
वाङ्क: वाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The ocean, the sea. E. वङ्क a bend or creek, aff. अण्.
वाङ्मय: वाङ्मय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Eloquent, rhetorical. n. (-यं) 1 Eloquence. 2 Rhetorical composition, rhetoric, belles lettres. f. (-यी) SARASVATĪ. E. वाक् speech, and मयट् aff.
वाङ्मुख: वाङ्मुख m. (-खः) The opening of a speech, an exordium. E. वाच् speech, मुख principal or beginning.
वाच्: वाच् f. (-वाक्,) 1 Speech. 2 Speaking. 3 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 4 A phrase, a proverb or adage. E. वच to speak, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made long.
वाच: वाच m. (-चः) A plant: see मदन.
वाचंयम: वाचंयम m. (-मः) A holy sage, practising rigid taciturnity, devoid of passions, and unmoved by pain or pleasure. E. वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. खच्.
वाचक: वाचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Declaratory, explaining, speaking. 2 Verbal, expressed by words. m. (-कः) 1 A word, a significant sound. 2 A speaker. 3 A messenger. E. वच to speak, aff. ण्वुल्.
वाचकता: वाचकता f. (-ता) Expressiveness, significance. E. वाचक, and तल् aff.; also वाचकत्वं.
वाचकपद: वाचकपद n. (-दं) A clear and explicit term. E. वाचक, and पद a word.
वाचनिक: वाचनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Verbal. 2 Textual. E. वचन, and ठक् aff.
वाचसाम्पति: वाचसाम्पति m. (-तिः) VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods. E. वाच् speech, in the second case pural, and पति master.
वाचस्पति: वाचस्पति m. (-तिः) VṚHASPATI: see the last. E. वाच् speech, in the sixth case, पति master.
वाचा: वाचा f. (-चा) Speech. E. वाच् as above, and टाप् added.
वाचाट: वाचाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Talkative, talking much and idly or blamably. E. वाच् speech, आटच् aff.
वाचाल: वाचाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Talkative, chattering, gabbling, talking much and idly or blamably. E. वाच् speech, and आलच् aff.
वाचिक: वाचिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Verbal. n. (-कं) News, tidings, intelligence. E. वाच् speech, aff. ठक्.
वाचिकपत्र: वाचिकपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A letter, a despatch. 2 A newspaper, a gazette. E. वाचिक news, and पत्र a leaf.
वाचिकहारक: वाचिकहारक m. (-कः) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A messenger, a courier. E. वाचिक news, हृ to convey, aff. ण्वुल्.
वाचोयुक्ति: वाचोयुक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Speaking much or well. E. वाच् speech in the sixth case, and युक्ति joining, fitness.
वाचोयुक्तिपटु: वाचोयुक्तिपटु m. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु) Eloquent, speaking much or well. E. वाचोयुक्ति as above, and पटु skilful.
वाच्छ: वाच्छ(इ)वाच्छि r. 1st cl. (वाच्छति) To wish or desire.
वाच्य: वाच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 Vile, bad. 2 Vile, contemptible, low, outcast. 3 Fit or proper to be spoken or said. 4 Attributive, adjective, to be predicated of any thing. 5 Declinable as an  adjective, taking the three genders. n. (-च्यं) 1 Blame, reviling. 2 A predicate, that which may be said of any thing. 3 (In grammar,) The voice or mode of a verb: कर्त्तृवाच्यं the active voice, कर्म्मणिवाच्यं the passive voice. E. वच to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
वाच्यता: वाच्यता f. (-ता) 1 Infamy, ill repute. 2 Blame, reproach. 3 The quality of that which may be said of any thing. 4 Conjugation. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, वाच्यत्वं.
वाज: वाज mn. (-जः-जं) A wing. m. (-जः) 1 The feather of an arrow. 2 Speed. 3 Sound. 4 A Muni. n. (-जं) 1 Ghee or clarified butter. 2 Water. 3 A Mantra or prayer which concludes a sacrifice. 4 Rice offered at a Śrāddha or obsequial ceremony. 5 Rice in general. 5 The acidulous mixture of ground meal and water left to ferment. E. वज to go, aff. घञ्.
वाजपेय: वाजपेय mn. (-यः-यं) A particular sacrifice. E. वाज the acetous fermentation of meal and water, and पेय to be drank, (by the gods.)
वाजभोजिन्: वाजभोजिन् m. (-जी) A particular sacrifice: see the last. E. वाज sour gruel, भुज to eat, aff. णिनि, and the radical vowel changed.
वाजिगन्ध: वाजिगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The name of a plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. वाजिन् a horse, and गन्ध smell; also वाजिगन्धक.
वाजिता: वाजिता f. (-ता) 1 The condition of having wings. 2 The nature of a horse. E. वाजिन् a horse, &c., तल् aff.; also with त्व, वाजित्वं.
वाजिदन्त: वाजिदन्त m. (-न्तः) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.) E. वाजि a horse, and दन्त a tooth, to which the flower is compared; also with कन् added, वाजिदन्तक.
वाजिन्: वाजिन् m. (-जी) 1 A horse. 2 An arrow. 3 A bird. 4 A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda.) f. (-जिनी) A mare. E. वाज speed or a feather, &c., and इनि poss. aff.
वाजिन: वाजिन n. (-नं) Curd of two milk whey, or the whey from which the curds have been separated. E. वज to prepare, aff. इनन्.
वाजिपृष्ठ: वाजिपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) Globe amaranth. E. वाजि a horse, and पृष्ठ back.
वाजिभूमि: वाजिभूमि f. (-मिः) Place where horses are bred. E. वाजिन्, and भूमि place.
वाजिशाला: वाजिशाला nf. (-लं-ला) A stable. E. वाजि a horse, and शाला a hall.
वाजीकर: वाजीकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Aphrodisiac. E. वाजिन् a horse, कर what makes, च्चि aff.
वाजीकरण: वाजीकरण n. (-णं) Stimulus or excitement of amorous desires by aphrodisiacs, &c. E. वाजि a horse, करण making, and च्चि augment.
वाञ्छत्: वाञ्छत् mfn. (-ञ्छन्-ञ्छन्ती-ञ्छत्) Wishing, desiring. E. वाछि to wish, शतृ aff.
वाञ्छन: वाञ्छन n. (-नं) Desiring, wishing. E. वाछि to desire, ल्युट् aff.
वाञ्छनीय: वाञ्छनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Desirable, to be wished for. E. वाछि to wish, and अनीयर् aff.; also वाञ्छितव्य and वाच्छ्य.
वाञ्छा: वाञ्छा f. (-ञ्छा) Wish, desire. E. वाच्छि to wish, aff. अच्.
वाञ्छित: वाञ्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wished, desired. E. वाच्छि to wish, क्त aff.
वाञ्छिन्: वाञ्छिन् mfn. (-ञ्छी-ञ्छिनी-ञ्छि) Wishing, desirous. f. (-ञ्छिनी) A libidinous woman, a wanton. E. वाञ्छा desire, इनि aff.
वाट्: वाट् ind. An exclamation on making an offering of boiled butter.
वाट: वाट mfn. adj. (-टः-टी-टं) Made of the Indian fig tree, of its wood, &c. subst. (-टः-टी-टं) 1 An enclosure, a piece of enclosed ground, whether a simple enclosure, as a courtyard, or one for trees and plants, as an orchard, a garden, a plantation, &c. 2 A road. 3 A mud wall, a bound hedge or any enclosure of a town or village, &c. 4 A sort of grain, (Panicum spicatum.) 5 The groin. f. (-टी) 1 The site of a house or building. 2 A house, a dwelling. 3 A plant: see वाट्यालक. E. वट to surround, aff. घञ्.
वाटधान: वाटधान m. (-नः) The descendant of an outcast Brahman by a Brahman female.
वाटशृङ्खला: वाटशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of chain enclosure or fence (?). E. वाट an enclosure, and शृङ्खला a chain.
वाटिका: वाटिका f. (-का) 1 The site of a house. 2 A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) 3 A garden, an orchard. E. कन् added to वाटी.
वाटिदीर्घ: वाटिदीर्घ m. (-र्घः) A sort of grass, commonly Icadā. E. वाटी an enclosure, दीर्घ long.
वाट्य: वाट्य mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं) Belonging to a house or garden, &c. E. वाटी, यत् aff.
वाट्यपुष्प: वाट्यपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Sandal. 2 Saffron. f. (-ष्पी) A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. वाट्य belonging to a house or garden, and पुष्प flower.
वाट्या: वाट्या f. (-ट्या) A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. वाटी a garden, यत् and टाप् affs.
वाट्याल: वाट्याल mf. (-लः-ली) A herbaceous shrub, (Sida cordifolia:) see the next.
वाट्यालक: वाट्यालक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Bariyāla, (Sida cordifolia). E. वाटी a garden, in the sixth case, अल to adorn, with अण् aff., and कन् added, the ornament of a garden.
वाड: वाड(ऋ)वाडृ r. 1st cl. (वाडते) To bathe, to dive and emerge: the best authorities read this बाडृ.
वाढ: वाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Much, abundant, exceeding. 2 Hard, firm. adv. n. or ind. (-ढं) 1 Much, excessive, excessively. 2 Very well, well, (assent, promise.) 3 A particle signifying conclusion, deduction. E. वह to take, to bear, aff. क्त, and the form. irr.
वाढविक्रम: वाढविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Powerful, very strong, mighty. E. वाढ, and विक्रम prowess.
वाण: वाण m. (-णः) 1 An arrow. 2 A name of fire. 3 The name of a sovereign considered also as an Asura or infernal being, the son of BĀLĪ, and destroyed by VIṢṆU. 4 The udder of a cow. 5 Alone, solitary. 6 A pipe, a fife, a flute. mf. (-णः-णा) 1 Blue Barleria. 2 The root or feathered part of an arrow. E. वण or बण to sound or go, aff. घञ्; whence this word and other derivatives are sometimes also written with an initial ब.
वाणदण्ड: वाणदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाण an arrow, and दण्ड a stick.
वाणनिकृत: वाणनिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pierced, wounded by an arrow. E. वाण, and निकृत hurt.
वाणपाणि: वाणपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Armed with arrows. E. वाण, and पाणि the hand.
वाणपुर: वाणपुर n. (-रं) The capital of VĀṆA Rāja. E. वाण, and पुर city; also with the final consonant वाणपुर्. f. (-पूः)
वाणमोक्षण: वाणमोक्षण n. (-णं) Shooting an arrow. E. वाण, and मोक्षण letting fly.
वाणवार: वाणवार m. (-रः) 1 Armour. 2 A breastplate, a cuirass. E. वाण an arrow, वृ to cover or screen, aff. घञ्.
वाणसुता: वाणसुता f. (-ता) UṢĀ, the daughter of VĀṆA, and wife of ANIRUDDHA. E. वाण, and सुता daughter.
वाणहन्: वाणहन् m. (-हा) VIṢṆU. E. वाण VĀṆA Rāja, and हन् destroyer.
वाणारि: वाणारि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU. E. वाण the demon, and अरि an enemy.
वाणाश्रय: वाणाश्रय m. (-यः) A bow. E. वाण an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.
वाणासन: वाणासन n. (-नं) A bow. E. वाण an arrow, असन throwing, or आसन a seat.
वाणि: वाणि f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 Weaving. 2 A species of the Aṣṭī metre. E. वण to sound, aff. इनि.
वाणिज्य: वाणिज्य n. (-ज्यं) Traffic, trade: see वाणिज्य.
वाणिन्: वाणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 1 Having an arrow. 2 Speaking. f. (-नी) 1 A sharp or clever woman, an intriguing woman. 2 An actress, a dancer, a Nāc girl. 3 A furious woman, one literally or figuratively intoxicated. E. वाण an arrow, or वाणि speech, इनि and ङीप् affs.
वाणी: वाणी f. (-णी) 1 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 2 Speech, sound. E. वण to sound, aff. इञ्, and ङीप् or ङीष् added.
वात: वात r. 1st cl. (वातयति) 1 To go. 2 To serve. 3 To be happy. 4 To give pleasure in travelling. 5 To blow gently, to fan or ventilate.
वात m. (-तः) 1 Air, wind. 2 Rheumatism, gout, inflammation of the joints. 2 Air, wind, as one of the humours of the body. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
वात्: वात् mfn. (वान् वाती वान्ती वात्) Going, moving. E. वा to go, शतृ aff.
वातक: वातक m. (-कः) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. वात wind, कृ to make, aff. ड.
वातकिन्: वातकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Rheumatic, gouty. E. वात inflammation of the joints, and इनि aff., कूक् augment.
वातकुण्डलिका: वातकुण्डलिका f. (-का) Scanty and painful flow of urine.
वातकुम्भ: वातकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal sinuses. E. वात wind, and कुम्भ a receptacle.
वातकेतु: वातकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust. E. वात wind, and केतु a symbol.
वातकेलि: वातकेलि m. (-लिः) 1 Speaking in murmurs, especially amorous converse. 2 The marks of finger nails on the lover's person. E. वात wind, केलि playing.
वातगामिन्: वातगामिन् m. (-मी) A bird. E. वात wind, and गामिन् who goes.
वातगुल्म: वातगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A gale, a high wind. 2 Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, गुल्म a cluster, a quantity.
वातग्रस्त: वातग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Epileptic. 2 Rheumatic. E. वात, and ग्रस्त seized.
वातघ्न: वातघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing disorders from wind. E. वात, and घ्न who destroys.
वातज: वातज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or arising from wind. E. वात, and ज born.
वातज्वर: वातज्वर m. (-रः) Fever arising from vitiated wind. E. वात, and ज्वर fever.
वाततूल: वाततूल n. (-लं) Cottony flocks or seeds floating in the air. E. वात wind, तूल cotton.
वातथुडा: वातथुडा f. (-डा) 1 A gale, a high wind. 2 Acute gout or rheumatism. 3 A handsome woman. 4 A disease, a sort of small pox. E. वात wind, हुड to reap, aff. क, deriv. irr.
वातध्वज: वातध्वज m. (-जः) A cloud. E. वात wind, and ध्वज banner.
वातपित्त: वातपित्त n. (-त्तं) Rheumatism attended with fever. E. वात, and पित्त bile.
वातपुत्त्र: वातपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A name of BHĪMA. 2 The monkey HANUMĀN. 3 A cheat, a swindler. E. वात the wind, and पुत्त्र a son.
वातपोथ: वातपोथ m. (-थः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वात rheumatism, पुथ to hurt, aff. अण्; also वातपोथक.
वातप्रमी: वातप्रमी m. (-मीः) A swift antelope. E. वात the wind, प्र before मा to measure, to surpass or outgo, Uṇādi aff. ईप्.
वातफुल्ल: वातफुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Inflated, puffed up with wind. E. वात, and फुल्ल blown.
वातफुल्लान्त्र: वातफुल्लान्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) Cholic, flatulence, borborygmi. E. वात wind, फुल्ल swoln, अन्त्र the intestines.
वातमज: वातमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Going in or against the wind. m. (-जः) An antelope. E. वात wind, अज to go, aff. खश्.
वातमण्डली: वातमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirlwind. E. वात wind, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्.
वातमृग: वातमृग m. (-गः) A swift antelope. E. वात wind, and मृग a deer.
वातरंहस्: वातरंहस् mfn. (-हाः-हाः-हः) Swift, (as the wind.) E. वात, and रंहस् speed.
वातर: वातर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Swift, (as the wind.) E. वात, रा to get, क aff.
वातरक्त: वातरक्त n. (-क्तं) Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, and रक्त blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of the blood and the aerial humour.
वातरक्तघ्न: वातरक्तघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā. E. वातरक्त gout, and घ्न destroying.
वातरक्तारि: वातरक्तारि m. (-रिः) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. वातरक्त acute gout, and अरि a foe.
वातरथ: वातरथ m. (-थः) A cloud. E. वात the wind, and रथ a car.
वातरायण: वातरायण m. (-णः) 1 An arrow. 2 An arrow's flight, the discharge of an arrow, a bow shot. 3 A saw. 4 The peak of a mountain. 5 A mad man, one wild or intoxicated, either literally or figuratively. 6 An idler, one who lives to no purpose. 7 The Saral, a sort of pine tree. E. वातर, and अयन going.
वातरूष: वातरूष m. (-षः) 1 A gale, a breeze. 2 The rainbow. 3 A bribe. E. वात wind, रूष to rage, aff. क.
वातरोग: वातरोग n. (-गं) Rheumatism, gout. E. वात wind, and रोग disease.
वातरोगिन्: वातरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Rheumatic, afflicted with gout or rheumatism, especially of the acute kind. E. वातरोग acute rheumatism, &c., aff. इनि.
वातर्द्धि: वातर्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) 1 A sort of cup or vessel made of wood, with an iron foot or stand. 2 A mace, a club or stick bound with iron. E. वात wind, ऋद्धि increase.
वातल: वातल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Flatulent. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of pulse, (Cicer arietinum.) 2 Wind. f. (-ला) A morbid state of the uterus. E. वात wind, ला to get, aff. क.
वातलमण्डली: वातलमण्डली f. (-ली) A whirlwind. E. वातल windy, मण्डल a region, aff. ङीप्; also वातमण्डली.
वातवत्: वातवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Windy, gusty. E. वात, and मतुप् aff.
वातवलासक: वातवलासक m. (-कः) Nervous or low fever.
वातवस्ति: वातवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Suppression of urine. E. वात, and वस्ति the bladder.
वातवृद्धि: वातवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Swelled testicle. E. वात, and वृद्धि increase.
वातव्याधि: वातव्याधि f. (-धिः) Any morbid affection attributed to disorder of the wind. E. वात, and व्याधि disease.
वातवैरिन्: वातवैरिन् m. (-री) The castor oil tree, &c.; see वातारि.
वातशीर्ष: वातशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The lower belly. E. वात wind, शीर्ष the head or source.
वातशूल: वातशूल n. (-लं) Cholic with flatulence. E. वात, and शूल cholic.
वातशोणित: वातशोणित n. (-तं) Acute gout or rheumatism. E. वात wind, शोणित blood; ascribed to a vitiated state of these two.
वातसह: वातसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Gouty, rheumatic. E. वात the disease, and सह bearing, suffering.
वातसारथि: वातसारथि m. (-थिः) AGNI or fire. E. वात wind, and सारथि charioteer.
वातस्कन्ध: वातस्कन्ध n. (-न्धं) The portion of the atmosphere where the wind blows. E. वात wind, स्कन्ध part.
वाताट: वाताट m. (-टः) 1 A horse of the sun. 2 An antelope. E. वात the wind, and अट who goes.
वातानुलोमन: वातानुलोमन n. (-नं) Forcing the wind downwards, as in inflating the lungs.
वातापि: वातापि m. (-पिः) The name of an Asura devoured by AGASTYA. E. वात wind, पा to drink, aff. कि, and आङ् prefixed.
वातापिद्विष्: वातापिद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) The Muni AGASTYA. E. वातापि, and द्विष who hates; also similar names, as वातापिसूदन, बातापिहन्, &c.
वातामोदा: वातामोदा f. (-दा) Musk. E. वात the wind, आमोदा a diffusive fragrance.
वाताय: वाताय n. (-यं) A leaf. E. वात wind, अय to go, aff. अच्.
वातायन: वातायन n. (-नं) 1 A window, an eyelet or loop-hole. 2 A porch, a portico, a covered shed, a pavilion. m. (-नः) A horse. E. वात the wind, and अयन going.
वातायु: वातायु m. (-युः) An antelope, a deer. E. वात wind, (like,) अय to go, aff. उण्.
वातारि: वातारि f. (-रिः) 1 The castor oil tree. 2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. वात rheumatism, अरि hostile.
वाताली: वाताली f. (-ली) A whirlwind, a gale. E. वात wind, आली a line.
वाताश्व: वाताश्व m. (-श्वः) A swift horse, or one of a good breed. E. वात the wind, and अश्व a horse.
वातासह: वातासह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Rheumatic, gouty. E. बात rheumatism, and आसह who bears or suffers.
वाताहत: वाताहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stirred or shaken by the wind. 2 Affected by rheumatism. E. वात, and आहत struck.
वाताहति: वाताहति f. (-तिः) 1 The action of the wind. 2 The occurrence of arthritic pains. E. वात, and आहति striking.
वाति: वाति m. (-तिः) Air, wind. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. अति.
वातिक: वातिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Windy, stormy. 2 Rheumatic. 3 Produced by or proceeding from wind, (disease, &c.) n. (-कं) Fever or inflammation ascribed to a vitiated state of the aerial humour. E. वात wind, &c., ठक् aff.
वातिग: वातिग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Acquainted with or working in minerals or fossils, &c. m. (-गः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वाति wind, and ग who counts, from गण with ड aff.
वातिङ्गण: वातिङ्गण m. (-णः) The egg-plant. E. वाति wind, गण to count, aff. खच्, curing rheumatism, &c.
वातीय: वातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind, &c. n. (-यं) Sour rice-gruel. E. वात the wind, छ aff.; acidulated by air.
वातुल: वातुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gouty, rheumatic. 2 Mad, crazy. m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale. E. वात wind, &c., and उलच् aff.; more commonly वातूल.
वातुलि: वातुलि f. (-लिः) A large bat, commonly the flying-fox. E. वात wind, उलि aff., form irr.
वातूल: वातूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Gouty, rheumatic. 2 Mad, insane, inebriate. m. (-लः) A whirlwind, a gale, a hurricane. E. वात wind, ऊलच् aff.; also वातुल; form irr.
वातृ: वातृ m. (-ता) Air, wind. E. वा to go, तृच् aff.
वात्या: वात्या f. (-त्या) Strong wind, a gale, a whirlwind, a hurricane. E. वात wind, यत् implying quantity.
वात्सक: वात्सक n. (-कं) A herd of calves. E. वत्स a calf, वुञ् aff. of number.
वात्सल्य: वात्सल्य n. (-ल्यं) Tenderness, affection, fondness. E. वत्सल affectionate, यञ् aff.
वात्सीपुत्त्र: वात्सीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A barber. E. वात्सी a girl born of a Śūdra woman by a Brahman, and पुत्त्र son.
वात्स्यायन: वात्स्यायन m. (-नः) The name of a Muni. E. वात्स्य the father of the sage, and फक् aff. of descent.
वाद: वाद m. (-दः) 1 Demonstrated conclusion, reply, result. 2 Discourse, discussion, defined as the speech of one desirous to know the truth. 3 A plaint, an accusation. 4 Sound, sounding. E. वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
वादकर: वादकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Causing or making a dispute. E. वाद, and कर what makes; also वादकृत्, &c.
वादन: वादन n. (-नं) Sound, sounding, (as musical instruments.) E. वद to sound, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
वादयत्: वादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sounding, playing, (as on a musical instrument.) E. वद to speak, causal v., शतृ aff.
वादयुद्ध: वादयुद्ध n. (-द्धं) Controversy, dispute. E. वाद, and युद्ध war.
वादरङ्ग: वादरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The religious fig tree.
वादरत: वादरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Adhering to or following a doctrine. 2 Addicted to controversy, disputatious. E. वाद, and रत fond of.
वादरायण: वादरायण m. (-णः) A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and reputed author of the Purāṇas, &c. E. वादर a place of pilgrimage, अयन going, aff. अण्.
वादल: वादल n. (-लं) Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it. E. वा for वात wind, दल to disperse, aff. अच्; form irr.
वादवादिन्: वादवादिन् m. (-दी) A Jaina. E. वाद result, truth, and वादिन् who declares.
वादसाधन: वादसाधन n. (-नं) Argument, maintaining a controversy. E. वाद, and साधन instrument.
वादानुवाद: वादानुवाद m. (-दः) Attack and rejoinder, plaint and reply. E. वाद, and अनुवाद subsequent dispute.
वादान्य: वादान्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Munificent, liberal, &c. E. वदान्य, and अण् pleonasm added.
वादाल: वादाल m. (-लः) A sheat fish. E. वदाल the same, अण् pleonasm added.
वादि: वादि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Wise, learned, skilful, sage. E. वद to speak, (wisely, &c.,) इञ् Uṇādi aff.
वादित्र: वादित्र n. (-त्रं) A musical instrument. E. वद to sound, Uṇādi aff. णित्रन्.
वादिन्: वादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) 1 Speaking, discoursing. 2 Asserting, declaring. m. (-दी) 1 A sage, an expounder of the law and the Śāstras. 2 A plaintiff, an accuser. 3 Leading or key note, (in music.) E. वद to speak, णिनि aff.
वादिराज्: वादिराज् m. (-राट्) A Bauddha sage; also MAÑJUGHOṢA. E. वादि a sage, and राज् chief.
वादिश: वादिश m. (-शः) A learned and virtuous man, a sage, a seer. E. वादि truth or true conclusion, and इशच् aff.
वाद्य: वाद्य n. (-द्यं) Any musical instrument. E. वद to sound, aff. ण्यत्; to be sounded or played.
वाद्यनिर्घोष: वाद्यनिर्घोष m. (-षः) The sound of musical instruments. E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and निर्घोष sound.
वाद्यभाण्ड: वाद्यभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) 1 A multitude of musical instruments, a band. 2 Any musical instrument. E. वाद्य a musical instrument, and भाण्ड assemblage or vessel.
वाध: वाध(ऋ)वाधृ r. 1st cl. (वाधते) To distress, to give pain: more correctly बाध.
वाधुक्य: वाधुक्य n. (-क्यं) Marriage. E. वधुका a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
वाधू: वाधू f. (-धूः) A vessel, a boat, a raft. E. वह to bear, aff. ऊण्; form irr.
वान: वान mfn. subst. (-नः-ना-नं) Dry fruit. adj. Dry, dried. n. (-नं) 1 Living. 2 Going, moving. 3 A mat of straw. 4 A heavy sea, the rolling of water from wind, &c.; hence the high tide in the Indian rivers, commonly called the Bore. 5 A hole in the wall of a house. 6 A perfume, a fragrance. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a wood, a house, &c.: see वन. n. (-नं) A number or multitude of woods. E. वै to dry or wither, aff. क्त; form irr.: in other of its applications वन to sound, aff. घञ्; or वन a wood, water, a house, &c., and अण् referential aff.
वानप्रस्थ: वानप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) 1 The Brahman of the third order, who has passed through the conditions of student and householder, and has left his house and family for lonely meditation in woods and wilds; the hermit, the anchoret. 2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 3 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वन a wood, अण् aff., वान a solitude in the woods, &c., प्रस्थ who goes forth to, from स्था to stay, with प्र prefix, and क aff.
वानर: वानर mf. (-रः-री) An ape, a monkey. f. (-री) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. वात what relates to a wood, रा to get, aff. क, a Sylvan; or वा implying resemblance, and नर a man, or वन a wood, रत to play, aff. ड, वनर, and अण् pleonasm added.
वानरप्रिय: वानरप्रिय m. (-यः) A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.) E. वानर a monkey, and प्रिय fond of.
वानराघात: वानराघात m. (-तः) A tree, commonly Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. वीनर a monkey, आघात struck, injured.
वानरेन्द्र: वानरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 The monkey chief, SUGRĪVA. 2 HANUMĀN. E. वानर, and इन्द्र chief.
वानल: वानल m. (-लः) A kind of holy basil, distinguished as the black species of Tulasī, (Ocymum sanctum.)
वानस्पत्य: वानस्पत्य m. (-त्यः) A tree bearing fruits from blossoms, as the mango, eugenia, &c. E. वनस्पति a tree bearing fruits without blossoms, and ण्य aff.
वानायु: वानायु m. (-युः) A country to the north-west of India; also वनायु.
वानायुज: वानायुज m. (-जः) A Vānāyu horse, considered as one of a particularly good breed. E. वनायु, and ज born.
वानीर: वानीर m. (-रः) A sort of cane or ratan, (Calamus rotang.) E. वन water, ईर aff., and the first vowel made long.
वानेय: वानेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Relating or belonging to water, &c. m. (यः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. वन water, ढञ् aff.
वान्त: वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Vomited, ejected from the mouth. E. वन to vomit, aff. क्त.
वान्ताद: वान्ताद m. (-दः) A dog. E. वान्त what is ejected from the mouth, and अद who eats.
वान्ति: वान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Vomiting, ejecting from the mouth. E. वम to vomit, क्तिन् aff.
वान्तिकृत्: वान्तिकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Emetic. m. (-कृत्) A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. वान्ति vomiting, and कृत् what makes; an emetic.
वान्तिद: वान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Emetic. f. (-दा) A medicinal plant, commonly Katiuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica; and Colotropis gigantea, BROVN.) E. वान्ति vomiting, and द what produces; an emetic.
वान्या: वान्या f. (-न्या) A multitude of groves or thickets. E. वन a wood, यञ् aff. of multitude; also with यत् aff. वन्या.
वाप: वाप m. (-पः) 1 Shaving. 2 Sowing seed. 3 Weaving. E. वप to sow seed, &c., aff. घञ्.
वापदण्ड: वापदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाप weaving, दण्ड a stick; also वायदण्ड.
वापि: वापि f. (-पिः or -पी) A large oblong pond, a pool, a lake. E. वप, to sow seed, (of the lotus, &c.) Uṇādi aff. इञ्, and ङीप् optionally added.
वापित: वापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sown as seed. 2 Shaven. E. वाप shaving, &c., इतच् aff.
वापीह: वापीह m. (-हः) The Cātaka, a bird, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वापी a pool, हां to abandon, aff. क; drinking rain water only.
वाप्य: वाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be sown, what may or ought to be sown. m. (-प्यः) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. वप to sow, aff. ण्यत्.
वाम: वाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Left, not right. 2 Reverse, contrary, inverted. 3 Beautiful, pleasing. 4 Vile, base, wicked. 5 Short. 6 Crooked. m. (-मः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 KĀMA or CUPID. 3 An udder, a breast. 4 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) 5 An animal, a sentient being. 6 A snake. n. (-मं) Wealth, possessions. f. (-मा) 1 A woman. 2 GAURĪ. 3 LAKṢMĪ. 4 SARASVATĪ. f. (-मी) 1 A mare. 2 A she-ass. 3 A young female elephant. 4 The female of the jackal. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
वामता: वामता f. (-ता) 1 Perverseness, contrariety. 2 Craftiness, wickedness. 3 Loveliness. E. तल् added to वाम; also with त्व, वामत्वं.
वामदेव: वामदेव m. (-वः) A name of ŚIVA. E. वाम contrary, (to human institutions,) देव who sports.
वामन: वामन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Short, dwarfish, a dwarf. 2 Depressed, pressed flat or down. 3 Low, vile, base. m. (-नः) 1 VIṢṆU in his character of the dwarf, in which he appeared on his fifth  descent from heaven, to prevent BALI from obtaining dominion of the three worlds. 2 The elephant that supports the south quarter. 3 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) f. (नी) 1 A female dwarf. 2 A sort of woman; also वामनिका. 3 A disease of the vagina. E. वम to eject from the mouth, and ल्यु or ल्युट् aff.
वामनीकृत: वामनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shortened, flattened. E. वामन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
वामलूर: वामलूर m. (-रः) An ant or mole hill, especially the hillocks of ground thrown up by the white ant. E. वाम inverted, reversed, लू to cut, aff. रक्.
वामलोचन: वामलोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fine-eyed. f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. वाम beautiful, and लोचन eye.
वामाक्षी: वामाक्षी f. (-क्षी) A handsome woman. E. वाम beautiful, and अक्षि an eye.
वामाचार: वामाचार m. (-रः) The doctrine of the Tantras according to one system. E. वाम left, and आचार institute; the left hand ritual, the use of flesh, spirits, &c. forming part of the Vāmācāra ceremonies.
वामाचारिन्: वामाचारिन् m. (-री) A follower of the left hand portion of the Tantras. E. वामाचार, and इनि aff.
वामापीडन: वामापीडन m. (-नः) A tree, (Salvadora Persica, &c.:) see पीलु.
वामावर्त: वामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell with the spiral turn running from right to left. E. वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.
वामावर्त्त: वामावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell with the spiral turn running from right to left. E. वाम, and आवर्त्त a turn.
वामिल: वामिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Proud, haughty, intolerant. 2 Handsome, beautiful. E. वम to eject from the mouth, (the faults of others,) aff. इलच्.
वाय: वाय m. (-यः) Weaving. E. वे to weave, घञ् aff.
वायक: वायक m. (-कः) A number, a multitude, a heap. E. बय to go ण्वुल् aff.
वायदण्ड: वायदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A weaver's loom. E. वाय weaving, दण्ड a stick.
वायन: वायन n. (-नं) 1 Sweetmeats or cakes, forming a light refreshment, which is not supposed to be any breach of a religious fast. 2 Sweetmeats or cakes, part of an offering to a deity, or prepared on particular occasions, as marriages, &c. and sent as presents to friends and acquaintances. E. वा to go, ल्युट् aff.; also with कन् added, वायनक n. (-कं.)
वायव: वायव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Windy, relating or belonging to wind. f. (-वी) The quarter or region of the wind; the northwest E. वायु air, wind, and अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्.
वायव्य: वायव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Relating to the wind, sacred to the deity of the wind, &c. E. वायु wind, and यत् aff.
वायस: वायस m. (-सः) 1 A crow. 2 Agallochum, (Amyris Agallocha.) 3 Turpentine. f. (-सी) 1 A species of fig, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.) 4 A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.) E. वय to go, Uṇādi aff. असच्, and the radical vowel made long.
वायसाराति: वायसाराति m. (-तिः) An owl. E. वायस a crow, and अराति an enemy; also similar compounds, as वायसारि.
वायसेक्षु: वायसेक्षु m. (-क्षुः) A sort of long grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.) E. वायस a crow, and इक्षु the sugar-cane.
वायसोली: वायसोली f. (-ली) A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. E. वायस a crow, उलच् aff.
वायु: वायु m. (-युः) 1 Air, wind, or its personified deification. 2 The air of the body. 3 Morbid affection of the windy humour. E. वा to go, उण् Uṇādi aff., and युक् augment.
वायुकेतु: वायुकेतु m. (-तुः) Dust. E. वायु wind, and केतु a symbol, a sign.
वायुकोण: वायुकोण m. (-णः) The north-west. E. वायु, and कोण corner.
वायुगण्ड: वायुगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Flatulence, indigestion. E. वायु wind, गडि to be a part of, aff. अच्.
वायुगति: वायुगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Quick, swift, as the wind. E. वायु, and गति going.
वायुगुल्म: वायुगुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 A whirlpool, an eddy. 2 A whirlwind, a hurricane. E. वायु wind, and गुल्म a cluster.
वायुग्रस्त: वायुग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Affected by wind, flatulent, epileptic. E. वायु, and ग्रस्त seized.
वायुघ्न: वायुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying or curing windy disorders. E. वायु, and घ्न what destroys.
वायुजात: वायुजात m. (-तः) HANUMAN. E. वायु, and जात born.
वायुदारु: वायुदारु m. (-रुः) A cloud. E. वायु wind, दृ to scatter, aff. उण्.
वायुनिवृत्ति: वायुनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Calm, lull. 2 Cure of windy disorders. E. वायु, and निवृत्ति stop.
वायुपुत्त्र: वायुपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A name of BHĪMA. 2 A name of HANUMAN. E. वायु the god of wind, and पुत्त्र a son; also similar compounds, as वायुतनय, वायुनन्दन, वायुसुत, &c.
वायुफल: वायुफल n. (-लं) 1 The rainbow. 2 Hail. E. वायु wind, and फल fruit.
वायुभक्ष: वायुभक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Eating air, fasting. m. (-क्षः) 1 A snake. 2 An ascetic. E. वायु wind, and भक्ष who eats.
वायुभक्षण: वायुभक्षण n. (-णं) Fasting, living on air. E. वायु, and भक्षण eating.
वायुभूत: वायुभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Becoming as the wind, going every where at will. E. वायु, and भूत become.
वायुरोषा: वायुरोषा f. (-षा) Night. E. वायु wind, रुष् to rage, aff. अच्.
वायुवर्त्मन्: वायुवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्मा) The atmosphere, sky, heaven. E. वायु wind, and वर्त्मन् path or road.
वायुवाह: वायुवाह m. (-हः) Smoke, vapour. E. वायु the wind, and वाह vehicle.
वायुवाहिनी: वायुवाहिनी f. (-नी) A vessel of the body, supposed, as the arteries were once imagined, to convey the aerial humour. E. वायु wind, वाहिनी bearing.
वायुवेगसम: वायुवेगसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Swift as the wind. E. वायु, वेग speed, सम equal.
वायुसख: वायुसख m. (-खः) Fire. E. वायु wind, and सखि friend, aff. टच्; also without the aff. वायुसखि.
वायुसम्भव: वायुसम्भव m. (-वः) HANUMAN. E. वायु, सम्भव born.
वायुसम: वायुसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Like wind, unsubstantial. 2 Swift. E. वायु, and सम same.
वाय्वास्पद: वाय्वास्पद n. (-दं) Ether, atmosphere. E. वायु wind, आस्पद place, site.
वार्: वार् n. (-वाः) Water. E. वृ to surround, aff. क्विप्.
वार: वार m. (-रः) 1 A multitude, a quantity, a flock or herd, a heap. 2 Occasion, opportunity. 3 A day of the week. 4 A moment. 5 A name of ŚIVA. 6 A door-way, a gate. 7 Achyranthes aspera. n. (-रं) A vessel for holding spirituous liquor. adv. A time, as वारं वारं many a time, repeatedly, often: see वारम्बारं. E. वृ to cover, to choose, &c., aff. घञ्.
वारक: वारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Opposing, obstructing, an obstacle or agent of resistance. m. (-कः) 1 A horse's paces. 2 A horse. -n. (-कं) 1 The seat of pain. 2 A sort of fragrant grass: see वाल. E. वृ to choose, &c., ण्वुल् aff.
वारकिन्: वारकिन् m. (-की) 1 The ocean. 2 A horse with good marks. 3 An enemy. 4 An ascetic, one living upon leaves, &c. E. वारक an obstacle, &c., इनि aff.
वारकीर: वारकीर m. (-रः) 1 A wife's brother. 2 Marine fire. 3 A louse. 4 A small comb. 5 A horse of high spirit, a war horse, a charger. 6 A bearer of burthens, a porter. E. वार् an obstacle, कॄ to scatter, aff. अच्.
वारङ्क: वारङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A bird in general. E. वार water, अकि to go, aff. अच्.
वारङ्ग: वारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The handle of a sword or knife, &c. E. वृ to select, aff. अङ्गच्, and the radical vowel changed to the Vṛddhi form.
वारट: वारट n. (-टं) 1 A field. 2 A number of fields. f. (-टा) A goose; also वरटा. E. वार् water, अट to go, aff. अच्.
वारण: वारण n. (-णं) 1 Resistance, opposition, prohibition, obstacle or impediment. 2 Defence, protecting, guarding. 3 Warding off a blow, guarding, warding. m. (-णः) 1 Armour, a cuirass, or mail for the body. 2 An elephant. E. वॄ to cover or screen, to defend, aff. ल्युट्.
वारणबुषा: वारणबुषा f. (-षा) The plantain or banana, (Musa sapientum.) E. वारण an elephant, बुष or बुस to cast off, aff. क; hence it is written also वारणबुसा; also वारवुषा.
वारणवल्लभा: वारणवल्लभा f. (-भा) The plantain tree. E. वारण an elephant, and वल्लभ beloved.
वारत्र: वारत्र n. (-त्रं) Leather fit for or made into thongs. E. वारत्रा a thong, and अण् aff.
वारनारी: वारनारी f. (-री) A harlot. E. वार, and नारी a woman.
वारमुख्या: वारमुख्या f. (-ख्या) The head of a set of harlots. E. वार a troop, and मुख्या a chief.
वारम्वारम्: वारम्वारम् ind. Repeatedly, again and again. E. वार a day, a time, repeated.
वारला: वारला f. (-ला) 1 A wasp. 2 A goose. E. वार a flock, a flight, ला to get, and क and टाप् aff.; also वरला, &c.
वारवधू: वारवधू f. (-धूः) The chief of a set of harlots. E. वार a number, and वधू wife.
वारवाण: वारवाण mn. (-णः-णं) Armour for the body or breast, an iron cuirass, or a thick quilted jacket worn for the same purpose. E. वार opposing, वाण an arrow; also वाणवार.
वारवाणि: वारवाणि m. (-णिः) 1 A player on the flute. 2 A singer, a musician. 3 A judge. 4 A year. f. (-णिः or -णी) 1 The chief of a set of harlots. 2 A whore. E. वार a multitude, वाणी speech.
वारविलासिनी: वारविलासिनी f. (-नी) A harlot, a whore. E. वार a multitude, and विलासिनी a wanton.
वारवेला: वारवेला f. (-ला) A portion of the day in which any act religious or secular is suspended. E. वार, and वेला time.
वारसुन्दरी: वारसुन्दरी f. (-री) A whore, a prostitute. E. वार the multitude, सुन्दरी a beauty.
वारसेवा: वारसेवा f. (-री) 1 A set of courtezans. 2 Prostitution, harlotry. E. वार the multitude, and सेवा service.
वारस्त्री: वारस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A whore. E. वार the many, and स्त्री a woman; a common woman.
वारांनिधि: वारांनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. वारां of water, and निधि receptacle.
वाराङ्गना: वाराङ्गना f. (-ना) A harlot. E. वार, and अङ्गना a woman.
वाराणसी: वाराणसी f. (-सी) The holy city Benares. E. वर best, अनस् water, affs. अण् and ङीष्, i. e. the Ganges on which it stands; also वराणसी.
वाराणसेय: वाराणसेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Produced at or born in Benares, &c. E. वाराणसी the city, and ढक् aff.
वारासन: वारासन n. (-नं) A large water jar, a cistern, a reservoir. E. वार् water, आसन place of abiding.
वाराह: वाराह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Relating to a boar, belonging to, derived from, &c. f. ही 1 An esculent root, a Yam, (Dioscorea.) 2 One of the divine mothers. 3 A measure. 4 The earth. 5 A sow. E. वराह a hog or VIṢṆU, &c., अण् aff., and ङीप् fem. form.
वारि: वारि n. (-रि) 1 Water. 2 A vegetable perfume, commonly Bāla. f. (-रिः) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech. 2 The place where an elephant is tied or fastened. 3 A captive, a prisoner. f. (-रिः or -री) 1 A water-pot, whether large or small, a pitcher, a jar. 2 The rope that fastens an elephant. 3 A hole or trap for catching elephants. E. वृञ् to surround, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
वारिकण्टक: वारिकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 Another plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. वारि water, and कण्डक a thorn.
वारिकर्णिका: वारिकर्णिका f. (-का) A plant, (Pistia stratiotes) E. वारि water, and कर्णिका here meaning leaf or leaflet.
वारिकर्पूर: वारिकर्पूर m. (-रः) The Ilīśa fish, (Cluponodon Ilisha, HAM.) E. वारि water, and कर्पूर camphor, to which it is compared in colour.
वारिकुब्ज: वारिकुब्ज m. (-ब्जः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. वारि water, कुब्ज Achyranthes; also with कन् added, वारिकुब्जक.
वारिक्रिमि: वारिक्रिमि m. (-मिः) A leech. E. वारि water, and क्रिमि a worm.
वारिचत्वर: वारिचत्वर m. (-रः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) 2 A piece of water. E. वारि water, चत्वर expanse.
वारिचर: वारिचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Aquatic, living or moving in water. m. (-रः) A fish. E. वारि water, and चर what goes.
वारिचामर: वारिचामर n. (-रं) A sort of weed, (Vallisneria.) E. वारि water, and चामर Chowri or brush.
वारिज: वारिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, born or produced in or by water. m. (-जः) 1 A conch shell. 2 Any bivalve shell. n. (-जं) 1 A lotus. 2 Salt. E. वारि water, and ज born.
वारित: वारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hindered, prevented, impeded. E. वॄ to cover, क्त aff.
वारितस्कर: वारितस्कर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. वारि water, तस्कर a thief.
वारित्रा: वारित्रा f. (-त्रा) A sort of umbrella, or portable shed of leaves carried on the head as one. E. वारि water, त्रा to preserve, affs. क and टाप्.
वारिद: वारिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) What yields water. m. (-दः) A cloud. n. (-दं) A sort of vegetable perfume; see वाल. E. वारि water, and द what yields.
वारिद्र: वारिद्र m. (-द्रः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. वारि water, दृ to take, aff. क.
वारिधि: वारिधि m. (-धिः) The sea. E. वारि water, घा to contain, aff. कि.
वारिनाथ: वारिनाथ m. (-थः) 1 The deity VARUṆA. 2 The ocean. 3 A cloud. 4 The habitation of the Nāgas, or serpent race. E. वारि water, नाथ lord.
वारिनिधि: वारिनिधि m. (-धिः) The sea, the ocean. E. वारि water, and निधि a receptacle.
वारिपथिक: वारिपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Proceeding or conveyed by water. E. वारि water, पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.
वारिपर्णी: वारिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, and पर्ण a leaf.
वारिप्रवाह: वारिप्रवाह m. (-हः) 1 A cascade, a water-fall. 2 A current or flow of water. E. वारि water, and प्रवाह a fall.
वारिप्रश्नी: वारिप्रश्नी f. (-श्नी) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, प्रश्नि the same.
वारिबदरा: वारिबदरा f. (-रा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. वारि water, वदर jujube.
वारिबालक: वारिबालक m. (-कं) A perfume: see वाल. E. वारि water, वाल a perfume.
वारिमसि: वारिमसि n. (-सिः) A cloud. E. वारि water, मसि ink.
वारिमुच्: वारिमुच् m. (-मुक्) A cloud. E. वारि water, and मुच् what emits.
वारिमूली: वारिमूली f. (-ली) An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.) E. वारि water, मूल a root.
वारिर: वारिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Giving or shedding water. m. (-रः) A cloud. E. वारि, and रा to give, क aff.
वारिरथ: वारिरथ m. (-थः) A raft, a float. E. वारि water, and रथ a carriage.
वारिरारव: वारिरारव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Sounding like clouds or thunder. E. वारिर, and आरव sound.
वारिराशि: वारिराशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. वारि water, and राशि a heap.
वारिलोमन्: वारिलोमन् m. (-मा) A name of VARUṆA. E. वारि water, and लोमन् hair.
वारिवदन: वारिवदन m. (-नः) A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. वारि water, and वदन countenance.
वारिवास: वारिवास m. (-सः) A distiller or dealer in spirituous liquors. E. वारि water, वास abode.
वारिवाह: वारिवाह m. (-हः) A cloud. E. वारि water, and वाह what bears; also वारिवाहन.
वारिवाहन: वारिवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud. E. वारि water, and वाहन a vehicle.
वारिश: वारिश m. (-शः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. वारि water, शीङ् to sleep, aff. ड.
वारीट: वारीट m. (-टः) An elephant. E. वारि the trap for an elephant, अट to go, aff. अच्, form irr.
वारीश: वारीश m. (-शः) The ocean. E. वार water, and ईश lord.
वारु: वारु m. (-रुः) A war elephant carrying a standard. E. वृ to cover, aff. उण्.
वारुठ: वारुठ m. (-ठः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried. E. वृ to cover, aff. उठञ्.
वारुणि: वारुणि m. (-णिः) The saint AGASTYA. E. वरुण VARUṆA, and इञ् aff. of descent.
वारुणी: वारुणी f. (-णी) 1 Any spirituous liquor, or more properly, a particular kind prepared from hogweed, ground with the juice of the date or palm, and then distilled. 2 The west, the region of VARUṆA. 3 The 25th lunar asterism, of which VARUṆA is the ruling deity. 4 A species of Dūrbbā grass. E. वरुण the deity VARUṆA, अण् and ङीष् affs.
वारुणीवल्लभ: वारुणीवल्लभ m. (-भः) VARUṆA. E. वारुणी the asterism, and वल्लभ loved.
वारुण्ड: वारुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The chief of the serpent race (?). mn. (-ण्डः-ण्ड) 1 The rheum of the eyes. 2 The wax of the ear. 3 A vessel for baling water out of a boat. E. वॄ to screen, aff. उण्ड.
वारेण: वारेण ind. Frequently, repeatedly. E. वार a time in the third case.
वारेन्द्री: वारेन्द्री f. (-न्द्री) Part of Bengal and Behar, or a tract of inundation north of the Ganges, and part of the present Zila of Rājṣāhi. E. वरेन्द्र a king, अण् aff.
वार्क्ष: वार्क्ष mfn. (-र्क्षः-र्क्षी-र्क्षं) Made of or derived from a tree. n. (-र्क्षं) A forest. f. (-र्क्षी) The name of a female mentioned in the Mahābhārata, a sort of Dryad. E. वृक्ष a tree, अण् aff.
वार्क्ष्य: वार्क्ष्य mfn. (-र्क्ष्यः-र्क्ष्यी-र्क्ष्यं) Made of or with trees. n. (-क्ष्य) A stockade. E. वृक्ष a tree, यञ् aff.
वार्णिक: वार्णिक m. (-कः) A scribe, a writer. E. वर्ण a letter, ठञ् aff.
वार्त: वार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Well, healthy. 2 Following any business or profession. m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Health. 2 Chaff. f. (-र्त्ता) 1 Tidings, news, intelligence. 2 Rumour, report. 3 Livelihood, business, profession. 4 Agriculture or trade, the proper occupation of the Vaiśya. 5 Abiding, staying, being. 6 The egg-plant. E. वृत्ति being, &c., aff. अण् or ण.
वार्त्त: वार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) 1 Well, healthy. 2 Following any business or profession. m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Health. 2 Chaff. f. (-र्त्ता) 1 Tidings, news, intelligence. 2 Rumour, report. 3 Livelihood, business, profession. 4 Agriculture or trade, the proper occupation of the Vaiśya. 5 Abiding, staying, being. 6 The egg-plant. E. वृत्ति being, &c., aff. अण् or ण.
वार्ताक: वार्त्ताक m. (-कः) The egg-plant: see वार्त्ताकु, उ being changed to अ.
वार्त्ताक: वार्त्ताक m. (-कः) The egg-plant: see वार्त्ताकु, उ being changed to अ.
वार्ताकर्मन्: वार्त्ताकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The peculiar occupation of the third or Vaiśya class, agriculture, trade, &c. E. वार्त्ता, and कर्म्मन् act.
वार्त्ताकर्म्मन्: वार्त्ताकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The peculiar occupation of the third or Vaiśya class, agriculture, trade, &c. E. वार्त्ता, and कर्म्मन् act.
वार्ताकि: वार्त्ताकि f. (-किः or -की) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकिन् aff.; ङीप् or इन् fem. aff., form irr.; also वार्त्ताकु.
वार्त्ताकि: वार्त्ताकि f. (-किः or -की) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकिन् aff.; ङीप् or इन् fem. aff., form irr.; also वार्त्ताकु.
वार्ताकिन्: वार्त्ताकिन् m. (-की) The egg-plant; also वार्त्ताकि, &c.
वार्त्ताकिन्: वार्त्ताकिन् m. (-की) The egg-plant; also वार्त्ताकि, &c.
वार्ताकु: वार्त्ताकु m. (-कुः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकु Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long by special rule.
वार्त्ताकु: वार्त्ताकु m. (-कुः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. वृत to be, काकु Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long by special rule.
वार्त्तायन: वार्त्तायन m. (-नः) A spy, an emissary, an agent, an embassador, an intelligencer, a newsmonger. E. वार्त्ता news, and अयन going.
वार्त्तावह: वार्त्तावह m. (-हः) 1 A chandler. 2 A messenger. E. वार्त्ता news, वह to bear, aff. अच्.
वार्त्तावृत्ति: वार्त्तावृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A householder. E. वार्त्ता news, and वृत्ति business.
वार्तिक: वार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to news, bringing or conveying intelligence, &c. 2 Commentatory, explanatory, belonging to a comment or gloss, (as a rule, &c.) m. (-कः) 1 An intelligencer, an informer, an agent or envoy. 2 A man of the third or mercantile tribe. n. (-कं) A gloss, a commentary, especially a supplementary explanation added to a grammatical or philosophical aphorism, and its immediate elucidation, supplying or illustrating both text and comment; it is defined to be, the exposition of the meaning, of that which is said, of that which is left unsaid, and of that which is ill or imperfectly said. f. (-का) A quail. E. वृत्ति news, &c., or a comment, aff. ठक्.
वार्त्तिक: वार्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to news, bringing or conveying intelligence, &c. 2 Commentatory, explanatory, belonging to a comment or gloss, (as a rule, &c.) m. (-कः) 1 An intelligencer, an informer, an agent or envoy. 2 A man of the third or mercantile tribe. n. (-कं) A gloss, a commentary, especially a supplementary explanation added to a grammatical or philosophical aphorism, and its immediate elucidation, supplying or illustrating both text and comment; it is defined to be, the exposition of the meaning, of that which is said, of that which is left unsaid, and of that which is ill or imperfectly said. f. (-का) A quail. E. वृत्ति news, &c., or a comment, aff. ठक्.
वार्त्त्रघ्न: वार्त्त्रघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The prince ARJUNA. E. वृत्रघ्न INDRA, and अण् aff.
वार्दर: वार्द्दर n. (-रं) 1 Silk. 2 Water. 3 The seed of the Abrus precatorius. 4 A conch shell. 5 A sort of curl on the right side of a horse's neck, considered as an auspicious mark. 6 Speech. E. वार् water, दृ to divide, aff. अप्.
वार्द्दर: वार्द्दर n. (-रं) 1 Silk. 2 Water. 3 The seed of the Abrus precatorius. 4 A conch shell. 5 A sort of curl on the right side of a horse's neck, considered as an auspicious mark. 6 Speech. E. वार् water, दृ to divide, aff. अप्.
वार्दल: वार्द्दल n. (-लं) A rainy day, bad weather, &c. m. (-लः) An inkstand. E. वार् water, and द what gives, वार्द a cloud, ला to take, aff. क.
वार्द्दल: वार्द्दल n. (-लं) A rainy day, bad weather, &c. m. (-लः) An inkstand. E. वार् water, and द what gives, वार्द a cloud, ला to take, aff. क.
वार्द्धक: वार्द्धक n. (-कं) 1 A number of old men. 2 Old age. 3 The infirmity, &c. of old age. E. वृद्ध old, वुञ् aff.
वार्द्धक्य: वार्द्धक्य n. (-क्यं) Old age. E. वृद्ध old, and ष्यञ् aff.
वार्द्धि: वार्द्धि m. (-र्द्धिः) The ocean. E. वार् water, घा to have, aff. कि.
वार्द्धुषि: वार्द्धुषि m. (-षिः) A usurer. E. वृद्धि interest or increase, वृधुषि substituted, aff. ठक्, and the क rejected; also वार्द्धुषिक, form irr.
वार्द्धुषिक: वार्द्धुषिक m. (-कः) A usurer: see the last.
वार्द्धुषिन्: वार्द्धुषिन् m. (-षी) A usurer. E. वृधुषि substituted for वृद्धि, and इनि aff.
वार्द्धुष्य: वार्द्धुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Usurious loan, usury, interest. E. वृद्धि increase, aff. ष्यञ्, form irr.
