वार्द्ध: वार्द्ध nf. (-र्द्धं-र्द्धी) A thong. E. वृद्ध to increase, to lengthen, aff. ष्ट्र, and अञ् added.
वार्द्धीणस: वार्द्धीणस m. (-सः) An old white goat with long ears. E. वार्द्धी a leather thong, and नस for नासिका a nose.
वार्भट: वार्भट m. (-टः) An alligator. E. वार् water, भट to maintain, aff. अच्.
वार्मण: वार्म्मण n. (-णं) A number of coats of mail. E. वर्म्मण् armour, aff. अण्.
वार्म्मण: वार्म्मण n. (-णं) A number of coats of mail. E. वर्म्मण् armour, aff. अण्.
वार्मिण: वार्म्मिण n. (-णं) A number of men in armour. E. वर्म्मिन् a man in armour, and अण् aff.
वार्म्मिण: वार्म्मिण n. (-णं) A number of men in armour. E. वर्म्मिन् a man in armour, and अण् aff.
वार्मुच्: वार्म्मुच् m. (-र्म्मुक्) A cloud. E. वार् water, भुच् to let loose, aff. क्विप्.
वार्म्मुच्: वार्म्मुच् m. (-र्म्मुक्) A cloud. E. वार् water, भुच् to let loose, aff. क्विप्.
वार्य: वार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be selected or appointed. 2 To be impeded, checked, stopped, &c. E. वृङ् to choose, aff. ण्यत्.
वार्य्य: वार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be selected or appointed. 2 To be impeded, checked, stopped, &c. E. वृङ् to choose, aff. ण्यत्.
वार्यमाण: वार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being prevented, impeded, prohibited, &c. E. वृ to select, passive v., शानच् aff.
वार्य्यमाण: वार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being prevented, impeded, prohibited, &c. E. वृ to select, passive v., शानच् aff.
वार्युद्भव: वार्य्युद्भव n. (-वं) A lotus. E. वारि water, उद्भव born.
वार्य्युद्भव: वार्य्युद्भव n. (-वं) A lotus. E. वारि water, उद्भव born.
वार्योक: वार्य्योक m. (-कः) A leech. E. वारि, and ओकस् abode.
वार्य्योक: वार्य्योक m. (-कः) A leech. E. वारि, and ओकस् abode.
वार्राशि: वार्राशि m. (-शिः) The ocean. E. वार्, and राशि quantity.
वार्वट: वार्व्वट m. (-टः) A boat, a vessel. E. वार् water, वट to surround, aff. अच्.
वार्व्वट: वार्व्वट m. (-टः) A boat, a vessel. E. वार् water, वट to surround, aff. अच्.
वार्ष: वार्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षी-ष) Belonging to a year, to the rains, &c. E. वर्ष, and अण् aff.
वार्षिक: वार्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Yearly, annual, or belonging to a year. 2 Growing, &c. in the rainy season, or fit for or suited to it, &c. n. (-कं) A drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa. E. वर्ष rains, or a year, and ठक् or ठञ् aff.
वार्षिला: वार्षिला f. (-ला) Hail. E. वार्ष belonging to rain, from वर्ष, with अण् aff., इलच् added.
वार्षुक: वार्षुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sprinkling, wetting, that which sprinkles, &c. E. वृष to sprinkle, उकञ् aff.
वार्हत: वार्हत n. (-तं) The fruit of the Solanum jacquini. E. वृहति the plant, with अण् aff.
वार्हद्रथ: वार्हद्रथ m. (-थः) A name of JARĀSAṂDHA. E. वृहद्रथ the father of this prince, and अण् patronymic; also with इञ् aff. वार्हद्रथि.
वार्हस्पत: वार्हस्पत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Sacred to VṚHASPATI. E. वृहस्पति, and अण् aff.
वार्हस्पत्य: वार्हस्पत्य n. (-त्यं) Ethics, morality. E. वृहस्पति the supposed original author of this science, and ण्य aff.
वालक: वालक m. (-कः) 1 A bracelet. 2 A finger-ring. E. वल to surround, aff. ण्वुल्.
वाल्क: वाल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Made of the bark of trees. E. वल्क bark, aff. अण्.
वाल्कल: वाल्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Made of bark. f. (-ली) Spirituous liquor. n. (-लं) A dress made of the bark of trees worn by ascetics. E. वल्कल bark, and अण् aff.
वाल्मिकि: वाल्मिकि m. (-किः) The author of the Rāmāyaṇa; also वाल्मीकि.
वाल्मीक: वाल्मीक m. (-कः) VĀLMĪKA or VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa. E. वल्मीक an ant-hill, aff. अण्, or with इञ् aff. वाल्मीकि; so immersed in abstraction as to be overrun with ant's nests.
वावदूक: वावदूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Talking much, gabbling, prattling. E. वद to speak, Uṇādi aff. ऊक, the root reiterated.
वावदूकता: वावदूकता f. (-ता) Garrulity, loquaciousness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, वावटूकत्वं.
वावय: वावय m. (-यः) A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)
वावहि: वावहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Who or what bears or carries much. E. वह to bear, कि aff.
वावृत: वावृत(उ) r. 4th cl. वावृतु (वावृत्यते) 1 To choose or select. 2 To serve.
वावृत्त: वावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Chosen, appointed. E. वृत to be, aff. क्त, and the root reiterated.
वावृत्यमान: वावृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Choosing, preferring. E. वावृत to choose, शानच् aff.
वाश: वाश(ऋ)वाशृ r. 4th cl. (वाश्यते) 1 To sound. 2 To cry as a bird. 3 To call.
वाशत्: वाशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Crying or singing like a bird. E. वाश to cry, aff. शतृ.
वाशन: वाशन n. (-नं) The cry or song of birds, bees, and the like. E. वाश to sound as a bird, ल्युट् aff.
वाशा: वाशा f. (-शा) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa:) see वास, and वासक; also with कन् added वाशिका.
वाशि: वाशि m. (-शिः) Fire. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
वाशित: वाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Sung, called, cried. n. (-तं) The cry of birds or animals. f. (-ता) 1 A woman. 2 A female elephant. E. वाष to call, or वास to perfume, aff. क्त, and स changed to श.
वाशिष्ठ: वाशिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Relating to the sage VASIṢṬHA. f. (-ष्ठी) The Goomti river, which rising in the Kemaün hills, pursues a winding and south-easterly course, and passing Lucknow and Jonpur falls into the Ganges, below Benares. E. वशिष्ठ the saint, अण् aff., derived from him.
वाशुरा: वाशुरा f. (-रा) Night. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
वाश्र: वाश्र m. (-श्रः) A day. n. (-श्रं) 1 An edifice, a dwelling, a building. 2 A place where four roads meet. E. वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. रक्; also read वास्र.
वाष्कल: वाष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Large, great. m. (-लः) A warrior.
वाष्प: वाष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 Vapour, hot mist, steam, &c. 2 A tear. 3 Iron. f. (-ष्पी) A drug. E. वा to go, or वै to dry, aff. प, form irr.; also बाष्प derived from वाध to oppose, and ध changed to ष.
वाष्पका: वाष्पका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri. E. कन् added to वाष्प vapour; also वाष्पिका.
वाष्पाकल: वाष्पाकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Uttered or articulated with tears. E. वाष्प, and आकल what sounds.
वाष्पाकुल: वाष्पाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Interrupted by tears. E. वाष्प, and आकुल perplexed.
वाष्पिका: वाष्पिका f. (-का) A drug, commonly Hingupatri. E. वाष्प a tear, कन् aff., form irr.
वाष्पोद्भव: वाष्पोद्भव m. (-वः) Starting of tears. E. वाष्प, and उद्भव production.
वास: वास r. 10th cl. (वासयति) To introduce another quality, but especially fragrant odors, to perfume, to incense, to fumigate, &c. (ऋ) वासृ r. 4th cl. (वास्यते) To sound, especially as a bird.

वास m. (-सः) 1 A house, a habitation. 2 Site, situation, abode, or place of staying or abiding. 3 Cloth, clothes. 4 Perfuming. mf. (-सः-सा) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वस to dwell, aff. घञ्, or वास to fumigate, aff. अच्.
वासःकुटी: वासःकुटी f. (-टी) A tent. E. वासस् cloth, and कुटी a hut.
वासक: वासक mf. (-कः-का) A shrub, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वास to perfume, aff. ण्वुल्.
वासकसज्जा: वासकसज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman dressed with all her ornaments, and having her apartments, &c. decorated to receive her lover. E. वास clothes, कन् pleonasm, and सज्जा accoutrements; also with कन् added, वासकसज्जिका.
वासकर्णी: वासकर्णी f. (-र्णी) A hall, where public exhibitions, as Nāces, &c. are held. E. वास a house, कर्ण the ear, aff. ङीप्.
वासगृह: वासगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bed-chamber. E. वास abiding, and गृह a house.
वासतेय: वासतेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Habitable, fit or proper to be dwelt in. f. (-यी) Night. E. वसति abode, or night, ढक् aff.
वासन: वासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for clothes, or a dwelling, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Perfuming, fumigating or perfuming with fragrant vapour, or with incense, &c. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 Abiding, abode. 4 A particular posture in which abstract meditation is performed; it is also a posture conceived to be peculiarly proper in princes and chiefs, and is then described as sitting with the knees bent and the feet turned backwards. 5 Knowledge. 6 A water-jar. 7 A box, a basket, a vessel, &c. 8 An envelope. 9 Any receptacle. 10 Steeping, infusing. f. (-ना) 1 The knowledge of any thing derived from memory, the present consciousness of past perceptions. 2 Fancy, imagination. 3 Trust, confidence. 4 Ignorance. E. वस to dwell, &c., aff. युच्; or वसन clothes, and अण् aff.
वासनस्थ: वासनस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Packed, folded, enveloped. E. वासन a box, &c., and स्थ what stays or is.
वासन्त: वासन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) 1 Placed, situated. 2 Vernal, relating to the season of spring, suitable to it, produced in it, &c. 3 Young, in the spring of life. 4 Diligent in the performance of religious ceremonies. m. (-न्तः) 1 A camel. 2 The Indian cuckoo. 3 Any young animal, or a young elephant. 4 A catamite. 5 The southern wind, zephyr. 6 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) 7 The black kind of Moong or bean. 8 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) 9 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. f. (-न्ती) 1 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.) 3 Long pepper. 4 Trumpet flower. 5 A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra. 6 A species of the Śarkarī metre. E. वस to dwell, aff. झच्, and the vowel made long; or वसन्त spring, and अण् aff.
वासन्तक: वासन्तक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Sown or growing in spring. 2 Suitable to the spring season. 3 Relating or belonging to it, vernal. E. वसन्त spring, and वुञ् aff.
वासन्तिक: वासन्तिक m. (-कः) An actor, a dancer. E. वसन्त spring, aff. ठक्; the spring being the festival season.
वासयोग: वासयोग m. (-गः) Fragrant powder sprinkled on the clothes, especially the red powder scattered about at the Holi festival. E. वास perfume, and योग joining.
वासर: वासर mn. (-रः-रं) A day. m. (-रः) One of the Nāgas or serpents. E. वस to abide, in the causal form, Uṇādi aff. अर.
वासरसङ्ग: वासरसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Morning. E. वासर, and सङ्ग connexion.
वासव: वासव m. (-वः) INDRA. f. (-वी) The mother of VYĀSA. E. वसु a Vasu, and अण् aff.
वासस्: वासस् n. (-सः) Cloth, clothes. E. वस to cover or clothe, aff. असुन्.
वाससज्जा: वाससज्जा f. (-ज्जा) A woman drest in all her ornaments to receive her lover. E. वास clothes, सज्ज armed, accoutred.
वासागार: वासागार n. (-रं) The inner or sleeping apartment. E. वास abiding, and आगार a house.
वासि: वासि mf. (-सिः-सी) A small hatchet or chopper, an adze. m. (-सिः) Abiding, dwelling. E. वस to abide, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
वासिका: वासिका f. (-का) A plant. (Justicia:) see वासक.
वासित: वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Perfumed, scented. 2 Clothed, dressed. 3 Famous, celebrated. 4 Steeped, infused. 5 Spiced, seasoned, (sauces, &c.) 6 Peopled, populous, flourishing, (a country.) 7 Having, possessing. n. (-तं) 1 The cry of birds. 2 Knowledge in general, but especially that derived from memory. 3 Sound. 4 Rendering a country populous and flourishing, causing it to be inhabited. f. (-ता) 1 A woman. 2 A female elephant. E. वस to dwell, or clothe, causal form, or वास to call, (as a bird,) aff. क्त
वासिन्: वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Abiding, staying. f. (-नी) A white sort of Jhiṇṭi, (Barleria.) E. वस to dwell, घिनुण् aff.
वासिष्ठ: वासिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Explained or composed by the sage VASIṢṬHA, a part of the Vedas or a particular prayer, &c. E. वसिष्ठ, and अण् aff.
वासु: वासु m. (-सुः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 The soul, or the SUPREME BEIṄG considered as the soul of the universe. E. वस to abide (eternally,) उण् Uṇādi aff.
वासुकि: वासुकि m. (-किः) The serpent VĀSUKI, sovereign of the snakes. E. वसु a jewel, क the head, वसुक here said to be a name of KAŚYAPA, aff. of descent इञ्.
वासुकेय: वासुकेय m. (-यः) The serpent VĀSUKI. E. see the last, aff. ढक्.
वासुकेयस्वसृ: वासुकेयस्वसृ f. (-सा) A name of MANASĀ, the wife of JARATKĀRU, and goddess presiding over snakes. E. वासुकेय the serpent VĀSUKI, and स्वसृ a sister.
वासुदेव: वासुदेव m. (-वः) 1 KṚṢṆA. 2 A descendant of VASUDEVA, the general appellation of a class of persons peculiar to the Jainas. E. वसुदेव the father of the deity, and अण् patronymic aff.
वासुपूज्य: वासुपूज्य m. (-ज्यः) The twelfth Jina or Jaina teacher of the present era.
वासुभद्र: वासुभद्र m. (-द्रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. वासु the soul, and भद्र auspicious.
वासुरा: वासुरा f. (-रा) 1 Night. 2 The earth. 3 A woman. 4 A female elephant. E. वास to perfume, or वस to abide, in the causal form, aff. उरच्.
वासू: वासू f. (-सूः) A young girl, (in theatrical language.) E. वस to abide, in the causal form, (to take to dwell with one,) aff. ऊ.
वासोद: वासोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives clothes. E. वासस्, and द what gives.
वासोयुग: वासोयुग n. (-गं) A suit of clothes. E. वासस्, and युग a pair.
वासौकस्: वासौकस् n. (-कः) The inner or private apartments. E. वास dwelling, and ओकस् a house.
वास्त: वास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं) Made or derived from a goat. E. वस्त, and अण् aff.
वास्तव: वास्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Determined, demonstrated, fixed, substantiated. 2 Real, substantial. n. (-वं) An appointment. E. वस्तु thing, substance, अण् aff.
वास्तविक: वास्तविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Real, material, substantial, genuine. 2 Determinate. E. वस्तु, and ठक् aff.
वास्तवोषा: वास्तवोषा f. (-षा) Night. E. वास्तव an appointment, and ऊषा a libidinous woman: the season in which she makes an assignation.
वास्तव्य: वास्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be abided or dwelt in, to be fixed as a habitation. 2 To be taken care of, (as a dependant.) m. (-व्यः) A kinsman, a dependant. E. वस to dwell, causal form, aff. of the future participle तव्यर्.
वास्तु: वास्तु mn. (-स्तुः-स्तु) 1 The site of a habitation. 2 A house, a habitation. E. वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. तुन्, and the radical vowel made long by special rule.
वास्तुक: वास्तुक n. (-कं) A potherb: see वास्तूक.
वास्तुसंशमन: वास्तुसंशमन n. (-नं) A ceremony or sacrifice performed on entering a new habitation. E. वास्तु, and संशमन consecration.
वास्तुसंशमनीय: वास्तुसंशमनीय n. (-यं) A ceremony performed on entering a new mansion. E. छ added to the preceding.
वास्तूक: वास्तूक n. (-कं) A potherb, (Chenopodium album, and other edible species.) E. वास्तु the site of a house, ठक् aff., and form irr. (growing there;) also with the vowel unaltered कास्तुक.
वास्तेय: वास्तेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Abdominal, relating or belonging to the belly. E. वस्ति, and ढक् aff.
वास्तोस्पति: वास्तोस्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA. E. वास्तु the site of a dwelling, in the sixth case, and पति master.
वास्त्र: वास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः-स्त्री-स्त्रं) Cloth, made of or covered with cloth, &c. E. वस्त्र cloth, अण् aff.
वास्प: वास्प m. (-स्पः) 1 Vapor. 2 Tears; more correctly वाष्प, q. v.
वास्पविक्लव: वास्पविक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Weeping, bursting into tears. E. वास्प, and विक्लव distressed.
वास्पाविलेक्षण: वास्पाविलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Suffused with tears, weeping. E. वास्प, आविल turbid, ईक्षण the sight.
वाह: वाह(ऋ)वाहृ r. 1st cl. (वाहते) To endeavour: the root is preferably read वाहृ.

वाह m. (-हः) 1 A horse. 2 A measure of capacity containing ten Kumbhas, or nearly equal to the weight of an English wey or a ton in freight. 3 A bull. 4 Air, wind. 5 The arm. 6 A buffalo. 7 A vehicle, a carriage or conveyance of any kind. 8 A bearer, a porter, a carrier of burthens, &c. E. वह to bear, aff. घञ्.
वाहक: वाहक m. (-कः) 1 A horseman. 2 A porter, a carrier. E. वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.
वाहद्विषत्: वाहद्विषत् m. (-षन्) A buffalo. E. वाह a horse, and द्विषत् inimical.
वाहन: वाहन n. (-नं) 1 A vehicle, a conveyance of any kind, as a horse, an elephant, a carriage. 2 Carrying, conveying, &c. 3 Marking effort or exertion. E. वह to bear, in the causal form, or वाह to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.
वाहभ्रंश्: वाहभ्रंश् mfn. (-भ्रट्) Falling from a vehicle, &c. E. वाह, भ्रंश to fall, क्विप् aff.
वाहयत्: वाहयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Employing, making use of. E. वह to bear, causal v., शतृ aff.
वाहस: वाहस m. (-सः) 1 A large snake, (Boa constrictor.) 2 A watercourse. 3 A potherb, (Marsilia dentata.) E. वह to bear, in the causal form, aff. असच्.
वाहिक: वाहिक m. (-कः) 1 A large drum. 2 A car, &c. drawn by oxen. E. वाह bearing, and ठक् aff.
वाहित: वाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Exerted, endeavoured. E. वाह to endeavour, क्त aff.
वाहित्थ: वाहित्थ n. (-त्थं) The part of an elephant's forehead below the frontal globes. E. वाहिन्, स्था to stay, aff. क, and स changed to त.
वाहिन्: वाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Bearing, carrying. E. वह to bear, णिनि aff.
वाहिनी: वाहिनी f. (-नी) 1 An army. 2 A body of forces consisting of 81 elephants, 81 cars, 243 horse, 405 foot, a cohort, a battalion. 3 A river. E. वाह a vehicle, &c., aff. इनि; fem. aff. ङीप्, comprising the conveyances of cars, horse, &c.
वाहिनीनिवेश: वाहिनीनिवेश m. (-शः) A camp. E. वाहिनी, and निवेश encampment.
वाहिनीपति: वाहिनीपति m. (-तिः) 1 A general, a commanding officer. 2 The ocean. E. वाहिनी an army or river, and पति master.
वाहीक: वाहीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Of burthen, bearing burthens. 2 Outer, external. m. (-कः) The name of a country, part of the Punjab. E. वाह bearing, or वाहिर् external, aff. ईकक् or ईकञ्, form irr.
वाह्य: वाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be carried or borne. 2 Outer, external. n. (-ह्यं) A carriage, a vehicle. m. (-ह्यः) A beast of burthen, an ox, a horse, &c. E. वह to bear, aff. ण्यत्, or वहिर् external, यञ् aff.: see वाह्य.
वाह्यतस्: वाह्यतस् ind. Externally, solitarily. E. तसि added to the preceding.
वाह्यमान: वाह्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being carried or conveyed. 2 Being induced, urged, incited, &c. E. वह to bear, pass. v., शानच् aff.
वाह्लि: वाह्लि f. (-ह्लिः) A country: see वाह्लीक.
वाह्लिज: वाह्लिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in Vahli or Vāhlika country. m. यः A Turki horse. E. वाह्लि, and ज born.
वाह्लीक: वाह्लीक m. (-कः) 1 A country lying north-west of Afghanistan, Balkh. 2 A horse from Balkh, considered as one of a good breed. 3 One of the principal Gandharbas or choristers of heaven. n. (-कं) 1 Saffron. 2 Asafoetida. E. वल्ह to be preeminent, इकन् or ईकन् aff., वह्लिक or वह्लीक; again, अण्.  pleonastic or derivative added, वाह्लिक; or वाह्लीक, the conjunct letters of the root being transposed; saffron, &c. are supplied still to India, especially from Kashmir, Khorasan, and the countries in that direction.
वि: वि mf. (-विः-वी) 1 A bird. 2 The eye. 3 Heaven. 4 The region of the wind. ind. A particle and prefix, implying: 1 Certainty, ascertainment, as विवेक्तुं to determine, to judge. 2 Separation, disjunction, as वियोक्तु to disjoin. 3 Aversion, repugnance, as विरोद्धु to oppose. 4 Impatience, intolerance, as विनृष्टं to be impatient. 5 Variety, difference, विशेष्टु to distinguish. 6 Cause, motive, विघातुं to prescribe or order. 7 Motion, progress, विचरितुं to go. 8 Privation, विणीतुं to take away. It generally corresponds to the English adjuncts, a, ex, de, dis, in, un, &c. and is frequently an expletive. E. वा to go, Uṇādi aff. इन् with the effect of डित् or ड, which ejects the final syllable.
विंश: विंश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Twentieth. E. विंशति twenty, and डट् aff.
विंशक: विंशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Twenty, collectively, or an aggregate of twenty. E. विंशति, and ड्वुन् aff.
विंशति: विंशति always f. sing. (-तिः) Twenty, a score. du. (-ती) Two twenties. plu. (-तयः) Many twenties.
विंशतिक: विंशतिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Worth twenty, produced from or bought with twenty, &c. E. विंशति twenty, and कन् added.
विंशतितम: विंशतितम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Twentieth. E. विंशति, and तमट् aff.
विंशतीश: विंशतीश m. (-शः) A governor of twenty villages. E. विंशति, and ईश sovereign; also विंशतीशिन्.
विंशिन्: विंशिन् m. (-शी) Twenty, (collectively,) a score. E. विंशति, and डिन् aff.
विक: विक n. (-कं) The milk of a prolific cow.
विकङ्कट: विकङ्कट m. (-टः) A plant, (Ruellia longifolia, &c.:) see गोक्षुर. E. वि apart, ककि to go, aff. अटन्.
विकङ्कत: विकङ्कत m. (-तः) A small tree. E. वि apart, separate, ककि to go or grow, अतच् aff., or वि a bird, ककि, &c. as before; on which the birds roost.
विकच: विकच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Blown, opened, expanded, spread, (as a flower, &c.) 2 Bald, having little or no hair on the head. m. (-चः) 1 A Bauddha mendicant. 2 The planet KETU, or the personified descending node. E. वि apart, separate, कच to go, aff. अच्, or वि privative, and कच hair.
विकट: विकट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Large, great. 2 Formidable, frightful, hideous, horrible. 3 Large-toothed. 4 Beautiful, pleasing. 5 Changed in form or appearance. 6 Obscure, obsolete. n. (-टं) A bile, a tumour. f. (-टा) A female divinity peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. वि implying separation or expansion, कट to go or be, aff. अच्, or with कटच् aff.
विकण्टक: विकण्टक m. (-कः) A herbaceous plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. वि expanding, कण्ट a thorn, कन् added.
विकत्थन: विकत्थन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Speaking idly. 2 Praising ironically. 3 Vaunting, boastful. n. (-नं) 1 Irony, ironical or unmerited praise. 2 Praise in general. 3 Assigning any thing to an unreal origin. 4 Boasting. 5 Repeating, proclaiming. E. वि implying difference or extension, and कत्थन praising.
विकत्थनीय: विकत्थनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be praised, commendable. 2 Ridiculous, to be praised ironically. E. वि before कत्थ to praise, अनीयर् aff.
विकत्था: विकत्था f. (-त्था) 1 Praise. 2 Irony, ironical praise. 3 Boasting. 4 Repeating, proclaiming. E. वि, कत्थ to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.
विकत्थिन्: विकत्थिन् mfn. (-त्थी-त्थिनी-त्थि) Who or what boasts, praises, proclaims, &c.: see विकथन. E. वि, कत्य to boast, घिनुण् aff.
विकम्प: विकम्प mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं) 1 Trembling. 2 Heaving. 3 Unsteady, not firm or continued.. 4 Shrinking form. E. वि, and कम्प trembling.
विकम्पित: विकम्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Trembling, tremulous, agitated. 2 Palpitating, heaving. 3 Broken, interrupted, unsteady. 4 Shrinking from. E. वि before कपि to tremble, aff. क्त.
विकर: विकर m. (-रः) Sickness, disease. E. वि implying difference, and कर making.
विकराल: विकराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Formidable, frightful. E. वि intensitive, and कराल frightful.
विकर्ण: विकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Ear-less. m. (-र्णं) One of the KURU princes. E. वि, and कर्ण an ear, or a proper name.
विकर्णिक: विकर्णिक m. (-कः) Sārasvata, a district in the north-west of Hindustan, generally considered as part of the Punjab, though sometimes confounded with Kashmir. E. वि privative, and कर्ण KARṆA; aff. ठक्; the region from which KARṆA was proscribed.
विकर्तन: विकर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A son who has usurped his father's kingdom. E. वि before कृत to cut, aff. ल्युट्; having been shorn of some of his beams, by VIŚVAKARMA.
विकर्त्तन: विकर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 A son who has usurped his father's kingdom. E. वि before कृत to cut, aff. ल्युट्; having been shorn of some of his beams, by VIŚVAKARMA.
विकर्मकृत्: विकर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Acting illegally, one who does forbidden acts. 2 Busy in various ways. E. विकर्म्म, and कृत् who does.
विकर्म्मकृत्: विकर्म्मकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) 1 Acting illegally, one who does forbidden acts. 2 Busy in various ways. E. विकर्म्म, and कृत् who does.
विकर्मक्रिया: विकर्म्मक्रिया f. (-या) Illegal or immoral act. E. विकर्म्म, and क्रिया act.
विकर्म्मक्रिया: विकर्म्मक्रिया f. (-या) Illegal or immoral act. E. विकर्म्म, and क्रिया act.
विकर्मन्: विकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Various business or duty. 2 Prohibited or unlawful act. 3 Fraud. E. वि, and कर्म्मन् act.
विकर्म्मन्: विकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Various business or duty. 2 Prohibited or unlawful act. 3 Fraud. E. वि, and कर्म्मन् act.
विकर्मस्थ: विकर्म्मस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Doing what is illegal or immoral, engaged in prohibited acts. 2 Engaged in various business. E. विकर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.
विकर्म्मस्थ: विकर्म्मस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Doing what is illegal or immoral, engaged in prohibited acts. 2 Engaged in various business. E. विकर्म्म, and स्थ who or what stays.
विकर्मिक: विकर्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Doing forbidden acts. 2 Transacting various affairs. m. (-कः) Clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs. E. वि implying variety, कर्म्म business, and ठक् aff.
विकर्म्मिक: विकर्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Doing forbidden acts. 2 Transacting various affairs. m. (-कः) Clerk or superintendant of markets or fairs. E. वि implying variety, कर्म्म business, and ठक् aff.
विकर्ष: विकर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Pulling, pulling apart or out. 2 An arrow. E. वि separate, कृष to attract, अच् aff.
विकर्षण: विकर्षण n. (-णं) Pulling, drawing, dragging. E. वि before कृष to attract, aff. ल्युट्.
विकल: विकल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Confused, confounded, agitated. 2 Defective, imperfect. 3 Decayed, impaired, withered, waned. f. (-ला-ली) A woman in whom menstruation has ceased. n. (-लं) The 1/60th of a Kalā, the second of a degree. E. वि privative, and कला a digit of the moon, &c.
विकलपाणिक: विकलपाणिक m. (-कः) A cripple with a crooked or withered arm. E. विकल defective, पाणि the hand, and कन् added.
विकलाङ्ग: विकलाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Deformed, crippled, maimed. E. विकल defective, अङ्ग the body.
विकलीकरण: विकलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Spoiling, breaking, maiming. 2 Confusing, agitating. E. विकल, and करण making, च्चि aff.
विकलीकृत: विकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Broken, injured, impaired. 2 Sick, lame, maimed. 3 Confused, distressed. E. विकल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
विकलीभूत: विकलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Agitated, distressed. 2 Maimed, defective. E. विकल, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
विकलेन्द्रिय: विकलेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having any of the organs of sense impaired or defective. E. विकल, and इन्द्रिय an organ.
विकल्प: विकल्प m. (-ल्पः) 1 Error, ignorance, mistake. 2 Alternative, option. 3 Doubt, indecision. 4 (In rhetoric,) Antithesis of opposites. 5 (In grammar, &c.,) Admission of more than one form or rule. E. वि distinction, and कल्प making, &c.
विकल्पयत्: विकल्पयत् mfn. (यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Doubting, deliberating, weighing alternatives. E. वि before कृप to be able, शतृ aff.
विकल्पित: विकल्पित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or acknowledged as optional. E. वि before कृप to be able, क्त aff.
विकश्वर: विकश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि separately, कश to go, वरच् aff.
विकषा: विकषा f. (-षा) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. वि before कष to injure, अच् aff.; also विकसा.
विकष्वर: विकष्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि before कष to go, aff. वरच्; also विकस्वर.
विकस: विकस m. (-सः) The moon. f. (-सा) Bengal madder. E. वि before कस to go, aff. अच्.
विकसत्: विकसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Opening, expanding. 2 Budding, blowing. E. वि before कस to go, शतृ aff.
विकसित: विकसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blown, as a flower, budded, opened, expanded. E. वि apart, कस to go, aff. क्त.
विकस्वर: विकस्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opening, expanding. E. वि apart, कस to go, aff. वरच्; also derived from कश or कष, विकश्यर, and विकष्वर.
विकार: विकार m. (-रः) 1 Change of form or nature, alteration or deviation from the natural state. 2 Sickness, disease change from the state of health. 3 Passion, feeling, emotion, transition from the natural or quiescent condition of the soul. E. वि implying alteration, कृ to make, aff. अण्
विकारित: विकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Changed, converted, made to undergo a changing. 2 Rendered unfavourable or unfriendly. E. वि before कृ to make, causal v., क्त aff.
विकारिन्: विकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Producing a change. 2 Undergoing a change. E. वि before कृ to make, णिनि aff., or विकार, and इनि aff.
विकाल: विकाल m. (-लः) Twilight. E. वि implying prohibition, (of peculiar ceremonies,) and काल time.
विकालक: विकालक m. (-कः) Evening, twilight. f. (-लिका) A perforated copper vessel, which is placed in a pan of water, and being filled at the expiration of a certain period, defines that period: a sort of Clepsydra, or water clock. E. वि before काल time, and कन् added, or वि before कल to go, aff. क्वुन्.
विकाश: विकाश m. (-शः) 1 Solitude, loneliness, privacy. 2 Display, manifestation, open or splendid appearance. 3 Opening, expanding. 4 Budding, blowing, (as a flower.) 5 Pleasure, enjoyment. 6 Ether, heaven. E. वि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्; the vowel of the prefix is more usually made long: see विकाश.
विकाशता: विकाशता f. (-ता) 1 Appearance, display. 2 Loneliness. 3 Expansion. E. विकाश shining, aff. तल्; also with त्व, विकाशत्वं.
विकाशन: विकाशन n. (-नं) 1 Expansion, extent. 2 Manifestation. 3 Blowing, (of a flower.) E. विकाश, and ल्युट् aff.
विकाशभृत्: विकाशभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Expanding, being full. 2 Blown, budded. E. विकाश, and भृत् who or what has.
विकाशिन्: विकाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Expanding, spreading. E. वि before कश to go, aff. घिनुण्.
विकाषिन्: विकाषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Expanding, &c. E. वि before कष to go, aff. घिनुण्.
विकासिन्: विकासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Expanding, opening, budding, blowing. E. वि before कस to go, aff. घिनुण्; also with कश or कष the same, विकाशिन्, and विकाषिन् as above.
विकिर: विकिर m. (-रः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A well. 3 A fallen fragment, a scattered portion. 4 Scattering. E. वि apart, &c., कॄ to scatter, क aff.
विकिरत्: विकिरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Throwing, scattering, sprinkling. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, शतृ aff.
विकिरण: विकिरण n. (-णं) Scattering, spreading about or abroad. m. (-णः) Gigantic swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) E. वि before कॄ to scatter, aff. यु.
विकीर्ण: विकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Scattered, spread about, extended, diffused. 2 Celebrated, famous. E. वि implying extension, कॄ to scatter, aff. क्त.
विकीर्य: विकीर्य्य ind. Having or being scattered. E. वि, and कॄ to scatter, aff. ल्यप्.
विकीर्य्य: विकीर्य्य ind. Having or being scattered. E. वि, and कॄ to scatter, aff. ल्यप्.
विकीर्यमाण: विकीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being tossed, agitated, scattered, &c. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विकीर्य्यमाण: विकीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being tossed, agitated, scattered, &c. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विकुर्वाण: विकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Joyful, cheerful, happy. 2 Undergoing or making a change of form, &c. E. वि before कृ to make or do, चानश or शानच् aff.
विकुर्व्वाण: विकुर्व्वाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Joyful, cheerful, happy. 2 Undergoing or making a change of form, &c. E. वि before कृ to make or do, चानश or शानच् aff.
विकुस्र: विकुस्र m. (-स्रः) The moon. E. वि before कस to shine, रक् Uṇādi aff., and उ substituted for the radical vowel.
विकूणन: विकूणन n. (-नं) A side glance, a leer, a wink. E. वि before कूण to contract or close, (the eyes,) aff. ल्युट्.
विकूणिका: विकूणिका f. (-का) The nose. E. वि before कूण to sound, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. form.
विकृत: विकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Entertaining the feeling of disgust, averse, estranged. 2 Sick, diseased. 3 Altered, changed, either in form or feeling. 4 Imperfect, unfinished, incomplete. 5 Overcome by feeling or passion. n. (-तं) Disgust, aversion. E. वि implying reverse, and कृत made.
विकृतवदन: विकृतवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having the face distorted. E. विकृत, and वदन face.
विकृताकार: विकृताकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Changed in aspect, form, or appearance. E. विकृत, and आकार form; also विकृताकृति.
विकृताङ्ग: विकृताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Distorted, deformed. E. विकृत, and अङ्ग the limbs.
विकृति: विकृति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Change of any kind, as of purpose, mind. form, nature, &c. either permanent or temporary. 2 Sickness, disease, change from the natural or healthy state. 3 Fear, apprehension. 4 Spirituous liquor. 5 A species of metre: the stanza consists of four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged. E. वि implying alteration or reverse, कृ to make, aff. क्तिन्.
विकृष्ट: विकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Pulled, drawn, (as a bow-string.) 2 Attracted. 3 Dragged, drawn, in general. 4 Sounded, making a noise. E. वि before कृष to draw, aff. क्त.
विकेश: विकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Bald. f. (-शी) 1 A small braid or tress of hair, first tied up severally, and then collected into the Veṇī or larger braid. 2 A woman without hair. E. वि severally or privative, and केश hair.
विकेशिका: विकेशिका f. (-का) A pledget, a piece of rag smeared with ghee or other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore.
विकोष: विकोष m. (-षः-षा-षं) Uncovered, denuded, unsheathed. E. वि privative, and कोष a sheath, a cover.
विकौतुक: विकौतुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Incurious, indifferent. E. वि, and कौतुक curious.
विक्क: विक्क m. (-क्कः) A young elephant. E. विक imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड.
विक्रम: विक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Heroism, prowess, heroic valour. 2 Great power or strength. 3 Walking, going, proceeding. 4 Overpowering, overcoming. 5 Strength in general. 6 The name of a sovereign of Ougein: see विक्रमादित्य. E. वि before क्रम to go, to move, to walk, aff. घञ्.
विक्रममाण: विक्रममाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Going, proceeding. 2 Overpowering. E. वि before क्रम to go, शानच् aff.
विक्रमादित्य: विक्रमादित्य m. (-त्यः) The name of a celebrated prince, the sovereign of Ougein, and reputed founder of an æra still in use amongst the Hindus, commencing 56 years before the Christian æra; there are however many princes of this name, and it has been applied to Rāja BHOJA, to ŚĀLIVĀHANA, and PṚTHVĪ Rāja, as well as to five or six others; the name also occurs variously written, as VIKRAMA, ĀDITYA, VIKRAMASENA, VIKRAMASIṂHA, VIKRAMĀRKA, &c. E. विक्रम power, and आदित्य the sun.
विक्रमार्क: विक्रमार्क m. (-र्कः) A name of the sovereign VIKRAMĀDITYA: see the last. E. विक्रम heroism, and अर्क the sun.
विक्रमार्जित: विक्रमार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, acquired by valour. E. विक्रम, and अर्ज्जित gained.
विक्रमार्ज्जित: विक्रमार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, acquired by valour. E. विक्रम, and अर्ज्जित gained.
विक्रमिन्: विक्रमिन् m. (-मी) 1 A lion. 2 A hero. E. विक्रम strength, valour, इनि aff.
विक्रय: विक्रय m. (-यः) Sale, selling, vending. E. वि before क्री to buy, अच् aff.
विक्रयानुशय: विक्रयानुशय m. (-यः) Rescission of sale. E. विक्रय, and अनुशय doubt.
विक्रयण: विक्रयण n. (-णं) Selling, vending. E. वि reverse, क्री to buy, ल्युट् aff.
विक्रयिक: विक्रयिक m. (-कः) A vender, a dealer, a salesman. E. विक्रय sale, ठन् aff.
विक्रयिन्: विक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A seller, a vender. E. विक्रय sale, इनि aff.
विक्रान्त: विक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Valiant, mighty. 2 Overcoming, victorious. m. (-न्तः) 1 A hero, a warrior. 2 A lion. n. (-न्तं) Valour. E. वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्त, in an active sense.
विक्रान्ति: विक्रान्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 A horse's canter or gallop. 2 Prowess, heroic strength and valour. 3 Great power or strength. E. वि before क्रम to go, aff. क्तिन्.
विक्रान्तृ: विक्रान्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) 1 Valiant. 2 Victorious. m. (-न्ता) A hero, a victor. E. वि before क्रम to go, तृच् aff.
विक्रायक: विक्रायक m. (-कः) A vender, a seller. E. वि before क्री to buy, खुल् aff.
विक्रिया: विक्रिया f. (-या) Change of mind, form, purpose, condition, &c. E. वि implying reverse, and क्रिया action; see विकार.
विक्रीत: विक्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sold. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. क्त.
विक्रीय: विक्रीय ind. Having sold. E. वि before क्री to buy, ल्यप् aff.
विक्रुष्ट: विक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Harsh, rugged, or unkind, (as speech.) 2 Called out, exclaimed. n. (-ष्टं) 1 A cry of alarm or for help. 2 Abuse. E. वि before क्रुश to call, aff. क्त.
विक्रेतृ: विक्रेतृ m. (-ता) A vender, a seller. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. तृच्.
विक्रेय: विक्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Vendible, saleable. E. वि before क्री to buy, aff. यत्.
विक्रोशन: विक्रोशन n. (-नं) 1 Abusing, reviling. 2 Calling out. E. वि before क्रश to curse, ल्युट् aff.
विक्रोष्टृ: विक्रोष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) 1 Who reviles, abuses, speaks harshly, &c. 2 Who calls or cries out. E. वि before क्रुश to cry, तृच् aff.
विक्लव: विक्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Overcome with fear or agitation, confused, confounded, lost, bewildered. E. वि before क्लु to go, aff. अच्.
विक्लवता: विक्लवता f. (-ता) Timidity, fear. E. विक्लव, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विक्लवत्वं.
विक्लिन्न: विक्लिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Old. 2 Withered, shrivelled, decayed. 3 Wet, moist. E. वि before क्लिद to moisten, aff. क्त.
विक्षण: विक्षण adv. n. (-णं) Momentarily, for a moment. E. वि, and क्षण a moment.
विक्षत: विक्षत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck, hurt, wounded. E. वि before क्षत broken, torn.
विक्षाव: विक्षाव m. (-वः) 1 Cough. 2 Sound. E. वि before क्षु to sound, aff. घञ्.
विक्षिपत्: विक्षिपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Throwing, tossing. 2 Agitating. E. वि before क्षिप to throw, and शतृ aff.
विक्षिप्त: विक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Scattered, dispersed. 2 Thrown, cast. 3 Agitated, bewildered, perplexed. 4 Sent, dispatched. 5 Refuted, falsified. E. वि severally, and क्षिप्त thrown or sent.
विक्षीण: विक्षीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wasted, destroyed. E. वि before क्षै to decay, क्त aff.
विक्षीणक: विक्षीणक m. (-कः) 1 The chief of a class of demigods, enumerated amongst those attached to ŚIVA, and the ministers of destruction amongst men by plague, pestilence, &c. 2 A meeting or assembly of the gods. 3 A place prohibited to eaters of meat. E. वि before क्षीण wasted, (by whom,) and कन् added.
विक्षेप: विक्षेप m. (-पः) 1 Casting, throwing, or throwing away. 2 Sending, dispatching. 3 Confusion, perplexity, fear proceeding from ignorance or error. 4 Looking about vaguely or wildly, as of a woman for her absent lover. 5 Refuting an argument, establishing its falsehood. 6 Celestial latitude. E. वि before क्षिप to throw, aff. घञ्.
विक्षेपण: विक्षेपण n. (-णं) 1 Scattering, dispersing. 2 Sending, dispatching. 3 Throwing. E. वि before क्षिप् to throw, ल्युट् aff.
विक्षेपध्रुव: विक्षेपध्रुव m. (-वः) (In astronomy), The greatest inclination of a planet's orbit. E. विक्षेप, and ध्रुव are.
विक्षोभ: विक्षोभ n. (-भं) 1 Agitating, shaking. 2 Conflict, struggle. 3 Fearing. E. वि before क्षभ to stir, and घञ् aff.
विखण्डित: विखण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Broken, divided. 2 Refuted. E. वि before खण्डित the same.
विखुर: विखुर m. (-रः) A goblin, a demon, a Rākṣasa. E. वि before खुर to cut, aff. क.
विख्य: विख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Noseless. E. वि privative prefix, and ख्य substituted for नस or नासिका; also other as arbitrary terms, or विख, विग्र, विग्र, &c.
विख्यात: विख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, notorious, famous. 2 Avowed, confessed. E. वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्त.
विख्याति: विख्याति f. (-तिः) Fame, celebrity, notoriety. E. वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्तिन्.
विख्यापन: विख्यापन n. (-नं) 1 Confessing, acknowledging, avowing, declaring. 2 Explaining, expounding. E. वि before ख्या to say, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
विख्रु: विख्रु mfn. (-ख्रुः-ख्रुः-ख्रु) Noseless; also विख and विखु.
विगणन: विगणन n. (-नं) Reckoning, computing. 2 Considering, deliberating. 3 Discharge of a debt. E. वि before गणन counting.
विगणय्य: विगणय्य ind. 1 Having deliberated or weighed. 2 Having reckoned. E. वि before गण to number, ल्यप् aff.
विगणित: विगणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reckoned, calculated. 2 Weighed, considered. 3 Discharged, (as a debt.) E. वि before गण to count, क्त aff.
विगत: विगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed, disappeared. 2 Separated, severed, parted. 3 Freed or exempt from. 4 Lost. 5 Gloomy, dark, obscured. E. वि implying disunion, (of light, &c.,) गत gone.
विगतकल्मष: विगतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Pure, righteous. 2 Unsoiled. E. विगत, and कल्मष sin.
विगतज्वर: विगतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Exempted from decay. 2 Cured of fever. E. विगत, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
विगतराग: विगतराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Devoid of passion or affection. E. विगत, and राग passion.
विगतश्रीक: विगतश्रीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, unprosperous. E. विगत gone, श्री prosperity, कप् aff.
विगतस्पृह: विगतस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Indifferent, devoid of wish or desire. E. विगत, and स्पृहा desire.
विगतार्तवा: विगतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) A woman past child-bearing. E. विगत gone, आर्त्तव the menstrual excretion.
विगतार्त्तवा: विगतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) A woman past child-bearing. E. विगत gone, आर्त्तव the menstrual excretion.
विगम: विगम m. (-मः) Separation, parting. E. वि apart, and गम going.
विगर: विगर m. (-रः) 1 An abstemious man, one who feeds on wind. 2 A naked man. 3 A mountain.
विगर्हण: विगर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) Abuse, abusing, censure, reproach. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, युच् aff.
विगर्हणीय: विगर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Bad, wicked, reprehensible. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
विगर्हित: विगर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abused, reviled. 2 Low, vile. 3 Bad, wicked. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, aff. क्त.
विगर्ह्य: विगर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Blamable, reprehensible. ind. Having blamed or reviled. E. वि before गर्ह to abuse, यत् or ल्यप् aff.
विगर्ह्यकथा: विगर्ह्यकथा f. (-था) Scandal, abuse. E. विगर्ह्य, and कथा speech.
विगलत्: विगलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Oozing, dropping, flowing. 2 Fading, dispersing, weakening, (as emotion, &c.) E. वि before गल to ooze, शतृ aff.
विगलित: विगलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, dropped, oozed, flowing. 2 Removed, gone. 3 Dissipated, dispersed. 4 Decayed, impaired. 5 Slackened, untied, (as a knot.) 6 Loose, disordered, (as dress.) E. वि before गल to ooze, aff. क्त.
विगलितकेश: विगलितकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Having the hair dishevelled. E. विगलित, and केश hair.
विगाढ: विगाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Immersed, plunged, bathed, bathing. 2 Much, exceeding. 3 Flowing copiously. E. वि before गाह to bathe, aff. क्त.
विगान: विगान n. (-नं) 1 Ill report, detraction, scandal. 2 Censure, reproach. E. वि depreciative prefix, गै to sing or sound, aff. ल्युट्.
विगाह: विगाह m. (-हः) 1 Bathing. 2 Plunging into, literally or figuratively, (as water, a crowd, &c.) E. वि before गाह to bathe, अच् aff.
विगाहमान: विगाहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Beholding, perceiving. 2 Knowing. 3 Bathing. 4 Going, proceeding. E. वि before गाह to agitate, aff. शानच्.
विगाह्य: विगाह्य ind. Having bathed or plunged in. E. वि before गाह to agitate, ल्यप् aff.
विगीत: विगीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Contradicted, contradictory, inconsistent. 2 Abused, reproached. 3 Sung or said in various ways. 4 Sung ill. E. वि, and गीत sung.
विगीति: विगीति f. (-तिः) 1 Reproach, abuse. 2 Contradiction. 3 Singing in various styles. 4 Singing ill. E. वि, and गीति singing.
विगुण: विगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Void of all qualities. 2 Bad, worthless, having no merit. E. वि, and गुण quality.
विगूढ: विगूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Concealed, hidden. 2 Blamed, reproached, censured. E. वि before गुह to conceal, aff. क्त.
विगृहीत: विगृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opposed, obstructed, prevented. 2 Encountered, as in fight. E. वि before ग्रह to seize, क्त aff.
विगृह्य: विगृह्य ind. Having warred or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, ल्यप् aff.
विगृह्यमाण: विगृह्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being warred upon or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विग्र: विग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Noseless. E. वि privative prefix, and ग्र substituted for नासिका.
विग्रह: विग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The body. 2 Extension, diffusion. 3 A portion, a part. 4 Shape, form, figure. 5 (A grammatical term,) the proper application or sense of a compound word. mn. (-हः-हं) 1 War, battle. 2 Opposition, encounter. E. वि various, (happiness, &c.) ग्रह to take, aff. अच्.
विग्रहावर: विग्रहावर n. (-रं) The back. E. विग्रह the body, and अवर the back.
विग्राह्य: विग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be warred or contended with. E. वि before ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
विघटिका: विघटिका f. (-का) Sixtieth part of a Gharī, equal to 24 seconds. E. वि, and घटिका a Gharī.
विघन: विघन m. (-नः) A mallet, a hammer, an implement for striking. E. वि before हन to strike, अप् aff.
विघट्टन: विघट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 Striking. 3 Opening, undoing, untying. 4 Offending. E. वि, घटृ to rub, aff. ल्युट्.
विघट्टित: विघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, touched. 2 Offended. 3 Struck. 4 Untied, undone. E. वि before घट्ट or rub, aff. क्त.
विघस: विघस m. (-सः) 1 The residue of food offered to the gods, to the manes, to a venerable guest, or a spiritual preceptor. 2 Food in general. E. वि before अद to eat, aff. अप्, and घस substituted for the root.
विघसाश: विघसाश m. (-शः) One who eats the remains of an offering. E. विघस, and आश eating; also विघसाशिन्, &c.
विघात: विघात mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Impediment, obstacle. 2 Prohibition or prevention. 3 Opposition. 4 Destruction. 5 A blow. E. वि before हन to kill or hurt, aff. क्त.
विघातसिद्धि: विघातसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Removing obstacles or impediments. E. विघात, and सिद्धि attainment.
विघातिन्: विघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Opposing, impeding, preventing. 2 Removing, destroying. 3 Wounding, killing. E. वि before हन to hurt or strike, aff. णिनि.
विघुष्ट: विघुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Cried, proclaimed. E. वि before घुष्ट cried.
विघुष्य: विघुष्य ind. Having proclaimed. E. वि before घुष to cry, ल्यप् aff.
विघोषण: विघोषण n. (-णं) Proclamation, crying. E. वि before घुष to cry aloud, ल्युट् aff.
विघ्न: विघ्न m. (-घ्नः) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 The Caronda, (Carissa Carondas.) E. वि before हन to be injured (by it), and क aff.
विघ्नकर: विघ्नकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Opposing, impeding, obstructing. E. विघ्न, and कर what makes.
विघ्नकारिन्: विघ्नकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Impeding, obstructing. 2 Fearful, formidable, terrible. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and कारिन् causing.
विघ्ननाशक: विघ्ननाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what removes difficulties, &c. m. (-कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न, and नाशक who or what destroys.
विघ्ननाशन: विघ्ननाशन n. (-नं) Removing obstacles. m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and नाशन removing; the deity being supposed capable of either causing or removing difficulties and impediments, and being therefore especially worshipped at the commencement of any undertaking: also other similar compounds.
विघ्नराज: विघ्नराज m. (-जः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an impediment, and राज ruler: see the last.
विघ्नलेश: विघ्नलेश m. (-शः) Slight obstacle or impediment. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and लेश a little.
विघ्नविनायक: विघ्नविनायक m. (-कः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and विनायक remover.
विघ्नसिद्धि: विघ्नसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Removal of obstacles. E. विघ्न, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
विघ्नहारिन्: विघ्नहारिन् m. (-री) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, हारिन् who removes see विघ्ननाशन.
विघ्नित: विघ्नित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, prevented, obstructed, impeded. E. विघ्न an obstacle, इतच् aff.
विघ्नेश: विघ्नेश m. (-शः) GAṆEŚA. E. विघ्न an obstacle, and ईश lord: see विघ्ननाशन.
विच: विच(औइर्)औ विचिर् r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति विंक्ते) 1 To differ, to be separate or distinct. To divide, to separate, especially in judgment, to discriminate, to judge.
विचकिल: विचकिल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of jasmine. 2 A flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.) 3 A shrub, (Vangueria spinosa) E. वि before चक to be satisfied, इलच् aff.
विचक्षण: विचक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Clever, able, wise, sensible. 2 Proficient, skilful. m. (-णः) A learned Brahman or Paṇḍita, a holy teacher. E. वि before चक्ष to speak, (sensibly,) and युच् aff.
विचक्षुस्: विचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) 1 Blind. 2 Sad, perplexed. E. वि privative, चक्षुस् the eye.
विचय: विचय m. (-यः) Search, research. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. अच्.
विचयन: विचयन n. (-नं) Search, research, seeking. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. ल्युट्.
विचरत्: विचरत् mfn. (-रत्-रन्ती-रत्) Wandering, roaming, going about. E. वि variously, चर to go, शतृ aff.
विचर्चिका: विचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Herpes, scab. E. वि before चर्च्च to speak or tell, aff. ण्वुल्.
विचर्च्चिका: विचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Herpes, scab. E. वि before चर्च्च to speak or tell, aff. ण्वुल्.
विचल: विचल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Unsteady, unfixed, moving, going. 2 Conceited. E. वि before चल the same.
विचलत्: विचलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Moving, going, shaking, waving. E. वि before चल to go, शतृ aff.
विचलन: विचलन n. (-नं) 1 Fickleness, unsteadiness. 2 Self-praise, conceit. 3 Deviating from. E. वि before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.
विचलित: विचलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, departed. 2 Deviated from, E. वि before चल to go, क्त aff.
विचार: विचार m. (-रः) 1 The exercise of judgment or reason on a present object, investigation, consideration, deliberation. 2 Dispute, discussion. E. वि before चर to go, aff. घञ्.
विचारक: विचारक m. (-कः) An investigator, a judge. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
विचारकता: विचारकता f. (-ता) Investigation, discussion. E. तल् added to the last; also त्व, विचारकत्व.
विचारकर्तृ: विचारकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A judge, an investigator. E. विचार, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
विचारकर्त्तृ: विचारकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A judge, an investigator. E. विचार, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
विचारण: विचारण nf. (-णं-णा) Deliberation, investigation, the exercise of judgment, or decision after due examination or discussion. f. (-णा) The Mīmāṃsā system of philosophy. E. वि before चर to go, causal form, aff. युच्.
विचारणीय: विचारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discussed or investigated. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
विचारभू: विचारभू f. (-भूः) 1 The judgment seat of YAMA, the judge of the dead. 2 Any meeting for literary or judicial investigation. E. विचार discussion or judgment, and भू place.
विचारस्थल: विचारस्थल n. (-लं) A logical disputation. E. विचार, and स्थल place.
विचारित: विचारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Judged, discussed, determined, decided. E. विचार discussion, aff. इतच्.
विचारिन्: विचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Judging, discussing. E. वि before चर to go, णिनि aff.
विचार्य: विचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be discussed, weighed, deliberated. &c. Ind. Having deliberated. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्यत् or ल्यप् aff.
विचार्य्य: विचार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be discussed, weighed, deliberated. &c. Ind. Having deliberated. E. वि before चर to go, causal v., ण्यत् or ल्यप् aff.
विचार्यमाण: विचार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being investigated or discussed. E. वि before चर to go, passive v., शानच् aff.
विचार्य्यमाण: विचार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being investigated or discussed. E. वि before चर to go, passive v., शानच् aff.
विचाल: विचाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Intervening, intermediate. E. वि disjunctive prefix, चल to go, aff. अण्.
विचि: विचि f. (-चिः-ची) A wave. E. वि before चि to collect, क्विप् aff., also वीची.
विचिकित्सा: विचिकित्सा f. (-सा) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Error, mistake. E. वि before कित to doubt, in the reduplicate form, aff. अच्.
विचित्र: विचित्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) 1 Variegated, spotted. 2 Painted, coloured. 3 Handsome, beautiful. 4 Wonderful, surprising. n. (-त्रं) 1 Variegated, (the colour.) 2 Surprise. 3 Speech implying apparently the reverse of the object intended. E. वि before चित्र variegated, &c.
विचित्रक: विचित्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Wonderful, surprising. n. (-कं) Astonishment, wonder. E. कन् added to the last.
विचित्रचीनांशुक: विचित्रचीनांशुक n. (-कं) Shot or watered China silk. E. विचित्र, and चीनांशुक China cloth.
विचित्रता: विचित्रता f. (-ता) 1 Wonder, wonderfulness. 2 Being variegated, variety of colour or tint, &c. E. विचित्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विचित्रत्वं.
विचित्रदेह: विचित्रदेह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) 1 Having the body painted, &c. 2 Elegant. m. (-हः) A cloud. E. विचित्र spotted, variegated, (with different tints,) and देह the body.
विचित्रवीर्य: विचित्रवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A sovereign, the 22nd monarch of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the son of ŚĀNTANU and husband of PĀṆḌU'S mother. E. विचित्र wonderful, वीर्य्य power.
विचित्रवीर्य्य: विचित्रवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) A sovereign, the 22nd monarch of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the son of ŚĀNTANU and husband of PĀṆḌU'S mother. E. विचित्र wonderful, वीर्य्य power.
विचित्रवीर्यसू: विचित्रवीर्य्यसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VICITRAVĪRYA by ŚĀNTANU; also of VYĀSA by PARĀŚARA. E. विचित्रवीर्य्य as above, and सू the mother.
विचित्रवीर्य्यसू: विचित्रवीर्य्यसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VICITRAVĪRYA by ŚĀNTANU; also of VYĀSA by PARĀŚARA. E. विचित्रवीर्य्य as above, and सू the mother.
विचित्राङ्ग: विचित्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Elegant, well-formed, handsome. 2 Having the body of various colours. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A peacock. 2 A tiger. E. विचित्र variegated or beautiful, and अङ्ग the body.
विचित्रित: विचित्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wonderful. 2 Painted, variegated. E. विचित्र, and इतच् aff.
विचिन्त्य: विचिन्त्य ind. Having reflected. E. वि before चित to think, ल्यप् aff.
विचिन्त्यमान: विचिन्त्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being to be thought of or considered. E. वि before चिति to think, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विचिन्वत्: विचिन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Thinking, considering. E. वि before चि to collect, aff. शतृ.
विचिन्वत्क: विचिन्वत्क m. (-त्कः) 1 A hero. 2 Discrimination, judging. E. कन् added to the last.
विचिन्वान: विचिन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thinking, considering, deliberating. E. वि before चि to collect, शानच् aff.
विचीर्ण: विचीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Entered. 2 Occupied or inhabited by.
विचेतन: विचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unconscious, senseless, lifeless. E. वि priv. चेतना sense.
विचेतस्: विचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) 1 Sad, perplexed, unhappy. 2 Ignorant, stupid. E. वि implying privation, चेतस् mind.
विचेष्टित: विचेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Investigated, ascertained, inquired into or looked after. 2 Inconsiderate, ill-judged. n. (-तं) 1 Evil or malicious act. 2 Exertion, effort. E. वि before चेष्टित sought.
विच्युत: विच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thrown or slipped off. 2 Fallen or deviated from, neglecting, (as a duty.) 3 Sloughed. E. वि before च्युत fallen.
विच्छ: विच्छ r. 6th cl. (विच्छायति) To go or approach, (the form is irr.) r. 10th cl. (विच्छयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak.
विच्छन्द: विछन्द m. (-न्दः) A building of several stories, and surrounded by a portico, or having a portico to the east and west only; a palace, a temple. E. वि before छन्द wish, will; also with कन् added, विछन्दक, and derived from छृदि to be splendid, with वुन् aff. विछर्द्दक.
विछन्द: विछन्द m. (-न्दः) A building of several stories, and surrounded by a portico, or having a portico to the east and west only; a palace, a temple. E. वि before छन्द wish, will; also with कन् added, विछन्दक, and derived from छृदि to be splendid, with वुन् aff. विछर्द्दक.
विच्छर्दक: विछर्द्दक m. (-कः) A large and handsome building, the temple of a god, or the palace of a prince: see the last.
विछर्द्दक: विछर्द्दक m. (-कः) A large and handsome building, the temple of a god, or the palace of a prince: see the last.
विच्छर्दन: विछर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Disregarding. 2 Wasting. 3 Being sick. E. वि before छृदि to vomit, ल्युट् aff.
विछर्द्दन: विछर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Disregarding. 2 Wasting. 3 Being sick. E. वि before छृदि to vomit, ल्युट् aff.
विच्छर्दित: विछर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disregarded, neglected. 2 Diminished, impaired. 3 Vomited. E. वि before छृद to vomit, क्त aff.
विछर्द्दित: विछर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disregarded, neglected. 2 Diminished, impaired. 3 Vomited. E. वि before छृद to vomit, क्त aff.
विच्छाय: विछाय n. (-यं) The shadow of a flock of birds. E. वि a bird, छाय a shadow, which in this sort of compound becomes neuter.
विछाय: विछाय n. (-यं) The shadow of a flock of birds. E. वि a bird, छाय a shadow, which in this sort of compound becomes neuter.
विच्छित्ति: विच्छित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Cutting, cutting off, excision. 2 Dividing, fracture. 3 Separation or absence. 4 Loss, disappearance, destruction. 5 Cæsura, pause, in a verse. 6 The boundary or limits of a house, &c. 7 A property of the Nāyikā or mistress, carelessness or irregularity in dress and decoration through flurry and agitation. 7 Colouring the body with coloured unguents. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. क्तिन्.
विच्छिन्न: विच्छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्नी-न्नं) 1 Cut, separated, severed. 2 Absent or separated from. 2 Divided, parted, portioned. 4 Shared, divided equally. 5 Crooked, curved. 6 Scattered, dispersed. 7 Hidden or cut off from view, intercepted. E. वि apart, छिद to cut, aff. क्त.
विच्छेद: विच्छेद m. (-दः) 1 Separation, disjunction, removal. 2 Prohibition, prevention. 3 Dividing, cutting. 4 The division of a book, a section, a chapter. 5 Space, interval. 6 Dissension, difference. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
विच्छेदक: विच्छेदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) What separates, divides, cuts, &c. m. (-कः) A sector, a cutter. E. वि before छिद to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
विच्छेदन: विच्छेदन n. (-नं) Separating, severing, dividing. E. वि before छिद to cut, ल्युट् aff.
विच्छेदनीय: विच्छेदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divisible, to be divided or separated. E. वि before छिद to cut, aff. अनीयर्.
विज: विज(औ इर)औ विजिर r. 3rd cl. (विवेक्ति) 1 To be distinct or separate, to differ. 2 To separate or divide, especially by reason; to judge, to distinguish, to discriminate. (ओ, ई,) ओविजी r. 6th cl. (विजते, or usually with उद् prefixed उद्विजते) also r. 7th cl. (विनक्ति) 1 To fear, to be afraid. 2 To tremble with fear. 3 To shake or tremble. 4 To be agitated or distressed.
विजन: विजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Private, lonely, solitary. E. वि privative, and जन man, people.
विजनन: विजनन n. (-नं) Birth, bearing, delivery. E. वि before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्.
विजनित: विजनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Born, begotten. E. वि before जन to be born, aff. क्त.
विजन्मन्: विजन्मन् n. (-न्म) Birth, separate or several birth. m. (-न्मा) A man born from a degraded Vaiśya. E. वि, and जन्मन् birth.
विजय: विजय m. (-यः) 1 Victory, triumph, conquest. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 A divine car or chariot of the gods. 4 The father of the twenty-first Jina. 5 One of the persons named ŚUKLA BĀLAS by the Jainas. 6 The god of Hades, YAMA. f. (-या) The goddess DURGĀ. 2 One of the female friends or attendants of  DURGĀ. 3 One of the wives of YAMA. 4 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa,) or the tops of the plant used as a narcotic. 5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 6 Orris root. 7 A peculiar lunar day; the third, eighth, or thirteenth of a fortnight; it is also applied to the tenth of the light half of the month Āśvina (Sept-Oct.), on which the image of DURGĀ, set up during the great festival in honour of her, is cast into the water. E. वि before जि to conquer, aff. अच्.
विजयकुञ्जर: विजयकुञ्जर m. (-रः) A royal or war elephant. E. विजय victory, and कुञ्जर an elephant.
विजयच्छन्द: विजयछन्द m. (-न्दः) A kind of necklace, one of 504 rows or strings. E. विजय triumph, &c., and छन्द covering, from छदि, aff. अच्.
विजयछन्द: विजयछन्द m. (-न्दः) A kind of necklace, one of 504 rows or strings. E. विजय triumph, &c., and छन्द covering, from छदि, aff. अच्.
विजयनन्दन: विजयनन्दन m. (-नः) A sovereign of the race of IKṢVĀKU. E. विजय victory or a proper name, and नन्दन the son.
विजयमर्दल: विजयमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A large military drum. E. विजय victory, and मर्द्दल a drum.
विजयमर्द्दल: विजयमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A large military drum. E. विजय victory, and मर्द्दल a drum.
विजयमान: विजयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Victorious, triumphant. E. वि before जि to conquer, शानच् aff.
विजयसिद्धि: विजयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Success, victory. E. विजय, and सिद्धि accomplishment.
विजयासप्तमी: विजयासप्तमी f. (-मी) The seventh day of the light half of a month falling on a Sunday. E. विजया victory, सप्तमी the seventh.
विजयिन्: विजयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Victorious, triumphant, conquering, a conqueror. E. विजय, and इनि aff.
विजयिन: विजयिन n. (-नं) Sauce mixed with the water of boiled rice; also विजिन, &c.
विजल: विजल n. (-लं) Sauce, &c. mixed with rice water or gruel. E. विज to shake, aff. कलच्; also विजिल, विज्जन, &c.
विजात: विजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Born severally. 2 Base born, of mixed origin. f. (-ता) The mother of children, a matron. E. वि severally, जात born, (from whom.)
विजाति: विजाति f. (-तिः) A different species or tribe. E. वि, and जाति sort.
विजातीय: विजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Of a different caste. 2 Of mixed origin. 3 Dissimilar, of a different sort or nature. E. वि, जाती caste, छ aff.
विजानत्: विजानत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) 1 Possessing various or extended knowledge. 2 Knowing, understanding. E. वि, and ज्ञा to know, शतृ aff.
विजिगीष: विजिगीष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Desirous of victory, emulative, anxious to overcome or conquer, &c. E. वि before जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.
विजिगीषा: विजिगीषा f. (-षा) Competition, emulation, wish to surpass, overcome, or subdue. E. जि to conquer, with वि prefixed, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
विजिगीषु: विजिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous to conquer or overcome. m. (-षुः) 1 A warrior. 2 An invader, an antagonist. 3 A disputant. 4 An opponent in general, &c. E. वि before जि to conquer, desiderative form, उ aff.
विजिग्राहयिषु: विजिग्राहयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to excite to war. E. वि before ग्रह to take, desid. of the causal v., उ aff.
विजिघृक्षु: विजिघृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Determined or wishing to encounter, oppose, fight with, overcome, &c. E. वि before ग्रह to take, desid. v., उ aff.
विजित: विजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, defeated. E. वि before जित conquered.
विजितवत्: विजितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Victorious, conquering. E. वि before जि to conquer, क्तवतु aff.
विजितव्य: विजितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be apprehended or feared. E. विज to fear, तव्य aff.
विजितात्मन्: विजितात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Self-subdued. E. विजित, and आत्मन् self.
विजितृ: विजितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what separates, divides, &c. m. (-ता) 1 A judge, a discriminator, a distinguisher. 2 A partner or co-heir. E. विज to separate, &c., aff. तृच्, and इट् augment.
विजितेन्द्रिय: विजितेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of subdued organs or passions. E. विजित, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
विजित्य: विजित्य ind. Having conquered. E. वि before जि to conquer, ल्यप् aff.
विजिन: विजिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice gruel, &c. (sauce or condiments.) E. विज to shake, aff. इनन्.
विजिविल: विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice water, or gruel, (sauce or condiments, &c.) E. विज to shake, aff. इलच्.
विजिविल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice water, (sauces, &c.)
विजिहीर्षा: विजिहीर्षा f. (-र्षा) Wish or intention to take pleasure or sport. E. वि before हृ to take, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
विजिहीर्षु: विजिहीर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) Wishing, or seeking for sport or amusement. E. वि before हृ to take, desid. v., उ aff.
विजिह्म: विजिह्म mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं) 1 Curved, bent. 2 Crooked in mind or purpose, dishonest, depraved. E. वि privative, and जिह्म straight.
विजिह्मता: विजिह्मता f. (-ता) 1 Crookedness. 2 Craftiness. E. विजिह्म, and तल् aff.
विजृम्भण: विजृम्भण n. (-णं) 1 Pastime, sport, especially amorous. 2 Budding, blossoming, expanding. 3 Yawning. E. वि before जृभि to yawn, aff. ल्युट्.
विजृम्भित: विजृम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blossomed, expanded, opened, unfolded. 2 Yawning, gaping. 3 Sported, wantoned. n. (-तं) 1 Wish, desire. 2 Pastime, sport. E. वि before जृभि to yawn or open, and क्त aff.
विजेतृ: विजेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Victorious, a victor. E. वि before जि to conquer, तृच् aff.
विज्जन: विज्जन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Mixed with rice-water or gruel, (sauce, gravy, &c.:) see विजिल; it also occurs विज्जिल.
विज्जल: विज्जल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mixed with rice-water, &c.: see विजिल. n. (-लं) An arrow.
विज्ञ: विज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Skilful, able, clever, conversant. 2 Wise, learned. E. वि implying separation, discrimination, and ज्ञ who knows.
विज्ञता: विज्ञता f. (-ता) Wisdom, learning. E. तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, विज्ञत्वं.
विज्ञप्त: विज्ञप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Stated, reported, represented. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विज्ञप्ति: विज्ञप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Information, representation, respectful communication of information, or opinion on any subject. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. क्तिन्.
विज्ञात: विज्ञात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Celebrated, famous, known, notorious. 2 Known, understood. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, aff. क्त.
विज्ञान: विज्ञान n. (-नं) 1 Knowledge, science, learning, worldly knowledge or wisdom, that which comprehends any subject, except an understanding of the true nature of GOD or BRAHMA, acquirable by abstract meditation, and the study of the Vedas; it also is described as conversancy with the arts of painting, &c., and with books, as the Smṛti Śāstras, or works on law, and other branches of science or literature. 2 Business, employment. 3 Music. E. वि implying variety, and ज्ञान knowledge.
विज्ञानमातृक: विज्ञानमातृक n. (-कः) A name of BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion. E. विज्ञान knowledge, and मातृक parent.
विज्ञानिक: विज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Clever, skilful, conversant; also वैज्ञानिक. E. विज्ञान, and ठक् aff.
विज्ञापक: विज्ञापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what makes known. m. (-कः) 1 An informant. 2 An instructor. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
विज्ञापन: विज्ञापन n. (-नं) 1 Teaching, instruction, communication of knowledge not religious, &c. 2 Representing, informing. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
विज्ञापनीय: विज्ञापनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made known, represented, taught, &c. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
विज्ञापित: विज्ञापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Apprised, informed. 2 Instructed. E. वि before ज्ञा to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विज्ञेय: विज्ञेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Cognizable, comprehensible, what is to be or may be known or understood. E. वि implying discrimination, ज्ञा to know, यत् participial aff.
विज्वर: विज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Exempt from decay. 2 Free from fever. E. वि, and ज्वरा decay, or ज्वर fever.
विझर्झर: विझर्झर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Harsh, disagreeable, (as sound.) E. वि before झर्झर clanging.
विञ्जमर: विञ्जमर n. (-रं) The white of the eye.
विञ्जोली: विञ्जोली f. (-ली) A line, a row, a range.
विट: विट r. 1st cl. (वेटति) 1 To sound. 2 To curse. (इ) विटि r. 10th cl. (विण्टयति) To decay.

विट m. (-टः) 1 A catamite, a pathic. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 An attendant on a dissolute character or courtezan. 4 A paramour, a gallant. 5 A mountain. 6 The Khayar tree, (Mimosa catechu.) 7 A medicinal salt: see विडल्वण. 8 A rat. 9 The orange tree. 10 A branch and its shoot. E. विट to sound, aff. क.
विटङ्क: विटङ्क mn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्कं) A dove-cot, an aviary. E. वि variously, टकि to bind, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added विटङ्कक.
विटप: विटप mn. (-पः-पं) 1 The branch of a tree with its new sprout or shoot. 2 A new shoot. 3 A branch. 4 Expansion, spreading. 5 A clump, a cluster. 6 The perinæum or septum of the scrotum. m. (-पः) The keeper of pathics. E. विट a branch, &c., and पा to cherish, aff. क, or विट to sound, Uṇādi aff. अप, with the radical vowel unchanged.
विटपिन्: विटपिन् m. (-पी) 1 A tree. 2 The large Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) E. विटप a branch or shoot, and इनि aff.
विटमाक्षिक: विटमाक्षिक m. (-कः) A mineral: see माक्षिक.
विटलवण: विटलवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt: see विट.
विट्कारिका: विट्कारिका f. (-का) A kind of bird, (probably a variety of the Turdus Salica of Buchannan.) E. विट् from विष् fæces, and कारिका working.
विट्खदिर: विट्खदिर m. (-रः) A fetid Mimosa. E. विट् fæces, and खदिर Mimosa catechu.
विट्चर: विट्चर m, (-रः) The tame or village hog. E. विट् filth, ordure, and चर who goes.
विट्पण्य: विट्पण्य n. (-ण्यं) Goods, merchandise. E. विट् a Vaiśya, and पण्य wares.
विट्पति: विट्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A son-in-law, a daughter's husband. 2 A head merchant. E. विश् a Vaiśya, &c., and पति master.
विट्लवण: विट्लवण n. (-णं) A fetid salt: see विड. E. विट् ordure, लवण salt.
विट्सङ्ग: विट्सङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Constipation. E. विट्, and सङ्ग aggregate.
विट्सारिका: विट्सारिका f. (-का) A bird, a sort of thrush; a variety of the bird, usually though inaccurately called Maina in Bengal. E. विट् fæces, and सारिका the same bird, or another species of the same.
विड: विड r. 6th cl. (वेडति) 1 To divide, to break. 2 To curse.

विड n. (-डं) 1 Factitious salt, or salt procured by boiling soil found near the sea shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles. 2 A particular fetid kind of salt, used as a tonic aperient, commonly called black salt or Vitlavan, or Bitnoben, prepared by fusing fossile salt with a small portion of Emblic myrobalans; the produce is muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur, and oxid of iron. 3 A part, a fracture, a bit. E. विड to divide, aff. क.
विड्: विड् f. (विड्) A bit, a fragment. E. विड to break, क्विप् aff.
विडगन्ध: विडगन्ध n. (-न्धं) The medicinal salt called Vitlavan: see the last. E. विड salt, गन्ध smell.
विडङ्ग: विडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) Clever, able, skilful, conversant. mn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गं) A vegetable and medicinal substance, considered of great efficacy as a vermifuge. E. विड to break, to curse, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्.
विडम्बन: विडम्बन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Afflicting, distressing. 2 Vexation, mortification. 3 Frustrating, rendering vain. 4 Imitation, copying, especially assuming a similar appearance or dress, disguise, masquerade. 5 The supernatural assumption of a borrowed form, transformation. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. युच्.
विडम्बनीय: विडम्बनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be distressed or annoyed. 2 To be assumed as a disguise. E. वि before डवि to heap, अनीयर् aff.
विडम्बयत्: विडम्बयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Assuming, putting on, (as a borrowed dress or appearance.) 2 Imitating. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. शतृ.
विडम्बित: विडम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Low, poor, abject, distressed. 2 Vexed, mortified. 3 Assumed, put on, (as a borrowed form, &c.,) simulated, transformed. E. वि before डवि to heap, aff. क्त.
विडारक: विडारक m. (-कः) A cat. E. see the next, the ल being changed to र.
विडाल: विडाल m. (-लः) 1 A cat. 2 The eye-ball. E. विड to divide, to tear, (rats,) Uṇādi aff. कालक; also with कन् added, विडालक, and ल being changed to र, विडारक.
विडालक: विडालक n. (-कं) 1 Yellow orpiment. m. (-कः) 1 Application of ointment to the external part of the eye, especially to the eye-lids, of which the lashes have fallen off or been ulcerated. 2 A cat. E. कन् added to the last.
विडालपद: विडालपद m. (-दः) A measure of weight, the same as the Karṣa or weight of sixteen Māṣas. E. विडाल a cat, पद the foot.
विडीन: विडीन n. (-नं) One of the different modes of flight attributed to birds, imitative flight. E. वि severally, and डीन flying.
विडुल: विडुल m. (-लः) A sort of cane, (Calamus rotang.)
विडोजस्: विडोजस् m. (-जाः) A name of INDRA. E. विड् a fragment; (splitting mountains, &c. with his thunderbolt,) or विट् from विश् a Vaiśya, (here meaning a subject or man in general,) and ओजस् strength, splendour; also विडौजस्.
विड्ग्रह: विड्ग्रह m. (-हः) Constipation. E. विट्, and ग्रह taking.
विड्ज: विड्ज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced from ordure. n. (-जं) A fungus. E. विट्, and ज born.
विड्भव: विड्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from ordure. E. विट्, and भव born.
विड्भुज्: विड्भुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Feeding on ordure. E. विष्, and भुज् who eats.
विड्लवण: विड्लवण n. (-णं) A medicinal salt, commonly black salt, Vitlavan or Bitnoben: see विड. E. विड to divide, aff. क्विप्, and लवण salt; also विट्लवण.
विड्वराह: विड्वराह m. (-हः) A village or tame hog. E. विट् fæces, ordure, and वराह a hog.
वितंस: वितंस m. (-सः) A cage, a net, a chain or any apparatus for confining beasts or birds. E. वि before तसि to adorn, aff. घञ्; also वीतंस.
वितण्ड: वितण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A sort of lock or bolt with three divisions or wards. 2 An elephant. f. (-ण्डा) 1 Controversy, argument, the subversion of another's opinion or interpretation, and establishment of one's own. 2 Criticism. 3 An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) 4 Benzoin or styrax (?) 5 The Oleander plant, (Nerium odorum.) 6 A ladle, a spoon. E. वि before तडि to beat, aff. अच् and टाप्.
वितत: वितत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stretched, spread, expanded. 2 Pervaded, diffused. 3 Lengthened. n. (-तं) Any stringed instrument. E. वि before तत stretched.
वितति: वितति f. (-तिः) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 Quantity, collection. 3 A clump, a cluster, (of trees, &c.) E. वि before तन to stretch, and क्तिन् aff.
विततीकरण: विततीकरण n. (-णं) Spreading, stretching. E. वितत, and करण making, च्चि augment.
विततीकृत: विततीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stretched, spread, expanded. E. वितत the same, कृत made, and च्चि augment, leaving ई.
वितत्य: वितत्य ind. Having spread. E. वि before तन to spread, ल्यप् aff.
वितथ: वितथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) False, untrue. E. वि implying reverse, तथ्य true, अच् aff., and the semivowel rejected; or वि before तम to desire, क्थन् aff., and म rejected.
वितद्रु: वितद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The name of a river, said to be situated in the Punjab. E. वि before तम to desire, aff. रु, and दङ् augment.
वितनु: वितनु mfn. (-नुः-न्वी-नु) Thin, graceful, delicate. E. वि, and तनु the same.
वितन्तु: वितन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A good horse. f. (-न्तुः) A widow.
वितन्वत्: वितन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्) Spreading, stretching, expanding. E. वि before तन to stretch, शतृ aff.
वितरण: वितरण n. (-णं) 1 Gift, donation. 2 Abandoning, quitting. 2 Passing, crossing. E. वि implying privation, &c., and तॄ to cross, ल्युट् aff.
वितमस्: वितमस् mfn. (-माः-माः-मः) 1 Light, free from darkness. 2 Exempt from the quality of ignorance. E. वि priv. तमस् darkness.
वितर्क: वितर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 Reasoning, discussion. 2 Doubt, deliberation. 3 A teacher, an instructor in divine knowledge. 4 Consideration of probabilities, mental anticipation of alternatives, conjecture. E. वि implying discrimination, &c., तर्क to reason or doubt, aff. अच्.
वितर्कण: वितर्कण n. (-णं) 1 Reasoning, discussion, whether mental or controversial, argument, reflection. 2 Apprehension, doubt. E. वि before तर्क to reason, aff. ल्युट्.
वितर्क्य: वितर्क्य ind. Having deliberated, considered, &c. mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं) Doubtful, questionable. E. वि before तर्क to reason, ल्यप् or यत् aff.
वितर्द्धि: वितर्द्धि f. (-र्द्धिः-र्द्धी) 1 A quadrangular building, or sort of covered terrace of wood in the centre of the court-yard of a temple or palace. 2 A quadrangular resting place made of wood, a seat, a bench. 3 A place in a court-yard for sitting in or standing under. 4 A floor on four posts in the midst of a quadrangular house. 5 A temporary stage or shed in the middle of a court-yard, for performing sacrifices, representing plays, &c. 6 A terrace furnished with pillars, a verandah, a balcony. 7 A covered temporary terrace on which idols are sometimes placed and worshipped. E. वि privative, तर्द to injure, aff. इन्; also ङीष् optionally added, and with कन् added in the fem. form वितर्द्धिका.
वितल: वितल n. (-लं) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla, the second in descent below the earth. E. वि before तल to be low or deep, aff. अच्.
वितस्ति: वितस्ति f. (-स्तिः) A long span measured by the extended thumb and little finger, considered equal to twelve fingers. E. वि apart, तस to throw, Uṇādi aff. ति.
वितान: वितान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Empty, pithless, sapless. 2 Empty, vacant. 3 Dull, stupid. 4 Wicked, abandoned. mn. (-नः-नं) 1 Spreading, expansion. 2 An awning, a canopy. 3 Sacrifice, offering, oblation. 4 The sacrificial hearth or hole in which the sacred fires are kept. 5 A heap, a quantity. n. (-नं) 1 A form of the metre Anuṣṭubh, or verse of four lines of eight syllables each; each line of the stanza named Vitāna consists of two Iambics, one Trochee, and one Spondee. 2 Leisure, rest, interval of occupation. E. वि before तन to spread, aff. घञ्.
वितानक: वितानक n. (-कं) 1 An awning, a canopy, especially a cloth spread over a large open hall or court, or any open space in which dancing, singing, &c. are exhibited, at solemn or  religious festivals. 2 A heap, a quantity. 3 An expanse. E. कन added to the preceding.
वितानीकरण: वितानीकरण n. (-णं) Covering, overspreading, (as a canopy.) E. वितान, and करण making, च्चि augment.
वितानीकृत: वितानीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spread or extended over, (as a canopy.) E. वितान, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
वितायमान: वितायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being overspread, covered, shaded, &c. E. वि before तन to stretch, pass. v., शानच् aff.
वितिष्ठमान: वितिष्ठमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Staying, being. 2 Fixed, stationary. 3 Permanent. E. वि before स्था to stay, शानच् aff.
वितीर्ण: वितीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Crossed, overpassed. 2 Subdued, overcome. 3 Effaced, rubbed out. 4 Conferred, bestowed. 5 Afforded, yielded. E. वि before तॄ to cross, क्त aff.
वितुन्न: वितुन्न n. (-न्नं) 1 A potherb, (Marsilia quadrifolia.) 2 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. वि privative, तुन्न pained, tortured; allaying pain.
वितुन्नक: वितुन्नक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) n. (-कं) 1 Coriander seed. 2 Blue vitriol. E. कन् added to the last.
वितुष्ट: वितुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Displeased, dissatisfied. E. वि priv., तुष्ट pleased.
वितृष्ण: वितृष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Content, satisfied, free from desire. E. वि priv., तृष्णा thirst.
वितृष्णता: वितृष्णता f. (-ता) 1 Satiety, satisfaction. 2 Content. E. वि priv., तृष्णता cupidity.
वित्त: वित्त r. 10th cl. (वित्तयति) To quit, to abandon, especially by giving away, to give alms.

वित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Judged, investigated, examined, discussed. 2 Known, notorious, famous. 3 Gained, acquired. n. (-त्तं) Wealth, property, thing, substance. E. विद to know, to discuss, to acquire, aff. क्त, form irr.
वित्तद: वित्तद m. (-दः) A benefactor, one who gives away property. E. वित्त wealth, and द who gives.
वित्तवत्: वित्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Rich, wealthy. E. वित्त, and मतुप् aff.
वित्तहीन: वित्तहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, indigent. E. वित्त, and हीन void of.
वित्ति: वित्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Discussion, discrimination, judgment, investigation. 2 Knowledge. 3 Gain, acquisition. 4 Probability, likelihood. E. विद to know, &c., aff. क्तिन्.
वित्तेहा: वित्तेहा f. (-हा) Cupidity, avarice. E. वित्त, and ईहा wish.
वित्रस्त: वित्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं) Frightened, alarmed, afraid. E. वि before त्रस to fear, aff. क्त.
वित्रास: वित्रास m. (-सः) Fear, alarm. E. वि before त्रास fear.
विथ: विथ(ऋ)विथृ r. 1st cl. (वेथते) To ask or beg.
विथुर: विथुर m. (-रः) 1 A thief. 2 An imp, a demon. E. व्यथ to fear, Uṇādi aff. उरन्, the semivowel changed to इ, and that unaltered.
विथ्या: विथ्या f. (-थ्या) A plant, commonly Gojihwa.
विद: विद r. 2nd cl. (वेत्ति वेदि) To know. With नि prefixed, To be sad or depressed. With सम्, (संवित्ते) To meditate, to know, to gain holy knowledge by abstract meditation. r. 4th cl. (विद्यते) To be, to exist, to be present, to exist actually. r. 7th cl. (विन्ते) To consider, to reason. r. 10th cl. (वेदयते) 1 To be sensible. 2 To know. 3 To declare, to describe or explain; (in this sense नि is usually prefixed.) 4 To dwell, to inhabit. 5 To be fixed or steady. 6 To suffer pain. With नि, or वि and नि prefixed, To deliver, to impart or communicate. With प्रति, To deliver, to give. (औ ऌ) औ विटॢ r. 6th cl. (विन्दति-ते) To gain, to get, to acquire or possess. With परि, To marry first.
विद्: विद् mfn. (वित्) Who or what knows. E. विद् to know, क्विप् aff.
विदग्ध: विदग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Clever, shrewd, knowing. 2 Sharp, witty. 3 Intriguing. 4 Undigested. 5 Burnt. m. (-ग्धः) 1 A libertine, a lecher, an intriguer. 2 A learned or clever man, a scholar, a Paṇḍita. f. (-ग्धा) A sharp knowing woman. E. वि before दह to burn, aff. क्त.
विदग्धता: विदग्धता f. (-ता) Sharpness, shrewdness, cleverness, wit. E. तल् aff. of the abstract, added to the last; also with त्व aff. विदग्धत्वं.
विदत्: विदत् mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्) Wise, intelligent, learned, knowing. E. विद to know, aff. शतृ.
विदथ: विदथ m. (-थः) 1 A wise or learned man, a sage, a scholar. 2 A saint, a devotee. E. विद to know, Uṇādi aff. अथ, and the radical vowel unchanged.
विदधत्: विदधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Having, wearing, assuming. E. वि before धा to have, शतृ aff.
विदर: विदर m. (-रं) Tearing, rending. n. (-रं) The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.) E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. अप्.
विदर्भ: विदर्भ mf. (-र्भः-र्भा) A district and city to the south-west of Bengal, the modern Bara-Nagpur or Berar proper. m. (-र्भः) Any dry or desart soil. E. वि privative, and दर्भ the sacred grass; not growing in that country in consequence of the curse of a saint, whose son had died of a wound from a blade of the grass.
विदर्भजा: विदर्भजा f. (-जा) 1 The wife of the saint AGASTYA. 2 DAMAYANTĪ the wife of NALA, and heroine of the Naiṣadha or poem so called. 3 RUKMIṆĪ the wife of KṚṢṆA. E. विदर्भ the country, and ज born.
विदल: विदल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Opened, expanded, blown, (as a flower, &c.) 2 Rent, split. n. (-लं) 1 A shallow basket made of split bambus, a vessel of wicker work. 2 Split peas. 3 Pomegranate bark. 4 The cuttings or chips of any substance, that which has been pared or split. m. (-लः) 1 Dividing, separating. 2 A cake. 3 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) E. वि before दल tearing, splitting.
विदलित: विदलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rent, torn, split. 2 Blown, expanded, (as a flower.) E. वि before दल to tear, क्त aff.
विदलीकरण: विदलीकरण n. (-णं) Rending, dividing. E. विदल, and करण making, with च्चि augment.
विदलीकृत: विदलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Divided, separated. 2 Cut, split, torn, broken. E. विदल dividing, कृत made, and च्चि augment.
विदश्यमान: विदश्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being bitten. E. वि before दशि to bite, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विदा: विदा f. (-दा) 1 Knowledge. 2 Intellect, understanding. E. विद to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
विदार: विदार m. (-रः) 1 Tearing, rending. 2 War, battle. 3 An inundation, an overflow, the rising of a river or pond above its banks. f. (-री) 1 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 2 A climbing plant, (Ipomoea paniculata.) 3 Bubo, swelling in the groin, &c. E. वि before दृ to tear, to divide, aff. घञ्.
विदारक: विदारक m. (-कः) 1 A divider, a render or tearer. 2 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream, dividing its course. 3 A hole or pit for water sunk in the bed of a dry river, &c. f. (-रिका) 1 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 2 A bubo. E. वि before दृ to divide, aff. ण्वुल्.
