विदारण: विदारण n. (-णं) 1 Tearing, breaking, splitting, severing, dividing. 2 Paining, afflicting. 3 Killing, slaughter. nf. (-णं-णा) War, battle. m. (-णः) A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. युच्.
विदारयत्: विदारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Tearing, rending, dividing. E. वि before दृ to tear, शतृ aff.
विदारित: विदारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Torn, rent, split, broken. E. वि before दॄ to tear, क्त aff.
विदारीगन्धा: विदारीगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. विदारी a plant, and गन्ध smell.
विदारु: विदारु m. (-रुः) A lizard. E. वि before दृ to tear, उ aff.
विदार्य: विदार्य्य ind. (-र्य्यः) Having torn or rent. E. वि, and दॄ to tear, ल्यप् aff.
विदार्य्य: विदार्य्य ind. (-र्य्यः) Having torn or rent. E. वि, and दॄ to tear, ल्यप् aff.
विदाह: विदाह m. (-हः) 1 Heat, burning. 2 Pungency. E. वि before दह to burn, घञ् aff.
विदाहिन्: विदाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 1 Burning, hot. 2 Pungent, acrid. E. वि before दह to burn, aff. घिनुण्.
विदिक्चङ्ग: विदिक्चङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of bird. E. विदिश् a point of the compass, and चङ्ग handsome.
विदित: विदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, understood. 2 Promised, agreed, assented. 3 Represented, submitted, solicited. 4 Apprised, informed, who or what knows. m. (-तः) A sage, a learned man. n. (-तं) Information, representation. E. विद to know, &c., aff. क्त.
विदित्वा: विदित्वा ind. 1 Having known. 2 Having promised. E. विद to know, क्ता aff.
विदिश्: विदिश् f. (-दिक्) An intermediate point of the compass. E. वि implying separation, and दिश् a quarter.
विदीर्ण: विदीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Torn, split, burst or broken. 2 Expanded, opened. E. वि before दृ to tear, aff. क्त, form irr.
विदीर्यमाण: विदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being torn, split, broken, cut, &c. E. वि before दॄ to rend, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विदीर्य्यमाण: विदीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being torn, split, broken, cut, &c. E. वि before दॄ to rend, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विदु: विदु m. (-दुः) 1 The hollow between the frontal globes of an elephant. 2 The hippopotamus. E. विद to know, (the goad,) aff. कु; also with कू aff. विदू.
विदुर: विदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Wise, knowing, intelligent. m. (-रः) 1 A libertine, an intriguer. 2 A learned or clever man. 3 The younger brother and counsellor of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. विद to know, कुरच् aff.
विदुल: विदुल m. (-लः) A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang;) also the same growing in water, (C. fasciculatus.) 2 Gum myrrh. E. विद to know, &c., Uṇādi aff. उलच्.
विदून: विदून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Agitated, distressed. E. वि, and दु to distress, क्त aff.
विदूर: विदूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very far or remote. E. वि intervening, and दूर distant.
विदूरग: विदूरग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Spreading, going far or wide. E. वि before दूर far, remote, and ग what goes.
विदूराद्रि: विदूराद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The name of a mountain. E. विदूर remote, and अद्रि a mountain.
विदूषक: विदूषक mfn. (-कः-षिका-कं) 1 Facetious, witty, a wag, a jester. 2 Censorious, detracting, a detractor or abuser of other people. m. (-कः) 1 An actor, especially an interlocutor with the audience between the acts or scenes, a jester, a buffoon. 2 (In dramatic language,) The humble and jocose companion of the principal character. 3 A catamite. E. वि before दूष to be or make bad, aff. क्कुन्.
विदूषण: विदूषण n. (-णं) Censuring, reviling, abuse, satire. E. वि before दूष to make bad or faulty, aff. ल्युट्.
विदेश: विदेश m. (-शः) 1 A foreign country, abroad. 2 Any place away from home. E. वि variety, देश place or country.
विदेशगत: विदेशगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone abroad. E. विदेश, and गत gone.
विदेशगमन: विदेशगमन n. (-नं) Travelling, going abroad. E. विदेश, and गमन going.
विदेशज: विदेशज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Foreign, exotic. E. विदेश, and ज born.
विदेशस्थ: विदेशस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Who or what remains abroad. E. विदेश, and स्थ what stays.
विदेशिन्: विदेशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Foreign, foreigner, exotic. E. विदेश, and इनि aff.
विदेह: विदेह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Incorporeal, without body. m. (-हः) A sovereign of the family of JANAKA, king of Mithilā. f. (-हा) A district in the province of Behar, the same as the ancient Mithilā, or the modern Tirhut. E. वि privative, and देह the body.
विद्ध: विद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pierced, perforated. 2 Thrown, cast, directed, sent. 3 Like, resembling. 4 Opposed, impeded. 5 Beaten, whipped. m. (-द्धः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. विध to pierce, or व्यध to beat, aff. क्त.
विद्धकर्ण: विद्धकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears pierced or slit. mf. (-र्णः-र्णा or -र्णी) A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra, Rox.) E. विद्ध pierced, and कर्ण the ear; also in the latter sense, with कन् added विद्धकर्णिका; also अविद्धकर्ण, &c.
विद्यमान: विद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being, being present or in existence. 2 Actual, real, in possession, (as property.) E. विद to be, 4th cl. and शानच् aff.
विद्या: विद्या f. (-द्या) Knowledge, learning, science, whether sacred or profane, though more especially the former: it is sometimes classed into fourteen divisions; or the four Vedas; the six Aṅgas, or grammar, astronomy, &c.; the Purāṇas as the eleventh class; and the Mīmāṃsā or theology, Nyāya or logic, and Dharma or law, as the remaining three. 2 The goddess DURGĀ. 3 A tree, (Premna spinosa.) 4 A magical pill or bolus, by putting which into the mouth a person has the power of ascending to heaven. E. विद to know, and aff. क्यप्.
विद्याकर: विद्याकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Giving wisdom or science. m. (-रः) A learned man. E. विद्या, and कर what makes, or आकर a mine: see विद्याघर.
विद्यागम: विद्यागम m. (-मः) Acquirement of knowledge. E. विद्या, and आगम coming.
विद्याचण: विद्याचण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Famous for learning or knowledge. E. विद्या knowledge, and चणप् aff. in this particular meaning.
विद्याचुञ्चु: विद्याचुञ्चु mfn. (-ञ्चुः-ञ्चुः-ञ्चु) Famous for knowledge. E. विद्या knowledge, and चुञ्चुप् aff. implying celebrity.
विद्यादल: विद्यादल m. (-लः) The Bhojpatra tree. E. विद्या, and दल a leaf: being used for writing on.
विद्यादान: विद्यादान n. (-नं) Giving knowledge or science. E. विद्या, and दान giving.
विद्यादेवी: विद्यादेवी f. (-वी) A female divinity, one of a class of sixteen, peculiar apparently to the mythological system of the Jainas. E. विद्या science, and देवी a goddess; a goddess of learning or science, a muse.
विद्याधन: विद्याधन n. (-नं) Property acquired by science, as by instruction, &c. E. विद्या knowledge, and धन wealth.
विद्याधर: विद्याधर m. (-रः) A demigod of a particular order or class, a spirit of the air. E. विद्या a magical pill, as above, and धर who has or holds.
विद्यानुपालन: विद्यानुपालन n. (-नं) 1 Patronising learning. 2 Studying, acquiring learning. E. विद्या, and अनुपालन encouraging.
विद्यानुपालिन्: विद्यानुपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Studied, acquiring or having acquired learning. E. विद्या, and अनुपालिन् who prosecutes.
विद्यानुसेवन: विद्यानुसेवन n. (-नं) Cultivating science or learning. E. विद्या, and अनुसेवन pursuing.
विद्यानुसेविन्: विद्यानुसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Cultivating learning, engaged in study. E. विद्या, and अनुसेविन् addicted to.
विद्याप्राप्ति: विद्याप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Acquirement of knowledge. 2 Acquisition made by or through learning. E. विद्या, and प्राप्ति gain.
विद्याभ्यास: विद्याभ्यास m. (-सः) Study, diligent application. E. विद्या, and अभ्यास exercise.
विद्यार्जन: विद्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Acquiring knowledge. 2 Acquiring any thing by knowledge, as by teaching, &c. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जन gaining.
विद्यार्ज्जन: विद्यार्ज्जन n. (-नं) 1 Acquiring knowledge. 2 Acquiring any thing by knowledge, as by teaching, &c. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जन gaining.
विद्यार्जित: विद्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained by or through knowledge. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जित obtained.
विद्यार्ज्जित: विद्यार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gained by or through knowledge. E. विद्या, and अर्ज्जित obtained.
विद्यार्थ: विद्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) Seeking for knowledge. E. विद्या, and अर्थ object.
विद्यार्थिन्: विद्यार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for knowledge. m. (-र्थी) A pupil, a student. E. विद्यार्थ, and इनि aff.
विद्यालब्ध: विद्यालब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Gained by or through learning. E. विद्या, and लब्ध gained.
विद्यालय: विद्यालय m. (-यः) A school, a college. E. विद्या, and आलय a house.
विद्यालाभ: विद्यालाभ m. (-भः) 1 Acquisition of learning. 2 Acquirement by or through learning. E. विद्या, and लाभ gain.
विद्यावत्: विद्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Learned, possessed of learning or science. E. विद्या learning, and मतुप् poss. aff.
विद्याविशिष्ट: विद्याविशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Possessed of learning or science. E. विद्या, and विशिष्ट endowed with.
विद्याविहीन: विद्याविहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed. E. विद्या, and विहीन deprived of.
विद्याव्रतस्नातक: विद्याव्रतस्नातक m. (-कः) The Brahman who has finished his studies and period of studentship. E. विद्या, and व्रत a religious obligation, स्नातक a householder.
विद्यास्नातक: विद्यास्नातक m. (-कः) The student who has finished his religious studies. E. विद्या, and स्नातक a householder.
विद्याहीन: विद्याहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ignorant, uninstructed. E. विद्या, and हीन void of.
विद्युत्: विद्युत् f. (-द्युत्) Lightning. E. वि intensitive or privative, and द्युत light, lustre.
विद्युत्वत्: विद्युत्वत् mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्) Having or containing lightning, electrical, (a cloud, &c.) E. विद्युत् lightning, and मतुप् aff.
विद्युत्प्रिय: विद्युत्प्रिय n. (-यं) Bell-metal. E. विद्युत् lightning, and प्रिय beloved.
विद्युल्लता: विद्युल्लता f. (-ता) Zigzag lightning. E. विद्युत्, and लता a creeper.
विद्योतमान: विद्योतमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, blazing, flashing. E. वि before द्युत to shine, शानच् aff.
विद्योपार्जन: विद्योपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of knowledge. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जन collecting.
विद्योपार्ज्जन: विद्योपार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of knowledge. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जन collecting.
विद्योपार्जित: विद्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by or through learning, &c. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जित obtained.
विद्योपार्ज्जित: विद्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by or through learning, &c. E. विद्या, and उपार्ज्जित obtained.
विद्र: विद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Piercing, perforating. E. विघ to pierce, aff. रक्, form irr., or वि before द्रा to sleep, aff. क.
विद्रधि: विद्रधि m. (-धिः) Phlegmonoid inflammation; especially deep seated, or internal abscess. E. विद्र piercing, धा to have, कि aff.
विद्रधिनाशन: विद्रधिनाशन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera Morunga.) E. विद्रधि a bile or abscess, नाशन destroying, discussing.
विद्रव: विद्रव m. (-बः) 1 Flight, escape, retreat. 2 Fear, agitation, panic. 3 Intellect, understanding. 4 Censure, abuse, reproach. 5 Liquefaction. 6 Flowing out, oozing. E. वि before द्रु to fly, aff. अप्.
विद्राव: विद्राव m. (-वः) 1 Flight, retreat, running away. 2 Liquefaction. E. वि before द्रु to go, causal v., aff. घञ्.
विद्रावक: विद्रावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Liquefying, causing to flow or melt. 2 Driving away. E. वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., ण्वुल् aff.
विद्रावण: विद्रावण n. (-णं) 1 Causing to flow or melt, fusing, liquefying. 2 Driving away, chasing, defeating. E. वि before द्रु to run, &c. causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विद्रावित: विद्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Liquefied, fused. 2 Driven away, put to flight. E. वि before द्रु to flow, &c., causal v., क्त aff.
विद्रुत: विद्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Liquid, liquefied, fluid, as an oily or metallic substance upon being heated. 2 Flown, fled. 3 Running, going fast. 4 Agitated, alarmed. E. वि before द्रु to ooze, &c., aff. क्त.
विद्रुम: विद्रुम m. (-मः) 1 Coral. 2 A tree bearing precious gems. 3 A young sprout or shoot. E. वि implying species, and द्रुम a tree.
विद्रुमलता: विद्रुमलता f. (-ता) A sort of vegetable perfume. E. विद्रुम coral, and लता a creeper.
विद्वत्कल्प: विद्वत्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Less learned, a little learned. E. विद्वत् learned, and कल्प aff. of diminution or inferiority; also with the similar affs. देशीयर् and देश्य, विद्वद्देशीय and विद्वद्देश्य.
विद्वस्: विद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वत्) 1 Intelligent, wise. 2 Learned. m. (-द्वान्) A sage, a seer, one who knows the true nature of the soul and of GOD. E. विद to know, वसु aff. in lieu of शतृ, the usual affix of the present participle.
विद्विष्: विद्विष् mfn. (-द्विट्) An enemy. E. वि before द्विष to hate, क्विप् aff.
विद्विष: विद्विष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Hating, adverse, inimical. m. (-षः) An enemy. E. वि before द्विष to hate, aff. क.
विद्विष्ट: विद्विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Hated, disliked. E. वि before द्विष to hate, क्त aff.
विद्वेष: विद्वेष m. (-षः) Enmity, hatred. E. वि before द्विष to hate, aff. घञ्.
विद्वेषिन्: विद्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Inimical, hostile, hating. m. (-षी) An enemy. E. विद्वेष enmity, इनि aff.
विद्वेष्टृ: विद्वेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what hates, adverse, inimical. E. वि before द्विष to hate, तृच् aff.
विध: विध r. 6th cl. (विधते) 1 To administer, to govern, to rule or command. 2 To pierce, to perforate.

विध mf. (-धः-धा) 1 Form, formula, rule. 2 Manner, kind, sort. 3 Fodder, the food of horses, elephants, &c. 4 Prosperity, thriving. 5 Hire, wages. 6 Act, action. 7 Piercing. E. वि before धा to have, aff. क, or अङ्, and fem. aff. टाप्; or विध to rule, &c., aff. क; the masculine form, though it does occur, is not common, except in composition, when the word is used attributively, as द्विविध of two sorts. mfn. (-धः-धा-धं), &c.
विधवन: विधवन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to shake, aff. ल्युट्.
विधवा: विधवा f. (-वा) A widow. E. वि privative, धव a husband.
विधवागामिन्: विधवागामिन् m. (-मी) One who has intercourse with a widow. E. विधवा, and गामिन् who approaches, (carnally.)
विधवावेदन: विधवावेदन n. (-नं) Marrying a widow. E. विधवा, and आवेदन marrying.
विधव्य: विधव्य n. (-व्यं) Trembling, tremor. E. वि before धू to shake, aff. यत्.
विधस्: विधस् m. (-धाः) BRAHMĀ. E. वि severally or every kind, धा to have, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and the radical vowel dropped.
विधातव्य: विधातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be done or performed. 2 To be done according to rule, to be observed as a rite or ceremony. 3 To be ruled or regulated. E. वि before धा to have, तव्य aff.
विधातृ: विधातृ m. (-ता) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 Love or KĀMA. 3 Fate. E. वि severally, धा to have or contain, (all things,) aff. तृच्.
विधातृभू: विधातृभू m. (-भूः) NĀRADA, the Muni and son of BRAHMĀ. E. विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and भू offspring.
विधात्री: विधात्री f. (-त्री) Long-pepper. E. वि before धा to have, तृच् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
विधान: विधान n. (-नं) 1 Act, action, general or particular, though more especially the performance of such acts or rites as are prescribed in the sacred books of the Hindus. 2 Rule, precept, ordinance, injunction. 3 An elephant's fodder. 4 Form, mode, manner. 5 Sending, ordering. 6 Means, expedient. 7 Wealth. 8 Worship. 9 Active enmity or act of hostility. 10 Gaining, getting, taking. 11 Conflict or contrast of opposite feelings. 12 (In grammar,) Affixing, prefixing, taking as an affix, &c. E. वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.
विधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having, possessing, assuming, wearing. E. वि before धा to have, शानच् aff.
विधानक: विधानक n. (-कं) Pain. E. वि before धा to have, ल्युट् aff., and कन् added.
विधानग: विधानग m. (-गः) A Paṇḍita, a wise or learned man or teacher. E. विधान action, the performance of those acts prescribed by the Śāstras, and ग who goes or performs.
विधानज्ञ: विधानज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A Paṇḍita, &c.: see the last. E. विधान, and ज्ञ who knows.
विधाय: विधाय ind. Having taken, assumed, put on, placed, &c. E. वि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
विधायक: विधायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Consigning, delivering, one who entrusts or deposits any thing, or causes it to be fixed or secure. E. वि before धा to have, (causal form,) aff. ण्वुल्.
विधायकत्व: विधायकत्व n. (-त्वं) Consignment or delivery of any thing, making any thing firm or secure. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, विधायकता.
विधायिन्: विधायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Causing, occasioning, making. 2 Placing, fixing, securing. 3 Delivering, entrusting. 4 Establishing as a rule or law. E. वि before धा to have or hold, causal form, aff. धिनुण्.
विधाव्य: विधाव्य n. (-व्यं) Shaking, agitation. E. वि before घू to shake, ण्यत् aff.
विधास्यत्: विधास्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यती-स्यत्) 1 Purposing or willing to do, make, cause, &c. 2 Intending to direct, enjoin, prescribe, &c. E. वि before धा to have, शतृ aff. in the future tense.
विधि: विधि m. (-धिः) 1 A sacred precept, an act or rite prescribed by the Vedas for effecting certain consequences. 2 Rule, form, formula. 3 Fate, luck, destiny. 4 BRAHMĀ. 5 Time. 6 Order, injunction, command. 7 A name of VIṢṆU. 8 Act, action, general or particular. 9 A text, a sentence in some authority of law or religion, prescribing any particular act or observance. 10 Kind, sort, manner. 11 Fodder, food for elephants or horses. 12 A sacred work, a Śāstra, scripture, the law, (by metonymy.) E. वि before धा to have, or विध to rule, aff. कि.
विधिघ्न: विधिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what deviates from, disregards, or disturbs rules or modes of proceeding. E. विधि, and घ्न what destroys.
विधिज्ञ: विधिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Who or what knows the prescribed mode, form, &c. m. (-ज्ञः) A Brahman who knows the ritual. E. विधि, and ज्ञ who knows.
विधितस्: विधितस् ind. According to rule. E. विधि, and तसि aff.
विधित्सा: विधित्सा f. (-त्सा) Wish to do or make, design, purpose, desire. E. वि before धा to have, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
विधित्सु: विधित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to make, produce, &c. E. वि before धा to have, desid. v., उ aff.
विधिदर्शिन्: विधिदर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) A priest whose business at a sacrifice is to see that every thing is done according to the prescribed rules, and to correct any deviation from them. E. विधि a sacred precept, and दर्शिन् who sees; also विधिदर्शक, &c.
विधिदेशक: विधिदेशक m. (-कः) A priest who corrects errors at a sacrifice: see the last. E. विधि the proper form, and देशक who shews.
विधिपूर्व्वक: विधिपूर्व्वक n. adv. (-कं) After or according to rule. E. विधि, and पर्व्वक prior.
विधिप्रयोग: विधिप्रयोग m. (-गः) Acting upon or in conformity to a rule, &c. E. विधि, and प्रयोग application.
विधिप्रसङ्ग: विधिप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Application of or acting upon a rule. E. विधि, and प्रसङ्ग association.
विधियज्ञ: विधियज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A ceremonial act of worship. E. विधि precept, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
विधियोग: विधियोग m. (-गः) 1 The occurrence of predoomed events. 2 Combination for any act or rite. E. विधि, and योग union, accession.
विधिवत्: विधिवत् ind. Agreeable to rule, conformably to established ordinances. E. विधि a precept, and वति aff.
विधिहीन: विधिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unauthorised, irregular. E. विधि, and हीन abandoned.
विधीयमान: विधीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being defined, enjoined, directed, &c. E. वि before धा to have, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विधु: विधु m. (-धुः) 1 The moon. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 Camphor. 4 A name of BRAHMĀ. 5 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin. 6 An expiatory oblation. E. व्यध to pain or hurt, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the semivowel changed.
विधुक्षय: विधुक्षय m. (-यः) The wane of the moon. E. विधु, and क्षय decay.
विधुत: विधुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, relinquished. 2 Shaken, trembling. E. वि before धु to tremble, aff. क्त.
विधुति: विधुति f. (-तिः) Shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्तिन्.
विधुनन: विधुनन m. (-नं) Tremour, trembling, shaking. E. वि before धू in the 10th cl. to shake, aff. ल्युट्, and the vowel short; also विधूनन.
विधुन्तुद: विधुन्तुद m. (-दः) RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. विध the moon, तुद to torment, aff. खश् or क, and the nasal inserted, the cause of the moon's eclipse.
विधुन्वत्: विधुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वती-न्वत्) Shaking, tossing. E. वि before घु to agitate, शतृ aff.
विधुपञ्जर: विधुपञ्जर m. (-रः) A scimitar, a sabre.
विधुप्रिया: विधुप्रिया f. (-या) A lunar mansion; in mythology, personified as a nymph, the daughter of DAKṢA, and wife of CANDRA or the moon. E. बिधु the moon, and प्रिया the beloved.
विधुर: विधुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Agitated, distressed, overcome with anxiety, distress, &c. 2 Bewildered, confused, (with fear, liquor, &c.) 3 Separate, absent from a mistress or lover. n. (-रं) 1 Separation. 2 Agitation of mind from terror or distress, &c. f. (-रा) Curds mixed up with sugar and spices. E. वि before धुर् a load, a burthen, aff. अप्.
विधुवन: विधुवन n. (-नं) Trembling, tremor. E. वि before धू to agitate, ल्युट् aff., and उवङ augment.
विधूत: विधूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken. 2 Trembling, tremulous. 3 Unsteady. 4 Abandoned. 5 Tossed, waving. E. वि before धू to agitate, aff. क्त.
विधूति: विधूति f. (-तिः) Shaking, agitation, tremor. E. वि before घू to shake, aff. क्तिन्.
विधूनन: विधूनन n. (-नं) Shaking, trembling, tremor. E. वि before घू to agitate, aff. ल्युट्.
विधूनित: विधूनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, (literally or figuratively,) agitated, alarmed. 2 Harassed, annoyed. E. वि before धू to shake, 10th cl. aff. क्त.
विधूय: विधूय ind. Having shaken, shaking, trembling. E. वि before धू to shake, ल्यप् aff.
विधूयमान: विधूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being shaken, shaking, waving, agitated. E. वि before धू to shake, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विधृत: विधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seized, held. 2 Withheld, restrained. 3 Having, possessing, assumed, taken. n. (-तं) 1 Disregard of an injunction or desire. 2 Dissatisfaction. E. वि before धृत held.
विधेय: विधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Compliant, tractable, governable. 2 To be done, what is or ought to be practised. 3 Proper to be enjoined as a rule or law. E. वि before धा to have, यत् aff.
विधेयता: विधेयता f. (-ता) 1 Necessary or proper act or conduct. 2 Docility, submission. 3 Fitness for enactment as a rule or law. E. तल् added to the last; also विधेयत्वं.
विधेयमार्ग: विधेयमार्ग n. (-र्गं) Attempting or seeking to do any necessary act. E. विधेय, and मार्ग seeking.
विधेयपद: विधेयपद n. (-दं) An affair to be done, an object to be accomplished. E. विधेय, and पद place.
विध्यत्: विध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) Piercing, striking, killing. E. व्यध to pierce, शतृ aff.
विध्यमान: विध्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being pierced, struck, wounded, &c. E. व्यध to pierce, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विध्वंस: विध्वंस m. (-सः) 1 Aversion, disrespect, enmity, dislike. 2 Offence, insult. 3 Destruction. E. वि before ध्वंस to fall, aff. घञ्.
विध्वंसिन्: विध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Hostile, adverse. 2 Destroying. E. वि before ध्वंस to fall, घिनुण् aff.
विनत: विनत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, bowed, stooping. 2 Crooked, curved. 3 Humble, modest. f. (-ता) 1 The wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of ARUṆA and GARUḌA. 2 A sort of basket. E. वि before नम to bow, aff. क्त.
विनतासूनु: विनतासूनु m. (-नुः) 1 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. 2 GARUḌA, the younger brother of ARUṆA. E. विनता the mother of these two, and सूनु the son.
विनति: विनति f. (-तिः) 1 Bowing, bending. 2 Humility, modesty. E. वि before नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
विनद: विनद m. (-दः) 1 Sound, noise. 2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. वि, नद to sound, अच् aff.
विनद्य: विनद्य ind. Having sounded, sounding. E. वि before नद to sound, ल्यप् aff.
विनमन: विनमन n. (-नं) Bending, bowing, bending down. E. वि before नम to bend, ल्युट् aff.
विनमित: विनमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bowed down, declined. E. वि, and नमित bowed.
विनम्र: विनम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) 1 Bent, bowed. 2 Humble, modest. E. वि, and नम्र bowed.
विनय: विनय m. (-यः) 1 Modesty, affability, humility, mildness. 2 Reverence, obeisance. 3 Decorum, decency, propriety, of conduct or behaviour. 4 Training, discipline. f. (-या) A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.) E. वि before णी to obtain or guide, aff. अच्.
विनयग्राहिन्: विनयग्राहिन् mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि) Compliant, tractable, humble, governable. E. विनय humility, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
विनयप्रमाथिन्: विनयप्रमाथिन् mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि) Behaving ill or improperly. E. विनय, and प्रमाथिन् vexing.
विनयभाज्: विनयभाज् mfn. (-भा) Modest, well-behaved. E. विनय, and भाज् who shares.
विनयवाच्: विनयवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking humbly or modestly. f. (-वाक्) Modest speech. E. विनय, and वाच् speech.
विनयस्थ: विनयस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Compliant, tractable, governable. E. विनय humility, and स्थ who stays or is.
विनर्दत्: विनर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. वि, and नर्द्द to sound, शतृ aff.
विनर्द्दत्: विनर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. वि, and नर्द्द to sound, शतृ aff.
विनशन: विनशन n. (-नं) 1 Destroying, destruction. 2 A country, northwest of Delhi, Kurukṣetra, the vicinity of the modern Paniput. E. वि before नश to destroy, aff. ल्युट्.
विनश्यत्: विनश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, perishable. E. वि before नश to perish, शतृ aff.
विनश्वर: विनश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Perishable. E. वि before नश to perish, क्वरप् aff.
विनष्ट: विनष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed. E. वि, and नष्ट the same.
विनष्टि: विनष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Disappearance, destruction. E. वि before नश to finish, aff. क्तिन्.
विनस: विनस mfn. (-सः-सा-सी-सं) Noseless. E. वि privative, and नस for नासिका the nose.
विना: विना ind. Without, except. E. वि privative, ना aff.
विनाकृत: विनाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, left, relinquished. E. विना except, and कृत made.
विनाडिका: विनाडिका f. (-का) The 60th part of an Indian hour. E. वि, and नाडिका a Nārī, or hour of twenty-four minutes.
विनाथ: विनाथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Deserted, unprotected, unowned. E. वि priv., नाथ a lord or master.
विनायक: विनायक m. (-कः) 1 A Buddha, a Bauddha deified teacher. 2 GAṆEŚA. 3 GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. 4 A Guru, or spiritual preceptor. 5 An obstacle, an impediment or difficulty. f. (-यिका) The wife of GARUḌA. E. वि before णी to conduct, to obtain, aff. खुल्.
विनाश: विनाश m. (-शः) Disappearance, destruction, loss, annihilation. E. वि before नश to perish, aff. घञ्.
विनाशक: विनाशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Destroying, a destroyer. E. वि before नश to perish, causal form, aff. वुञ्.
विनाशयत्: विनाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Destroying. E. वि before नश to perish, causal v., शतृ aff.
विनाशित: विनाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed. E. वि before नश to perish, causal v., क्त aff.
विनाशिन्: विनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि) 1 Destroyer, destructive. 2 Perishing, being destroyed. 3 Undergoing change or transformation. E. वि before नश to perish, णिनि aff.
विनाशोन्मुख: विनाशोन्मुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Ripe, mature. E. विनाश perishing, उन्मुख in the presence of; verging to rottenness.
विनासक: विनासक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Noseless. E. वि privative, नासिका the nose, or नासा with कप् aff.
विनाह: विनाह m. (-हः) The top or cover of a well. E. वि before नह to bind or tie, aff. घञ्; also वीनाह.
विनिःसरण: विनिःसरण n. (-णं) Going forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before सू to go, ल्युट् aff.
विनिःसृत: विनिःसृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before सृत gone.
विनिक्षिप्त: विनिक्षिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Tossed, thrown, sent. E. वि and नि, before क्षिप्त thrown.
विनिक्षेप: विनिक्षेप m. (-पः) Tossing, throwing, sending. E. वि and नि, before क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.
विनिघ्नत्: विनिघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्) Killing. E. वि before हन to kill, शतृ aff.
विनिद्र: विनिद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown, budded. 2 Awake, awakened, sleepless. E. वि privative, निद्रा sleep.
विनिद्रत्व: विनिद्रत्व n. (-त्वं) Vigilance, wakefulness, waking. E. विनिद्र sleepless, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विनिद्रता.
विनिधाय: विनिधाय ind. Having taken or placed. E. वि, and नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.
विनिपात: विनिपात m. (-तः) 1 Falling, falling down, (literally or figuratively, as from a height, or from dignity, virtue, &c.) 2 Calamity, unavoidable evil, the infliction of the gods or of fate. 3 Disrespect. 4 Pain, distress. 5 Death, destruction. E. वि and नि, prefixed to पत to fall, aff. घञ्.
विनिपातशंसिन्: विनिपातशंसिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Portentous, announcing misfortune or destruction. E. बिनिपात, and शंसिन् what proclaims.
विनिपातित: विनिपातित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Killed, destroyed. 2 Thrown down. E. वि, and नि before पत to fall, causal v., क्त aff.
विनिपात्य: विनिपात्य ind. Having killed. E. वि and नि, before पत to fall, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
विनिमय: विनिमय m. (-यः) 1 Barter, exchange. 2 A pledge, a deposite or security. E. वि and नि, prefixed to मी to go, aff. अच्.
विनियत: विनियत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Regulated, restrained. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, क्त aff.
विनियम: विनियम m. (-मः) Restraint, government. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, aff. अच्.
विनियम्य: विनियम्य ind. Having restrained, checked, &c. E. वि and नि, before यम to restrain, ल्यप् aff.
विनियुक्त: विनियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separated, sundered or detached from, absent, parted. 2 Appointed, attached to. 3 Parted with for a specific purpose. 4 Applied to, employed in. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, क्त aff.
विनियोक्तव्य: विनियोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be employed in, applied to, &c. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, तव्यर aff.
विनियोग: विनियोग m. (-गः) 1 Giving or parting with any thing for a consideration, or in expectation of some advantage. 2 Abandoning, leaving. 3 Separation or detachment from. 4 Impediment. 5 Appointment to any office, &c. 6 Application to or employment in. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. घञ्.
विनियोजित: विनियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Appointed, appropriated, applied, (as to any particular duty or purpose, &c.) 2 Attached or joined to. 3 Deputed, appointed. 4 Employed. E. वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
विनिर्गत: विनिर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone out or from. E. वि and निर्, before गम to go, क्त aff.
विनिर्गम: विनिर्गम m. (-मः) Going forth or out. E. वि and निर्, before गम to go, अच् aff.
विनिर्जय: विनिर्जय m. (-यः) Victory, conquest. E. वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, अच् aff.
विनिर्जित: विनिर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, overcome. E. वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, क्त aff.
विनिर्ज्जित: विनिर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Conquered, overcome. E. वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, क्त aff.
विनिर्णय: विनिर्णय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. वि, and निर्णय the same.
विनिर्णीत: विनिर्णीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, determined, ascertained. E. वि before निर्णीत the same.
विनिर्द्धूत: विनिर्द्धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Scattered, dissipated, dispersed. E. वि, and निर्द्धूत shaken.
विनिर्धूय: विनिर्धूय ind. Having dispersed, scattered, thrown off, &c. E. वि and निर्, before धू to agitate, ल्यप् aff.
विनिर्मुक्त: विनिर्मुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Liberated, let loose or free. 2 Exempt, free from. E. वि and निर् before मुच to loose, क्त aff.
विनिर्यत्: विनिर्य्यत् mfn. (-र्य्यन्-र्य्यन्ती-र्य्यत्) Going out or forth, issuing. E. वि and निर् before या to go, शतृ aff.
विनिर्य्यत्: विनिर्य्यत् mfn. (-र्य्यन्-र्य्यन्ती-र्य्यत्) Going out or forth, issuing. E. वि and निर् before या to go, शतृ aff.
विनिर्वृत्त: विनिर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Excited, occasioned, produced, occurring. 2 Completed, finished. E. वि and निर् privative or intensitive prefixes, वृत to be, aff. क्त.
विनिवारित: विनिवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Kept off, resisted, prevented. 2 Screened, covered, kept out of view. E. वि and नि before वॄ to chuse, क्त aff.
विनिवृत्त: विनिवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Stopped, ceased, ended, refrained, resting or desisting, &c. E. वि and नि privatives, वृत to be, aff. क्त.
विनिवृत्ति: विनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Stop, term, cessation. E. वि and नि before वृत to be, क्तिन् aff.
विनिश्चय: विनिश्चय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. वि, and निश्चय certainty.
विनिश्चल: विनिश्चल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Firm, steady, immovable. E. वि before निश्चल steady.
विनिश्चित: विनिश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Certain, determined, ascertained. E. वि before निश्चित the same.
विनिश्वसत्: विनिश्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sighing. 2 Breathing hard. E. वि and नि before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
विनिश्वास: विनिश्वास m. (-सः) Strong expiration, sighing, breathing hard. E. वि, and नि before श्वस to breathe, aff. घञ्.
विनिहत: विनिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Struck, wounded. 2 Overcome. m. (-तः) 1 A portent, a comet, a meteor. 2 A great or unavoidable calamity; the infliction of fate or heaven. E. वि and नि intensitive prefixes, हत struck.
विनिह्नुत: विनिह्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hidden, concealed. E. वि, and निह्वुत the same.
विनीत: विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Modest, humble, unassuming, unpretending. 2 Compliant, governable, tractable. 3 Placid, meek, virtuous, gentle, having the passions restrained, and the senses under subjection. 4 Well-behaved, decent, decorous. 5 Taken. 6 Trained, (as a horse or ox, &c.) 7 Thrown, sent, dismissed. 8 Lovely, handsome. 9 Led, conveyed. 10 Chastised, punished. 11 Plain, neat, (in dress, &c.) m. (-तः) 1 A horse trained for the manege. 2 A merchant, a trader. E. वि before णी to guide, aff. क्त.
विनीतक: विनीतक mn. (-कः-कं) A mediate conveyance, as a bearer carrying a litter, or a horse dragging a carriage. E. वि implying sort or kind, and णी to take, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
विनीतात्मन्: विनीतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) 1 Well-behaved. 2 Humble, lowly. E. विनीत, and आत्मन् self.
विनीय: विनीय ind. Having taken. m. (-यः) 1 Sediment, dregs. 2 Sin. E. वि before णी to take, aff. क्यप् or ल्यप्.
विनुद्यमान: विनुद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being sent, ordered, dispatched, &c. E. वि before नुद to send, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विनेतृ: विनेतृ m. (-ता) 1 A guide, an instructor, a teacher. 2 A king, a ruler. E. वि before णी to conduct, aff. तृच्.
विनेय: विनेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be taken, to be taken away or separated, &c. 2 To be governed or directed, docile, governable. E. वि before णी to take or obtain, &c., aff. यत्.
विनेश्यत्: विनेश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Wishing or intending to take or take away, to deprive of, &c. E. वि before णी to take, शतृ aff. with a future sense.
विनोक्ति: विनोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) The rhetorical use of the word, ‘without;’ as, का निशाशशि ना विना What is the night without the moon. E. विना, and उक्ति saying.
विनोद: विनोद m. (-दः) 1 Eagerness, vehemence. 2 Play, sport, pastime. 3 Dismissing, abandoning. 4 Interest, interesting pursuit or occupation. 5 Pleasure, gratification. E. वि before नुद to order, aff. घञ्.
विनोदित: विनोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dismissed, dissipated, sent or driven away. 2 Allayed, soothed. 3 Delighted, made happy. E. वि before नुद to send, क्त aff.
विन्द: विन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Who or what finds, gets, gains, &c. E. विद to gain, श aff., नुन् augment.
विन्दु: विन्दु mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु) 1 Intelligent, knowing. 2 Liberal, munificent. m. (-न्दुः) 1 A drop of water or any liquid. 2 A spot, a dot, a mark. 3 The bite or mark of a tooth. 4 The part of the forehead between the eye-brows. 5 A mark or spot of coloured paint on an elephant's face or trunk. 6 The dot over a letter representing the nasal termination. 7 A secondary but connecting incident in a drama. E. विद to know, to be, to be a part of, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the nasal augment.
विन्दुचित्रक: विन्दुचित्रक m. (-कः) The spotted deer. E. विन्दु a spot, and चित्रक variegated.
विन्दुजाल: विन्दुजाल n. (-लं) Coloured marks or spots on an elephant's face and trunk, &c. E. विन्दु a spot, and जाल multitude; also with कन् added, विन्दुजालक n. (-कं.)
विन्दुतन्त्र: विन्दुतन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A die, a dice. E. विन्दु a dot, and तन्त्र chief.
विन्दुरेखक: विन्दुरेखक m. (-कः) A kind of bird. E. विन्दु a spot, and रेखा a line, aff. कन्.
विन्धपत्र: विन्धपत्र f. (-त्रः) A plant, commonly Bel Saṇṭh.
विन्ध्य: विन्ध्य m. (-न्ध्यः) 1 The Vindhya or Bindh mountain, or the mountainous range which runs across India from the province of Behar, nearly to Guzerat, and properly divides Hindustan from the Dekhin. 2 A hunter. f. (-न्ध्या) 1 A fruit, (Annona reticulata.). 2 Small cardamoms. E. वि implying opposition, ध्यै to think, and क aff., form irr.; the mountain is supposed to obstruct the course of the sun.
विन्ध्यकूट: विन्ध्यकूट m. (-टः) The saint AGASTYA. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and कूट to give pain, aff. क, or with युच् aff. विन्ध्यकूटन; Vindhya the personified mountain, having once prostrated himself before AGASTYA his spiritual guide, was ordered by the saint to remain in that posture, as a punishment for the presumption, which had induced him to attempt rivalling the heighth of Meru and Himālaya. The legend appears to originate in the little elevation of the Vindhya chain compared with its extent.
विन्ध्यवासिन्: विन्ध्यवासिन् m. (-सी) The saint and grammarian VYĀḌI. f. (-सिनी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A village and temple sacred to DURGĀ under the forms of Yoga Māyā, and Bhoga Māyā, and a place of great resort amongst the Hindus, situated about three miles from Mirzāpur on the Ganges. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and वासिन् who dwells.
विन्ध्यस्थ: विन्ध्यस्थ m. (-स्थः) The name of a Muni; also VYĀḌI, a saint, and inspired grammarian. E. विन्ध्य the mountain, and स्थ abiding.
विन्ध्याचल: विन्ध्याचल m. (-लः) The Vindhya range of mountains. E. विन्ध्य, and अचल a mountain; also विन्ध्यपर्ब्बत, विन्ध्यशैल.
विन्ध्याटवी: विन्ध्याटवी f. (-वी) The great Vindhya forest, which appears to have spread at one time from near Mathura to the Narmadā. E. विन्ध्य, and अटवी a forest.
विन्ध्याबलीपुत्त्र: विन्ध्याबलीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of the demon BĀṆA or VĀṆA. E. विन्ध्यावली the mother of the demon, and पुत्त्र son; also विन्ध्यावलीसुत.
विन्न: विन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Judged, discussed. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 Fixed, placed. 4 Known. 5 Married, &c. E. विद to know, and aff. क्त.
विन्यस्त: विन्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Placed, deposited, fixed. 2 Delivered. 3 Offered, presented. E. वि and नि before अस to be or throw, aff. क्त.
विन्यास: विन्यास m. (-सः) 1 Assemblage, collecting, collecting or depositing any thing. 2 Site, place, receptacle, that in or on which any thing is placed or deposited. 3 Orderly arrangement or disposition. 4 Entrusting, depositing. 5 A deposit. E. वि, and नि prefixed to अस to take, to throw or place, &c., aff. घञ्.
विपक्त्रिम: विपक्त्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Matured, ripened. 2 Fulfilled, come to pass, as the consequence of former actions. E. वि, and पच to cook, क्त्रि aff., and मप् augment.
विपक्ष: विपक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Opposed or adverse to, contrary, inimical. m. (-क्षः) 1 An enemy, an adversary. 2 A disputant, an opponent. 3 Exception, (in grammar, &c.) 4 (In logic,) An argument or syllogism in which the proposition to be maintained is wanting. E. वि implying opposite, contrary, and पक्ष part or side.
विपक्षतस्: विपक्षतस् ind. Hostilely, inimically. E. विपक्ष, and तसि aff.
विपक्षता: विपक्षता f. (-ता) 1 Hostility, enmity, opposition. 2 Controversy, contradiction in argument. E. तल् added to विपक्ष; also with त्व विपक्षत्वं.
विपक्षपात: विपक्षपात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Indifferent, impartial. E. वि priv., पक्षपात an adherent.
विपञ्चिका: विपञ्चिका f. (-का) A lute. E. कन् fem. form, added to the next.
विपञ्ची: विपञ्ची f. (-ञ्ची) 1 A lute. 2 Play, sport, pastime. E. वि before पचि to extend, (causal form,) to diffuse sounds, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
विपण: विपण m. (-णः) Sale, contract of sale. E. वि before पण to be of price, aff. घञ् or घ; also with ल्युट्, विपणन n. (-नं.)
विपणि: विपणि mf. (-णिः-णी) 1 A place where things are sold, a shop, a stall. 2 A fair, a market, a market place. 3 The street of a market. 4 An article or commodity for sale. E. वि before पण to transact business, aff. इक्, and fem. aff. ङीष्.
विपणिन्: विपणिन् m. (-णी) A dealer, a trafficker, a shop-keeper or merchant. E. विपण sale, इनि aff.
विपत्काल: विपत्काल n. (-लं) Time of calamity or misfortune, adversity. E. विपट्, and काल time.
विपत्ति: विपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Adversity, calamity, misfortune. 2 Pain, agony. 3 Death, dying. E. वि implying reverse, पत् to go, aff. क्तिन्.
विपत्तियुक्त: विपत्तियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unfortunate. E. विपत्ति, and युक्त joined.
विपत्तिरहित: विपत्तिरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Properous, happy. E. विपत्ति, and रहित free from.
विपत्सागर: विपत्सागर m. (-रः) Heavy calamity. E. विपत्, and सागर ocean.
विपथ: विपथ mn. (-थः-थं) A bad road. E. वि depreciative prefix, and पथ for पथिन् a road.
विपद्: विपद् f. (-पत् or पद्) Calamity, adversity, misfortune. E. वि before पद to go, क्विप् aff.; also with टाप् added, विपदा.
विपदा: विपदा f. (-दा) Adversity. E. see the last.
विपदुद्धार: विपदुद्धार m. (-रः) Extrication from misfortune. E. विपत्, and उद्धार lifting up; also विपटुद्धरणं, &c.
विपद्ग्रस्त: विपद्ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Overtaken by or involved in calamity. E. विपट्, and ग्रस्त seized.
विपद्युक्त: विपद्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unhappy, unfortunate. E. विपट्, and युक्त joined.
विपद्रहित: विपद्रहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Prosperous. E. विपट्, and रहित left by.
विपन्न: विपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Unfortunate, declined, fallen into adversity or misfortune. 2 Lost, destroyed, annihilated. 3 Dead, defunct. m. (-न्नः) A snake. E. वि implying reverse, and पद to go, aff. क्त; also with कन् added विपन्नक.
विपरिणाम: विपरिणाम m. (-मः) Change of state or form. E. वि and परि before णम to bow, aff. घञ्.
विपरिणामिन्: विपरिणामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Undergoing or producing change of state or form. E. वि and परि before णम to bow, घिनुण् aff.
विपरिवर्तन: विपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning back or away from. E. वि, and परिवर्त्तन turning round.
विपरिवर्त्तन: विपरिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Turning back or away from. E. वि, and परिवर्त्तन turning round.
विपरिवर्तित: विपरिवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned back or away from, reverted, averted. E. वि and परि before वृत to turn, क्त aff.
विपरिवर्त्तित: विपरिवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned back or away from, reverted, averted. E. वि and परि before वृत to turn, क्त aff.
विपरीत: विपरीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverse, inverse, opposite, contrary. f. (-ता) A lewd woman, a dishonest wife. E. वि and परि implying contrariety or reverse, before इत gone.
विपरीतकारिन्: विपरीतकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Perverse, contradictory, acting contrary to another's wishes. E. विपरीत, and कारिन् who does; also विपरीतकर, विपरीतकर्त्तृ, &c.
विपरीतगति: विपरीतगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Going backwards or reversely. f. (-तिः) Inverse or reverse motion. E. विपरीत, and गति going.
विपरीतता: विपरीतता f. (-ता) Contrariety, reverse or opposite state or condition. E. विपरीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, विपरीतत्वं.
विपर्णक: विपर्णक m. (-कः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. वि separate, पर्ण a leaf, and कन् added.
विपर्यय: विपर्य्यय m. (-यः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse in general, and thence applied to that of which reverse is predicated, as misery, calamity, (the reverse of fortune;) error, misapprehension, (the reverse of reason or truth;) inverted order or succession, (the reverse of that which is usual or prescribed,) &c. 3 Destruction, annihilation. 4 Perverseness of disposition. 5 Change of purpose or conduct. 6 Enmity, hostility. E. वि and परि implying reverse, and इ to go, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff. विपर्य्याय m. (-यः)
विपर्य्यय: विपर्य्यय m. (-यः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse in general, and thence applied to that of which reverse is predicated, as misery, calamity, (the reverse of fortune;) error, misapprehension, (the reverse of reason or truth;) inverted order or succession, (the reverse of that which is usual or prescribed,) &c. 3 Destruction, annihilation. 4 Perverseness of disposition. 5 Change of purpose or conduct. 6 Enmity, hostility. E. वि and परि implying reverse, and इ to go, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff. विपर्य्याय m. (-यः)
विपर्यस्त: विपर्य्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Opposite, contrary, reverse. 2 Conceived to be real (what is not so). E. वि and परि before अस to be, or to throw, क्त aff.
विपर्य्यस्त: विपर्य्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Opposite, contrary, reverse. 2 Conceived to be real (what is not so). E. वि and परि before अस to be, or to throw, क्त aff.
विपर्यास: विपर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse. 3 Investing imaginary things with real attributes, imagining what is unreal or false to be real or true. E. वि and परि before अस to be, aff. घञ्.
विपर्य्यास: विपर्य्यास m. (-सः) 1 Contrariety, opposition. 2 Reverse. 3 Investing imaginary things with real attributes, imagining what is unreal or false to be real or true. E. वि and परि before अस to be, aff. घञ्.
विपल: विपल n. (-लं) A moment, an instant, either a Pala or second, or (1/6)th of it; a simple breathing or (1/16)th of the latter. E. वि, and पल a second.
विपलायन: विपलायन n. (-नं) Flying, running away. E. वि, and पलायन the same.
विपलायित: विपलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Put to flight, run away. E. वि before पलायित the same.
विपव्य: विपव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cleansed or purified. E. वि before पूञ् to purify, aff. क्यप्.
विपश्चित्: विपश्चित् m. (-श्चित्) A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher. E. वि before चि to collect, affs. क्विप् and तुक्, form irr.
विपश्य: विपश्य n. (-श्यं) Knowledge. E. वि variously, पश्य seeing.
विपश्यिन्: विपश्यिन् m. (-श्यी) A Bauddha saint, the first of the seven principal Buddhas. E. विपश्य, and इनि aff.
विपाक: विपाक m. (-कः) 1 Cooking, dressing. 2 Ripening, maturing. 3 Flavour, taste.. 4 Unexpected or improbable result. 5 Poverty, distress. 6 Change of form or state. 7 The consequences of actions, either in this or in a former birth; the operation of time in maturing their results. 8 Assimilation of food, its conversion into a state differing from its original one, digestion. E. वि before पच to ripen, aff. घञ्.
विपाण्डुर: विपाण्डुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Pale, pallid, white. E. वि, and पाण्डुर pale.
विपादन: विपादन n. (-नं) Destroying, killing. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विपादनीय: विपादनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be killed, fit or proper to be destroyed. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विपाद्य and विपादयितव्य.
विपादिका: विपादिका f. (-का) 1 A kibe, a sore or blister on the foot. 2 A riddle, an enigma. E. वि before पद to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
विपादित: विपादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, destroyed. E. वि before पद to go, causal v., क्त aff.
विपाल: विपाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unattended, unguarded. E. वि priv., पाल a keeper.
विपाश्: विपाश् f. (-पाट्) The Vipāś or Vipāśā river. E. see the next.
विपाश: विपाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Unnoosed, unfettered, freed from a noose or tie. f. (-शा) 1 The Vipāśā or the Beyāh river in the Pañjāb. E. वि privative, and पाश् or पाशा a noose, from पश to bind, causal form, with अच् and टाप् or क्विप् aff.; hence also विपाश्; the name applies to the river as having destroyed the cord which the Muni VAŚIṢṬHA had tied round his neck, when about to hang himself through grief for the death of his sons slain by VIŚVĀMITRA.
विपिन: विपिन n. (-नं) A wood, a forest. E. वेप to shake, Uṇādi aff. इनन्.
विपुल: विपुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Large, great. 2 Broad. 3 Deep, profound. m. (-लः) 1 The mountain Meru, or rather the western branch of it. 2 The Himālaya mountain. 3 A respectable man. f. (-ला) 1 The earth. 2 A form of the Āryā metre in which the line is irregularly divided by the Cœsura or pause: three species of this form are reckoned; the Ādivipulā with the pause in the first line, Antyavipulā in the second, and Ubhayavipulā in both lines. E. वि before पुल to be large or lofty, aff. क.
विपुलक: विपुलक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Free from horripilation. E. वि privative, and पुलक erection of the hair of the body.
विपुलता: विपुलता f. (-ता) Magnitude, extent. E. विपुल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व विपुलत्वं.
विपुलरस: विपुलरस m. (-सः) The sugar-cane. E. विपुल much, and रस juice.
विपुलेक्षण: विपुलेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Large-eyed. E. विपुल, and ईक्षण sight.
विपूय: विपूय m. (-यः) The Munja grass, (Saccharum Munja.) E. वि before पुञ् to cleanse, aff. क्यप्; that which is to be cleaned before making into ropes, &c.
विप्र: विप्र m. (-प्रः) 1 A Brahman. 2 (In prosody,) A foot of four short syllables. E. वि before प्रा Sautra root, to fill or complete, (the essential observances,) and क aff.; or वप to shave, Uṇādi aff. रन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
विप्रकार: विप्रकार m. (-रः) 1 Injury, contumely, abuse. 2 Wickedness. 3 Opposition, counteraction. 4 Retaliation. E. वि and प्र depreciative prefixes, and कार making.
विप्रकारिन्: विप्रकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Opposed to, treating with contempt. 2 Retaliating. E. वि and प्र before कृ to do, णिनि aff.
विप्रकृत: विप्रकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Reviled, abused, treated with contempt or contumely. 2 Opposed, counteracted. 3 Injured, offended. 4 Retaliated, requited. E. वि and प्र before कृत made; made little or nothing of.
विप्रकृति: विप्रकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Abuse, injury, contumely. 2 Retaliation, retort. E. वि and प्र implying depreciation or mutuality, and कृति action.
विप्रकृष्ट: विप्रकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Remote, distant. E. वि and प्र before कृष to attract, aff. क्त; also with कन् added, विप्रकृष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
विप्रतिकार: विप्रतिकार m. (-रः) 1 Contradiction, counteraction, opposition. 2 Reverse. 3 Retaliation. E. वि and प्रति before कृ to do, घञ् aff.
विप्रतिकृत: विप्रतिकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Opposed, counteracted. 2 Requited. E. वि and प्रति before कृ to do, क्त aff.
विप्रतिपत्ति: विप्रतिपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Perplexity, confusion. 2 Various acquirement. 3 Mutual connexion with or relation to. 4 Conversancy. 5 Contradiction, difference, discrepancy. 6 Contest, dispute. 7 Opposition of interests. E. वि privative, or implying variety, and प्रतिपत्ति knowledge.
विप्रतिपद्य: विप्रतिपद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be opposed, contradicted, contested. 2 To be acquired. E. प्रति before पद to go, यत् aff.
विप्रतिपद्यमान: विप्रतिपद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being disputed or contested. 2 Being in course of acquirement. E. वि and प्रति before पद to go, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विप्रतिपन्न: विप्रतिपन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Bewildered, perplexed, confused, uncertain. 2 Conversant or acquainted with in various ways, severally or mutually. 3 Connected with. 4 Contested, disputed. 5 Contradicted. 6 Opposed, (as interests.) E. वि, and प्रतिपन्न ascertained, &c.
विप्रतिसिद्ध: विप्रतिसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Contradicted, opposed. 2 Prohibited, forbidden. E. वि, and प्रति implying opposition, and सिद्ध proved, perfected.
विप्रतीसार: विप्रतीसार m. (-रः) 1 Repentance. 2 Evil, wickedness, evil action. 3 Hate, enmity. 4 Rage, wrath. E. वि implying reverse, प्रति to or towards, सार going, conduct; the इ of प्रति optionally long; otherwise विप्रतिसार.
विप्रदह: विप्रदह m. (-हः) Dried fruit or roots, &c.
विप्रदुष्ट: विप्रदुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Spoiled, vitiated, defiled. 2 Bad, corrupt. E. वि and प्र before टुष्ट the same.
विप्रदुष्टभाव: विप्रदुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Bad, vicious, sensual, corrupt. E. विप्रटुष्ट, and भाव disposition or nature.
विप्रमोच्य: विप्रमोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be liberated or freed from. E. वि and प्र before मुच् to loose, यत् aff.
विप्रयाण: विप्रयाण n. (-णं) Flight, retreat. E. वि and प्र before या to go, aff. ल्युट्.
विप्रयुक्त: विप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, disjoined, sundered, away or absent from. E. वि implying separation, प्रयुक्त joined.
विप्रयोग: विप्रयोग m. (-गः) 1 Separation, absence, especially the separation of lovers. 2 Disunion, disjunction. 3 Quarrel, disagreement. 4 Deserving. E. वि before प्रयोग union, contiguity.
विप्रलब्ध: विप्रलब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Tricked, cheated, deceived. 2 Disappointed. f. (-ब्धी) A mistress whose lover is not true to his appointment. E. वि and प्र before लब्ध gained.
विप्रलम्भ: विप्रलम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Tricking, deceiving, disappointing, deceiving by a false affirmation or by not keeping a promise. 2 Separation, especially of lovers. 3 Disunion, disjunction. 4 Quarrel, disagreement. E. वि and प्र implying reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. घञ्.
विप्रलाप: विप्रलाप m. (-पः) 1 Quarrel, wrangling, mutual contradiction. 2 Idle or unmeaning discourse, nonsense. E. वि and प्र implying contradiction or reciprocity, and लाप talk.
विप्रलुम्पक: विप्रलुम्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Rapacious, exacting, avaricious. E. वि and प्र before लुपि to cut off, ण्वुल् aff.
विप्रवास: विप्रवास m. (-सः) Residence in a foreign country. E. वि and प्र implying separation, वस to abide, and घञ् aff.
विप्रवासन: विप्रवासन n. (-नं) 1 Residence abroad. 2 Banishment. E. वि and प्र before वस to dwell, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विप्रश्निका: विप्रश्निका f. (-का) A female fortune-teller. E. वि variously, पृच्छ to ask, aff. इञ्, with नङ् augment, and ठन् added.
विप्रसात्: विप्रसात् ind. As, like as, one with, a Brahman. E. विप्र, and साति aff.
विप्रस्व: विप्रस्व n. (-स्वं) The property of a Brahman. E. विप्र, and स्व own.
विप्रापवाद: विप्रापवाद m. (-दः) Abuse of a Brahman. E. विप्र, and अपवाद reviling.
विप्रिय: विप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Disliked, unbeloved, disagreeable. n. (-यं) Offence, transgression. E. वि privative, and प्रिय fond of.
विप्रुष्: विप्रुष् f. (-प्रुट) 1 A drop of water, &c. 2 A spot, a mark, a dot. E. वि privative, प्रुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.
विप्रोषित: विप्रोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Absent, away from. 2 Banished. E. वि and प्र before वस to dwell, aff. क्त, the semivowel changed to उ.
विप्रोषितभर्तृका: विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.
विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका: विप्रोषितभर्त्तृका f. (-का) A woman whose husband or lover is absent. E. विप्रोषित absent, भर्त्तृ a husband, कन् aff.
विप्रोष्य: विप्रोष्य ind. Having been absent, returning, coming home. E. वि, and प्र before वस to dwell, ल्यप् aff.
विप्लव: विप्लव m. (-वः) 1 Tumult, confusion, trouble. 2 Evil, calamity. 3 Rapine, extortion. 4 Sin, wickedness. 5 Predatory or irregular warfare. 6 Affray, scuffle. 7 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. 8 Confusion, perplexity, (of thought or speech.) E. वि before प्लु to go, aff. अप्.
विप्लाव: विप्लाव m. (-वः) 1 Deluging, inundating. 2 Devastating. 3 Causing tumult or public disturbance. 4 A horse's canter or gallop. E. वि, and प्लु to go, aff. घञ्.
विप्लाव्य: विप्लाव्य ind. 1 Having cast away, defiled, contaminated. 2 Having taught at improper seasons. 3 Having caused to be deluged, devastated, &c. E. वि before प्लु to go, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
विप्लुत: विप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Depraved, wicked, addicted to evil practices, as gaming, whoring, &c. 2 Committing any crime. 3 Contrary, adverse, averse. 4 Inundated, immersed. 5 Devastated, ravaged. E. वि before प्लु to go, aff. क्त.
विप्लुष्: विप्लुष् f. (-प्लुट) 1 A drop of any fluid. 2 A spot, a dot. E. वि before प्लुष to burn, aff. क्विप्; also विप्लुष्.
विप्सा: विप्सा f. (-प्सा) Repetition, succession: see वीप्सा.
विफल: विफल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Vain, idle, unmeaning, fruitless, useless. E. वि privative, and फल fruit.
विफलता: विफलता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness, fruitlessness. E. विफल, and तल् added; also विफलत्वं.
विफलीकरण: विफलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Frustrating, foiling, defeating. 2 Doing any thing in vain. E. विफल, and करण making, च्चि augment.
विफलीकृत: विफलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rendered vain, frustrated. 2 Done in vain. E. विफल, and कृत done, च्चि augment.
विफलीभविष्णु: विफलीभविष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Become unprofitable. E. विफल, and भविष्णु become, च्चि augment.
विफलीभविष्णुता: विफलीभविष्णुता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness. E. तल् added to the last; also, विफलीभविष्णुत्वं.
विफलीभूत: विफलीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become useless. E. विफल, and भत become, च्चि augment.
विबन्ध: विबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Ischury or constipation. E. वि before बन्ध to bind, aff. घञ्.
विबाधा: विबाधा f. (-धा) Pain, agony, anguish. E. वि various, बाधा pain.
विबुद्ध: विबुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Awake, aroused. 2 Unconscious. E. वि, and बुद्ध wakened.
विबुध: विबुध m. (-धः) 1 A god, an immortal. 2 A Paṇḍita, a learned man, a teacher. 3 The moon. E. वि variously, बुध to know, aff. क.
विबोध: विबोध m. (-धः) 1 Inattention, absence. 2 Intelligence. 3 Awaking. 4 Discovering any circumstance. E. वि privative or intensitive, and बोध understanding.
विबोधित: विबोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Awakened. 2 Instructed. E. वि before बुध to know, causal v., क्त aff.
विभक्त: विभक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Divided, portioned, partitioned. 2 Separated, parted. 3 Dividing, sharing, a partner. 4 Distinct. E. वि severally, भज to divide, aff. क्त.
विभक्तज: विभक्तज m. (-जः) A son born after partition of the family property between his parents and brethren. E. विभक्त divided, (being or having been,) and ज born.
विभक्ति: विभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Part, portion, inheritance or share of inheritance, &c. 2 A division, a partition. 3 Inflexion of nouns, declension. E. वि before भज to divide, aff. क्तिन्.
विभङ्ग: विभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Breaking, fracture. 2 Division. 3 Bending, contracting, (especially of the eye-brows.) 4 Expression or play of features. E. वि, and भजि to break, aff. घञ्.
विभजनीय: विभजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be portioned or partitioned. E. वि before भज to divide, अनीयर् aff.
विभज्य: विभज्य ind. Having divided, portioned, &c. E. वि before भज to divide, ल्यप् aff.
विभज्यमान: विभज्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Divisible, portionable, to be or being divided or parted. E. वि before भज to divide, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विभव: विभव m. (-वः) 1 Substance, thing, property, wealth. 2 Emancipation from existence. 3 Supreme or superhuman power. 4 Magnanimity, lofty-mindedness. E. वि implying variety, privation, &c., and भव being.
विभा: विभा f. (-भा) 1 A ray of light. 2 Light, lustre. 3 Beauty. E. वि variously, भा to shine, aff. क्विप्.
विभाकर: विभाकर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. विभा light, and कर who makes.
विभाग: विभाग m. (-गः) 1 Part, portion, share. 2 The share or portion of an inheritance. 3 Partition of inheritance. 4 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. E. वि implying variously, and भाग a portion.
विभागकल्पना: विभागकल्पना f. (-ना) Apportioning or allotment of shares or portions. E. विभाग a division, and कल्पना a making.
विभागतस्: विभागतस् ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share. E. विभाग, and तसि aff.
विभागभाज्: विभागभाज् m. (-भाक्) One who shares in a portion, of property already distributed, applied especially to a son by a father and mother of the same tribe, born subsequent to a distribution of property amongst his parents and brethren, in which case he inherits the portion allotted or reserved to the parents. E. विभाग a portion, and भाक् who shares.
विभागशस्: विभागशस् ind. Proportionately, according to a part or share. E. विभाग, and शसि aff.
विभाज्य: विभाज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) Divisible, portionable, what may be divided or apportioned. E. वि severally, भज to divide, ण्यत् aff.
विभात्: विभात् mfn. (-भान्-भान्ती-भाती-भात्) Shining, splendid. E. वि before भा to shine, शतृ aff.
विभात: विभात n. (-तं) Dawn, day-break. E. वि before भा to shine, aff. क्त; also विभातक n. (-कं)
विभाव: विभाव m. (-वः) 1 A friend or acquaintance. 2 One of the Bhāvas or classes of properties into which the objects of poetical composition are divided; the causative or exciting property, as dress, perfumes, &c. of amorous desire; extravagant gesture of mirth; distress or pain of tenderness; arms and tumult of wrath or heroism, &c. E. वि various, and भाव property, disposition.
विभावक: विभावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discussing, shewing, illustrating. E. वि before भू to think, ण्वुल् aff.
विभावन: विभावन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Discussion, examination, discrimination. 2 Perceiving, seeing, distinguishing. 3 Conceiving, imagination. 4 Ascertaining or judging of facts. 5 Describing effects not arising from the usual causes (in rhetoric.) E. वि before भू in the 10th cl. to think, &c., aff. युच्.
विभावनीय: विभावनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Distinguishable, ascertainable, to be judged or determined. E. वि, and भू to think, अनीयर् aff.
विभावरी: विभावरी f. (-री) 1 Night. 2 Turmeric. 3 A bawd. 4 A harlot. 5 The shreds of a garment torn in a scuffle (?). E. वि before भा to shine, (with stars,) क्वनिप् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्, and रच् substituted for the final; also विभाव amorous excitement, रच् aff.
विभावस्: विभावस् m. (-वान्) The sun. E. विभा, and क्वसु aff.
विभावसु: विभावसु m. (-सुः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 The moon. 4 A sort of necklace or garland. E. विभा light, वसु being, substance.
विभावित: विभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, perceived, marked. 2 Judged, discriminated. 3 Conceived, imagined. 4 Known, understood. 5 Proved, established. E. वि before भू 10th cl. to know or perceive, aff. क्त.
विभावितत्व: विभावितत्व n. (-त्वं) The state of being perceived or judged. E. त्व added to the last.
विभाव्य: विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be seen or observed, remarkable, distinguishable. 2 To be conceived or imagined. E. वि before भू to be, ण्यत् aff.
विभाषा: विभाषा f. or ind. (-षा) Alternative, either of two ways. E. वि alternative, and भाषा speech.
विभासा: विभासा f. (-सा) Light, shining. E. वि before भास to be luminous, अङ् and टाप् affs.
विभासित: विभासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Lighted, shining. E. वि before भास to shine, क्त aff.
विभिद्यमान: विभिद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being wounded; pierced, broken. 2 Being divided or scattered. E. वि before भिद to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विभिन्न: विभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Pierced, wounded. 2 Broken. 3 Scattered, dispersed. 4 Mixed, intermixed, mingling. 5 Various, different. 6 Disappointed. 7 Bewildered, perplexed. E. वि before भिद to break, &c., क्त aff.
विभिन्नता: विभिन्नता f. (-ता) The state of being broken, scattered, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विभिन्नत्व.
विभीत: विभीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fearless. E. वि priv., भीत afraid.
विभीतक: विभीतक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) E. विभीत fearless, कन् aff.
विभीषण: विभीषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fearful, formidable, terrific, horrible. nf. (-णं-णा) The property of exciting fear. m. (-णः) The brother of RĀVAṆA. E. वि before भी to fear, युच् aff., and षुक augment.
विभु: विभु mfn. (-भुः-भुः or भ्वी-भु) 1 Omnipresent, all-pervading. 2 Always, eternal. 3 Firm, solid, hard. m. (-भुः) 1 A master, an owner. 2 ŚIVA. 3 BRAHMĀ. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A servant. 6 Ether. 7 Space. 8 Time. 9 The soul. E. वि before भू to be, aff. डु.
विभुग्न: विभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Bent, bowed, crooked. E. वि before भुज to bend, and क्त aff.
विभुता: विभुता f. (-ता) Power, supremacy. E. विभु, and तल् aff.; also विभुत्वं.
विभूति: विभूति m. (-तिः) 1 Superhuman power, consisting of eight faculties, especially attributed to ŚIVA, and supposed to be attainable by human beings, through a course of austere worship, attended with magical rites, in honor of that deity and his spouse DURGĀ: the eight properties thus supposed to be assumable at will are, अणिमा extreme minuteness or invisibility; लघिमा extreme lightness or incorporeality; प्राप्ति attaining or reaching any thing, as illustrated by the power of touching the moon with the tip of the finger; प्राकाम्यं the fulfilment of every wish; महिमा illimitable bulk; ईशिता supreme dominion over animate or inanimate nature; वशिता the power of enchanting or changing the course of nature, and कामावशायिता the accomplishment of every promise or engagement. 2 Power, dignity, dominion. 3 Ashes of cow-dung, &c. with which ŚIVA is said to have smeared his body, and thence used in imitation of him by devotees. E. वि implying change of form, &c., भू to be, aff. क्तिन्.
विभूतिमत्: विभूतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Superhuman. 2 Smeared with ashes. E. विभूति, and मतुप् aff.
विभूषण: विभूषण n. (-णं) Ornament, decoration. E. वि implying variety, and भूषण adorning.
विभूषा: विभूषा f. (-षा) 1 Lustre, splendour, beauty. 2 Ornament, decoration. E. वि before भूष to adorn, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
विभूषित: विभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Adorned, decorated. E. वि variously, भूष to adorn, क्त aff.
विभृत: विभृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Held, retained. 2 Upheld, supported. E. वि before भृत supported.
विभेद: विभेद m. (-दः) 1 Dividing, breaking. 2 Wounding, piercing. 3 Variety, distinction. 4 Bewildering, perplexing. 5 A division or separation. 6 Enmity, opposition. 7 Contradiction. E. वि before भिद to break, घञ् aff.
विभेदन: विभेदन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking, dividing. 2 Separating, literally or figuratively, as setting at variance. E. वि before भिद to divide, ल्युट् aff.
विभ्रम: विभ्रम m. (-मः) 1 One of the classes of feminine actions proceeding from the passion of love, flurry, confusion. 2 Error, mistake, blunder. 3 Hurry, flurry. 4 Doubt, apprehension. 5 Beauty. 6 Whirling, going round. f. (-मा) Old age. E. वि before भ्रम to err, &c., aff. घञ्.
विभ्रष्ट: विभ्रष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Lost, gone. 2 Broken off or from, fallen, separated. E. वि before भ्रस्ज to be broken, क्त aff.
विभ्राज्: विभ्राज् mfn. (-भ्राड् or -भ्राट्) 1 Elegant, richly dressed or decorated. 2 Splendid, luminous, shining. E. वि before भ्राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
विभ्राजमान: विभ्राजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Resplendent, glittering. E. वि, भ्राज to shine, शानच् aff.
विभ्राण: विभ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having, possessing. E. वि before भृ to have, शानच् aff.
विभ्रान्त: विभ्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Hurried, flurried, erring, &c. through precipitation. E. वि before भ्रम to err, aff. क्त.
विभ्रान्तशील: विभ्रान्तशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Mad, drunk, intoxicated, or insane. m. (-लः) 1 A monkey. 2 The disk of the sun or moon. E. विभ्रान्त wandering, and शील disposition.
विभ्रान्ति: विभ्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Error, confusion. 2 Hurry, flurry, precipitation. 3 Whirling, going round. E. वि before भ्रम to err, aff. क्तिन्.
विमत: विमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Disliking, averse or hostile to. 2 Disagreeing, of a different opinion. m. (-तः) An enemy. E. वि adverse, and मत disposed.
विमति: विमति f. (-तिः) 1 Dislike, aversion. 2 Difference of opinion, dissent. E. वि, and मति mind.
विमत्सर: विमत्सर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Unenvious, unambitious. E. वि priv., मत्सर envious.
विमनस्: विमनस् mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः) 1 Sad, perplexed, disordered, heartbroken. 2 Changed in mind or feeling. 3 Averse, disliking, displeased. 4 Absent, thinking of something else. E. वि privative, and मनस् the mind; having no mind or heart.
विमनस्क: विमनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Sad, bewildered, heart-broken, &c. E. कन् added to the preceding.
विमनीकृत: विमनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Altered in mind or feeling. 2 Sad, sorrowful. 3 Displeased, offended. E. विमनस्, and कृत made with च्चि augment.
विमनीभूत: विमनीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Changed in mind or feeling, &c.: see the last. E. विमनस्, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
विमय: विमय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. वि before मि to scatter, aff. अच्.
विमर्द: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 The trituration of perfumes. 3 Touch, contact. 4 Destroying, killing. 5 A plant, (Cassia esculenta.) E. वि before मृद to grind, aff. अच्.
विमर्द्द: विमर्द्द m. (-र्द्दः) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 The trituration of perfumes. 3 Touch, contact. 4 Destroying, killing. 5 A plant, (Cassia esculenta.) E. वि before मृद to grind, aff. अच्.
विमर्दन: विमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, pounding, grinding. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 The trituration of perfumes. 4 Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse. E. वि before मृद to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also विमर्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना.)
विमर्द्दन: विमर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, pounding, grinding. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 The trituration of perfumes. 4 Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse. E. वि before मृद to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also विमर्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना.)
विमर्दार्ध: विमर्द्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) (In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunction to the end of an eclipse. E. विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.
विमर्द्दार्द्ध: विमर्द्दार्द्ध n. (-र्द्धं) (In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunction to the end of an eclipse. E. विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.
विमर्दोत्थ: विमर्द्दोत्थ m. (-त्थः) A pleasing scent. E. विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.
विमर्द्दोत्थ: विमर्द्दोत्थ m. (-त्थः) A pleasing scent. E. विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.
विमर्श: विमर्श n. (-र्शः) Discussion, investigation, reasoning, examination by reason. E. वि implying discrimination, मृश to perceive, aff. घञ्.
विमर्शन: विमर्शन n. (-नं) Investigating, discussing. E. वि, मृश to judge, ल्युट् aff.
विमर्शिन्: विमर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Thinking, deliberating. E. विमश, and इनि aff.
विमर्ष: विमर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Irritation, impatience. 2 Displeasure, dissatisfaction. 3 Interruption of the prosperous course of a dramatic story, reverse. E. वि before मृष to endure, aff. अप्.
विमर्षिन्: विमर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) 1 Impatient, intolerant. 2 Averse, disliking. E. विमर्ष, and इनि aff.
विमल: विमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Clean, pure, (either literally, as clothes, &c., or figuratively, as the heart or mind.) 2 Beautiful. 3 White. 4 Transparent. f. (-ला) 1 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 2 A sort of soil. m. (-लः) An Arhat or Jaina deified sage. n. (-लं) Silver gilt. E. वि privative, मल dirt.
विमलमणि: विमलमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal. E. विमल clean, clear, and मणि a jewel.
विमलात्मक: विमलात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clean, pure. E. विमल clean, and आत्मन् nature, aff. कन्.
विमलात्मन्: विमलात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Pure, undefiled. E. विमल, and आत्मन् self.
विमलाद्रि: विमलाद्रि m. (-द्रिः) A particular mountain. E. विमल clean, or crystal, and अद्रि a mountain.
विमलार्थक: विमलार्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Clear, clean, pure. E. विमल clean, अर्थ purpose, कन् added.
विमस्तकित: विमस्तकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beheaded, decapitated. E. वि priv., मस्त the head, इतच् aff.
विमांस: विमांस mn. (-सः-सं) Unclean meat, as the flesh of dogs, &c. E. वि depreciative prefix, and मांस flesh.
विमातृ: विमातृ f. (-ता) A step-mother, a father's wife. E. वि different, मातृ mother.
विमातृज: विमातृज m. (-जः) A step-mother's son. E. विमातृ, and ज born.
विमान: विमान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A car or chariot of the gods, sometimes serving as a seat or throne, and at others carrying them through the skies self-directed and self-moving. 2 Any car or vehicle. 3 A horse. 4 A palace, the palace of an emperor or supreme monarch. 5 Disrespect, dishonour. 6 Measure. E. वि before मन to understand, with घञ् aff., or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्, or वि priv., मान honour.
विमानित: विमानित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dishonoured. E. विमान, and इतच् aff.
विमार्ग: विमार्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A broom, a brush. 2 A bad road. 3 A wrong road, literally or figuratively, evil conduct. E. वि before मृज to clean, aff. घञ्, or वि privative, and मार्ग a road.
विमार्गण: विमार्गण n. (-णं) Searching, seeking. E. वि before मृग to search, ल्युट् aff.
विमुक्त: विमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Loosed, liberated. 2 Hurled, thrown. 3 Quitted, abandoned. 4 Issued or let loose from, given vent to. E. वि before मुक्त the same.
विमुक्ति: विमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Liberation, especially final emancipation from future existence. 2 Separation, parting. E. वि before मुक्ति the same.
विमुख: विमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Averted, having the face cast down or turned away. 2 Opposed. E. वि reverse, and मुख the countenance.
विमुखता: विमुखता f. (-ता) 1 Disappearance, departure. 2 Turning away. 3 Opposition. E. तल् added to the last; also विमुखत्वं.
विमुखिता: विमुखिता f. (-ता) 1 Turning away from, enmity. 2 Departure. 3 Opposition. E. विमुखिन्, and तल् aff.; also विमुखित्वं.
विमुखिन्: विमुखिन् mfn. (-खि-खिनी-खि) 1 Averted, turned away. 2 Hostile, averse to or from. E. विमुख, and इनि aff.
विमुखीकरण: विमुखीकरण n. (-णं) Turning away from, leaving. E. विमुख, and करण doing, च्चि augment.
विमुखीकृत: विमुखीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Turned away from, averted, departed. E. विमुख, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
विमुग्ध: विमुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Bewildered, absorbed. E. वि before मुह to be bewildered, क्त aff.
विमुच्यमान: विमुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being let loose or liberated, in the act of spreading abroad. E. वि before मुच to be loosed, शानच् aff.
विमुद्र: विमुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) 1 Blown, budded, opened as a bud or flower. 2 Unsealed, unclosed. E. वि privative, मुद्रा a seal.
विमूढ: विमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Bewildered, discomposed. 2 Foolish. 3 Beguiled, led astray, seduced, tempted. E. वि, and मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त.
विमूढसंज्ञ: विमूढसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Senseless, unconscious. E. विमूढ, and सज्ञा sense.
विमूढात्मन्: विमूढात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Beguiled, foolish. E. विमूढ, and आत्मन् self.
विमृदित: विमृदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed. 2 Ground, pounded. E. वि, मृद to rub, क्त aff.
विमृश्य: विमृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) To be discussed or reflected upon. ind. Having considered. E. वि, मृश to reflect, युच् or ल्यप् aff.
विमृश्यकारिन्: विमृश्यकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Acting after due deliberation. E. विमृश्य, and कारिन् who acts.
विमोक्ष: विमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) Liberation, freedom, being or letting loose. E. वि before मोक्ष the same.
विमोक्षण: विमोक्षण nf. (-णं-णा) Quitting, abandoning, resigning. E. वि before मोक्षण the same.
विमोचन: विमोचन n. (-नं) Liberating. E. वि before मुच to set free, ल्युट् aff.
विमोचित: विमोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Liberated, set free. E. वि before मुच to liberate, causal v., aff. क्त.
विमोहन: विमोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) Fascinating, seducing, bewitching, tempting, (the instrument or agent.) n. (-नं) Seducing, tempting, confounding the mind and exciting the passions, (the act.) E. वि before मुह to be foolish, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
विमोहित: विमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fascinated, beguiled. E. वि before मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
विम्ब: विम्ब mn. (-म्बः-म्बं) 1 The disk of the sun or moon. 2 An image, a picture, a shadow, a reflected or represented form. 3 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha. nf. (-म्बं-म्बा or -म्बी) A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, (Momordica monadelpha.) E. वि to go, to shine, वन Uṇādi aff., and मुस् augment, with the radical vowel made short.
विम्बक: विम्बक n. (-कं) 1 The disk of the sun or moon. 2 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha or the plant itself. E. कन् added to the last.
विम्बजा: विम्बजा f. (-जा) The Momordica monadelpha or the gourd. E. विम्ब the plant, and ज born.
विम्बट: विम्बट m. (-टः) The mustard plant, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.) E. विम्ब as above, अट to go or grow (like), aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
विम्बागत: विम्बागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reflected. E. विम्ब, and आगत arrived.
विम्बिका: विम्बिका f. (-का) 1 A cucurbitaceous plant bearing a bright red gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.) 2 The disk of the sun or moon. E. कन् in the fem. form, added to विम्ब as above.
विम्बित: विम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pictured, imaged, reflected. E. विम्ब, and इतच् aff.
विम्बु: विम्बु m. (-म्बुः) The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
विम्बोष्ठ: विम्बोष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Red-lipped, having lips like the Vimba fruit. E. विम्ब as above, and ओष्ठ the lip; also विम्बौष्ठ.
विम्लान: विम्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Fresh, pure, free from soil or decay. 2 Refreshed. E. वि priv., म्लान decayed.
विम्लापन: विम्लापन n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, wiping. 2 Refreshing, reviving. E. वि priv., म्लै to decay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
वियच्चारिन्: वियच्चारिन् m. (-री) A kite. E. वियत् the sky, and चारिन् who goes.
वियत्: वियत् n. (-यत्) Sky, heaven, ether, atmosphere. E. वि privative, यम to refrain or cease, aff. क्विप, and तुक् final.
वियति: वियति m. (-तिः) A bird. E. वि before यत to endeavour, कि aff.
वियद्गङ्गा: वियद्गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The Ganges or river of heaven. E. वियत् heaven, गङ्गा the river.
वियद्गति: वियद्गति f. (-तिः) Moving in the air. E. वियत्, and गति motion.
वियद्भूति: वियद्भूति f. (-तिः) Darkness. E. वियत् the sky, and भूति superhuman power.
वियन्मणि: वियन्मणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. वियत् the sky, and मणि a gem.
वियम: वियम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, restraint. 2 Rest, cessation, stop. 3 Pain or distress of various kinds. E. वि before यम to check or restrain, aff. अप्; also वियाम.
वियात: वियात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shameless, impudent, ill-behaved. E. वि implying prevention, and यात wished; wishing for what is prohibited or improper.
वियाम: वियाम m. (-मः) 1 Forbearance, restraint. 2 Rest, stop, cessation. 3 Pain or distress of various kinds. E. वि before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.
वियुक्त: वियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Separated, sundered. E. वि privative, and युक्त jointed.
वियोग: वियोग m. (-गः) 1 Absence, separation, especially of lovers. 2 Disunion, disjunction. E. वि privative, and योग union.
वियोगभाज्: वियोगभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Suffering separation. E. वियोग separation, भज् to serve, to be subject to, causal form, aff. क्विप्.
वियोगिन्: वियोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Separated, absent, remote, apart. m. (-गी) The ruddy goose. E. वियोग separation, and इनि aff.
वियोजित: वियोजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separated, disjoined, disunited. 2 Parted from, deprived of. E. वि privative, योजित joined.
विरक्त: विरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Averse, indifferent, free from inclination or affection. 2 Stoical, void of attachment to worldly objects. 3 Empassioned, interested, feeling passion or regard for any person or any thing. E. वि privative or pleonastic, before रञ्ज to feel passion, aff. क्त.
विरक्तभाव: विरक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Disinclined to, disliking. E. विरक्त, and भाव quality.
विरक्ति: विरक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Aversion, disinclination. 2 Absence of affection. E. वि before रञ्ज to affect, क्तिन् aff.
विरचत्: विरचत् mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्) Making, composing, fabricating, embellishing, &c. E. वि before रच to make, aff. शतृ.
विरचन: विरचन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Making. 2 Composing. 3 Embellishing. 4 Embellishment, any artificial and ornamental fabric or contrivance. E. वि before र to make, युच् aff.
विरचित: विरचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made, prepared, effected. 2 Written, composed. 3 Trimmed, ornamented. 4 Contrived, constructed, arranged. E. वि pleonasm, and रच made, क्त aff.
विरच्य: विरच्य ind. Having made. E. वि, रच to make, ल्यप् aff.
विरजस्: विरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) Free from dust. f. (-जाः) A woman who has ceased to menstruate. E. वि privative, रजस् the menses.
विरजस्तमस्: विरजस्तमस् m. (-माः) A virtuous man, one free form the two properties of ignorance and passion. E. वि privative, रजस the quality of passion, and तमस् that of ignorance.
विरजा: विरजा f. (-जा) 1 A plant, commonly कवित्थानी. 2 A sort of grass, commonly Dūb.
विरजीकृत: विरजीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Exempt or freed from passion. 2 Clean, freed from dust, &c. E. वि priv., रजस् passion, &c., कृत made, च्चि augment.
विरजीभूत: विरजीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Free from passion, pure, holy. 2 Clean, clear. E. वि priv., रजस् passion, भूत become, च्चि augment.
विरञ्च: विरञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) BRAHMĀ. E. वि before रच to create, aff. अच्, and नुम् augment, more properly विरिञ्च.
विरट: विरट m. (-टः) 1 The name of a king. 2 The shoulder. 3 A black kind of Agallochum.
विरण: विरण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthum.) E. see वीरण.
विरत: विरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stopped, ceased, rested. E. वि before रम to stop or rest, aff. क्त.
विरति: विरति f. (-तिः) 1 Stop, cessation, term, rest. 2 End, term. E. वि before रम to play, क्तिन् aff.
विरमत्: विरमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) 1 Resting, stopping. 2 Sporting. E. वि before रम to sport, शतृ aff.
विरल: विरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fine, delicate, thin, (but with interstices.) 2 Loose, relaxed. 4 Apart, wide, separated by an interval. 4 Remote, rare, occurring at distant or repeated intervals of time. n. (-लं) Sour curds. E. वि apart, रा to go or be, aff. कलन्.
विरलजानुक: विरलजानुक m. (-कः) A man with bandy legs. E. विरल wide, and जानु the knee, कन् added.
विरलद्रवा: विरलद्रवा f. (-वा) Gruel made of rice or other grain, with the addition, of Ghee, &c. E. विरल apart, द्रु to ooze, aff. अच्.
विरस: विरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Insipid. E. वि, and रस flavour.
विरह: विरह m. (-हः) 1 Separation, parting, absence, especially the separation of lovers. 2 Forbearance, cessation, relinquishment. E. वि before रह to abandon, aff. अच्.
विरहय्य: विरहय्य ind. Having abandoned. E. वि before रह to quit, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
विरहार्त: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover. E. विरह, and आर्त्त pained.
विरहार्त्त: विरहार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained by the absence of a lover. E. विरह, and आर्त्त pained.
विरहित: विरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, deserted, relinquished. 2 Void of exempt, or free from. E. वि before रह to abandon, aff. क्त.
विरहिन्: विरहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Separate, sundered, absent or apart from. f. (-हिणी) 1 Wages, hire. 2 A woman absent from her husband or lover. E. विरह absence, इनि aff.
विरहोत्कण्ठिता: विरहोत्कण्ठिता f. (-ता) A woman whose lover or husband is absent. E. विरह separation, उत्कण्ठित afflicted.
विराग: विराग m. (-गः) The absence of desire or passion, indifference, philosophy, the disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in  this world or the next. E. वि privative, and राग passion, desire.
विरागार्ह: विरागार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Void of passion or desire. E. विराग the absence of desire, and अर्ह worthy.
विरागिन्: विरागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Void of passion or desire. E. विराग, and इनि aff.
विराज्: विराज् m.
