(-राट्) 1 A man of the regal or military class. 2 Splendour, beauty. 3 The first progeny of BRAHMĀ, who having divided himself into male and female, produced from the female, VIRĀJ; VIRĀJ then by himself produced the first Menu or SVAYAMBHUVA, who was the progenitor of the Prajāpatis, and the secondary framer of the visible world: in other places VIRĀJ is the same as BRAHMĀ, and assumer of the androgynous form in his own person. E. वि severally or separately, &c., राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.
विराजत्: विराजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Shining, splendid, handsome. E. वि, and राज to shine, aff. शतृ.
विराजमान: विराजमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Splendid, brilliant, handsome. E. वि before राज to shine, शानच् aff.
विराजित: विराजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illuminated, irradiated, splendid. 2 Manifested, made visible. E. वि before राज to shine, क्त aff.
विराट: विराट m. (-टः) 1 A country, one of the midland divisions of India, probably Berar. 2 A sovereign. E. वि before रट to sound, aff. घञ्.
विराटज: विराटज m. (-जः) An inferior sort of diamond, said to be found in the country Virāṭa. E. विराट the country, and ज produced.
विराणिन्: विराणिन् m. (-णी) An elephant. E. वि before रण battle, aff. अण्, and इनि added.
विराद्ध: विराद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Treated with disrespect, reviled, abused. 2 Opposed. 3 Offended. E. वि before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.
विराद्धृ: विराद्धृ mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ) 1 Thwarting, opposing. 2 Offending, injuring. 3 Abusive, calumnious. E. वि before राध to accomplish, aff. तृच्.
विराध: विराध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition, prevention. 2 Vexation, annoyance. E. वि before राध to accomplish, घञ् aff.
विराध्यत्: विराध्यत् mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्) 1 Opposing, thwarting. 2 Offending, annoying, injuring. E. वि before राध to accomplish, शतृ aff.
विराम: विराम m. (-मः) 1 End, conclusion, cessation, term. 2 Rest, cessation from labour. 3 Stop, pause. 4 Interval between words or sentences. E. वि before रम to stop, aff. घञ्.
विराल: विराल m. (-लः) A cat. E. विडाल as above, and ड changed to र.
विराव: विराव m. (-वः) Sound, noise. E. वि before रु to make a noise, aff. घञ्.
विराविन्: विराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Shouting, roaring, crying, &c. f. (-णी) 1 A broom. 2 The name of a river. 3 Weeping, crying. E. विराव noise, इनि and ङीप् aff.
विरिक्त: विरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Purged. E. वि before रिच to void by stool, क्त aff.
विरिञ्चन: विरिञ्चन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ: see the next.
विरिञ्चि: विरिञ्चि m. (-ञ्चिः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 ŚIVA. E. वि implying various kinds, (of beings,) रच to make or create, इन् aff., the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment; also with अच् aff. विरिञ्च, and with युच्, विरिञ्चन; some authorities omit the change of the radical vowel, and write विरञ्च and विरञ्चि, but these seem to be less accurate.
विरिब्ध: विरिब्ध m. (-ब्धः) A note, a tone. E. वि before रेभ to sound, क्त aff., इट् augment, form irr.
विरुग्न: विरुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Broken, bent. 2 Blunted. 3 Destroyed. E. वि before रुज to be sick, क्त aff.
विरुद: विरुद m. (-दः) 1 Crying. 2 Proclaiming. E. वि, रुद to cry, क aff.
विरुद्ध: विरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Opposed, hindered. 2 Reverse, contrary, opposite. 3 Inconsistent, (in argument,) incongruous, a nonsequitur. 4 Opposed in quality, as sweet with sour, &c. 5 Disagreeing with each other, (as articles of medicine or food.) 6 Hostile, adverse. 7 Excluded, disqualified. 8 Surrounded, blockaded. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. क्त.
विरुद्धता: विरुद्धता f. (-ता) 1 Opposition, contraiety. 2 Incongruity. 3 Enmity. E. तल् added to विरुद्ध; also with त्व, विरुद्धत्वं.
विरुद्धभुज्: विरुद्धभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Eating incompatible things. E. विरुद्ध, and भुज who eats.
विरुद्धभोजन: विरुद्धभोजन n. (-नं) Incompatible food. E. विरुद्ध, and भोजन eating.
विरुद्धान्न: विरुद्धान्न n. (-न्नं) Incompatible food. E. विरुद्ध, and अन्न food.
विरूक्षण: विरूक्षण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Astringent, drying. n. (-णं) 1 Censure, blame, reviling, abuse. 2 Oath, imprecation. 3 Contracting, roughening, acting as an astringent. E. वि before रूक्ष to be rough, aff. ल्युट्.
विरूढ: विरूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Budded, blossomed. 2 Born. E. वि before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.
विरूप: विरूप mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं) 1 Deformed, monstrous. 2 Unusual in form or nature, unnatural. n. (-पं) 1 Irregular or monstrous shape. 2 Difference of nature or character. f. (-पा) The wife of YAMA. E. वि implying variety, and रूप form.
विरूपक: विरूपक mfn. (-कः-पिका-कं) 1 Frightful, hideous. 2 Deformed, mis-shapen. E. कन् added to the last.
विरूपकरण: विरूपकरण n. (-णं) Disfiguring. E. विरूप, and करण making.
विरूपाक्ष: विरूपाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 One of the Rudras. E. वि implying reverse, रूप form, and अक्ष the eye; having three eyes.
विरेक: विरेक m. (-कः) 1 Purging, evacuation by stool. 2 A purgative. E. वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.
विरेचन: विरेचन n. (-नं) 1 Purging, evacuation by stool. 2 A purgative. E. वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.
विरेचित: विरेचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purged, evacuated. E. वि before रिच to purge, क्त aff.
विरेच्य: विरेच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) To be purged. E. वि, रिच to purge, यत् aff.
विरेफ: विरेफ m. (-फः) 1 A river in general. 2 The absence of the letter र. E. वि privative, रेफ the letter र, &c.
विरेभित: विरेभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, uttered. E. वि before रेभे to sound, aff. क्त.
विरोक: विरोक n. (-कं) A hole, a chasm. m. (-कः) A ray of light. E. वि before रुच to shine, aff. घञ्.
विरोचन: विरोचन m. (-नः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 The son of the sovereign PRAHLĀDA. E. वि before रुच to shine, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
विरोचनसुत: विरोचनसुत m. (-तः) BALI, the sovereign of Mahābalipura. E. विरोचन the son of PRAHLĀDA, and सुत son.
विरोचिष्णु: विरोचिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) 1 Shining. 2 Illuminating. E. वि before रुच to be light, इष्णुच् aff.
विरोध: विरोध m. (-धः) 1 Enmity, animosity. 2 Restraint, check, controul, confinement. 3 Opposition, contradiction. 4 Preventing, hindrance. 5 War. 6 Calamity, misfortune. 7 Surrounding, investing, siege, blockade. 8 Impediment to a successful progress of the story (in a play). 9 Antithesis, contrast. 10 Opposition of qualities (in articles of food or medicine, &c.) 11 Inconsistency, (in argument.) f. (-धी) Fixed rule, ordinance, institute. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. घञ्.
विरोधन: विरोधन n. (-नं) 1 Opposition, resistance, contradiction. 2 Hindering, obstructing, preventing. 3 Incongruity, inconsistency. 4 Taunting, provoking. 5 Encountering or defying peril. 6 Investing, blockading. E. वि before रुध to stop, aff. ल्युट्.
विरोधिकृत्: विरोधिकृत् m. (-कृत्) The forty-fifth year of the Indian cycle. E. विरोधि opposition, कृत् making.
विरोधिन्: विरोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 1 Inimical, adverse, hostile. 2 Opposing, preventing. 3 Obstructive. 4 Exclusive, disqualifying. 5 Contradictory, inconsistent. 6 Quarrelsome, contentious. 7 Of opposite and incompatible quality, (food, medicine, &c.) 8 Besieging, blockading. m. (-धी) 1 An enemy, an opponent. 2 The twenty-fourth year of the cycle. E. विरोध enmity, aff. इनि.
विरोधोक्ति: विरोधोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Quarrel, dispute, mutual contradiction. E. विरोध contradiction, and उक्ति speech.
विरोहित: विरोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, destitute, forsaken. E. वि, रुह to ascend, क्त aff.
विल: विल r. 6th cl. (विलति) 1 To wear, to put on, to clothe or cover. 2 To break or divide. r. 10th cl. (वेलयति) To throw, to cast, to direct or send.
विल n. (-लं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 A cave, a cavern. m. (-लः) 1 One of INDRA'S horses. 2 A sort of reed or cane, (Calamus rotang.) E. विल to divide, &c., aff. क.
विलक्ष: विलक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Astonished, surprised. 2 Abashed, ashamed. 3 Markless, having no mark or aim. 4 Contra-indicated, having a character or mark contrary to what is usual or natural. 5 Having no characteristic mark or property. E. वि before लक्ष to see, aff. अच्.
विलक्षण: विलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Other, different. n. (-णं) 1 State or condition for which no cause can be assigned, vain and causeless state. 2 Seeing, observing. E. वि privative or negative, and लक्षण a mark or sign.
विलक्षत्व: विलक्षत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Shame. 2 Surprise. 3 Absence of mark or aim. 4 Absence of distinguishing property. E. त्व added to विलक्ष; also with तल् aff. विलक्षता.
विलक्षित: विलक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen, observed. 2 Affected without a cause. 3 Undiscriminated, unmarked. E. वि inten. or priv., and लक्षित marked.
विलग्न: विलग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Joined or attached to, fixed on or connected with. n. (-ग्नं) The waist, the middle. E. वि before लग to be connected with, क्त aff., form irr.
विलङ्घन: विलङ्घन n. (-नं) Overstepping, transgressing. E. वि before लघि to leap over, ल्युट् aff.
विलङ्घनीय: विलङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be transgressed or overstepped. E. वि before लघि to leap over, अनीयर् aff.
विलङ्घित: विलङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Transgressed, overstepped. E. वि before लघि to leap over, क्त aff.
विलज्ज: विलज्ज mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं) Shameless, impudent, unabashed. E. वि privative, लज्जा shame.
विलज्जमान: विलज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Modest. E. वि before लस्ज to be modest, शानच् aff.
विलपत्: विलपत् mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्) 1 Speaking, talking. 2 Prating, talking idly or wildly. E. वि before लप to speak, शतृ aff.
विलपन: विलपन n. (-नं) 1 The dirt or sediment of any oily substance, as of clarified butter, &c. 2 Talking, chattering, talking idly or wildly. E. वि before लप to speak, aff. ल्युट्.
विलपित: विलपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Said. 2 Chattered. 3 Lamented, spoken in grief, spoken idly. E. वि before लप to speak, क्त aff.
विलम्ब: विलम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 Falling or hanging down, pendulousness. 2 Slowness, tardiness, delay. E. वि before लबि to go, aff. अच्.
विलम्बन: विलम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Delaying, retarding. 2 Hanging on or from, depending. E. वि before लबि to go, ल्युट् aff.
विलम्बमान: विलम्बमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Suspended on, hanging on or from. E. वि before लबि to go, शानच् aff.
विलम्बित: विलम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Falling, pendulous, hanging or fallen down. 2 Slow, tardy, retarded. 3 Slow, (as time in music,) adagio. E. विलम्ब delay, &c., इतच् aff.
विलम्बिन्: विलम्बिन् mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि) 1 Delaying, retarding. 2 Pendulous, depending, hanging on or from. m. (-म्बी) The thirty-second year of the Indian cycle. E. विलम्ब slowness, delay, इनि aff.
विलम्भ: विलम्भ m. (-म्भः) Gift, donation, giving. E. वि reverse, लभि to get or gain, aff. अच्.
विलय: विलय m. (-यः) 1 Destruction of the world. 2 Destruction in general. 3 Liquefaction. E. वि before ली to liquefy, aff. अच्.
विलयन: विलयन n. (-नं) 1 Destroying. 2 Corroding, eating away. 3 Liquefying. 4 Removing, taking away. 5 Attenuating, (as the fluids of the body.) 6 An attenuant. 7 An escharotic. E. वि before ली to melt, ल्युट् aff.
विलला: विलला f. (-ला) A sort of Sida, (S. cordifolia, &c.) E. वि before लल to shake, aff. अच् and टाप्.
विलवासिन्: विलवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living in a hole, burrowing. m. (-सी) A snake. E. विल a hole, and वासिन् who inhabits.
विलशय: विलशय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Living or burrowing in holes. m. (-यः) A snake. E. विल a hole, शी to sleep, aff. श.
विलसत्: विलसत् mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्) 1 Shining, beautiful, splendid. 2 Sportive, wanton. E. वि before लस to shine, &c., aff. शतृ.
विलसन: विलसन n. (-नं) Sporting, dallying. E. वि before लस to shine, ल्युट् aff.
विलसित: विलसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sportive, wanton. n. (-तं) Wanton pastime or gestures. E. वि before लस to shine, क्त aff.
विलाप: विलाप m. (-पः) Lamentation, the language of grief and distress. E. वि before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
विलाल: विलाल m. (-लः) 1 An instrument, a machine. 2 A cat. E. वि before लल to desire, &c., aff. घञ्, or विडाल as above, and ड changed to its congener ल.
विलास: विलास m. (-सः) 1 One kind of feminine action, considered as proceeding from and indicative of amorous sentiments; change of place, posture, gait or look, on the approach of the lover, as hiding at his approach, assuming a look of displeasure, &c. 2 Sport, pastime, play, especially amorous pastime, dalliance, wantonness. 3 Grace, elegance. E. वि before लस to desire, aff. घञ्.
विलासकानन: विलासकानन n. (-नं) A pleasure ground. E. विलास sport, and कानन a wood, a grove.
विलासमन्दिर: विलासमन्दिर n. (-रं) A pleasure house, a summer house, &c. E. विलास sport, and मन्दिर a building.
विलासवत्: विलासवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sportive, dallying, wanton. E. विलास, and मतुप् aff.
विलासिका: विलासिका f. (-का) A drama in one act on any light subject or adventure. E. वि, लस to shine, ण्वुल् aff. fem. form.
विलासिन्: विलासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Wanton, sportive, dallying. m. (-सी) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. 4 A sensualist, an enjoyer. 5 A snake. 6 ŚIVA. 7 KṚṢṆA. 8 KĀMA or CUPID. f. (-सिनी) 1 A woman. 2 A whore, a harlot. E. विलास pastime, &c., aff. इनि or वि, लस to shine, घिनुण् aff.; also read विलाषिन्.
विलिप्त: विलिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Anointed, plastered, smeared. E. वि before लिप to smear, क्त aff.
विलीन: विलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Liquid, liquified, semifluid, as melted oil or butter, &c. 2 Disappeared, perished, removed from sight, either temporarily or permanently. 3 Imagined, formed or infused, as in the mind. 4 Contiguous to, in contact with, united or blended with. E. वि before ली to melt, &c., aff. क्त.
विलुप्त: विलुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Seized, taken. 2 Cut off. 3 Lost. E. वि before लुप to cut off, क्त aff.
विलुभित: विलुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bewildered, disturbed, agitated. 2 Shaken, (by the wind.) E. वि before लुभ to beguile, क्त aff.
विलुलित: विलुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Tremulous, shaking, waving. E. वि before लुल to agitate, क्त aff.
विलेखन: विलेखन n. (-नं) 1 Digging, delving, rooting up. 2 Dividing, splitting. 3 Making marks or furrows. E. वि before लिख to write, aff. ल्युट्.
विलेप: विलेप m. (-पः) 1 Ointment, unguent, especially fragrant unguent of Sandal, Agallochum, &c.. 2 Mortar, plaster. 3 Anointing, plastering. (-पी) Rice-gruel. E. वि before लिप to anoint or smear, aff. घञ्.
विलेपन: विलेपन n. (-नं) 1 Perfume for the person, unguent or oil of Sandal, saffron, camphor, bdellium, &c. 2 Smearing the body with fragrant oils, &c. 2 Plastering. f. (-नी) 1 A woman adorned with perfumes, &c. 2 Rice-gruel. E. वि before लिप to smear, aff. ल्युट्.
विलेप्य: विलेप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be spread or plastered. m. (-प्यः) Ricegruel. E. वि before लिप to smear, aff. ण्यत्
विलेवासिन्: विलेवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living or burrowing in holes. m. (-सी) A snake. E. विल 7th case, वासिन् who dwells.
विलेशय: विलेशय m. (-यः) 1 A snake. 2 A rat. 3 A hare. 4 Any animal living or burrowing in holes. E. विल a hole, in the seventh case, and शय who sleeps or dwells.
विलोक: विलोक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Solitary, lonely. E. वि priv., लोक a person.
विलोकन: विलोकन nf. (-नं-ना) Sight, seeing, looking. E. वि before लोकृ to see, युच् aff.
विलोकनीय: विलोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Agreeable, beautiful, fit to be seen or looked at. E. वि before लोक to see, अनीयर् aff.
विलोकनीयता: विलोकनीयता f. (-ता) Loveliness, beauty. E. तल् added to the last.
विलोकयत्: विलोकयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Seeing, looking at. E. वि before लोक to see, शतृ aff.
विलोकित: विलोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. वि before लोकृ to see, aff. क्त.
विलोचन: विलोचन n. (-नं) The eye. E. वि before लोच to see, aff. ल्युट्.
विलोचनपात: विलोचनपात m. (-तः) A glance, a look. E. विलोचन, and पात alighting.
विलोचनाम्बु: विलोचनाम्बु n. (-म्बु) Tears. E. विलोचन, and अम्बु water.
विलोटक: विलोटक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Clupea cultrata.) E. वि before लुट to roll on the ground, aff. खुल्.
विलोडन: विलोडन n. (-नं) 1 Agitating, shaking, churning. 2 Rolling or tossing. E. वि, लुड to agitate, ल्युट् aff.
विलोडित: विलोडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Agitated, churned, shaken. 2 Rolling or tumbling on the ground. E. वि before लोड to be tremulous, aff. क्त.
विलोपन: विलोपन n. (-नं) 1 Destruction. 2 Deluding. E. वि before लुप to cut, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विलोभ: विलोभ m. (-भः) Attraction, delusion, seduction. E. वि before लुभ to delude, aff. घञ्.
विलोभन: विलोभन n. (-नं) 1 Allurement, attraction, temptation, seduction. 2 Beguiling, perplexing. 3 Praise, commendation, especially by contrast with inferiority. E. वि before लुभ to delude, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
विलोभित: विलोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Allured, beguiled. 2 Deceived. 3 Praised. E. वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., क्त aff.
विलोभ्य: विलोभ्य ind. Having beguiled, fascinated, &c. E. वि before लुभ to delude, causal v., ल्यप् aff.
विलोभ्यमान: विलोभ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being fascinated, overcome, beguiled, &c. E. वि before लुभ to beguile, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विलोम: विलोम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Reverse, opposite, contrary, backward, against the hair or grain. m. (-मः) 1 Reverse, opposite course or order, &c. 2 A snake. 3 VARUṆA, regent of the waters. 4 A dog. n. (-मं) A water-wheel or machine for raising water. f. (-मी) Emblic myrobalan. E. वि implying difference, &c., and लोम the hair of the body; also with कन् added विलोमक.
विलोमक्रिया: विलोमक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Doing any thing backwards or in reverse order. 2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion. E. विलोम, and क्रिया act.
विलोमज: विलोमज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born of a father of an inferior caste and mother of a superior. E. विलोम inverse order, and ज born; also विलोमजात, विलोमोत्पन्न, &c.
विलोमजिह्व: विलोमजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) An elephant. E. विलोम reversed, जिह्वा the tongue.
विलोमत्रैराशिक: विलोमत्रैराशिक n. (-कं) Rule of Three inverse. E. विलोम, and त्रैराशिक rule of Three.
विलोमवर्ण: विलोमवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A man of mixed or inferior birth. E. विलोम contrary to the proper order, (of marriage, &c.) and वर्ण a class.
विलोमविधि: विलोमविधि f. (-धिः) 1 Inverted or reversed ceremony. 2 (In arithmetic,) Rule of Inversion. E. विलोम, and विधि rule.
विलोल: विलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Shaking, trembling, tremulous. 2 Fickle, unsteady. 3 Rolling, (as the eyes.) 4 Tossing, waving. E. वि before लुल to agitate, aff. घञ्.
विलोलता: विलोलता f. (-ता) 1 Tremulousness. 2 Unsteadiness. 3 Rolling, (of the eyes.) E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विलोलत्वं.
विलोलन: विलोलन n. (-नं) Shaking, stirring, agitating. E. वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., aff. ल्युट्.
विलोलित: विलोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, agitated, tossed. E. वि before लुल to agitate, causal v., क्त aff.
विलौकस्: विलौकस् m. (-काः) Any animal living in holes, a reptile. E. विल, and ओकस् abode.
विल्ल: विल्ल n. (-ल्लं) 1 A pit, a hole. 2 Asafoetida. E. विल a hole, लच् aff.
विल्लमूला: विल्लमूला f. (-ला) A sort of yam: see वाराही.
विल्व: विल्व m. (-ल्वः) A fruit tree, commonly named Bel, (Ægle marmelos.) n. (-ल्वं) 1 The fruit of the Bel. 2 A measure, the same as the Pala. E. विल to divide, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
विवक्षा: विवक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Wish, desire. 2 The wish to speak. E. वच to speak, in the desiderative form, aff. अच्.
विवक्षित: विवक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Purposed, intended. 3 Literal, not figurative, (a word or phrase.) 4 Intended to be spoken or said. n. (-तं) An object desired. f. (-ता) Purpose, wish, what one wishes to declare or speak. E. वच to speak, desiderative form, क्त aff.
विवक्षु: विवक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to speak. E. वच to speak, desid. v., उ aff.
विवञ्चिषु: विवञ्चिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Crafty, deceitful. E. वि before वञ्च to trick, desid. v., उ aff.
विवत्सा: विवत्सा f. (-त्सा) A cow whose calf is dead. E. वि priv., वत्स a calf.
विवदत्: विवदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Disputing, contending. 2 Litigating. E. वि variously, वद to speak, शतृ aff.
विवदमान: विवदमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Disagreeing, contending, maintaining different arguments. 2 Litigating. E. वि before वद to speak, शानच् aff.
विवध: विवध m. (-धः) 1 A road, a highway. 2 A yoke for carrying burdens. 3 A load. 4 Storing grain or hay, &c. 5 An ewer, a pitcher. E. वि before वध to strike, aff. घञ्; also वीवध.
विवधिक: विवधिक m. (-कः) A chandler. E. विवध storing grain, ठन् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also वैवधिक.
विवन्दिषु: विवन्दिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Desirous or wishing to praise. E. वदि to praise, desid. v., उ aff.
विवर: विवर n. (-रं) 1 A hole, a chasm, a vacuity. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Separation, disjunction. E. वि before वृञ् to choose, to cover, &c., and अच् aff.
विवरण: विवरण n. (-णं) 1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment. 2 Interpretation, translation. 3 Uncovering, exposing, laying bare or open. 4 Detailing, describing. E. वि before वृ to select (the meaning), aff. ल्युट्.
विवरनालिका: विवरनालिका f. (-का) A pipe, a fife, a flute. E. विवर a hole, a perforation, नाल a pipe, कन् added, fem. form.
विवरिषु: विवरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to make manifest or declare. E. वि before वृ to choose, desid. v., उ aff.
विवर्जन: विवर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Abandoning, leaving, shunning. E. वि before वृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.
विवर्ज्जन: विवर्ज्जन n. (-नं) Abandoning, leaving, shunning. E. वि before वृज to leave, ल्युट् aff.
विवर्जनीय: विवर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be avoided, shunned, quitted, &c. E. वि before वृज to abandon, अनीयर् aff.
विवर्ज्जनीय: विवर्ज्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be avoided, shunned, quitted, &c. E. वि before वृज to abandon, अनीयर् aff.
विवर्जयत्: विवर्ज्जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Avoiding, leaving. E. वि before वृज to quit, शतृ aff.
विवर्ज्जयत्: विवर्ज्जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Avoiding, leaving. E. वि before वृज to quit, शतृ aff.
विवर्जित: विवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, avoided, shunned. E. वि before वृज to leave, aff. क्त.
विवर्ज्जित: विवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Left, abandoned, avoided, shunned. E. वि before वृज to leave, aff. क्त.
विवर्ण: विवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Bad coloured. 3 Wanting colour. 4 Changing colour. m. (-र्णः) A man of a low caste, one of degrading occupation, an outcaste. E. वि privative, and वर्ण caste.
विवर्णवदन: विवर्णवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Pale-faced. E. विवर्ण colourless, वदन face.
विवर्त: विवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Assemblage, collection, heap or multitude. 2 Dancing. 3 Going or turning round, revolving, returning. 4 Human error, worldly ignorance, the confounding of truth and falsehood, or the mistaking of unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c. 5 Modification, various or altered state or condition. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. क्त.
विवर्त्त: विवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Assemblage, collection, heap or multitude. 2 Dancing. 3 Going or turning round, revolving, returning. 4 Human error, worldly ignorance, the confounding of truth and falsehood, or the mistaking of unreal objects and conceiving them to be what they are not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c. 5 Modification, various or altered state or condition. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. क्त.
विवर्तन: विवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going round, circumambulating an altar, &c. 2 Revolving, turning round. 3 Whirling, causing to go round. 4 Returning. 5 Passing through in succession, as various lives, various hells, &c. 5 Being, abiding. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. ल्युट्.
विवर्त्तन: विवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Going round, circumambulating an altar, &c. 2 Revolving, turning round. 3 Whirling, causing to go round. 4 Returning. 5 Passing through in succession, as various lives, various hells, &c. 5 Being, abiding. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. ल्युट्.
विवर्तमान: विवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Turning back or round, recoiling, revolving, returning, &c. E. वि before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
विवर्त्तमान: विवर्त्तमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Turning back or round, recoiling, revolving, returning, &c. E. वि before वृत to be, शानच् aff.
विवर्तित: विवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Revolved, returned. 2 Whirled round. 3 Turned back or away. E. वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
विवर्त्तित: विवर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Revolved, returned. 2 Whirled round. 3 Turned back or away. E. वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
विवर्द्धन: विवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Increase. 2 Cutting, dividing. E. वि before वृध to increase, to cut, ल्युट् aff.
विवर्द्धित: विवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Increased, enlarged. 2 Cut, divided. E. वि before वृध to increase, to cut, क्त aff.
विवश: विवश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Subject, subjected. 2 Independant. 3 Apprehensive of death, unwilling though about to die. 4 Desirous of death, sedate at that period, or having the soul free from worldly cares and fears. 5 Uncontrouled, unrestrained, unsubdued. E. वि before वश to wish, aff. अच्.
विवस्त्र: विवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Unclothed, naked. E. वि priv., and वस्त्र clothes.
विवस्वत्: विवस्वत् m. (-स्वान्) 1 A god. 2 The sun. 3 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. 4 The seventh or present MANU; also VAIVASVATA. f. (-ती) The city of the sun. E. वि implying variety, वस to cover or hide, affix क्विप्, विवस् here said therefore to imply various covering, as a garment of light, i. e. the rays of the sun, and मतुप् poss. aff.
विवात्: विवात् mfn. (-वान्-वान्ती-वाती-वात्) Blowing, blowing gently. E. वि before वा to blow, शतृ aff.
विवाद: विवाद m. (-दः) 1 Contest, contention. 2 Contest at law, a legal dispute, litigation, a law suit. E. वि before वद to speak, aff. घञ्.
विवादानुगत: विवादानुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Disputed, litigated. E. विवाद a law suit, अनु according to, and गत gone.
विवादार्थिन्: विवादार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for a dispute or quarrel. m. (-र्थी) A litigant, a prosecutor, a plaintiff. E. विवाद, and अर्थिन् who seeks.
विवादास्पदीभूत: विवादास्पदीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Litigated, contested at law. E. विवाद, and आस्पद place, भूत become, च्चि augment.
विवादिन्: विवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Disputing, contending, a litigant. E. विवाद, and इनि aff.
विवार: विवार m. (-रः) 1 Dilatation, expansion. 2 Open or expanded state of the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants. E. वि before वृ to cover, घञ् aff.
विवास: विवास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Without clothes, naked. m. (-सः) Banishment. E. वि priv., and वास vesture or abode.
विवासकरण: विवासकरण n. (-णं) Banishing, transporting. E. विवास, and करण making.
विवासन: विवासन n. (-नं) Exile, banishment. E. वि away, वासन abiding.
विवासित: विवासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Banished, expelled. E. वि, and वस to dwell, causal v., क्त aff.
विवास्य: विवास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) To be expelled or transported. E. वि away, वस to dwell, causal v., यत् aff.
विवाह: विवाह m. (-हः) Marriage. E. वि mutually, वह to take, aff. घञ्.
विवाहित: विवाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Married. E. वि before वह to bear, causal v., क्त aff.
विवाह्य: विवाह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Marriageable, to be married. m. (-ह्यः) A son-in-law, a bridegroom. E. विवाह marriage, and यत् aff.
विविक्त: विविक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Lonely, solitary, desart. 2 Pure, faultless. 3 Separated, distinguished, disjoined, detached. 4 Discriminative, judicious, a judge. 5 Discriminated, judged. 6 Profound, (as judgment or thought.) 7 Intent on. E. वि before विच to be or make separate, aff. क्त.
विविक्तभाव: विविक्तभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Intent upon any object. E. विविक्त, and भाव disposition.
विविक्तसेविन्: विविक्तसेविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Solitary, retired, recluse, seeking or affecting solitude. E. विविक्त, and सेविन् who serves or pursues.
विविक्षत्: विविक्षत् mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षती-क्षत्) Wishing or purposing to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., शतृ Aff.
विविक्षा: विविक्षा f. (-क्षा) Wish or purpose to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
विविक्षु: विविक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing or intending to enter. E. विश to enter, desid. v., उ aff.
विविच्य: विविच्य ind. Having considered, discussed, judged. E. विच to judge, with वि prefixed, and ल्यप् aff.
विविदिवस्: विविदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-द्युषी-वस्) Obtaining, getting. E. विद to know, वसु aff., with इट् inserted.
विविद्वस्: विविद्वस् mfn. (-द्वान्-दुषी-द्वस) Knowing, wise. E. विद to know, वसु aff.
विविध: विविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various, multiform, of many sorts. E. वि before विधि sort, kind.
विविशिवस्: विविशिवस् mfn. (-वान्-श्युषी-वस्) Entering. E. विश to enter, root rep., वसु aff., इट् augment.
विविश्वस्: विविश्वस् mfn. (-श्वान्-शुषी-श्वस्) Entering, who or what enters. E. विश to enter, वसु aff., root rep.
विवीत: विवीत m. (-तः) An inclosed spot of ground, abounding in grass, wood, &c., a preserved pasture, a paddock, &c. E. वि privative, and वीत gone.
विवीतभर्तृ: विवीतभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The superintendant or owner of a preserved pasture. E. विवीत a paddock, &c., and भर्त्तृ a master.
विवीतभर्त्तृ: विवीतभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) The superintendant or owner of a preserved pasture. E. विवीत a paddock, &c., and भर्त्तृ a master.
विवृक्त: विवृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Abandoned, left. f. (-क्ता) A woman disliked or deserted by her husband. E. वि before वृच to abandon, aff. क्त.
विवृत: विवृत m. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expanded, extended, extensive, large. 2 Evident, displayed, made manifest. 3 Exposed, discovered. 4 Opened. 5 Explained, interpreted, expounded. 6 Open (as the organs of speech for the articulation of vowels and sibilants.) f. (-ता) A disease, an ulcer attended with much pain and heat. E. वि before वृ to be, aff. क्त.
विवृताक्ष: विवृताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Large-eyed. m. (-क्षः) A cock. E. विवृत large, अक्षि the eye, and अच् aff.
विवृति: विवृति f. (-तिः) 1 Explanation, exposition, gloss, comment, interpretation. 2 Making clear or manifest. 3 Discovery, exposure. E. वि before वृ to prefer or choose, aff. क्तिन्.
विवृत्त: विवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Turned or twisted round, whirling, revolving, rolling. E. वि before वृत to be, क्त aff.
विवृत्सत्: विवृत्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to be. E. वृत to be, desid. v., शतृ aff.
विवृत्सितृ: विवृत्सितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Who or what wishes to be. E. वृत to be, desid. v., तृच् aff.
विवृत्ति: विवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Turning round, rolling, whirling, tumbling. E. वि before वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.
विवृद्ध: विवृद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Augmented, increased. E. वि, and वृद्ध the same.
विवृद्धि: विवृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Growth, increase, augmentation. E. वि before वृद्धि the same.
विवेक: विवेक m. (-कः) 1 Discrimination, judgment, the faculty of distinguishing things by their properties, and classing them according to their real not apparent nature; in the Vedānta system, it is applied to the power of separating Brahma or invisible spirit, from the ostensible world, truth from untruth, or reality from illusion. 2 Discussion, investigation. 3 A reservoir, a bath. E. वि severally, विच to judge, aff. घञ्.
विवेकता: विवेकता f. (-ता) Judgment, discrimination, the faculty or property of judgment. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, विवेकत्वं.
विवेकदृश्वत्व: विवेकदृश्वत्व n. (-त्वं) Discrimination, discernment. E. विवेकदृश्वन्, and त्व aff.; or with तल्, विवेकदृश्वता.
विवेकदृश्वन्: विवेकदृश्वन् m. (-श्वा) A wise or discerning man. E. विवेक, and दृश्वन् who sees.
विवेकिता: विवेकिता f. (-ता) Discussion, discrimination, discriminativeness. E. विवेकी discriminative, and तल् aff.; also विवेकित्व n. (-त्वं)
विवेकिन्: विवेकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Judicious, discriminative. m. (-की) A sage, a philosopher, a judge. E. वि before विच to judge, घिनुण् aff.
विवेक्तव्य: विवेक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be discussed or judged. E. वि before विच to judge, तव्य aff.; also विवेच्य and विवेचनीय.
विवेचन: विवेचन n. (-नं) Discrimination, judgment, distinguishing truth from falsehood. E. वि before विच to judge, aff. ल्युट्.
विवेचनीय: विवेचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be judged or discussed. E. वि, विच् to judge, अनीयर् aff.
विवोढृ: विवोढृ m. (-ढा) A husband, a bridegroom, a lover. E. वि before वह to obtain, aff. तृन्.
विव्रुवत्: विव्रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वती-वत्) Silent, refraining from or refusing to speak. E. वि privative वुवत् speaking.
विव्वोक: विव्वोक m. (-कः) Affectation of indifference, one of the branches of amorous dalliance, or feminine actions, tending to excite love or desire. E. वि before वा to go, aff. कु, विवु said here to mean a particular gait, and ओक house, place, site.
विश: विश r. 6th cl. (विशति) 1 To enter, to pervade. With आङ् or प्र prefixed, 1 To go in, to enter. 2 To occupy or engross. With उप, 1 To sit, to sit down. 2 To approach. With नि, 1 To dwell, to abide. 2 To place or station. With नि or अभि and नि, 1 To rest, to halt, to sit down, especially before or in presence of. 2 To conceal. With निर्, To go out or forth. With परि, To, place before, to present. With सम, To lie down, to repose. With सम् and नि, To be near, to be close to or in the neighbourhood. With सम् and आङ्, To introduce.
विश n. (-शं) The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily. E. विश to enter, aff. क.
विश्: विश् m. (विट्) 1 A man of the mercantile tribe. 2 A man in general. f. (विट्) 1 Entrance. 2 A daughter. E. विश to enter, aff. क्विप्.
विशङ्क: विशङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Fearless, undaunted. E. वि, and शङ्का fear.
विशङ्कट: विशङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा or -टी-टं) Great, large. E. वि the particle, and शङ्कटच् aff. in this sense.
विशङ्कमान: विशङ्कमान mfn. (-नः-ना-न) Fearing, apprehending. E. वि before शकि to doubt, शानच् aff.
विशत्: विशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Entering. E. विश to enter, शतृ aff.
विशद: विशद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Of a white colour. 2 Clear, pure, pellucid. 3 Evident, apparent, manifest. 4 Beautiful. m. (-दः) White, the colour. E. वि before शद to wither or perish, aff. अच्.
विशय: विशय m. (-यः) 1 Doubt, uncertainty. 2 Refuge, asylum. E. वि before शी to sleep, अच् aff.
विशयिन्: विशयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Dubious, uncertain. 2 Doubting. E. विशय doubt, इनि aff., or वि before शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
विशर: विशर m. (-रः) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. वि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. अप्; also with ल्युट्, aff. विशरण n. (-णं).
विशल्य: विशल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Free from thorns or spikes. 2 Free from care or pain. f. (-ल्या) 1 A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.) 2 A sort of potherb, the kind not ascertained. 3 A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.) 4 Another, commonly Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.) 5 A sort of fruit, Langaliya. E. वि privative, and शल्य a stalk or stem.
विशल्यकृत्: विशल्यकृत् m. (-कृत्) A plant, (Echites dichotoma, Rox.)
विशसन: विशसन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaying, slaughter. 2 Dissecting, cutting. m. (-नः) A sabre, a crooked sword. E. वि before शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
विशसित: विशसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hurt, killed. 2 Cut, dissected. 3 Wellmannered. E. वि before शस to injure, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
विशसितृ: विशसितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Killing. 2 Dissecting. E. वि before शस to kill, तृच् aff.
विशस्त: विशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Praised, celebrated. 2 Arrogant, ill-mannered, rude. E. वि before शस to praise, aff. क्त.
विशस्त्र: विशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Disarmed, unarmed. E. वि, and शस्त्र a weapon.
विशाकार: विशाकार m. (-रः) A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.)
विशाख: विशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Branchless. m. (-खः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. 3 A solicitor, a petitioner, a beggar. 4 A spindle. f. (-खा) The sixteenth lunar asterism, figured by a festoon, and containing four, or according to some, two stars, one of which is α or κ Libra. 2 A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica charantia.) E. वि without, शाख a branch, or विशाखा the asterism, (by which personified the god was cherished,) अण् aff., and the vowel unchanged.
विशाखज: विशाखज m. (-जः) The orange, (Citrus aurantium.) E. विशाख the asterism, and जन् to be born; aff. ड; coming into season, when the sun is in this asterism, or about the end of October.
विशाखल: विशाखल n. (-लं) An attitude in shooting. E. विशाखा the same, and लच् pleonasm.
विशाय: विशाय m. (-यः) Sleeping, and watching alternately. E. वि intervening, शी to sleep, aff. घञ्.
विशारण: विशारण n. (-णं) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. वि before शॄ to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
विशारद: विशारद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Learned, wise. 2 Confident, bold, presuming. 3 Famous, celebrated. E. विशाल great, extensive, (fame, &c.) and दा to give, aff. क, the ल changed to र.
विशाल: विशाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Great, large. 2 Broad. 3 Great, eminent, illustrious. m. (-लः) 1 A sort of deer. 2 A sort of bird. f. (-ला) 1 The city Ougein. 2 Bitter apple, (Cucumis colocynthis.) E. वि particle, and शालच् aff., or विश to enter, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.
विशालकुल: विशालकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Well born. n. (-लं) An illustrious family. E. विशाल, and कुल race.
विशालता: विशालता f. (-ता) 1 Width, breadth. 2 Magnitude, bulk. 2 Eminence, distinction. E. विशाल large, तल् aff. of the abstract; also विशालत्व n. (-त्वं)
विशालत्वच्: विशालत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. विशाल large, and त्वच् skin or bark.
विशालाक्ष: विशालाक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Having large or beautiful eyes. m. (-क्षः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 GARUḌA. f. (-क्षी) PĀRVATĪ. E. विशाल large, and अक्षि the eye, टच् aff.
विशिख: विशिख m. (-खः) 1 An arrow. 2 An iron crow. f. (-खा) 1 A spade, a hoe. 2 A highway, a broad or carriage road. 3 A very minute arrow, a sort of needle or spindle. 4 A barber's wife. 5 A sick room, or the dwelling of the sick. E. वि implying possessed of, &c., and शिखा a crest.
विशिञ्जान: विशिञ्जान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding. E. वि before शिजि to sound, शानच् aff.
विशित: विशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened. E. वि before शि to sharpen, क्त aff.
विशिप: विशिप n. (-पं) A palace, a temple. E. विश to enter, अप Uṇādi aff., and इ substituted for the pen. vowel.
विशिष्ट: विशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, inherent or attached to. 2 Excellent, superior, distinguished. 3 Especial, peculiar. 4 Having distinctive and exclusive properties. E. वि before शिष to tell qualities, aff. क्त.
विशिष्टता: विशिष्टता f. (-ता) 1 Excellence, distinction. 2 Individuality, having distinguishing or characteristic qualities. 3 Peculiarity, as of duty, &c. E. तल् added to the last; also विशिष्टत्न.
विशीर्ण: विशीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Dry, dried up, withered, decayed. 2 Wasted, impaired. E. वि before शॄ to injure, क्त aff.
विशीर्य: विशीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To crumble or fall to ruin, likely or fit to. E. वि before शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
विशीर्य्य: विशीर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To crumble or fall to ruin, likely or fit to. E. वि before शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
विशीर्यमाण: विशीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being wasted or destroyed, decaying, perishing. E. वि before शॄ to injure, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विशीर्य्यमाण: विशीर्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being wasted or destroyed, decaying, perishing. E. वि before शॄ to injure, pass. v., शानच् aff.
विशील: विशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Ill-behaved, indecorous, immoral. E. वि priv., शील behaved.
विशुद्ध: विशुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed, free from vice or fault. 2 Pious, virtuous. 3 Humble, modest, compliant. 4 Corrected. E. वि intensitive prefix, and शुद्ध pure, clean.
विशुद्धि: विशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Purity, purification. 2 Equality, similarity. 3 Removal of doubt. 4 Correctness. 5 In Algebra, a subtractive quantity. E. वि before शुद्धि purity.
विशुद्धिभाज्: विशुद्धिभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Pure, free from soil or vice. E. विशुद्धि, and भाज् who shares.
विशृङ्खल: विशृङ्खल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Unchecked, unrestrained, unfettered, (literally or figuratively.) E. वि privative, and शृङ्खला a chain.
विशेष: विशेष m. (-षः) 1 Sort, kind, manner. 2 Difference, individual or specific identity and consequent distinction from every other individual or species. 3 (In logic,) The peculiar attribute, (predicabile proprium,) the cause of perception of exclusion. 4 Excellence, superiority. 5 A limb, a member. 6 A mark on the forehead with Sandal. 7 A figure of rhetoric, distinguished as of three kinds, all implying variety of means or effect. E. वि discriminative prefix, शिष to attribute or distinguish by attributes, aff. घञ्.
विशेषक: विशेषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Discriminative, distinguishing, attributive, characteristic. mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A mark on the forehead made with Sandal, &c., and worn either as an ornament or sectarial distinction. 2 An attribute, a predicate. 3 An arrangement of poetical composition. E. वि before शिष to attribute, or distinguish, aff. ण्वुल्.
विशेषकाम: विशेषकाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Amorous, desirous. E. विशेष, and काम who desires.
विशेषगुण: विशेषगुण m. (-णः) An object of a single and distinct kind, as the soul, mind, time, place, and the atoms of earth, water, light, and air. E. विशेष, and गुण property.
विशेषज्ञ: विशेषज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Wise, intelligent. E. विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.
विशेषण: विशेषण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Discriminative, attributive. 2 Distinctive, (as a property, &c.) n. (-णं) 1 Distinguishing, discriminating. 2 An epithet, an attribute, an adjective. E. वि before शिष to distinguish by attributes, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
विशेषणीय: विशेषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be discriminated or distinguished, what may or ought to be marked as distinct. E. वि before शिष to distinguish, अनीयर् aff.
विशेषतस्: विशेषतस् ind. Especially, particularly, specifically. E. विशेष, and तसि aff.
विशेषधर्म: विशेषधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Peculiar or different duty. E. विशेष, and घर्म्म duty.
विशेषधर्म्म: विशेषधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Peculiar or different duty. E. विशेष, and घर्म्म duty.
विशेषभावना: विशेषभावना f. (-ना) 1 Reflecting on or perceiving differences. 2 (In algebra,) Composition by the difference of the products. E. विशेष, and भावना considering.
विशेषलक्षण: विशेषलक्षण n. (-णं) Specific or characteristic mark or sign. E. विशेष, and लक्षण mark.
विशेषवचन: विशेषवचन n. (-नं) Special or different text. E. विशेष, and वचन a text.
विशेषविद्वस्: विशेषविद्वस् m. (-द्वान्) A sage, a philosopher. E. विशेष excellence, and विद्वान् learned.
विशेषविधि: विशेषविधि f. (-घिः) Special rule or observance. E. विशेष, and विधि rule.
विशेषित: विशेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Divided, distinguished, separated. 2 Predicated, attributed, having as an attribute or being distinguished by it. 3 Excellent, superior. E. विशेष sort, kind, &c., इतच् aff.
विशेषोक्ति: विशेषोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 A figure of rhetoric, coupling cause with effect, so as to explain any peculiar manner or condition. 2 Panegyric, recapitulation of merits. E. विशेष sort, kind, and उक्ति saying.
विशेष्य: विशेष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) To be distinguished or discriminated. 2 Distinguishing, to be discriminated by. 3 Principal, primary, chief. m. (-ष्यः) A name, a substantive. n. (-ष्यं) The object of a predicate. E. वि before शिष to distinguish by its attributes, and ण्यत् aff.
विशोक: विशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Without grief, happy. E. वि priv., शोक sorrow.
विशोधन: विशोधन n. (-नं) Cleaning, purifying, freeing from soil, defect, or sin. f. (-नी) 1 A plant, commonly Nāgadanti. 2 The capital of BRAHMĀ. E. वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विशोधनीय: विशोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cleaned or purified, to be freed from soil, fault, &c. E. वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विशोधितव्य and विशोध्य.
विशोधित: विशोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified, cleansed, freed from soil, &c. E. वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त aff.
विशोधित्व: विशोधित्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Cleaning, purifying. 2 Clearing, freeing from obstructions. E. विशोघिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विशोधिता.
विशोधिन्: विशोधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) 1 Cleaning, purifying. 2 Clearing. E. वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., णिनि aff.
विशोषण: विशोषण n. (-णं) Drying, desiccating. E. वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विशोषित: विशोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up. E. वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., क्त aff.
विश्न: विश्न m. (-श्नः) Lustre, shining. E. विच्छ to shine, नङ् aff.
विश्रणन: विश्रणन n. (-नं) Gift, giving, donation. E. वि before श्रण to give, ल्युट् aff.; also विश्राणन.
विश्रब्ध: विश्रब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Trusted, confided in, confided to. 2 Patient, tranquil. 3 Lowly-minded, not lofty, not magnanimous. 4 Excessive, exceeding, much. 5 Firm, steady. 6 Rested, reposed. E. वि before श्रम to be weary or स्रम्भ to trust, &c. aff. क्तः see विस्रब्ध.
विश्रब्धता: विश्रब्धता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness. E. विश्रब्ध, and तल् aff.
विश्रम: विश्रम m. (-मः) Rest, repose, cessation from fatigue or work. E. वि privative, श्रम to be weary, aff. अच्; also विश्राम.
विश्रमित: विश्रमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wearied, exhausted. E. विश्रम, and इतच् aff.
विश्रम्भ: विश्रम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Trust, confidence. 2 Affection, affectionate inquiry. 3 Festive or sportive noise or tumult. E. वि before स्रम्भ to trust, aff. घञ्, and the initial optionally changed; also विस्रम्भ.
विश्रम्य: विश्रम्य ind. Having rested. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, ल्यप् aff.
विश्रय: विश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Abode, asylum. 2 Dependance upon. E. वि, श्री to serve, श aff.
विश्रयिन्: विश्रयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि) 1 Living or dwelling in. 2 Serving, depending on. E. वि before श्री to serve, घिनुण् aff.
विश्राणन: विश्राणन n. (-णं) Gift, giving, donation. E. वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. aff. ल्युट्.
विश्राणित: विश्राणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bestowed, given. E. वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. क्त aff.
विश्रान्त: विश्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Rested, reposed. 2 Ceasing, desisting from. 3 Calm, composed. E. वि before श्रान्त the same.
विश्रान्ति: विश्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Rest, repose, cessation from toil or occupation. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. क्तिन्.
विश्राम: विश्राम m. (-मः) 1 Rest, repose. 2 Pause, stop, cessation. 3 Tranquillity, composure. E. वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. घञ्.
विश्राव: विश्राव m. (-वः) 1 Fame, celebrity. 2 Flowing, dropping. E. वि before श्रु to hear or to drop, aff. घञ्.
विश्रावण: विश्रावण n. (-णं) 1 Causing to flow or drop. 2 Bleeding. 3 Apprising, causing to hear. E. वि before श्रु to ooze, &c., causal v., ल्युट् aff.
विश्रुत: विश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, celebrated, notorious. 2 Known. 3 Pleased, delighted, happy. 4 Dropped, flowing. E. वि before श्रुत heard.
विश्रुति: विश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Celebrity, fame, notoriety. 2 Oozing, flowing. E. वि before श्रु to hear, aff. क्तिन्.
विश्लथ: विश्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Languid, relaxed. E. वि before श्लथ loose.
विश्लथाङ्ग: विश्लथाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Weak, relaxed, nerveless. E. विश्लथ, and अङ्ग the body.
विश्लिष्ट: विश्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Separated, disunited. E. वि before श्लिष to unite, क्त aff.
विश्लेष: विश्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Separation, distance, especially of lovers, or husband and wife. 2 Disunion, disjunction, separation in general. 3 (In arithmetic,) The converse of addition. E. वि before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.
विश्लेषजाति: विश्लेषजाति f. (-तिः) (In arithmetic,) The assimilation of difference, the reduction of fractional difference. E. विश्लेष, and जाति kind.
विश्व: विश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) All, entire, whole, universal. n. (-श्वं) The world, the universe. m. (-श्वः) A deity of a particular class in which ten are enumerated; their names are VASU, SATYA, KRATU, DAKṢA, KĀLA, KĀMA, DHṚTI, KURU, PURURĀVAN, and MADRAVA: They are worshipped particularly at the funeral obsequies in honor of deceased progenitors in general, and receive an oblation of clarified butter at the daily and domestic Śrāddha. nf. (-श्वं-श्वा) Dry ginger. f. (-श्वा) A tree, the bark of which is said to be used in dying red, commonly Atis, (Betula.) E. विश to enter, to pervade, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
विश्वकद्रु: विश्वकद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) Wicked, vile. m. (-द्रुः) 1 A dog trained for the chase. 2 Sound, noise. E. विश्व all, कन् pleonasm, द्रु to run, to pursue, aff. डु, or विश्व with कदि to cry or call, aff. डु, and र augment.
विश्वकर्मन्: विश्वकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 The sun. 2 The son of BRAHMĀ, and artist of the gods. 3 A saint. E. विश्व universal, कर्म्म work, act.
विश्वकर्म्मन्: विश्वकर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 The sun. 2 The son of BRAHMĀ, and artist of the gods. 3 A saint. E. विश्व universal, कर्म्म work, act.
विश्वकर्मसुता: विश्वकर्म्मसुता f. (-ता) SAṂJÑĀ, one of the wives of the sun. E. विश्वकर्म्म the artist of the gods, and सुता the daughter; also विश्वकर्म्मजा, &c.
विश्वकर्म्मसुता: विश्वकर्म्मसुता f. (-ता) SAṂJÑĀ, one of the wives of the sun. E. विश्वकर्म्म the artist of the gods, and सुता the daughter; also विश्वकर्म्मजा, &c.
विश्वका: विश्वका f. (-का) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.) E. विश्व all, कै to cry, aff. क.
विश्वकृत्: विश्वकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Who or what makes all. m. (-कृत्) 1 The creator, the maker of all things. 2 The carpenter or architect, and artist of the gods. E. विश्व all, and कृत् who makes.
विश्वकेतु: विश्वकेतु m. (-तुः) ANIRUDDHA, an incarnation of KĀMA, as the son of PRADYUMNA. E. विश्व universe, केतु a banner.
विश्वक्सेन: विश्वक्सेन m. (-नः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A particular form of that deity, to whom the fragments of a sacrifice to VIṢṆU are offered. f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. विश्वक every way. and सेना an army, more properly विष्वक्सेन.
विश्वगन्धा: विश्वगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The earth. E. विश्व all, and गन्ध fragrance.
विश्वगायत्: विश्वगायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Spreading or going in every direction. E. विश्वक् and आयत् going.
विश्वगोप्तृ: विश्वगोप्तृ m. (-प्ता) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 INDRA. E. विश्व all, and गोप्तृ preserver.
विश्वङ्कर: विश्वङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-creating, making all. m. (-रः) The eye. E. विश्व all, and कर making.
विश्वजन: विश्वजन n. (-नं) All men, mankind. E. विश्व, and जन people.
विश्वजनीन: विश्वजनीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Good for or suitable to all men. E. विश्वजन, and ख aff.
विश्वजनीय: विश्वजनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Suitable or relating to all men. E. विश्व all, जन mankind, छ aff.
विश्वजन्य: विश्वजन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Fit or good for all men. E. विश्वजन, and यत् aff.
विश्वजित्: विश्वजित् mfn. (-तित्) All-subduing. m. (-जित्) 1 A particular ceremony or sacrifice. 2 The cord or noose of VARUṆA. E. विश्व all, and जित् what subdues.
विश्वञ्च्: विश्वञ्च् mfn. (-श्वङ्-शुची-श्वक्) Going every where. ind. or adv. n. (-श्वक्) Every where, universally. E. विञ्च all, अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्; it is more usually written both in simple and compound forms विष्वञ्च, from a different etymology.
विश्वतस्: विश्वतस् ind. Every where, all around, universally. E. विश्व all, and तसि aff.
विश्वदेव: विश्वदेव m. (-वः) A Viśvadeva, a deity of a particular class: see विश्व. f. (-वा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. विश्व all, दिव to sport, aff. घञ्.
विश्वद्र्यञ्च्: विश्वद्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Moving every where or universally. E. विश्वक every where, अद्रि substituted for the final, अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्; also विष्वद्र्यञ्च्.
विश्वधारिन्: विश्वधारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) All-sustaining. m. (-री) A deity. f. (-रिणी) The earth. E. विश्व all, and धारिन् upholding.
विश्वनाथ: विश्वनाथ m. (-थः) A name of ŚIVA, especially as the object of peculiar adoration at Benares. E. विश्व the universe, and नाथ lord.
विश्वपा: विश्वपा m. (-पाः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 Fire. E. विश्व, and पा who nourishes.
विश्वप्सन्: विश्वप्सन् m. (-प्सा) 1 Fire, or the deity of fire, AGNI. 2 The moon. 3 The sun. E. विश्व all, प्सा to eat, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.
विश्वबोध: विश्वबोध m. (-धः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint. E. विश्व all, and बोध who explains.
विश्वभुज्: विश्वभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) 1 Enjoying or possessing all things. 2 Eating all things. E. विश्व, and भुज् who possesses.
विश्वभू: विश्वभू m. (-भूः) The third of the seven Buddhas, according to some systems. E. विश्व all, and भू being.
विश्वभेषज: विश्वभेषज n. (-जं) Dry ginger. E. विश्व all (diseases), भेषज a medicament.
विश्वभोजन: विश्वभोजन n. (-नं) Eating all sorts of food. E. विश्व, and भोजन food.
विश्वभोजस्: विश्वभोजस् m. (-जाः) One who enjoys all things. E. विश्व all, भुज to enjoy, Uṇādi aff. असि.
विश्वमदा: विश्वमदा f. (-दा) One of the seven tongues of fire. E. विश्व all, मद to intoxicate, aff. लङ् and टाप्.
विश्वम्भर: विश्वम्भर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) All-sustaining. m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 INDRA. f. (-रा) The earth. E. विश्व all (things), भृ to support or nourish, खच् aff.
विश्वम्भराधिप: विश्वम्भराधिप m. (पः) A king. E. विश्वम्भरा the earth, and अधिप ruler.
विश्वयु: विश्वयु m. (-युः) Air, wind. E. विश्व all, यु to join, aff. क्विप्.
विश्वराज्: विश्वराज् m. (-राट् or -राड्) A universal sovereign. E. विश्व all, and राज who rules.
विश्वरूप: विश्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Taking all forms, existing in all forms, universal, omnipresent. m. (-पः) VIṢṆU. n. (-पं) Agallochum. E. विश्व all, and रूप form.
विश्वरेतस्: विश्वरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ. E. विश्व all, and रेतम् seed.
विश्वरोचन: विश्वरोचन m. (-नः) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. विश्व all, रोचन digestive.
विश्वविधायिन्: विश्वविधायिन् m. (-यी) A deity, a creator. E. विश्व, and विघायिन् who makes.
विश्ववेदस्: विश्ववेदस् m. (-दाः) A sage, a saint, one who knows all things. E. विश्व all, विदि to know, aff. असि.
विश्वव्यापक: विश्वव्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) All-pervading, every where diffused. E. विश्व, and व्यापक what pervades.
विश्वव्यापिन्: विश्वव्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) All-diffused or pervading. E. विश्व, and व्यापिन् what spreads.
विश्वव्याप्ति: विश्वव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Universal diffusion or permeation. E. विश्व, and व्याप्ति spreading.
विश्वसन: विश्वसन n. (-नं) Trusting, confiding in. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, ल्युट् aff.
विश्वसह: विश्वसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) All-enduring. f. (-हा) 1 The earth. 2 One of the tongues of fire. E. विश्व all, सह to bear, aff. अच् and टाप्.
विश्वसारक: विश्वसारक n. (-कं) The prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus, Rox.) E. विश्व all, सार essence, and कन् added.
विश्वसित: विश्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Trusted, believed or confided in. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.
विश्वसृज्: विश्वसृज् m. (-सृक् or -सृग् or -सृट् or -सृड्) BRAHMĀ. E. विश्व all (the universe), सृज to create, aff. क्विन्.
विश्वस्त: विश्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Trusted, confided in, faithful. f. (-स्ता) A widow. E. वि implying kind or sort, or in the fem. form, privation, and श्वस to live or breathe, aff. क्त.
विश्वस्रष्टृ: विश्वस्रष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) The creator of all, GOD. E. विश्व, and स्रष्ट्ट creator.
विश्वाची: विश्वाची f. (-ची) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga.
विश्वात्मन्: विश्वात्मन् m. (-त्मा) BRAHMĀ. n. (-त्म) The soul of the world, the universal spirit, GOD. E. विश्व all, and आत्मन् soul.
विश्वाधायस्: विश्वाधायस् m. (-याः) A deity, a god. E. विश्व all, आङ् before धा to hold or support, असि aff., form irr.
विश्वामिच: विश्वामिच m. (-चः) A Muni, the son of GĀDHI, originally of the military order, but who became by long and painful austerities a Brahmarṣi, in which character he appears in the Rāmāyaṇa, as the early preceptor and counsellor of RĀMA. E. विश्व all, मिच the friend, and the vowel of the prefix made long in this sense; if attributively used, the compound is विश्वमिच.
विश्वामिचप्रिय: विश्वामिचप्रिय m. (-यः) The cocoanut tree. E. विश्वामिच the saint VIŚVĀMITRA, and प्रिय beloved, having been created by the saint.
विश्वावसु: विश्वावसु m. (-सुः) One of the Gandharbas or celestial singers. f. (-सुः) A particular night.
विश्वास: विश्वास m. (-सः) Trust, faith, confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe or live, aff. घञ्.
विश्वासकारण: विश्वासकारण n. (-णं) Cause or motive of trust. E. विश्वास, and करण cause.
विश्वासकृत्: विश्वासकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Inspiring confidence or faith. E. विश्वास, and कृत् who or what makes.
विश्वासघात: विश्वासघात m. (-तः) Violation of trust, treachery. E. विश्वास, and घात destroying.
विश्वासघातक: विश्वासघातक m. (-कः) A traitor, one who betrays confidence. E. विश्वास, and घातक who destroys; also विश्वासघातिन्.
विश्वासपात्र: विश्वासपात्र n. (-त्रं) A confidential agent, one worthy to be trusted. E. विश्वास, and पात्र vessel.
विश्वासप्रद: विश्वासप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Inspiring confidence. E. विश्वास, and प्रद who gives.
विश्वासप्रतिपन्न: विश्वासप्रतिपन्न m. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Confiding, trusting. E. विश्वास, and प्रतिपन्न possessed of.
विश्वासभङ्ग: विश्वासभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Breach of faith, violation of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भङ्ग breaking.
विश्वासभूमि: विश्वासभूमि f. (मिः) An object of trust, a person worthy of confidence. E. विश्वास, and भूमि soil.
विश्वासस्थान: विश्वासस्थान n. (-नं) An object or person of trust or confidence. E. विश्वास, and स्थान place.
विश्वासित: विश्वासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Inspired with confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, causal v., क्त aff.
विश्वासिन्: विश्वासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Trusting, confiding in. 2 Honest, trusty. E. विश्वास, and इनि aff.
विश्वास्य: विश्वास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be trusted or depended on, to be believed. 2 To be encouraged or inspired with confidence. ind. Having encouraged or inspired with confidence. E. वि before श्वस to breathe, ण्यत् aff. or causal v., and यत् or ल्यप् aff.
विश्वास्यता: विश्वास्यता f. (-ता) Trust-worthiness. E. विश्वास्य, and तल् aff.
विश्वेश: विश्वेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. विश्व all, and ईश lord: see the next.
विश्वेश्वर: विश्वेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA, under a form or appellation in which especially he is worshipped at Benares, where a celebrated temple is appropriated to him in the character of lord or god of the universe. E. विश्व the universe, and ईश्वर god; also similar compounds, as विश्वेश, विश्वनाथ, &c.
विष: विष r. 6th cl. (विषति) To pervade. (औ) औविष r. 9th cl. (विष्णाति) To have no occasion or use for, to separate or withdraw from. (उ) विषु r. 1st cl. (वेषति) To sprinkle. (औ इर ऌ) औ इर विषॢ r. 3rd cl. (विवेष्टि विविष्टे) To pervade, to spread or extend through nature, &c.

विष mn. (-षः-षं) Poison, venom. n. (-षं) 1 Water. 2 The fibres attached to the stalk of the lotus. 3 Gum myrrh. 4 A vegetable poison, (Aconitum ferox.) f. (-षा) A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing of a red colour. E. विष to pervade, aff. क.
विष्: विष् f. (-विट्) 1 Fæces, ordure, excrement. 2 Diffusion, spreading. E. विष to pervade, aff. क्विप्.
विषक्त: विषक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Clinging or adhering to closely. 2 In contact with. E. वि before षञ्ज to embrace, क्त aff.
विषघा: विषघा f. (-घा) A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.) E. विष poison, हन् to destroy, aff. ड, and घ substituted for the final.
विषघातिन्: विषघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Antidotic, an antidote. m. (-ती) A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) E. विष poison, and घातिन् removing.
विषघ्न: विषघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Antidotic, an antidote. m. (-घ्नः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 2 A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 3 Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.) f. (-घ्नी) 1 A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.) 2 A plant, commonly Bichhati. 3 Turmeric. 4 Bitter apple or colocynth. E. विष poison, and घ्न what destroys.
विषजुष्ट: विषजुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Poisoned, suffering from poison. 2 Poisonous. E. विष, and जुष्ट united with.
विषणि: विषणि m. (-णिः) A sort of snake.
विषण्ड: विषण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The fibres of the stalk of the water-lily.
विषण्ण: विषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) Dejected, desponding, spiritless, disinclined to exertion. E. वि before सद to go, aff. क्त.
विषण्णता: विषण्णता f. (-ता) Dejection, lassitude, want of energy or spirit, especially as one of the effects of unsuccessful love. E. विषण्ण relaxed, तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व, विषण्णत्वं.
विषण्णवदन: विषण्णवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking sad or dejected. E. विषण्ण, and वदन face: also विषण्णमुख, &c.
विषतुल्य: विषतुल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Fatal, deadly. E. विष, and तुल्य equal to.
विषद: विषद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Yielding or giving poison. 2 Shedding water. m. (-दः) A cloud. n. (-दं) Green vitriol. E. विष poison or water, and दा to give, aff. क.
विषदंष्ट्रा: विषदंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) A medicinal plant and antidote, commonly Sarpa or Sāmpkaṅkāli, or snake skin. E. विष venom, दंष्ट्र a tooth.
विषदन्तक: विषदन्तक m. (-कः) A snake. E. विष poison, दन्त tooth, and कप् added.
विषदर्शनमृत्युक: विषदर्शनमृत्युक m. (-कः) A kind of pheasant. E. विष poison, (perhaps put for the snake,) दर्शन seeing, मृत्युक who dies.
विषधर: विषधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Venomous, poisonous. m. (-रः) A snake. E. विष poison, घर who has.
विषधात्री: विषधात्री f. (-त्री) The wife of Jaratkāru, and goddess presiding over snakes. E. विष venom, घात्री a nurse.
विषनाशन: विषनाशन m. (-नः) 1 A tree, (Mimosa sirisa.) 2 An antidote. n. (-नं) Removing or curing poison. E. षिव poison, and नाशन destroying.
विषनाशिन्: विषनाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Antidote. f. (-नी) A plant: see विषदंष्ट्रा. E. विष venom, नाशिन् destroying.
विषनुद्: विषनुद् m. (-नुत्) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. विष poison, नुद् to eject, aff. क्विप्.
विषपुष्प: विषपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) n. (-ष्पं) The blue lotus. E. विष poison, and पुष्प flower.
विषपुष्पक: विषपुष्पक m. (-कः) Sickness or disease induced by eating poisonous flowers. E. विष poison, पुष्प a flower, or विषपुष्प the Vangueria, &c., कन् aff. in this sense.
विषप्रयोग: विषप्रयोग m. (-गः) Employing or administering poison. E. विण, and प्रयोग application.
विषभक्षण: विषभक्षण n. (-णं) Taking poison. E. विष, and भक्षण feeding.
विषभिषज्: विषभिषज् m. (-षक्) A dealer in antidotes, a snake-catcher, or one who pretends to cure the bite of a snake. E. विष poison, and भिषज् a doctor.
विषभुजङ्ग: विषभुजङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A poisonous snake. E. विष poison, and भुजङ्ग a snake.
विषभृत्: विषभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Venomous, poisonous. m. (-भृत्) A snake. E. विष, and भृत् who or what has.
विषम: विषम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult, (of access,) rough, uneven. 2 Difficult, &c. (of comprehending,) as a book. 3 Painful, difficult, troublesome, (in general.) 4 Odd, (in numbers.) 5 Unparalleled, unequalled. 6 Wicked, dishonest. 7 Fearful, frightful, awful. n. (-मं) 1 Difficulty, pain. 2 Unevenness, inequality. 3 Oddness, (in numeration.) 4 An inaccessible place, a thicket, a precipice. 5 (In rhetoric,) Description of unusual or incompatible cause and effect. E. वि privative or contra-indicative, before सम even, smooth, equal, &c., and स after the इ of the prefix, changed to ष.
विषमकर्ण: विषमकर्ण m. (-र्णः) The hypothenuse of a right angled triangle, formed between the gnomon and the two sides of the shadow. E. विषम, and कर्ण hypothenuse.
विषमकर्मन्: विषमकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) 1 An odd or unparalleled act. 2 (In arithmetic,) The finding of quantities from their difference or that of their squares. E. विषम, and कर्म्मन् act.
विषमकर्म्मन्: विषमकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) 1 An odd or unparalleled act. 2 (In arithmetic,) The finding of quantities from their difference or that of their squares. E. विषम, and कर्म्मन् act.
विषमखात: विषमखात n. (-तं) An irregular excavation or one with unequal sides. E. विषम, and खात excavation.
विषमचतुरस्र: विषमचतुरस्र n. (-स्रं) An unequal four-sided figure, a trapezium. E. विषम, and चतुरस्र four-angled.
विषमच्छद: विषमछद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. विषम odd, and छद a leaf; having seven leaves on a stalk.
विषमछद: विषमछद m. (-दः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. विषम odd, and छद a leaf; having seven leaves on a stalk.
विषमच्छाया: विषमछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoxes. E. विषम oblique, and छाया shadow.
विषमछाया: विषमछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoxes. E. विषम oblique, and छाया shadow.
विषमज्वर: विषमज्वर m. (-रः) 1 A violent fever. 2 Irregularly remittent fever. E. विषम, and ज्वर a fever.
विषमत्रिभुज: विषमत्रिभुज m. (-जः) A scalene triangle. E. विषम unequal, त्रिभुज triangle.
विषमनयन: विषमनयन m. (-नः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd, नयन an eye; having a third eye in his forehead.
विषमन्त्र: विषमन्त्र m. (-न्त्रः) A snake-catcher, one who by pretended charms, &c. attracts snakes and cures the bite. n. (-न्तं) A charm for curing snake bites. E. विष poison, मन्त्र a charm.
विषममय: विषममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Resulting from or produced by inequality. E. विषम, and मयट् aff.
विषमरूप्य: विषमरूप्य mfn. (प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Resulting from or produced by unequal quantities or qualities. E. विषम uneven, and रूप्य aff. in this sense.
विषमविभाग: विषमविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal division of property amongst coheirs. E. विषम uneven, विभाग portion of inheritance.
विषमशायिन्: विषमशायिन् mfn. (-यी यिनी-यि) Sleeping irregularly. E. विषम, and शायिन् who sleeps.
विषमशिष्ट: विषमशिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unjust, unfair, (division.) E. विषम, and शिष्ट left.
विषमशील: विषमशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Uneven. 2 Uneasy, difficult. E. विषभ, and शील having.
विषमसाहस: विषमसाहस n. (-मं) Temerity, daring. E. विषम, and माहस violence.
विषमस्थ: विषमस्थ mfn. (-स्थः स्था-स्थं) 1 Standing unevenly. 2 Inaccessible, safely posted. 3 Being in difficulty or misfortune. E. विषम uneven, and स्थ who stays.
विषमाशन: विषमाशन n. (-नं) Eating irregularly, either as to quantity or time. E. विषम, and अशन eating.
विषमाक्ष: विषमाक्ष m. (-क्षः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd, अक्षि the eye, aff. टच्; having a third eye, or one in his forehead.
विषमायुध: विषमायुध m. (-धः) KĀMADEVA. E. विषम odd, आयुध a weapon, armed with five arrows.
विषमाशय: विषमाशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Crafty, dishonest. E. विषम, and आशय asylum.
विषमित: विषमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made or become uneven, irregular, &c. E. विषम, and इतच् aff.
विषमीय: विषमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Produced or resulting from inequalities. E. विषम uneven, and छ aff.
विषमुष्टि: विषमुष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A kind of shrub of medicinal properties, commonly termed Biṣdori or Karsinh. E. विष poison, मुष्टि a handful.
विषमृत्यु: विषमृत्यु m. (-त्युः) A sort of bird, a kind of pheasant. E. विष poison, and मृत्यु death.
विषमेक्षण: विषमेक्षण m. (-णः) ŚIVA. E. विषम odd (three), ईक्षण eye.
विषमेषु: विषमेषु m. (-षुः) KĀMADEVA. E. विषम odd (five), इषु an arrow.
विषय: विषय m. (-यः) 1 Any object of sense, any thing perceivable by the senses, as colour, form, flavour, odour, and sound. 2 An object in general, as of affection or desire, &c. 3 Worldly object or pursuit, affair, business, transaction, &c. 4 A country, whether inhabited or uninhabited. 5 Refuge, asylum. 6 Department, sphere, element, home, province, that which is peculiarly known or frequented, as a particular study by its professors, a particular town by its townsfolk, water by fish, air by birds, &c. 7 A collection of villages. 8 Any thing indigenous or peculiar to a province, &c. 9 A religious obligation or observance. 10 Semen virile. 11 A lover, a hus band. E. वि before षि to bind, aff. अच्.
विषयक: विषयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Relating to, concerning, (any object.) E. विषय, and कन् added.
विषयकत्व: विषयकत्व n. (-त्वं) State of an affair, circumstance or thing. E. त्व added to the preceding.
विषयकर्मन्: विषयकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Worldly concern or act. E. विषय, and कर्म्म act.
विषयकर्म्मन्: विषयकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Worldly concern or act. E. विषय, and कर्म्म act.
विषयकाम: विषयकाम m. (-मः) Desire of worldly goods or pleasures. E. विषय, and काम desire.
विषयात्मक: विषयात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Identical with or affecting sensual or worldly objects. E. विषय, and आत्मक own.
विषयवासिन्: विषयवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Engaged in the affairs of life. E. विषय, and वासिन् who abides.
विषयायिन्: विषयायिन् m. (-यी) 1 A king. 2 An organ of sense. 3 KĀMADEVA. 4 An epicurean, a sensualist, one heedful of objects of sense or attentive to worldly objects. 5 A materialist, one who disbelieves the existence of that which is not cognizable by the senses. E. विषय an object of sense, अय to go, to follow, and इनि aff.
विषयासक्त: विषयासक्त m. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Attached to objects of sense, devoted to the world. E. विषय, and आसक्त attached to.
विषयिन्: विषयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Attached to objects of sense, carnal, sensual. 2 Conversant with or interested in worldly occupations or enjoyments. n. (-यि) An organ of sense. m. (-यी) 1 A king. 2 The deity KĀMA. 3 A sensualist. 4 A materialist, one who denies the existence of any thing which is not an object of sense. 5 A man of business or of the world. E. विषय an organ of sense, aff. इन्.
विषयोपसेवा: विषयोपसेवा f. (-वा) Sensuality. E. विषय, and उपसेय addiction to.
विषल: विषल m. (-लः) Poison, venom. E. विष poison, लच् aff.
विषविद्या: विषविद्या f. (-द्या) The administration of antidotes, the cure of poisons by drugs or charms. E. विष poison, विद्या science.
विषविधान: विषविधान n. (-नं) Administering poison judicially, or by way of ordeal. E. विष, and विधान rule.
विषवेग: विषवेग m. (-गः) Absorption of venom, as shewn by some bodily effects or changes. E. विष poison, and वेग natural excretion.
विषवैद्य: विषवैद्य m. (-द्यः) A dealer in antidotes, one professing by charms, &c. to cure the bite of a snake. E. विष poison, and वैद्य a physician.
विषशूक: विषशूक m. (-कः) A wasp. E. विष venom, and शूक a parrot.
विषशृङ्गिन्: विषशृङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A wasp. E. विष poison, शृङ्ग a horn, and इनि poss. aff.
विषसूचक: विषसूचक m. (-कः) The Greek partridge, (Perdix rufa.) E. विष poison, and सूचक informer.
विषसृक्कन्: विषसृक्कन् m. (-क्का) A wasp. E. विष poison, and सृक्कन् the corner of the mouth.
विषहर: विषहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) An antidote, removing venom. f. (-रा or -री) The goddess of the serpent race, the sister of VĀSUKI, and wife of JARATKĀRU. E. विष venom, हृ to take, aff. अप् or टच्.
विषहृदय: विषहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Malicious, malignant, cherishing hatred or hostility. E. विष, and हृदय the heart.
विषह्य: विषह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be borne or endured. ind. Having borne. E. वि before षह to bear, aff. यत् or ल्यप्.
विषा: विषा ind. Aptote noun. Intellect, understanding. E. षो to destroy (ignorance), with वि prefixed, and ओ Uṇādi aff.; see विष.
विषाङ्कुर: विषाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A spear, a dart. E. विष poison, अङ्कर a shoot.
विषाण: विषाण subst. mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 The horn of an animal. 2 The tusks of an elephant. 3 The tusk or fang of the boar. f. (-णी) 1 A plant, the fruit of which is compared to the horn of a ram, &c. commonly Meṣa Śṛṅgī. 2 A medicinal root: see क्षीरकाकोली. n. (-णं) A sort of Costus (C. speciosus.) E. वि before अस to be, चानश् aff.; the initial of the radical rejected, and स changed to ष; otherwise, वि before षण to serve, aff. घञ्.
विषाणिका: विषाणिका f. (-का) A sort of plant, commonly Meṣa Śṛṅgī. E. विषाणी as above, and कन् pleonasm, fem. form.
विषाणिन्: विषाणिन् m. (-णी) 1 An elephant. 2 A bull. 3 Any animal with horns. E. विषाण a horn or tusk, and इनि aff.
विषाद: विषाद m. (-दः) 1 Lassitude, dejection, lowness of spirits, want of energy, especially as the result of unrequited love. 2 Distress, affliction. 3 Disappointment. E. वि before सद to go, aff. घञ्.
विषादिन्: विषादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Dejected, disconsolate, sorrowful. E. विषाद, and इनि aff.
विषानन: विषानन n. (-नः) A snake. E. विष poison, and आनन the face.
विषान्तक: विषान्तक m. (-कः) ŚIVA. E. विष poison, and अन्तक destroyer; having swallowed the poison that was produced at the churning of the ocean.
विषापह: विषापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Antidotic, an antidote. f. (-हा) A kind of birth wort, (Aristolochia Indica.) E. विष poison, and अपह removing.
विषायुध: विषायुध m. (-घः) A snake. E. विष poison, and आयुध a weapon.
विषार: विषार m. (-रः) A snake. E. विष poison, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.
विषालु: विषालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Venomous, poisonous. E. विष, and आलुच् aff.
विषास्य: विषास्य m. (-स्यः) A snake. f. (-स्या) Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.) E. विष poison, and आस्य face.
विषीदत्: विषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sorrowing, despairing. E. वि before षद to go, शतृ aff.
विषु: विषु ind. 1 Many, various. 2 Equally, same, like.
विषुण: विषुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having or possessing various or uniform motion or extension. E. विष्वञ्च going every where, न poss. aff., and the final consonant of the primitive rejected.
विषुप: विषुप n. (-पं) The equinox: see the next.
विषुव: विषुव n. (-वं) The equinox. E. विषु equally, (the night and day,) and व or प aff.; also विषुप.
विषुवच्छाया: विषुवछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoctial points. E. विषुव, and छाया shade.
विषुवछाया: विषुवछाया f. (-या) The shadow of the gnomon at noon when the sun is in the equinoctial points. E. विषुव, and छाया shade.
विषुवत्: विषुवत् n. (-वत्) The equinox. E. विषु equally, (long, the day and night,) and मतुप् poss. aff.
विषुवदिन: विषुवदिन n. (-नं) The day of the equinox. E. विषुव, and दिन day.
विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति: विषुवसङ्क्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) The passage of the sun to the next sign at the equinoxes. E. विषुव, and सङ्क्रान्ति sun's entrance into a sign.
विष्कन्तृ: विष्कन्तृ mfn. (-न्त्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Going, going in various directions, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, तृन् aff.; also विस्कन्तृ.
विष्कन्द: विष्कन्द m. (-न्दः) Going, dispersing. E. वि before स्कदि to go, अच् aff.; also विस्कन्द.
विष्कन्न: विष्कन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Gone. 2 Gone in various directions, dispersed. E. वि before स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
विष्कम्भ: विष्कम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 The first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods, called Yogas, or Yoga star of the first lunar mansion, 2 Obstacle, hindrance, impediment, resistance. 3 Spreading, extension. 4 Act, doing any thing. 5 A posture of the devotees called Yogits. 6 One of the performers at a dramatic entertainment, either an actor who in the intervals of the scenes explains to the audience the progress of the story, or one or two of the personages of the drama, who do the same in a soliloquy or dialogue. 7 A tree. 8 The bolt or bar of a door. 9 A post, the roof-tree of a house. 10 The diameter of a circle. E. वि before ष्कभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्; also with कन् added विस्कम्भक.
विष्कम्भक: विष्कम्भक m. (-कः) A Yoga, &c.: see the last.
विष्कम्भिन्: विष्कम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) Obstructive, impeding. m. (-म्भी) The bolt or bar of a door. E. विष्कम्भ obstruction, and इनि aff.
विष्किर: विष्किर m. (-रः) 1 A bird in general. 2 Pulling or tearing to pieces. E. वि before कॄ to scatter, and क aff., with सुट् aug.
विष्ट: विष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Entered, penetrated, pervaded. f. (-ष्टा) Fæces. E. विष to pervade, aff. क्त.
विष्टप: विष्टप mn. (-पः-पं) A world. E. विश to enter, (into which,) प aff, deriv. irr.; also विष्टभृ.
विष्टभ: विष्टभ n. (-भं) A world. E. विश to pervade, अभच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; deriv. irr.
विष्टब्ध: विष्टब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Hindered, obstructed. 2 Stayed, fixed firm, well-supported. 3 Placed in or upon. 4 Paralysed, made stiff or motionless. E. वि before स्तभि to stop, क्त aff.
विष्टम्भ: विष्टम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Impediment, hindrance, obstacle. 2 Stopping, staying. 3 Placing in or upon. 4 A disease, obstruction of urine or fæces, ischury, constipation. 5 Paralysis, loss of motion. E. वि before स्तभि to stop or hinder, aff. घञ्.
विष्टम्भिन्: विष्टम्भिन् mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि) 1 Stopping, impeding, what hinders or obstructs. 2 Checking (as perspiration), chilling. 3 Making motionless. E. वि before स्तभि to stop, घिनुण् aff.
विष्टर: विष्टर m. (-रः) 1 A tree. 2 A handful of Kuśa or sacred grass. 3 A seat, a stool, a chair, a couch, &c. 4 The seat of the Brahman, either real or in effigy, as presiding at a sacrifice. 5 A bed. 6 A seat made of twenty-five straws of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप, and स changed to ष.
विष्टरश्रवस्: विष्टरश्रवस् m. (-वाः) KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. विष्टर a tree, श्रु to hear, aff. असुन्.
विष्टरस्थ: विष्टरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Sitting on a seat, or reclining on a bed of leaves. E. विष्टर, and स्थ who stays.
विष्टार: विष्टार m. (-रः) A form of metre, a species of the order termed Paṅkti, consisting of a verse of four lines, the first and last of which consist of eight syllables each, and the second and third of twelve each. E. वि before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्, and स changed to ष.
विष्टि: विष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Working, labouring, a workman. f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Unpaid labour, working without wages. 2 Occupation, act,  action. 3 Hire, wages. 4 The seventh of the variable Karaṇas, or astrological periods so termed, each answering to half a lunar day. 5 Sending, dispatching. 6 Consigning to torture, casting into hell, &c. E. विश to enter, (into pain by it,) and क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.
विष्ठल: विष्ठल n. (-लं) A place situated remote or apart. E. वि implying apart, स्थल a place, and स changed to ष.
विष्ठा: विष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Fæces, ordure. E. वि before स्था to stay, (in the intestines,) aff. अङ् and टाप्.
विष्णु: विष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) VIṢṆU, one of the three principal Hindu deities, and the preserver of the world: during the periods of temporary annihilation, he is supposed to sleep on the waters floating on the serpent Śeṣa: BRAHMĀ is fabled to have sprung from a lotus, which originally grew from the navel of VIṢṆU, and the holy river Ganges is said to spring from his foot: the different Avatāras are considered as emanations of this deity, and in KṚṢṆA, he is supposed to have been really and wholly incarnate: LAKṢMĪ his wife, and he is usually represented as a mild and benevolent deity. 2 AGNI or fire. 3 One of the demigods called Vasus. 4 A pure or pious man. 5 The name of an ancient law-giver. E. विश to enter or pervade (the universe), नु Uṇādi aff.
विष्णुक्रान्ता: विष्णुक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A flower, (Clitorea ternatea.) E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and क्रान्त overcome; prized by or sacred to that deity.
विष्णुगुप्त: विष्णुगुप्त m. (-प्तः) The saint KAUṆḌILYA. E. विष्णु, and गुप्त hidden, having been concealed by VIṢṆU when pursued by ŚIVA, whom he had incensed.
विष्णुगृह: विष्णुगृह n. (-हं) The name of a city or country; also Stambapur. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and गृह residence.
विष्णुदैवत्या: विष्णुदैवत्या f. (-त्या) The twelfth lunar day of each fortnight. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and दैवत्य divinity.
विष्णुपद: विष्णुपद n. (-दं) 1 The sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 The sea of milk. 3 A lotus. f. (-दी) 1 The Ganges. 2 One of the twelve Saṅkrāntis or periods, at which the sun enters a sign of the zodiac, especially the first sign after the equinox. E. विष्णु, and पद् abode, or foot; where VIṢṆU resides or rests, or proceeding from his foot.
विष्णुरथ: विष्णुरथ m. (-थः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. विष्णु, and रथ car or conveyance.
विष्णुलिङ्गी: विष्णुलिङ्गी f. (-ङ्गी) A quail. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and लिङ्ग a mark, ङीप् diminutive aff.
विष्णुवल्लभ: विष्णुवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Beloved by VIṢṆU. f. (-भा) 1 A plant, (Echites caryophyallata.) 2 A small fragrant shrub, (Ocymum sanctum.) 3 LAKṢMI. E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, and वल्लभ the beloved.
विष्णुवाहन: विष्णुवाहन m. (-नः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. विष्णु, and वाहन vehicle.
विष्पन्द: विष्पन्द m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, beating. E. वि before स्यन्दि to go, अच् aff.
विष्फार: विष्फार m. (-रः) The twang of a bow. E. वि before स्फर or स्फुर to expand, aff. घञ्; in the latter आ is substituted for the vowel, and स is changed to ष, also विस्फार.
विष्य: विष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Deserving death by poison. E. विष venom, and यत् aff.
विष्यन्द: विष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Flowing, issuing, trickling. E. वि before ष्यदि to go, अच् aff.; also read विस्यन्द.
विष्यन्दमान: विष्यन्दमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Flowing-trickling. E. वि before ष्यदि to go, शानच् aff.; also read विस्यन्दमान.
विष्व: विष्व mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं) Injurious, mischievous. E. विष to pervade, Uṇādi aff. व.
विष्वक्: विष्वक् ind. Every way, all around: see विष्वच्.
विष्वक्सेन: विष्वक्सेन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Priyangu. E. विष्वक् every where, सेना an army.
विष्वक्सेनप्रिया: विष्वक्सेनप्रिया f. (-या) 1 A sort of yam, (Dioscorea.) 2 LAKṢMĪ. E. निष्वक्सेन VIṢṆU, and प्रिया beloved by, sacred to.
विष्वग्गत: विष्वग्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone all about, spread, extended. E. विष्वक्, and गत gone.
विष्वग्गति: विष्वग्गति f. (-तिः) Going all about. E. विष्वक्, and गति going.
विष्वच्: विष्वच् or विष्वञ्च् mfn. (-ष्वङ्-षूची-ष्वक्) Going every where, allpervading. n. (-ष्वक्) The equinox. E. विषु variously (in various directions), or equally, अञ्च् to go, क्विन् aff.; it is also written, but less accurately विश्वच्.
विष्वणन: विष्वणन n. (-नं) Food, eating. E. वि before स्वन to sound, (with the lips, to smack the lips,) and ल्युट् aff.
विष्वद्र्यच्: विष्वद्र्यच् or द्र्यञ्च् mfn. (-द्र्यङ्-द्रीची-द्र्यक्) Going every where. E. विष्वच् every where, with अद्री augment.
विष्वाण: विष्वाण m. (-णः) Eating, food. E. वि before स्वन to sound, aff. घञ्.
विसंयुक्त: विसंयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Separate, detached. 2 Omitting. E. वि priv., संयुक्त joined.
विसंयोग: विसंयोग m. (-गः) 1 Separation. 2 Omission. E. वि priv., संयोग union.
विस: विस r. 4th cl. (विस्यति) 1 To throw, to send. 2 To put forth.
विस n. (-सं) The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily. E. विस to send, to put forth, aff. क.
विसकण्ठिका: विसकण्ठिका f. (-का) A small crane. E. विस the fibres of the lotus stalk, aff. अंच्, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff. fem. form, implying comparison.
विसङ्कट: विसङ्कट m. (-टः) A lion. E. वि and सम before कट to encompass, अच् aff.
विसच्छेद: विसछेद m. (-दः) A part of the fibres of the lotus. E. विस, and छेद a section.
विसछेद: विसछेद m. (-दः) A part of the fibres of the lotus. E. विस, and छेद a section.
विसज: विसज n. (-जं) A lotus. E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and ज born.
विसज्ञ: विसज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Lifeless, bereft of sense. E. वि priv., सज्ञा sense.
विसनाभि: विसनाभि m. (-भिः) A quantity of lotuses. E. विस the fibres of the stalk, and नाभि navel.
विसनासिका: विसनासिका f. (-का) A sort of crane. E. विस the film of the lotus stalk, and नासिका the nose or beak.
विसपुष्प: विसपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) A lotus. E. विस the stalk, and पुष्प flower.
