वेदान्तिन्: वेदान्तिन् m. (-न्ती) A Vedāntī, a follower of the Vedānta philosophy. E. वेदान्त the theism of the Vedas, and इनि aff.
वेदान्तोपगत: वेदान्तोपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Derived from or produced by the Vedānta. E. वेदान्त, and उपगत derived from.
वेदाभ्यास: वेदाभ्यास m. (-सः) 1 The repetition of the mystical syllable Om. 2 Study of scripture. E. वेद the Vedas, and अभ्यास exercise.
वेदार: वेदार m. (-रः) A chameleon, a lizard.
वेदि: वेदि f. (-दिः-दी) 1 Ground for placing the vessels used at an oblation, or for binding the victim, or lighting the sacrificial fire; it is more or less raised and of various shapes; an altar, &c. 2 A quadrangular spot in the court-yard of a temple or palace, usually furnished with a raised floor or seat, and covered with a roof supported by pillars: see वितर्दि. 3 A seal ring. m. (-दिः) A Paṇḍita, a teacher. f. (-दिः) A name of SARASVATĪ, the wife of BRAHMĀ. E. विद to know, &c. Uṇādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added in the fem. form.
वेदिका: वेदिका f. (-का) 1 A quadrangular open shed in the middle of a court yard, erected for various purposes: see वितर्द्दि. 2 Ground prepared for sacrificial ceremonies, a rude kind of altar. E. कन् added to the last.
वेदिजा: वेदिजा f. (-जा) DRAUPADĪ, the sister and wife of the Pāṇḍus. E. वेदि an altar, and ज born; born from sacrificial fire.
वेदित: वेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Set forth, represented, made known. E. विद to know, causal form, aff. क्त.
वेदितव्य: वेदितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be known or ascertained. 2 To be made known, to be explained or expounded. E. विद to know, causal form, aff. तव्यर्.
वेदितृ: वेदितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wise, learned. E. विद to know, तृच् aff., with the augment इट्.
वेदित्व: वेदित्व n. (-त्वं) Knowledge, experience. E. वेदिन् who knows, त्व aff.; also with तल्, वेदिता.
वेदिन्: वेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what knows. m. (-दी) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned Brahman, a teacher. 2 BRAHMĀ. n. (-दि) A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. विद to know, घिनुण् aff.
वेदीश: वेदीश m. (-शः) BRAHMĀ. E. वेदी SARASVATĪ, and ईश lord.
वेदोक्त: वेदोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Scriptural, taught or declared in the Vedas. E. वेद the Vedas, and उक्त said.
वेदोदय: वेदोदय m. (-यः) SŪRYA, or the sun. E. वेद the Veda, (the Sāma Veda,) and उदय rise, origin; being said to have proceeded from the sun.
वेदोदित: वेदोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught in the Vedas, scriptural. E. वेद the Vedas, and उदित spoken, from वद to speak, with क्त aff.
वेदोपकरण: वेदोपकरण n. (-णं) A subordinate branch of the study of the Vedas: see वेदाङ्ग. E. वेद, and उपकरण implement.
वेद्य: वेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be known or ascertained. 2 To be explained or taught. E. विद to know, ण्यत् aff.
वेध: वेध m. (-धः) 1 Perforation, piercing. 2 Depth, (in measurement.) E. व्यध to pierce, aff. अच्.
वेधक: वेधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sharp, piercing, a piercer or perforator. m. (-कः) Camphor. n. (-कं) Grain, rice in the ear. E. व्यध to pierce, aff. वुन्.
वेधन: वेधन n. (-नं) 1 Piercing, perforation. 2 Depth, (in measurement.) f. (-नी) 1 An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear. 2 A small gimblet or perforating instrument used to pierce gems, shells, &c. 3 An augre, a gimblet, &c. or any similar instrument. E. व्यध to pierce, ल्युट् aff.
वेधनिका: वेधनिका f. (-का) A small-pointed perforating instrument, used especially to make holes in jewels, pearls, shells, &c., an augre, an awl, a gimblet, &c. E. कन् added to वेधन as above.
वेधमुख्यक: वेधमुख्यक m. (-कः) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. वेध piercing, (figuratively for pervading as by its odour,) मुख्य principal, कन् added.
वेधस्: वेधस् m. (-धाः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A wise or learned man. 4 The sun. E. वि before घा to have, Uṇādi aff. असि, and वेध substituted for the root and prefix.
वेधस: वेधस n. (-सं) The root of the thumb, considered as sacred to BRAHMĀ. E. वेधस् BRAHMĀ, and अण् added, the vowel unchanged.
वेधित: वेधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pierced, perforated. E. व्यघ to pierce, aff. क्त.
वेधिन्: वेधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Piercing, perforating. f. (-धिनी) A leech. E. व्यघ piercing, णिनि aff.
वेध्य: वेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be pierced or perforated. n. (-ध्यं) A mark, a butt. E. व्यघ to pierce, aff. यत्.
वेन: वेन r. 1st cl. (वेनति) To go, &c.: see वेण.
वेन m. (-नः) BRAHMĀ. E. वी substituted for अज to go, Uṇādi aff. न.
वेन्ना: वेन्ना f. (-न्ना) A river. E. वन to sound, Uṇādi aff. न, and इ with the usual change, substituted for the vowel.
वेप: वेप (टु ऋ) टुवेपृ r. 1st cl. (वेपते) To shake or tremble.
वेपथु: वेपथु m. (-थुः) Trembling, tremor. E. वेप to tremble, अथुच् aff.
वेपन: वेपन n. (-नं) Tremor, trembling. E. वेप to tremble, aff. ल्युट्.
वेपमान: वेपमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Trembling, shaking. E. वेप to tremble, शानच् aff.
वेपस्: वेपस् n. (-पः) Trembling. E. वेप to tremble, aff. असि.
वेम: वेम m. (-मः) A loom. E. वेञ् to weave, aff. मन्.
वेमन्: वेमन् mn. (-मा-म) A loom. E. वेञ् to weave, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
वेर: वेर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The body. 2 The egg-plant. 3 Saffron. E. वी to go, रक् aff.
वेरट: वेरट m. (-टः) A low man, one of mixed or inferior caste. n. (-टं) The fruit of the Jujube.
वेल: वेल (ऋ) वेऌ r. 1st cl. (वेलति) 1 To go or move. 2 To shake, to tremble. r. 10th cl. (वेलयति) To count or declare the time.

वेल n. (-लं) A garden. f. (-ला) 1 Time. 2 Tide, flow, current. 3 Boundary, limit. 4 Sea-shore. 5 Easy or sudden death. 6 Sickness, disease. 7 The food of ŚIVA. 8 Speech. 9 Leisure, interval, opportunity. 10 The wife of Budha. 11 The gums. E. वेल to go, aff. अच् and टाप्.
वेलाकुल: वेलाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Agitated by the tide. E. वेला, and आकुल perplexed.
वेलाकूल: वेलाकूल n. (-लं) Tamlūck, the district or kingdom as it formerly existed, the southern part of the present Hūgli district, forming the west bank of the Hūgli river, at its union with the sea: a village called Beercool, derived from this word probably, is still found in the maps, near the sea shore immediately south of the boundary of the Hūgli district. E. वेला tide, and कूल bank or shore.
वेलामूल: वेलामूल n. (-लं) The sea shore. E. वेला, and मूल root.
वेलायाम्: वेलायाम् ind. 1 On the sea shore, coast wise, &c. 2 Seasonably, opportunely. E. वेला a shore, &c. in the seventh case, used as a particle.
वेल्ल: वेल्ल r. 1st cl. (-वेल्लति) 1 To go. 2 To tremble or shake.
वेल्ल m. (-ल्लः) Going, moving, shaking. mn. (-ल्लः-ल्लं) A plant, the seed of which is used as a vermifuge. E. वेल्ल to shake, aff. अच्.
वेल्लज: वेल्लज n. (-जं) Black pepper, (Piper nigrum.) E. वेल्ल shaking, and ज born.
वेल्लन: वेल्लन n. (-नं) 1 Rolling on the ground, (as a horse.) 2 A sort of rolling pin with which cakes, &c. are prepared. 3 Shaking. 4 Going. E. वेल्ल to shake, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
वेल्लहल: वेल्लहल m. (-लः) A libertine, a debauchee.
वेल्लि: वेल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) A creeping plant. E. वेल्ल to shake, aff. इन्.
वेल्लिका: वेल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Bel Sunṭh. E. कन् added to the last.
वेल्लित: वेल्लित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling, tremulous. 2 Crooked. n. (-तं) 1 Going, moving. 2 Shaking. E. वेल्ल to shake, to move, aff. क्त.
वेवी: वेवी r. 2nd cl. (वेवीते) 1 To go. 2 To pervade. 3 To conceive or become pregnant. 4 To desire. 5 To throw or send. 6 To eat; also वी.
वेश: वेश m. (-शः) 1 Dress, decoration. 2 Disguise, masquerade. 3 The abode of harlots. 4 A house in general. 4 Entrance, ingress. E. विश to enter, (literally or figuratively, as to enter or occupy the mind,) aff. घञ्.
वेशक: वेशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what enters. m. (-कः) A house. f. (-शिका) Entrance, ingress. E. विश to enter, ण्वुल् aff.
वेशदान: वेशदान m. (-नः) The sun-flower. E. वेश ornament, and दान gift.
वेशधारिन्: वेशधारिन् m. (-री) A hypocrite, a false devotee. E. वेश disguise, and घारिन् having.
वेशभृत्: वेशभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Dressed, adorned. 2 Disguised. E. वेश, and भृत who has.
वेशन: वेशन n. (-नं) 1 A house. 2 Entering. E. विश to enter, ल्यट् aff.
वेशन्त: वेशन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A basin, a small pond. 2 Fire. E. विश to enter, झच् Uṇādi aff.
वेशर: वेशर m. (-रः) A mule; also वेसर.
वेशवार: वेशवार m. (-रः) A condiment, as pepper, cloves, mace, &c.: see वेसवार.
वेशिन्: वेशिन् mfn. (-शि-शिनी-शि) Assuming a particular dress or form. E. वेश, and इनि aff.
वेश्मन्: वेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A house. E. विश to enter, मनिन् aff.
वेश्मनकुल: वेश्मनकुल m. (-लः) The musk shrew or rat. E. वेश्म a house, and नकुल an ichneumon.
वेश्मभू: वेश्मभू f. (-भूः) The site of a habitation. E. वेश्म a house, and भ ground.
वेश्मस्थूणा: वेश्मस्थूणा f. (-णा) The main post of a house. E. वेश्म् a dwelling, and स्थूणा a pillar.
वेश्य: वेश्य n. (-श्यं) The habitation of harlots. f. (-श्या) 1 A harlot, a prostitute, a whore. 2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. विश to enter, ण्यत् aff. or वेश ornament, and यत् aff.
वेश्यागण: वेश्यागण m. (-णः) A company of harlots. E. वेश्या, and गण a number, a class.
वेश्याचार्य: वेश्याचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A catamite. 2 The master or keeper of dancing girls, prostitutes, &c. E. वेश्या a whore, and आचार्य्य spiritual teacher.
वेश्याचार्य्य: वेश्याचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A catamite. 2 The master or keeper of dancing girls, prostitutes, &c. E. वेश्या a whore, and आचार्य्य spiritual teacher.
वेश्याजनसमाश्रय: वेश्याजनसमाश्रय m. (-यः) The habitation of harlots, a brothel. E. वेश्या a whore, जन people, सम् collective particle, and आश्रय asylum.
वेश्यावार: वेश्यावार m. (-रः) A number or company of harlots. E. वेश्या, and वार assemblage.
वेश्याश्रय: वेश्याश्रय m. (-यः) A brothel, the habitation of harlots. E. वेश्या a whore, आश्रय asylum.
वेष: वेष m. (-षः) Ornament, dress, decoration. E. विष to invest, aff. घञ्.
वेषण: वेषण m. (-णः) A shrub, (Cassia sophora.) f. (-णा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) n. (-णं) Entrance, ingress, possession, occupation. E. विष to enter, &c., aff. युच्.
वेषवार: वेषवार m. (-रः) A condiment; also वेसवार.
वेष्ट: वेष्ट r. 1st cl. (वेष्टते) To surround, to inclose, to encompass or circle.
वेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A fence, an enclosure. 2 Surrounding, enclosing. 3 A turban. 4 Exudation, gum, resin in general. 5 Turpentine. E. वेष्ट to surround, aff. अच्.
वेष्टक: वेष्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Surrounding, a surrounder, that which encompasses or encloses. n. (-कं) 1 A turban. 2 Exudation, resin, gum, &c. 3 Turpentine. m. (-कः) 1 A wall, a fence. 2 A pumpkin gourd. E. वेष्ट as above, with कन् added, or वेष्ट to surround, aff. वुन्.
वेष्टन: वेष्टन n. (-नं) 1 Surrounding, encompassing. 2 A wall, an enclosure, a fence. 3 A turban. 4 A diadem, a tiara. 5 The outer ear, or the meatus auditorius and the concha. 9 An attitude in dancing, a particular disposition of the hands; also a crossing of the feet. 7 Bdellium. E. वेष्ट to surround aff. ल्युट्.
वेष्टनीय: वेष्टनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be surrounded or encompassed. E. वेष्ट to surround, अनीयर् aff.; also वेष्टितव्य and वेष्ट्य.
वेष्टयित्वा: वेष्टयित्वा ind. Having bound round or encompassed. E. वेष्ट to surround, causal v., क्त्वाच् aff.
वेष्टवंश: वेष्टवंश m. (-शः) A sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.) E. वेष्ट surrounding, and वंश a bambu.
वेष्टित: वेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Surrounded, encompassed, enclosed. 2 Stopped, secured from access. 3 Bound, round, enveloped, wrapped up. n. (-तं) 1 Encompassing, encircling. 2 One of the gestures or attitudes of dancing, particular motion of the  fingers or a crossing of the feet. E. वेष्ट surrounding, इतच् aff. or वेष्ट the verb, and क्त aff.
वेष्य: वेष्य m. (-ष्यः) Water. E. विष to pervade, Uṇādi aff. प.
वेस: वेस (ऋ) वेसृ r. 1st cl. (वेसति) To go, to move.
वेसर: वेसर m. (-रः) A mule; also वेशर.
वेसवार: वेसवार m. (-रः) A condiment, as ground coriander, mustard, pepper, spice, &c. E. विस to send, aff. घञ्, वेस despatching, वॄ to choose, aff. अण्; also वेशवार and वेषवार.
वेह: वेह (ऋ) वेहृ r. 1st cl. (वेहते) To resolve or endeavour diligently; also sometimes read वेहृ.
वेहत्: वेहत् f. (-हत्) A cow miscarrying from taking the bull unseasonably. E. वि before हन् to kill (the embryo), Uṇādi aff. अति; the radical final rejected, and vowel changed.
वेह्ल: वेह्ल r. 1st cl. (वेह्लति) 1 To go. 2 To tremble; also वेल and वेल्ल.
वै: वै (ॐ) ओवै r. 1st cl. (वायति) To dry, to become dried or withered.
वै ind. 1 A particle of affirmation, (so, indeed.) 2 An expletive. A vocative particle. E. वा to go, aff. डै.
वैंशतिक: वैंशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purchased with twenty. E. विंशतिक relating to twenty, अण् aff.
वैकक्ष: वैकक्ष n. (-क्षं) 1 A garland worn over one shoulder and under the other, like the sacrificial thread. 2 An upper garment, a wrapper, a mantle. E. वि implying possessed of or belong to, कक्ष the flank, अण् aff.
वैकक्षक: वैकक्षक n. (-कं) A garland or string of flowers worn as a scarf or like the sacrificial cord, over the left shoulder and under the right arm, hanging down below the hip. E. कन् added to the last; also as derived from वि, and कक्ष with ठक् aff. वैकक्षिक n. (-कं)
वैकङ्कत: वैकङ्कत m. (-तः) A plant, (Flacourtia sapida.) E. अण् pleonasm, added to विकङ्कत.
वैकटिक: वैकटिक m. (-कः) A jeweller. E. विकट difficult (occupation), and ठक् aff.
वैकल्पिक: वैकल्पिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Doubtful, indeterminate. 2 Alternative. E. विकल्प, and ठञ् aff.
वैकल्य: वैकल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Lameness, mutilation. 2 Deficiency, defect. 3 Non-existence. 4 Incompetency, insufficiency. 5 Agitation, flurry. E. विकल defective, ष्यञ् aff.
वैकाल: वैकाल m. (-लः) Evening, afternoon. E. वि gone, काल time, अण् aff.
वैकालिक: वैकालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Occurring in or belonging to the afternoon. E. विकाल, and ठक् aff.; also with खञ्, वैकालीन.
वैकुण्ठ: वैकुण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 INDRA. n. (-ण्ठं) 1 The paradise or world of Vaikuṇṭha or VIṢṆU; its site is variously described, either as in the northern ocean, or on the eastern peak of mount Meru. 2 Talc. E. विकुण्ठा the wife of ŚUBHRA, and mother of VIṢṆU, in one form, अण् patronymic aff.: other etymologies occur, as वि privative, &c. and कुण्ठ said to mean destruction, he who is indestructible; or वि before the same, explained knowledge or abode, being omniscient or omnipresent, &c.; again वि various, and कुण्ठ illusion, aff. अण्.
वैकृत: वैकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Changed, in mind or form. n. (-तं) 1 Aversion, disgust. 2 Change in mind or form. E. विकृत the same, अण् pleonasm.
वैकृतापह: वैकृतापह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Removing or preventing change E. वैकृत, and अपह what takes away.
वैकृत्य: वैकृत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Changed, in form or mind. n. (-त्यं) Aversion, disgust. 2 Change, alteration. E. विकृत the same, ष्यञ् pleonasm.
वैक्रान्त: वैक्रान्त n. (-न्तं) A kind of gem, said to resemble a diamond, and to be of similar properties; it is also considered to be a burnt diamond, and to be the common load-stone or magnet. E. विक्रान्त a warrior, अण् aff.
वैक्लव्य: वैक्लव्य n. (-व्यं) Confusion, bewilderment, commotion. E. विक्लव confused, ष्यञ् aff.
वैखानस: वैखानस m. (-सः) A man of the third religious order, a hermit, an anchoret. f. (-सी) A vessel used for frying meal to be offered in sacrifice. E. वि before खन to dig, deriv. irr.; subsisting on roots, &c.
वैगुण्य: वैगुण्य n. (-ण्यं). 1 Absence of attributes or qualities. 2 Contrariety of properties or qualities. 3 Inferiority, badness, vileness. 4 Fault, defect. E. विगुण void of properties or merit, ष्यञ् aff.
वैचक्षण्य: वैचक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Skill, cleverness, proficiency. E. विचक्षण clever, ष्यञ् aff.
वैचित्य: वैचित्य n. (-त्यं) Confusion of ideas, distraction, grief. E. विचित्ति wandering, ष्यञ् aff.
वैचित्र्य: वैचित्र्य n. (-त्र्यं) 1 Variety. 2 Surprisingness. E. विचित्र astonishing, ष्यञ् aff.
वैजनन: वैजनन n. (-नं) The last month of uterine gestation. E. वि before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्, and अण् added.
वैजयन्त: वैजयन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The palace of INDRA. 2 The banner or emblem of INDRA. f. (-न्ती) 1 A flag, a banner, an ensign. 2 A small tree, (Sesbana Ægyptiaca.) 3 Another tree, (Premna spinosa, &c.) 4 A kind of garland. E. वि before जि to conquer, भृञ् aff.
वैजयन्तिक: वैजयन्तिक m. (-कः) A flag-bearer. f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Sesbana Ægyptiaca.) 2 A flag, a banner. E. वैजयन्ती a flag, with ठक् aff., or कन् pleonasm, fem. form.
वैजयि: वैजयि m. (-यिः) The third Cakravartī or emperor according to the Jainas. E. विजया a proper name, and इञ् patronymic aff.
वैजात्य: वैजात्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Difference or deviation from ordinary character or conduct. 2 Exclusion from caste. 3 Difference of caste or species. 4 Looseness, wantonness. E. वि before जाति species, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
वैजिक: वैजिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Seminal, relating to seed or origin. n. (-कं) 1 Cause, origin, motive. 2 Oil prepared from the Śigru or Morunga. 3 The spiritual cause of existence, soul, spirit. m. (-कः) A young shoot or sprout. E. वीज seed, ठञ् aff.
वैज्ञानिक: वैज्ञानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Skilful, clever, dexterous, proficient. E. विज्ञान knowledge, science, aff. ठक्.
वैडालव्रतिक: वैडालव्रतिक m. (-कः) A hypocrite, a religious impostor, one who under the appearance of piety and virtue is covetous, malicious, and cruel. E. विडाल a cat, व्रत observance, and ठक् aff.; acting like a cat.
वैण: वैण m. (-णः) A cutter of bambus, a worker in bambu work. E. वेणु a bambu, अण् aff., and the primitive final rejected.
वैणव: वैणव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Produced by or made of a bambu. m. (-वः) 1 A bambu staff in general. 2 A worker in bambu or wickerwork. E. वेणु a bambu, and अण् aff.
वैणविक: वैणविक m. (-कः) A player on a flute. E. वेणु a pipe, ठक् aff.
वैणिक: वैणिक m. (-कः) A lutist, a player on the Vīṇā or Indian lute. E. वीणा the Vīṇā, and ठक् aff.
वैणुक: वैणुक n. (-कं) A goad or bambu pike headed with iron, used to drive an elephant. m. (-कः) A player on a pipe or flute. E. वेणु a flute, कञ् aff.
वैणुकेय: वैणुकेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Relating or belonging to a bambu, &c. E. वेणु a bambu, and छण् aff., with कुक् augment.
वैण्य: वैण्य m. (-ण्यः) A name of PṚTHU, the fifth sovereign of the solar race. E. वेण the father of this monarch, and यञ् aff.; also read वैन्य.
वैतंसिक: वैतंसिक m. (-कः) A vender of the flesh or meat, either of beasts or birds. E. वीतंस a snare or net, and ठक् aff.
वैतनिक: वैतनिक m. (-कः) 1 A hireling, a labourer. 2 A stipendiary. E. वेतन wages, hire, ठञ् aff.
वैतरणि: वैतरणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 The river of hell. 2 The mother of the Rākṣasas. E. वि various, तरण crossing, aff. इञ् or अण्, and ङीष् aff., or वि prohibitive, तरणी crossing; or वितरण giving, (liberality in life securing a passage;) or again, वि priv. तरणी a boat, passed without a boat; the affix is the same.
वैतस: वैतस m. (-सः) A sort of cane, (Calamus fasciculatus.) E. वेतस the Ratan, अण् pleonasm.
वैतान: वैतान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Sacrificial, sacred, (as fire.) n. (-नं) Oblation with fire. E. वितान the hole in the hearth in which sacred fire is kept, and अण् aff.
वैतानिक: वैतानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, sacred, (as fire.) n. (-कं) Burnt-offering, especially of clarified butter, as presented daily by the Brahmans. E. वितान the hearth, ठक् aff.
वैतानोपासना: वैतानोपासना f. (-ना) The regular presentation of burnt-offering morning and evening. E. वैतान sacrificial, (fire,) and उपासना service.
वैतालिक: वैतालिक m. (-कः) 1 A bard whose duty it is to awaken a chief or prince at dawn with music and song. 2 A singer out of tune(?) 3 One who has a demon for a familiar, the servant of a Vetāla. E. वि privative, &c. ताल tune, अण् aff., and ठक् added.
वैतालीय: वैतालीय m. (-यः) A kind of metre, or tetrastich, the first and third lines of which contain the time of fourteen short syllables, and the second and fourth of sixteen; it admits of some varieties.
वैत्रक: वैत्रक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Cany, reedy, relating to a cane, &c. E. वेत्र a cane, छण aff., with कुक augment, and the final of the aff. rejected.
वैत्रकीय: वैत्रकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a stick or cane. E. वेत्र a stick, and छण aff.
वैद: वैद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Relating to or connected with a wise man, learned, knowing. E. विट् who knows, अञ् aff.
वैदग्ध: वैदग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 1 Cleverness, skill, dexterity. 2 Acuteness, sharpness. 3 Craft, cunning. E. विदग्ध clever, अण् aff.
वैदग्ध्य: वैदग्ध्य n. (-ग्ध्यं-ग्धी) 1 Cunning, craft. 2 Cleverness, dexterity, skill. 3 Knowingness, sharpness, wit. E. विदग्घ clever, sharp, aff. ष्यञ्.
वैदर्भ: वैदर्भ n. (-र्भं) Crafty or indirect speech. m. (-र्भः) 1 The sovereign of VIDARBHĀ, the father of DAMAYANTĪ, &c. 2 Gum boil. f. (-र्भी) 1 The law of VIDARBHĀ, as one by which cousins german were allowed to intermarry in that country, &c. 2 The wife of AGASTYA. 3 DAMAYANTĪ, the wife of NALA. 4 RUKMIṆĪ, one of KṚṢṆA'S wives. E. विदर्भा the country so named, and अण् aff. of derivation or production.
वैदल: वैदल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wicker, of cane, wicker or basket work. n. (-लं) 1 A shallow cup or saucer made of clay usually, though sometimes of metal, and sometimes of wood or wicker. 2 Any seat or vessel of basket or wicker work. m. (-लः) 1 A flat unleavened cake, made of flower, &c. with cumin or coriander seeds, and fried in Ghee. 2 Any leguminous vegetable or grain, as peas, beans, &c. E. वि before दल to divide, aff. अच्, and अण् added.
वैदिक: वैदिक mfn. (-कः-की or का-कं) Scriptural, derived from or conformable to the Vedas. m. (-कः) A Brahman well versed in the Vedas. E. वेद, and ठञ् or ङीप् aff.
वैदिकत्व: वैदिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Scriptural character or origin. E. वैदिक relating to the Vedas, and त्व aff. of the abstract.
वैदुष्य: वैदुष्य nf. (-ष्यं-षी) Learning, sapience. E. विदूस् a learned man, ष्यञ् aff.
वैदूर्य: वैदूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A gem of a dark colour, the lapis lazuli. E. विदूर said to be the name of a mountain where the stone is found, or a city where it is polished, and ञ्य aff.
वैदूर्य्य: वैदूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A gem of a dark colour, the lapis lazuli. E. विदूर said to be the name of a mountain where the stone is found, or a city where it is polished, and ञ्य aff.
वैदेशिक: वैदेशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Foreign, stranger. E. विदेश, and ठक् aff.
वैदेह: वैदेह m. (-हः) 1 A trader by caste, or profession. 2 An attendant on the women's apartments: see the next. f. (-ही) 1 SĪTĀ, the daughter of JANAKA. 2 Long-pepper. 3 The wife of a trader or woman of the Vaideha caste. 4 A sort of pigment, commonly Rocanā. E. विदेह the country, अण् aff. of origin or production, &c.: see the next.
वैदेहक: वैदेहक m. (-कः) 1 A trader by profession. 2 A man of a mixed caste, the offspring of a Vaiśya father and Brahman mother, whose business is attendance in the women's apartments. E. विदेह the country, वुञ् aff., or वि various, दिह to collect, (goods, &c.), aff. ण्वुल् and अण् added; or विदेह a king, the supposed author of rules for merchants, वुञ् aff. or with अण् aff. and ठक् added वैदहिक.
वैद्य: वैद्य mfn. (-द्यः-दी-द्यं) 1 Medical, practising or relating to medicine. 2 Relating or conformable to the Vedas. m. (-द्यः) 1 A physician. 2 A tree, (Justicia ganderussa, &c.) 3 A learned man. 4 A follower of the Vedas, or one well read in them. f. (-द्या) A drug, commonly Kākoli. E. वेद the medical or Āyur Vedas, or the Vedas in general, and यञ् or ष्यञ् aff.
वैद्यनाथ: वैद्यनाथ m. (-थः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of DHANVANTARI. E. वैद्य a physician, and नाथ lord.
वैद्यबन्धु: वैद्यबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) Cassia fistula. E. वैद्य a physician, बन्धु the friend.
वैद्यमातृ: वैद्यमातृ f. (-ता) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वैद्य a physician, and मातृ mother.
वैद्यसिंही: वैद्यसिंही f. (-ही) A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.) E. वैद्य medical, and सिंह pre-eminent, fem. aff. ङीष्.
वैध: वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) According to rule, preceptive, ritual. E. विधि, and अण् aff.
वैधव्य: वैधव्य n. (-व्यं) Widowhood. E. विधवा, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैधर्म्म्य: वैधर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्म्यं) 1 Irreligion, injustice, impropriety. 2 Difference of duty or obligation. E. वि before धर्म्म virtue, &c., ष्यञ् aff.
वैधात्र: वैधात्र m. (-त्रः) SANATKUMĀRA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and eldest of the progenitors of mankind. E. विधातृ BRAHMĀ, and अण् aff. of descent; it is applicable also to the other three sons of the same deity.
वैधिक: वैधिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ritual, preceptive, according to rule, &c. E. विधि, ठक् aff.
वैधेय: वैधेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Foolish, ignorant, an idiot, a fool. E. विधेय performance of religious ceremonials, अण् aff.
वैध्यत: वैध्यत m. (-तः) YAMA'S porter or chamberlain.
वैनतक: वैनतक n. (-कं) A vessel for holding or pouring ghee, used at sacrifices with fire.
वैनतेय: वैनतेय m. (-यः) A name of GARUḌA. E. विनता the mother of this being, and ढक् aff.
वैनयिक: वैनयिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to morals or behaviour. 2 Enforcing proper conduct. 3 Magisterial. E. विनय, and ठक् aff. m. (-कः) A chariot used formerly in battle, a war carriage. E. वि before णी to get, अण् aff., and ठक् added.
वैनायिक: वैनायिक m. (-कः) A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha. E. विनायक a Buddha or teacher of this sect, ठक् aff.
वैनाशिक: वैनाशिक m. (-कः) 1 A dependant, a subject, a slave. 2 A spider. 3 An astrologer. E. विनाश loss, destruction, aff. ठञ्.
वैनीतक: वैनीतक mn. (-कः-कं) A mediate conveyance, as a porter carrying a letter, a horse dragging a chariot, &c. E. वि variously, णी to take, aff. क्त, with कन् and अण् added.
वैपरीत्य: वैपरीत्य n. (-त्यं) Contrariety, opposition, reverse. E. विपरीत contrary, aff. ष्यञ्.
वैबोधिक: वैबोधिक m. (-कः) A watchman, a bell man, one who announces the hours. E. विबोध awakening, ठक् aff.
वैभव: वैभव n. (-वं) Grandeur, wealth. E. विभव, and अण् added.
वैभाजित्र: वैभाजित्र n. (-त्रं) Apportioning, dividing. E. विभाजयितृ one who makes a division or causes it to be made, अञ् aff., and the semivowel rejected.
वैभ्र: वैभ्र n. (-भ्रं) The heaven of VIṢṆU. E. वि variously, भ्राज् to shine, ड aff., and अण् added.
वैभ्राज: वैभ्राज n. (-जं) A garden of the gods, a celestial grove or garden. E. वि variously, भ्राज to shine, aff. अच्, and अण् added.
वैमात्र: वैमात्र m. (-त्रः) A step-mother's son. f. (-त्री) A step-mother's daughter. E. वि different, मातृ a mother, and अण् aff.
वैमात्रेय: वैमात्रेय m. (-यः) A step-mother's son. f. (-यी) A half sister, or one by a different mother. E. विमातृ a step-mother, and ढक् aff.
वैमानिक: वैमानिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a heavenly car, borne in one, &c. E. विमान, and ठक् aff.
वैमुक्त: वैमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Liberated, emancipated, being at liberty or loose. n. (-क्तं) Liberation. E. विमुक्त free, loose, and अण् aff. implying property or possession.
वैमुख्य: वैमुख्य n. (-ख्यं) 1 Turning away the face. 2 Flight, retreat. E. विमुख, and ख्यञ् aff.
वैमेय: वैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. वि before मेङ् to barter, यत् aff., and अण् added.
वैयर्थ्य: वैयर्थ्य n. (-र्थ्यं) Unprofitableness, uselessness. E. व्यर्थ useless, ष्यञ् aff.
वैयाकरण: वैयाकरण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Grammatical, relating to grammar. m. (-णः) A grammarian. E. व्याकरण grammar, and अण् aff.
वैयाघ्र: वैयाघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्री-घ्रं) Covered with a tiger-skin, (a car, &c.) E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and अञ् aff.
वैयात्य: वैयात्य n. (-त्यं) Immodesty, boldness. E. वियात, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैयुष्ट: वैयुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं) Early, betimes, occurring or performed in the morning. E. व्युष्ट morning, and अण् aff.
वैर: वैर n. (-रं) 1 Enmity, hostility. 2 Heroism, prowess. E. वीर a warrior, aff. अण्.
वैरकर: वैरकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Causing or occasioning enmity, mischief-making. E. वैर, and कर who or what makes.
वैरकार: वैरकार m. (-रः) An enemy. E. वैर, and कार who makes.
वैरक्त्य: वैरक्त्य n. (-क्त्य) Aversion, displeasure, dislike. E. विरक्त, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैरङ्गिक: वैरङ्गिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued passion or desire. E. वि privative, रङ्ग passion, aff. ठक् or ठञ्.
वैरनिर्यातन: वैरनिर्य्यातन n. (-नं) Revenge, retaliation, requital of an injury. E. वैर enmity, निर्य्यातन donation, return.
वैरनिर्य्यातन: वैरनिर्य्यातन n. (-नं) Revenge, retaliation, requital of an injury. E. वैर enmity, निर्य्यातन donation, return.
वैरप्रतिक्रिया: वैरप्रतिक्रिया f. (-या) Revenge. E. वैर enmity, प्रतिक्रिया return.
वैरशुद्धि: वैरशुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Revenge, retaliation. E. वैर enmity, शुद्धि purification.
वैराग: वैराग n. (-गं) Absence of worldly passion or desire. E. वि privative, राग passion, अण् aff. or with ष्यञ् aff. वैराग्य.
वैरागिक: वैरागिक m. (-कः) An ascetic, one with subdued passions. E. वि privative, राग passion, ठञ् aff.
वैरागिन्: वैरागिन् m. (-गी) An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued his worldly desires: at present the term in common use is applied to a particular class of religious mendicants. E. वैराग absence of passion, aff. इनि.
वैराग्य: वैराग्य n. (-ग्यं) Subjection of the appetite and passions, absence of worldly desires. E. विराग, and ष्यञ् aff.: see वैराग.
वैराट: वैराट m. (-टः) An earth worm. E. वि before राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्, and अण् added.
वैराट्या: वैराट्या f. (-ट्या) One of the sixteen goddesses of the Bauddhas, termed Vidyādevīs or goddesses of learning.
वैरानुवन्धिन्: वैरानुवन्धिन् m. (-न्धी) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The solar ray which is charged with heat. E. वैर heroism or strength, अनुवन्धिन् connected with.
वैरायमाण: वैरायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hostile, inimical, an enemy. E. वैर enmity used as a verb, with क्यङ् and शानच् affs.
वैरारोह: वैरारोह m. (-हः) Desperate or arduous combat. E. वैर enmity or heroism, आरोह ascending.
वैरिता: वैरिता (-ता) 1 Enmity. 2 Heroism. E. वैरिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वैरित्वं.
वैरिन्: वैरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Hostile, inimical. m. (-री) 1 An enemy. 2 A hero. E. वैर enmity, इनि aff.
वैरूप्य: वैरूप्य n. (-प्यं) 1 Deformity. 2 Difference of form, &c. E. विरुप, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैरोचन: वैरोचन m. (-नः) 1 The third of the Buddhas, called Dhyāni Buddhas. 2 BALI, the sovereign so named. 3 The son of AGNI. 4 The son of SŪRYA, or the sun. 5 A Siddha, a sort of demi-god  or deified mortal. E. विरोचन the sun, &c., and aff. of descent अण्.
वैरोचननिकेतन: वैरोचननिकेतन n. (-नं) Pātāla the intermediate region between the earth and Tartarus or Naraka, over part of which BALI presides. E. वैरोचन the prince BALI, and निकेतन abode; the sovereign of this name being an incarnate Daitya or hereditary foe of the gods, and being invested with a sovereignty in the lower regions after his humiliation by VIṢṆU.
वैरोचनि: वैरोचनि m. (-निः) 1 A BUDDHA. 2 BALI. 3 The son of SŪRYA. E. विरीचन the sun, &c., and इञ aff. of descent.
वैरोचि: वैरोचि m. (-चिः) The demon or Daitya VĀṆA.
वैरोद्धार: वैरोद्धार n. (-रं) Revenge, retaliation. E. वैर enmity, and उद्धार a debt.
वैलक्ष्य: वैलक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 Contrariety, reverse, inversion. 2 Contrary course or conduct to that which is usual or natural. 3 Absence of any characteristic. E. विलक्ष, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैलक्षण्य: वैलक्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) Difference, contrariety. E. विलक्षण, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैल्व: वैल्व mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वी-ल्वं) Relating or belonging to the Vilva tree. n. (-ल्वं) The fruit of the Vilva, (Ægle marmelos.) E. विल्व the plant, अण् aff.
वैल्वमय: वैल्वमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of the Vilva, of the wood, &c. of that plant. E. वैल्व relating to the Bel, and मयट् aff.
वैवधिक: वैवधिक m. (-कः) A chandler, a vender of grain, oil, ghee, fruit, sweetmeats, &c. E. विवध storing grain, &c., aff. ठक्.
वैवर्ण्य: वैवर्ण्य n. (-र्ण्यं) 1 Change of colour or complexion. 2 Change of colour in general. 3 Deviation or secession from tribe or caste, &c. 4 Heterogeneousness, difference. E. वि privative or contra-indicative, and वर्ण colour, tribe, &c., aff. ष्यञ्.
वैवस्वत: वैवस्वत m. (-तः) 1 YAMA. 2 One of the RUDRAS. 3 The seventh MANU, or the MANU of the present period. 4 The planet Saturn. E. विवस्वत् the sun, अण् aff.
वैवाहिक: वैवाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Nuptial, matrimonial, relating to marriage. E. विवाह marriage, ठक् aff. of reference or relation.
वैशद्य: वैशद्य n. (-द्यं) 1 Whiteness. 2 Cleanness, purity. E. विशद white, &c., and ष्यञ् aff.
वैशम्पायन: वैशम्पायन m. (-नः) A sage, the original teacher of the Yajur Veda, and narrator of the Mahābhārata to JANAMEJAYA.
वैशस्त्र: वैशस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 Government. sway, rule. 2 The state of being disarmed or defenceless. E. विशस्तृ ruling, अञ् aff., and the pen. vowel changed, or वि privative, शस्र a weapon, and अण् aff.
वैशाख: वैशाख m. (-खः) 1 The month in which the moon is full near the southern scale, (April-May,) the first month in the Hindu calendar. 2 A churning stick. n. (-खं) An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart. f. (-खी) The day of full moon in the month Vaiśākha. E. विशाखा the constellation in which the moon is full this month, अण् aff. or विशाखा said to mean here, pervading, revolving, अण् aff.
वैशिक: वैशिक n. (-कं) Harlotry, allurement of harlots. E. वेश्या, and ठक् aff.
वैशेषिक: वैशेषिक m. (-कः) A follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine. n. (-कं) The Vaiśeṣika doctrine, or branch of the Nyāya or logical school of philosophy, instituted by KAṆĀDA. E. विशष difference, (from the original Nyāya of GAUTAMA,) ठञ् aff.
वैशिष्टा: वैशिष्टा n. (-ष्ट्यं) 1 Endowment with, possession of. 2 Distinction. E. विशिष्ट, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैशेष्य: वैशेष्य n. (-ष्यं) 1 Specific or generic distinction. 2 Superiority, pre-eminence. E. विशेष, and ष्यञ् aff.
वैश्य: वैश्य m. (-श्यः) The Vaiśya, or man of the third or agricultural and mercantile tribe. f. (-श्या) A woman of the Vaiśya caste. E. विश to enter, (fields, &c.) क्विप् aff., and यञ pleonasm added.
वैश्यक्रिया: वैश्यक्रिया f. (-या) 1 Trade, agriculture. E. वैश्य, and क्रिया act, business; also वैश्यकर्म्म, &c.
वैश्यवृत्ति: वैश्यवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Agriculture or trade. E. वैश्य, and वृत्ति subsistence.
वैश्रवण: वैश्रवण m. (-णः) KUVERA, the god of wealth. E. विश्रवस् the father of the deity, aff. अण्, and the form irr.
वैश्रवणालय: वैश्रवणालय m. (-यः) The Indian fig tree. E. वैश्रवण KUVERA, and आलय abode.
वैश्रवणावास: वैश्रवणावास m. (-सः) The Indian fig tree. E. वैश्रवण KUVERA, and आवास abode.
वैश्रवणोदय: वैश्रवणोदय m. (-यः) The Indian fig tree. E. वैश्रवण KUVERA, and उदय prosperity.
वैश्वदेव: वैश्वदेव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Sacred or dedicated to the Viśvadevas. offered to them, relating to them, &c. 2 Relating to all divinities. n. (-वं) Offering to all the divinities. f. (-वी) Species of the Paṅkti metre. E. विश्वदेव, and अण् aff.
वैश्वदेवकर्मन्: वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) Oblation or offering to the deities collectively. E. वैश्वदेव, and कर्म्मन् act.
वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन्: वैश्वदेवकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्मा) Oblation or offering to the deities collectively. E. वैश्वदेव, and कर्म्मन् act.
वैश्वदेवहोम: वैश्वदेवहोम n. (-मं) Oblation to the Viśvadevas. E. वैश्वदेव, and होम burnt-offering.
वैश्वानर: वैश्वानर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Relating to, fit for, &c. all men. m. (-रः) AGNI or fire. f. (-री) A particular sacrifice to be performed at the beginning of every year. E. विश्वानर a Muni, or विश्व all, नर mankind, and अण् aff. of descent.
वैश्वी: वैश्वी f. (-श्वी) The second of the constellations called Āṣārhā, and twenty-first of the whole. E. विश्व a Viśvadeva, अण् and ङीष् aff.; those deities presiding over the asterism.
वैषम्य: वैषम्य n. (-म्यं) 1 Inequality, unevenness. 2 Solitariness, singleness. 3 Difficult. E. विषम odd, uneven, &c., aff. ष्यञ्.
वैषयिक: वैषयिक m. (-कः) 1 A sensualist, one addicted to the pleasures of sense. 3 One occupied with worldly objects or interests. E. विषय an object of sense, and ठञ् aff.
वैष्टुत: वैष्टुत n. (-तं) The ashes of a burnt-offering. E. वि before स्तु to praise, aff. क्त, and अण् added.
वैष्ट्र: वैष्ट्र n. (-ष्ट्रं) A world. E. विश to enter, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
वैष्णव: वैष्णव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating or belonging to VIṢṆU. m. (-वः) A follower of VIṢṆU. f. (-वी) 1 One of the Mātṛs, the personified energy or Śakti of VIṢṆU. 2 A name of DURGĀ. 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) 4 Sacred basil, (Ocymum sanctum.) E. विष्णु VIṢṆU, अण् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
वैसारिन: वैसारिन m. (-नः) A fish. E. वि before सृ to go, णिनि aff., and अण् added.
वैसूचन: वैसूचन n. (-नं) A man's assuming female attire, (in the drama.) E. वि before सूच to make known, क्युच् aff., and अण added.
वैहासिक: वैहासिक m. (-कः) A comic actor, a buffoon, an actor. E. वि before हास laughter, mirth, aff. ठञ्.
वोटा: वोटा f. (-टा) A female servant or slave. E. पुट to contract, aff. अच्, and व being substituted for प, perhaps more correctly वोटा.
वोड्र: वोड्र m. (-ड्रः) 1 A large snake, (Bor or Boa Constrictor.) 2 A sort of fish. f. (-ड्री) The fourth part of a Paṇa.
वोढव्य: वोढव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be borne or carried. 2 Able to bear or carry. E. वह to bear, तव्यर् aff., form irr.
वोढु: वोढु m. (-ढुः) The son of a woman living in her father's house, and whose husband is absent. E. वह to bear, उ aff., form irr.
वोढृ: वोढृ m. (-ढा) 1 A bridegroom. 2 A porter, a bearer. 3 A charioteer. 4 A bull. 5 A guide, a leader. E. वह to bear, aff. तृच्, ह changed to ढ, and ओ substituted for the vowel.
वोण्ट: वोण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A stalk, a stem.
वोदाल: वोदाल m. (-लः) A sheat fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.)
वोर: वोर m. (-रः) A sort of pulse, (Dolichos catjang.) E. Apparently not a Sanscrit word, though occurring in regular compounds.
वोरक: वोरक m. (-कः) A scribe, a writer. E. see वोलक.
वोरट: वोरट m. (-टः) A sort of jasmine.
वोरपट्टी: वोरपट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of mat or mattress for sleeping on. E. वोर Dolichos catjang, and पट्टी coarse cloth; perhaps made of the straw.
वोरव: वोरव m. (-वः) A kind of rice, perhaps that called Boro, which is cut in March or April.
वोरुखान: वोरुखान m. (-नः) A horse, described as of a white and red colour.
वोल: वोल m. (-लः) Gum myrrh. E. वा to go, to smell, उलच् aff.
वोलक: वोलक m. (-कः) A scribe. f. (-लिका) A sort of cake or pudding made with flower and sugar. E. वा to go, and उलच् aff., and कन् added; also ल being changed to र, वोरक.
वोल्लह: वोल्लह m. (-हः) A horse, with light mane and tail.
वोहित्थ: वोहित्थ n. (-त्थं) A vessel, a ship.
वौषट्: वौषट् ind An exclamation used on offering an oblation to the gods or manes. E. वह to bear, (what is borne by this,) and डौषट् aff.
व्यंशक: व्यंशक m. (-कः) A mountain. E. वि various, अंश part, कन् added.
व्यंशुक: व्यंशुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Undressed, naked. E. वि priv., and अंशुक a garment.
व्यंसक: व्यंसक m. (-कः) A cheat, a rogue, a juggler. E. वि before अंस to divide, ण्वुल् aff.
व्यंसन: व्यंसन n. (-नं) Cheating, tricking, deceiving. E. वि before अंस to divide, ल्युट् aff.
व्यंसनीय: व्यंसनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be deceived or cheated. E. वि before अंस to divide, अनीयर् aff.; also व्यंसितव्य and व्यंस्य.
व्यंसित: व्यंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Deceived, tricked, cheated. E. वि before अंस to divide, aff. क्त.
व्यक्त: व्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Wise, learned. 2 Evident, manifest, apparent, absolutely and specifically known or understood. 3 Individual, specific. E. वि before अञ्ज to make clear, aff. क्त.
व्यक्तत्व: व्यक्तत्व n. (-त्वं) Distinctness, manifestation. E. त्व added to the last; also व्यक्तता.
व्यक्तदृष्टार्थ: व्यक्तदृष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Perceiving, understanding, present. E. व्यक्त evident, दृष्ट seen, अर्थ meaning or object, (by whom.)
व्यक्तराशि: व्यक्तराशि f. (-शिः) Known or absolute quantity, (in arithmetic) E. व्यक्त, and राशि quantity.
व्यक्तलक्ष्मन्: व्यक्तलक्ष्मन् mfn. (-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मा-क्ष्म) Evident by certain signs or marks, manifested, characterised. E. व्यक्त, and लक्ष्मन् a mark.
व्यक्ति: व्यक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Individuality, specific appearance or being. 2 Appearance, manifestation. 3 Case, inflexion, or the proper form of any inflected word. E. वि before अघ to make clear, aff. क्तिच्.
व्यक्तिता: व्यक्तिता f. (-ता) Individuality. E. तल् added to व्यक्ति; also with त्व, व्यक्तित्वं.
व्यक्तीकरण: व्यक्तीकरण n. (-णं) Making distinct or manifest. E. व्यक्ति, and करण making, च्चि aug.
व्यक्तीकृत: व्यक्तीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made clear or manifest. E. व्यक्ति, and कृत made, च्चि aug.
व्यक्तीभूत: व्यक्तीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distinct, clear. E. व्यक्त, and भूत become, च्चि aug.
व्यक्तोदित: व्यक्तोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Manifested, displayed. 2 Spoken plainly. E. व्यक्त, and उदित risen or said.
व्यग्र: व्यग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) 1 Bewildered, perplexed, distracted. 2 Alarmed, agitated, frightened. 3 Engaged in, zealous, eager. E. वि before अग्र chief, principal.
व्यग्रता: व्यग्रता f. (-ता) 1 Perplexity, anxiety. 2 Zeal. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, व्यग्रत्वं.
व्यङ्ग: व्यङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Deformed, lame. 2 Bodiless. 3 Ill-arranged. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A frog. 2 A cripple. 3 Discoloration of the face, dark spots on the cheek. E. वि depreciative, &c., अङ्ग body.
व्यङ्गार: व्यङ्गार mfn. (-र;-रा-रं) Having no fire alight. E. वि priv., अङ्गार hot coals.
व्यङ्गुल: व्यङ्गुल n. (-लं) The 60th part of a digit or Aṅgula. E. वि, and अङ्गुल a digit.
व्यङ्ग्य: व्यङ्ग्य m. (-ङ्ग्यः) 1 Figurative or poetical speech, elliptical language or that which conveys something more than the simple meaning of the words. 2 Sarcasm, the covert but intelligible expression of suspicion or contempt. E. वि before अञ्च to make clear or manifest, घञ् aff., and यत् added.
व्यच: व्यच r. 6th cl. (व्यचति) To cheat, to trick, to defraud or deceive.
व्यज: व्यज m. (-जः) A fan. E. वि before अज to go, घ aff.
व्यजन: व्यजन n. (-नं) A fan. E. वि before अज to go, aff. ल्युट्.
व्यञ्जक: व्यञ्जक m. (-कः) 1 External indication of passion or feeling. 2 A sign, a mark, a symbol. 3 Figurative or elliptical expression. E. वि before अञ्ज to manifest, aff. ण्वुल्.
व्यञ्जकत्व: व्यञ्जकत्व n. (-त्वं) The nature or existence of figurative or poetical expression. E. व्यञ्जक, and त्व added.
व्यञ्जन: व्यञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 A mark, a spot, a sign, a token. 2 Paraphernalia, insignia. 3 The beard. 4 A privy part, either male or female. 5 Sauce, condiment. 6 A consonant. nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Figurative expression. 2 Irony, sarcasm. E. वि before अञ्ज to make clear or evident, ल्युट् aff.
व्यञ्जनावृत्ति: व्यञ्जनावृत्ति, f. (-त्तिः) Rhetorical or elliptical style. E. व्यञ्जना, and वृत्ति style.
व्यञ्जयत्: व्यञ्जयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Making visible or manifest. E. वि, and अञ्ज to go, शतृ aff.
व्यञ्जित: व्यञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Distinguished, characterised. 2 Manifested, visible. E. वि before अञ्ज to go, क्त aff.
व्यञ्जिजिषु: व्यञ्जिजिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing or trying to expose, detect. make manifest, &c. E. वि before अञ्ज to go, desid. v., उ aff.
व्यडम्बक: व्यडम्बक m. (-कः) The castor oil plant, (Ricinus communis.) E. वि before अड to strive, aff. अच्, व्यड here said to mean excretion, अवि to go, to cause, ण्वुल् aff.; form irr.; also with युच् aff. व्यडम्बन m. (-नः) and by another reading, व्यडम्बर; other etymologies are given.
व्यतिकर: व्यतिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Reciprocal, acting on or with one another. 2 Pervading, who or what spreads through or over 3 Contiguous to, in contact with. m. (-रः) 1 Misfortune, calamity. 2 Reciprocity, reciprocal action or relation. 3 Reverse. 4 Contact, contiguity. E. वि and अति before कृ to make, to do, aff. अप्.
व्यतिक्रम: व्यतिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Inverted or retrograde order, inversion, reverse. 2 Contrariety, opposition in general; as the contrary of what is right or wrong, crime, vice; the contrary of prosperity, adversity, misfortune, &c. 3 Retraction, non-performance, (as of contracts.) 4 Passing over or beyond. E. वि and अति before क्रम to go, aff. अच्.
व्यतिक्रान्त: व्यतिक्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Reversed, inverted. 2 Retracted. 3 Passed over. E. वि and अति before क्रम to go, क्त aff.
व्यतिरिक्त: व्यतिरिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Different, distinct. 2 Excepted. 3 Withdrawn, withheld. E. वि and अति before रिच to unite, aff. क्त.
व्यतिरेक: व्यतिरेक m. (-कः) 1 Difference, separateness. 2 A figure in rhetoric, the dissimilitude of things compared in some respects to each other. 3 Exception, exclusion. E. वि and अति before रिच to unite, aff. घञ्.
व्यतिरेकव्याप्ति: व्यतिरेकव्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Comprehensive argument derived from negatives or non-existence. E. व्यतिरेक, and व्याप्ति pervading.
व्यतिरेकिन्: व्यतिरेकिन् mfn. (-की-किणी-कि) 1 Different, reverse. 2 Excepting. distinguishing. E. व्यतिरेक, and इनि aff.
व्यतिरेक्युदाहरण: व्यतिरेक्युदाहरण n. (-णं) Illustration by contrast or negatives. E. व्यतिरेकिन्, and उदाहरण example.
व्यतिषक्त: व्यतिषक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Mutually connected, joined, related, &c. E. वि and अति before षञ्ज to embrace, aff. क्त.
व्यतिषङ्ग: व्यतिषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Mutual or reciprocal junction or relation. 2 Fastening, tying together. E. वि and अति before षञ्ज to embrace, and ड aff.
व्यतिषङ्गवत्: व्यतिषङ्गवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Connected, united, mixed. E. व्यतिषङ्ग, and मतुप् aff.
व्यतिहार: व्यतिहार m. (-रः) 1 Barter, exchange. 2 Exchange of blows or abuse. E. वि and अति before हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also व्यतीहार.
व्यतीत: व्यतीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Past, gone. E. वि before अतीत the same.
व्यतीपात: व्यतीपात m. (-तः) 1 Great and portentous calamity, or a portent, indicating or occasioning it and therefore identified with it, as a comet, an earthquake, &c. 2 Disrespect, contempt. 3 The seventeenth of the astrological Yogas. 4 Day of new moon when it falls on a Sunday, and the moon is in certain mansions, Śravaṇā, &c. E. वि and अति before पत to fall, &c., aff. घञ.
व्यतीहार: व्यतीहार m. (-रः) 1 Barter, exchange. 2 Exchange of blows or abuse. E. वि, and अति implying reciprocity, हृ to take, aff. घञ्, and इ optionally long.
व्यत्यय: व्यत्यय m. (-यः) 1 Contrariety, opposition, reverse. 2 Inverted or retrograde order. E. वि, and अति before इ to go, aff. अच्.
व्यत्यस्त: व्यत्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Reversed, inverted, contrary, opposite. E. वि, and अति before अस to throw, क्त aff.
व्यत्यास: व्यत्यास m. (-सः) 1 Contrariety, opposition, reverse. 2 Inverted or retrograde order. 3 Reversed position. E. वि, and अति before अस to throw or send, aff. ष.
व्यथ: व्यथ r. 1st cl. (व्यथते) 1 To fear. 2 To be disquieted or unhappy. 3 To suffer pain.
व्यथक: व्यथक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Inflicting pain, torturing, painful. 2 Distressing, afflicting. E. व्यथ to give pain, क्वुन् aff.
व्यथन: व्यथन n. (-नं) Giving pain, paining. E. व्यथ to pain, ल्युट् aff.
व्यथनीय: व्यथनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be put to pain, what may be or ought to be pained. E. व्यथ, and अनीयर् aff.; also व्यथ्य and व्यथितव्य.
व्यथयत्: व्यथयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Paining, distressing. E. व्यथ to pain, शतृ aff.
व्यथा: व्यथा f. (-था) 1 Pain. 2 Distress. 3 Alarm, fear. E. व्यथ to fear, to suffer pain, &c., aff. अङ् and टाप्.
व्यथाकर: व्यथाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Painful, excruciating. E. व्यथा, and कर what makes.
व्यथारहित: व्यथारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from pain. E. व्यथा, and रहित quitted.
व्यथित: व्यथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pained, tortured. 2 Distressed, afflicted. 3 Disturbed, troubled. 4 Alarmed, frightened. E. व्यथा pain, इतच् aff.
व्यथ्यमान: व्यथ्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being agitated, distressed, pained, &c. E. व्यथ to suffer pain, pass. v., शानच् aff.
व्यध: व्यध r. 4th cl. (औ) औव्यध (विध्यति) To beat, to strike, to pierce, to tear, to hurt or wound.
व्यघ: व्यघ m. (-घः) 1 Perforating, piercing. 2 Striking, smiting. E. व्यघ to strike, to hurt, aff. अप्.
व्यघन: व्यघन n. (-नं) Piercing, perforating. E. व्यघ to pierce, ल्युट् aff.
व्यध्य: व्यध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be pierced or wounded. m. (-ध्यः) A butt, a mark to shoot at. E. व्यध to pierce, aff. यत्.
व्यध्व: व्यध्व m. (-ध्वः) A bad road. E. वि depreciative, अध्वन् a road, अच् aff.
व्यनुनाद: व्यनुनाद m. (-दः) Reverberation, loud and extending sound or noise. E. वि, and अनु before नद to sound, घञ् aff.
व्यनुनादयत्: व्यनुनादयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Causing to reverberate, filling with sound or noise. E. वि, and अनु before नद to sound, causal v., शतृ aff.
व्यप: व्यप r. 10th cl. (व्यापयति) To diminish, to lessen, to decay.
व्यपगत: व्यपगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, gone away. E. वि, and अप before गम to go, क्त aff.
व्यपगम: व्यपगम m. (-मः) Going away, departure. E. वि, and अप before गम to go, अच् aff.
व्यपत्रपमाण: व्यपत्रपमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Ashamed. E. वि, and अपत्रप to be shameless, शानच् aff.
व्यपदिष्ट: व्यपदिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Named. 2 Informed. 3 Tricked. 4 Pleaded in excuse. E. वि and अप before दिश to show, क्त aff.
व्यपदेश: व्यपदेश m. (-शः) 1 Dishonesty, fraud, craft. 2 Stratagem, device. 3 Name, appellation. 4 Information, notice, apprising. 5 Hint. 6 Excuse, pretext. E. वि and अप before दिश to show, aff. धञ्.
व्यपदेष्टृ: व्यपदेष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्ट) 1 Deceiving, a cheat. 2 One who shows, names, &c. E. वि and अप before दिश to show, तृच् aff.
व्यपनीत: व्यपनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taken away, removed. E. वि and अप before नीत taken.
व्यपरोपण: व्यपरोपण n. (-णं) Extirpating, expelling. E. वि and अप before रुह to grow, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
व्यपरोपित: व्यपरोपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Extirpated, eradicated, expelled. E. वि and अप before रुह to grow, causal v., क्त aff.
व्यपाकृति: व्यपाकृति f. (-तिः) Repelling, denial. E. वि, and अप implying opposition, and आङ् before कृ to make, aff. क्तिन्.
व्यपाश्रय: व्यपाश्रय m. (-यः) 1 Taking refuge with, relying upon, trusting to. 2 Expectation. E. वि, अप and आङ् before श्री to serve, aff. अच्
व्यपाश्रित: व्यपाश्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having taken refuge with, relying upon, trusting to, who or what does so. E. वि, अप and आङ् before श्री to serve, aff. क्त.
व्यपाश्रित्य: व्यपाश्रित्य ind. Having sought or taken refuge with. E. वि, अप, and आङ् before श्री to serve, ल्यप् aff.
व्यपेक्ष: व्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Expectant, waiting, attentive. E. वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, अच् aff.
व्यपेक्षण: व्यपेक्षण n. (-णं) Expecting, looking for. E. वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.
व्यपेक्षणीय: व्यपेक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be expected or looked for. E. वि and अप before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.; also व्यपेक्ष्य and व्यपक्षितव्य.
व्यपेक्षा: व्यपेक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Expectation, especially if reciprocal. 2 Mutual connexion or relation. 3 Application, use. 4 (In grammar,) the mutual application of two rules. E. वि severally, अपेक्षा looking to.
व्यपेक्षित: व्यपेक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Looked to reciprocally. 2 Mutually related. 3 Employed, applied. E. वि, and अपेक्षित expected.
व्यपेत: व्यपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone, passed away, got rid of. 2 Opposed, contrary. E. वि and अप before इ to go, क्त aff.
व्यपोढ: व्यपोढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Opposite, contrary, reverse. 2 Driven off or away. E. वि and अप before वह to bear, क्त aff.
व्यपोह्य: व्यपोह्य ind. 1 Having driven away, got rid of. 2 Having passed through a place. E. वि, and अप before वह to convey, ण्यत् aff.
व्यभिचार: व्यभिचार m. (-रः) 1 Following improper courses, doing what is prohibited or wicked. 2 Erring, straying, (literally or figuratively.) 3 Wandering from an argument. E. वि and अभि before चर to go, aff. घञ्.
व्यभिचारिन्: व्यभिचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Following or doing what is im- proper. 2 Going astray, (literally or figuratively.) n. (-रि) A property, or class of properties into which feelings and emotions, as objects of poetical description, are classed: the Bhāvas called Vyabhicāris are thirty-two in number, to which two others are sometimes added, making thirty-four, viz. 1 Nirveda, humility, self-abasement; 2 Glāni, weakness, exhaustion; 3 Śaṅkā, apprehension; 4 Asūyā, calumny; 5 Mada, inebriety; 6 Śrama, fatigue; 7 Ālasya, indolence; 8 Dainya, indigence, distress; 9 Cintā, secret desire, contemplation of the object beloved; 10 Moha, loss of sense or presence of mind from fear, anxiety, &c.; 11 Smṛti, recollection, but especially the recollection of an absent or faithless lover excited by present objects; 12 Dhṛti, the enjoyment or consciousness of amatory woe, resignation or abandonment to despair, &c.; 13 Vrīḍā, shame; 14 Capalatā, fickleness, unsteadiness, want of firmness and steadiness; 15 Harṣa, delight; 16 Avega, hurry, flurried haste; 17 Jaraṭha, ignorance, imbecility; 18 Garva, pride, arrogance; 19 Viṣāda, want of energy or spirits, depression of mind; 20 Autsukya, regret, painful remembrance of some object lost or absent; 21 Nidrā, sluggishness, sleepiness; 22 Apasmāra, epilepsy; 23 Supta, sleep; 24 Vibodha, waking; 25 Amarṣa, wrathful impatience; 26 Avahittha, dissimulation; 27 Ugratā, passion, rage; 28 Mati, intelligence, knowledge; 29 Upālambha, reviling, railing; 20 Vyādhi, sickness, disease; 21 Unmada, madness, delirium; 22 Maraṇa, death; the other two are, 23 Trāsa, fear; 24 Vitarka, doubt, deliberation. f. (-रिणी) A wanton woman, an unchaste wife. E. वि and अभि before चर to go, aff. णिनि.
व्यभ्र: व्यभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) Unclouded. E. वि priv., अभ्र a cloud.
व्यय: व्यय r. 1st cl. (व्ययति) 2 To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (व्यययति) 1 To lessen, to diminish. 2 To send. r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्ययते व्यययति) To expend, to disburse, to abandon wealth, to give away money, &c.
व्यय m. (-यः) 1 Expenditure, spending. 2 Destruction, disappearance. 3 Misfortune, downfall, decline. E. व्यय to expend, &c., aff. अच्.
व्ययन: व्ययन n. (-नं) 1 Spending. 2 Destroying. E. व्यय, and ल्युट् aff.
व्ययमान: व्ययमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Spending, expending. E. व्यय to spend, शानच् aff.
व्ययित: व्ययित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expended, spent. 2 Gone, dissipated, dispersed. 3 Declined, fallen into decay. E. व्यय to expend, aff. क्त.
व्ययिन्: व्ययिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Spending. 2 Declining, falling into calamity. 3 Wasting, decaying. E. व्यय, and इनि aff.
व्ययीकरण: व्ययीकरण n. (-णं) Expending, wasting. E. व्यय, and करण making, च्चि augment.
व्ययीकृत: व्ययीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expended, spent, wasted. E. व्यय, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
व्ययीभूत: व्ययीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spent, wasted. E. व्यय, and भत been, च्चि augment.
व्यर्ण: व्यर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Asked. 2 Gone. E. अर्द्द to ask, with वि prefix, and क्त aff.
व्यर्थ: व्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Useless, vain, unprofitable. 2 Unmeaning. E. वि privative, and अर्थ meaning, object.
व्यर्थक: व्यर्थक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Vain, useless. E. कन् added to the last.
व्यर्थकता: व्यर्थकता f. (-ता) Unprofitableness, uselessness. E. व्यर्थक, and तल् aff.
व्यर्थता: व्यर्थता f. (-ता) 1 Unprofitableness, uselessness. 2 Absence of meaning, nonsense. E. तल् added to अर्थ; also with त्व, व्यर्थत्वं.
व्यलीक: व्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Disagreeable, displeasing, offensive. 2 Improper, unfit to be done. 3 Painful. 4 Strange. n. (-कं) 1 Pain, torture. 2 Fault, transgression. 3 Any thing displeasing. 4 Any improper act. 5 Reverse. 6 Cheating, tricking. m. (-कः) A catamite. E. वि, and अल to be able or to adorn, aff. ईकन्.
व्यलीकता: व्यलीकता f. (-ता) 1 Impropriety. 2 Disagreeableness. E. तल् added to the last; also व्यलीकत्वं.
व्यवकलन: व्यवकलन n. (-नं) Subtraction. E. वि, and अव before कल to reckon, ल्युट् aff.
व्यवकलित: व्यवकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subtracted, deducted. n. (-तं) Subtraction. E. वि and अव before कल to count, and क्त aff.
व्यवक्रोशन: व्यवक्रोशन n. (-नं) 1 Wrangling, altercation, mutual abuse. 2 Abuse, reviling. E. वि and अव before क्रुश to call, ल्युट् aff.
व्यवच्छिन्न: व्यवछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Different, separate, divided. 2 Distinguished, discriminated. 3 Cut in pieces. E. वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. क्त.
व्यवछिन्न: व्यवछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Different, separate, divided. 2 Distinguished, discriminated. 3 Cut in pieces. E. वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. क्त.
व्यवच्छेद: व्यवछेद m. (-दः) Dividing, separating. 2 A division. 3 Discrimination. 4 Contrast, distinction. 5 Letting fly an arrow, shooting, darting. 6 Cutting in pieces. E. वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
व्यवछेद: व्यवछेद m. (-दः) Dividing, separating. 2 A division. 3 Discrimination. 4 Contrast, distinction. 5 Letting fly an arrow, shooting, darting. 6 Cutting in pieces. E. वि and अव before छिद to cut, aff. घञ्.
व्यवतिष्ठमान: व्यवतिष्ठमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Arranged, placed. E. वि and अव before स्थ to stay, शानच् aff.
व्यवधा: व्यवधा f. (-धा) 1 A covering, a screen, any thing which holds or conceals from sight. 2 The state of being covered, concealment, disappearance. E. वि and अव before घा to have, अङ् and टाप् affs.
व्यवधान: व्यवधान m. (-नं) 1 Covering, disappearance, either the thing which conceals, or the state of being concealed from sight. 2 Intervening, intervention, space. 3 The intervention of a letter, (in grammar.) E. वि and अव before घा to have, aff. ल्युट्.
व्यवधायक: व्यवधायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Concealing, screening, hiding. 2 Intervening, intermediate, separating. E. वि and अव before धा to have, ण्वुल् aff.
व्यवधि: व्यवधि m. (-धिः) Covering, or a covering: see व्यवघान. E. वि and अव before धा to have, aff. कि.
व्यवसाय: व्यवसाय m. (-यः) 1 Effort, exertion, persevering or industrious effort, perseverance, industry. 2 Following any business or profession. 3 Plan, device, trick. 4 Resolve, determination. 5 Boasting. E. वि and अव before षो to destroy, aff. अच्.
व्यवसायात्मिक: व्यवसायात्मिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Laborious, relating to exertion. E. व्यवसाय, and आत्मन् self, with कन् added.
व्यवसायिन्: व्यवसायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Active, energetic, persevering, resolute. 2 Engaged in business. E. व्यवसाय, and इनि aff.
व्यवसित: व्यवसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tricked, cheated. 2 Energetic, taking pains, making effort or exertion. 3 Resolved, determined. n. (-तं) Certainty, ascertainment. E. वि and अव before षो to destroy, aff. क्त.
व्यवस्था: व्यवस्था f. (-स्था) 1 Separating, placing remote or apart. 2 Placing or staying in or on. 3 A decree, a written declaration of the law; applied in practice to the written extracts from the codes of law, stated as the opinions of the Hindu law officers attached to the courts of justice. 4 An engagement, an agreement, a contract. E. वि and अव before स्था to stay or be, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
व्यवस्थातिक्रम: व्यवस्थातिक्रम m. (-मः) 1 Breaking an agreement or contract. 2 Disregarding the law. E. व्यवस्था, and अतिक्रम transgressing.
व्यवस्थातिवर्तन: व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Breaking an agreement or contract. E. व्यवस्था, and अतिवर्त्तन transgressing.
व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तन: व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तन n. (-नं) Breaking an agreement or contract. E. व्यवस्था, and अतिवर्त्तन transgressing.
व्यवस्थातिवर्तिन्: व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) One who does not keep an engagement, perform a contract, &c. E. व्यवस्था, and अतिवर्त्तिन् going from or over.
व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तिन्: व्यवस्थातिवर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) One who does not keep an engagement, perform a contract, &c. E. व्यवस्था, and अतिवर्त्तिन् going from or over.
व्यवस्थापन: व्यवस्थापन n. (-नं) 1 Declaring, deciding, laying down as law. 2 Fixing, determining. 3 Appointing. 4 Placing apart. 5 Placing. E. वि and अव before स्था to stay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
व्यवस्थापित: व्यवस्थापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Declared, determined. 2 Caused to be placed. E. वि and अव before स्था to stay, causal v., क्त aff.
व्यवस्थित: व्यवस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separated, distant. 2 Excerpted, extracted. 3 Invariable, constant. 4 Appointed. 5 Declared, decreed. 6 Staying, or fixed in or on. E. वि and अव before स्था to be, aff. क्त.
व्यवस्थिति: व्यवस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Constancy, perseverance. 2 Determining, appointing. 3 Extracting. E. वि and अव before स्था to stay, क्तिन् aff.
व्यवहर्तव्य: व्यवहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be litigated or decided judicially. 2 To be done or transacted. E. वि and अव before हृ to take, तव्य aff.
व्यवहर्त्तव्य: व्यवहर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be litigated or decided judicially. 2 To be done or transacted. E. वि and अव before हृ to take, तव्य aff.
व्यवहर्तृ: व्यवहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्तृ-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Transacting business, engaged in affairs. 2 Observing or following established usages. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A judge, an umpire, one conducting a judicial procedure. 2 A litigant, a plaintiff, one instituting a dispute at law. 3 Partaker, associate. E. वि and अव before हृ to take, aff. तृच्.
व्यवहर्त्तृ: व्यवहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्तृ-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Transacting business, engaged in affairs. 2 Observing or following established usages. m. (-र्त्ता) 1 A judge, an umpire, one conducting a judicial procedure. 2 A litigant, a plaintiff, one instituting a dispute at law. 3 Partaker, associate. E. वि and अव before हृ to take, aff. तृच्.
व्यवहार: व्यवहार m. (-रः) 1 The practice of the courts, or civil and criminal law, judicial procedure, administrative justice, as the examination of evidence, &c. 2 Title of jurisprudence, any act cognizable in courts of justice. 3 Contest at law, law suit, litigation. 4 Usage, custom. 5 Profession, business. 6 Steadiness, propriety, adherence to law and custom. 7 A contract. 8 A sort of tree. 9 Mathematical or arithmetical determination or ascertainment. E. वि, and अव implying dissension, and हृ to take, aff. घञ्, the term being explained to mean especially, a dispute between two parties, or the counter-statements of plaintiff and defendant.
व्यवहारज्ञ: व्यवहारज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A person who has passed his minority, a young man of age, or one who has passed his sixteenth year, at which period he can assert his own rights in a court of law. E. व्यवहार a law suit, and ज्ञ who knows.
व्यवहारदर्शन: व्यवहारदर्शन n. (-नं) Judicial investigation, trial. E. व्यवहार legal proceeding, and दर्शन seeing, inspecting.
व्यवहारपद: व्यवहारपद n. (-दः) A title of jurisprudence, any act cognizable in a court of law: see व्यवहारविषय. E. व्यवहार, and पद object.
व्यवहारपाद: व्यवहारपाद m. (-दः) A division of legal proceedings, one of the four parts which are necessary to conduct a regular suit, or the plaint, the defence, the proof, and the decision. E. व्यवहार a law suit, and पाद a quarter.
व्यवहारप्राप्त: व्यवहारप्राप्त m. (-प्तः) A youth who has come of age. E. व्यवहार, and प्राप्त obtained.
व्यवहारमातृका: व्यवहारमातृका f. (-का) Legal procedure or process in general, simple judicature, law as in all ordinary cases administered. E. व्यवहार legal contest, and मातृका parent.
व्यवहारमार्ग: व्यवहारमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A title of jurisprudence: see व्यवहारविषय. E. व्यवहार, and मार्ग road or path.
व्यवहारविधि: व्यवहारविधि m. (-धिः) Law, the law, the precepts or code by which judicature is to be regulated and decisions to be made. E. व्यवहार legal process, and विधि a rule.
व्यवहारविषय: व्यवहारविषय mn. (-यः-यं) A title of jurisprudence, an act which may become the object of dispute amongst men, and should therefore be regulated by law; according to MANU, there are eighteen heads, but these are the principal only, and many things not comprised under them may still be actionable; the eighteen are: 1 ऋणादानं debt; 2 निक्षेपः deposit; 3 अस्वामिविक्रयः sale without ownership; 4 सम्भूयसमुत्थानं concerns amongst partners; 5 दत्तस्यानपकर्म्म subtraction of what has been given; 6 वेतनादानं non-payment of wages; 7 सम्विद्व्यतिक्रमः non-performance of agreement; 8 क्रयविक्रयानुशयः rescission of sale and purchase; 9 स्वामिपालयोर्विवादः disputes between master and servant; 10 सीमाविवादः disputes about boundaries; 11 वाक्पारुष्यं defamation, abuse; 12 दण्डपारुष्यं assault; 13 स्तेयं theft, larceny; 14 साहसं robbery, and other violence; 15 स्त्रीसंग्रहणं adultery; 16 स्त्रीपुंधर्म्मः duties of man and wife; 17 विभागः portioning of property, inheritance; 18 द्यूतं gambling of any kind, as fighting animals, laying wagers, &c. E. व्यवहार legal process, and विषय object.
व्यवहारस्थान: व्यवहारस्थान n. (-नं) A title of jurisprudence: see व्यवहारविषय. E. व्यवहार legal procedure, and स्थान place.
व्यवहाराभिशस्त: व्यवहाराभिशस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Prosecuted, accused, proceeded against legally. E. व्यवहार, and अभिशस्त accused.
व्यवहारायोग्य: व्यवहारायोग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Unfitted or unsuited to legal proceedings. m. (-ग्यः) 1 A minor. 2 One incompetent to conduct business. E. व्यवहार, and अयोग्य unfit.
व्यवहारिक: व्यवहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Customary, usual. 2 Engaged in customary duty or avocation. 3 Connected with or relating to legal process. 4 Litigant, being party to a suit. E. व्यवहार, and ठक् aff.
व्यवहारिका: व्यवहारिका f. (-का) 1 Usage, custom. 2 A brush, a broom. 3 A plant, commonly Ingua. E. कन् added to व्यवहार, fem. form.
व्यवहारिन्: व्यवहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Litigant, litigating, engaged in a law suit. 2 Relating to legal process. 3 Customary, usual. 4 Following one's ordinary affairs or avocation. E. व्यवहार, and इनि aff.
व्यवहार्य: व्यवहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be observed or practised, as a duty or avocation, customary, usual. 2 Actionable, subject to legal process. E. वि and अव before हृ to take or convey, ण्यत् aff.
व्यवहार्य्य: व्यवहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be observed or practised, as a duty or avocation, customary, usual. 2 Actionable, subject to legal process. E. वि and अव before हृ to take or convey, ण्यत् aff.
व्यवहास: व्यवहास m. (-सः) Mutual laughter. E. वि and अव before हस to laugh, घञ् aff.
व्यवहित: व्यवहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Placed or situated contiguously to, attached or adhering to, &c. 2 Intervening, separating. 3 Covered, concealed. 4 Excelled, surpassed, put to shame. 5 Done, acted, performed. E. वि and अव before घा to have or hold, aff. क्त.
व्यवाय: व्यवाय m. (-यः) 1 Copulation. 2 Covering, disappearance. 3 Purity. 4 Interval, space. n. (-यं) Light, lustre. E. वि and अव before इण to go, aff. ण.
व्यवायिन्: व्यवायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Lecherous. 2 Pervading, diffusive. m. (-यी) 1 A lecher, a libertine. 2 A drug, an aphrodisiac. 2 Any article that produces general excitement, as wine, poison, &c. E. व्यवाय copulation, and इनि aff.
व्यश्नुवान: व्यश्नुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Occupying, pervading. E. वि before अश to pervade, शानच् aff.
व्यसन: व्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Calamity, misfortune. 2 Fate. 3 Fault, vice, crime, frailty, arising from desire, or from anger; ten vices or faults are enumerated under the first head, or hunting, gambling, sleeping in the day, calumny, whoring, dancing, singing, playing, idle roaming, and drinking: the second comprehends eight, depravity, violence, injury, envy, malice, fraud, abuse, and assault. 4 Sin. 5 Fated consequence. 6 Evil destiny, ill luck. 7 Fruitless effort. 8 Incompetence, inability. 9 Intent, application or attachment to an object. 10 Falling. 11 Air, wind. 12 Individuality. E. वि before अस to throw, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
व्यसनप्रहारिन्: व्यसनप्रहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Troublesome, giving trouble or pain. E. व्यसन, and प्रहारिन् taking.
व्यसनार्त: व्यसनार्त्तं mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Afflicted, suffering pain or calamity. E. व्यसन misfortune, and आर्त्त affected.
व्यसनार्त्तं: व्यसनार्त्तं mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Afflicted, suffering pain or calamity. E. व्यसन misfortune, and आर्त्त affected.
व्यसनिता: व्यसनिता f. (-ता) 1 Wickedness. 2 Calamity. E. व्यसनिन्, and तल् aff.; also त्व, व्यसनित्वं.
व्यसनिन्: व्यसनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) 1 Addicted to evil practices, as to gaming, drinking, wenching, &c. 2 Calamitous, unfortunate. E. व्यसन vice, and इनि aff.
व्यसनीय: व्यसनीय m. (-यः) A profligate, a debauchee. E. व्यसन, and छ aff.
व्यसु: व्यसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Inanimate, lifeless. E. वि priv., असु breath.
व्यस्त: व्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Confounded, confused, bewildered. 2 Pervaded, penetrated, spread. 3 Present and essential, or inherent in all the parts of any thing, in opposition to the Samasta, or that which pervades the whole together. 4 Reverse, inverse. 5 Opposite. 6 Opposed to, set or struck against. 7 Tossed, thrown up, or about. 8 Reversed, inverted. E. वि severally, &c., अस to be or pervade, aff. क्त.
व्यस्तता: व्यस्तता f. (-ता) 1 Agitation, bewilderment. 2 Severalty, individuality. 3 Inherence. E. व्यस्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, व्यस्तत्वं.
व्यस्तपद: व्यस्तपद n. (-दं) 1 Perplexed and indistinct statement, want of precision in an accusation or defence, (in law.) 2 (In grammar,) A simple or uncompounded word. E. व्यस्त perplexed, पद a sentence, &c.
व्यस्तविधि: व्यस्तविधि f. (-धिः) Inversion, rule for inversion. E. व्यस्त, and विधि rule.
व्यस्तार: व्यस्तार n. (-रं) The issue of the fluid from the temples of the elephant. E. व्यस्त pervaded, ऋ to go, aff. ण.
व्यह्न: व्यह्न mfn. (-ह्नः-ह्ना-ह्नं) Done or produced, &c. in two days. E. वि severally, and अह्नं for अहन् a day.
व्याकरण: व्याकरण n. (-णं) 1 Grammar. 2 Explaining, expounding. E. वि and आङ् before कृ to make or do, ल्युट् aff.
व्याकार: व्याकार m. (-रः) 1 Change of form. 2 Deformity. E. वि, and आकार form.
व्याकीर्ण: व्याकीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Scattered, tossed, or thrown about or away. E. वि and आङ् before कॄ to scatter, क्त aff.
व्याकुल: व्याकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Confounded, bewildered, perplexed, overcome with fear, &c. E. वि before आकुल the same.
व्याकुलता: व्याकुलता f. (-ता) Perplexity, agitation, alarm. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, व्याकुलत्वं.
व्याकुलमनस्: व्याकुलमनस् mfn. (-नाः-ना-नः) Agitated, flurried, bewildered. E. व्याकुल, and मनस् the mind.
व्याकुलित: व्याकुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Agitated, flurried, perplexed. E. व्याकुल, and इतच् aff.
व्याकूति: व्याकूति f. (-तिः) Fraud, deception, disguise. E. वि and आङ् before कू to sound, aff. क्तिन्.
व्याकृत: व्याकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expounded, explained, made clear. 2 Transformed, changed. E. वि and आङ् before कृ to make, क्त aff.
व्याकृति: व्याकृति f. (-तिः) 1 Explaining, making clear. 2 Grammar. 3 Change of form. E. वि and आङ् before कृ to make, क्तिन् aff.
व्याकोश: व्याकोश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Budded, blown. E. वि, and आङ् implying separation, कोश or कोष a sheath.
व्याकोष: व्याकोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Budded, blown, (as a flower.) E. see the last.
व्याख्या: व्याख्या f. (-ख्या) Exposition, explanation, gloss, comment. E. वि and आङ् before ख्या to relate, aff. अङ् and टाप्; also with ल्युट् aff. व्याख्यान n. (-नं.)
व्याख्यागम्य: व्याख्यागम्य n. (-म्यं) Indistinct averment, proceeding from grammatical inaccuracy or faulty construction. E. व्याख्या an explanation, and आगम्य to be attained.
व्याख्यात: व्याख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Spoken, said. 2 Conquered, overcome. 3 Explained, expounded. E. वि and आङ् before ख्या to say, aff. क्त.
व्याख्यान: व्याख्यान n. (-नं) Explaining, expounding. E. वि and आङ् before ख्या to say, ल्युट् aff.
व्याख्येय: व्याख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be explained or described. E. वि and आङ् before ख्या to say, ण्यत् aff.
व्याघट्टन: व्याघट्टन n. (-नं) 1 Rubbing, friction. 2 Churning. E. वि and आङ् before घट्ट to use effort, ल्युट् aff.
व्याघट्टित: व्याघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed, rubbed together. 2 Stirred, churned. E. वि and आङ् before घट्ट to use effort, क्त aff.
व्याघात: व्याघात m. (-तः) 1 Obstacle, impediment. 2 Striking, beating. 3 Destroying, destruction. 4 The thirteenth of the astronomical Yogas. 5 A tree, (Cassia fistula.) 6 A rhetorical figure, the production of two different effects from a similar cause or by similar agency. E. वि and आङ् before हन to strike, aff. घञ्.
व्याघातक: व्याघातक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what opposes, resists, &c. E. वि and आङ् before हन् to strike, ण्वुल् aff.
व्याघातिन्: व्याघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Who or what opposes, resists, beats, &c. E. वि and आङ् before हन to strike, णिनि aff.
व्याघारित: व्याघारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sprinkled, lubricated, (as with oil or ghee.) E. वि and आङ् before घृ to sprinkle, क्त aff.
व्याघ्र: व्याघ्र m. (-घ्रः) 1 A tiger. 2 (In composition,) Best, pre-eminent. 3 A variety of the castor oil plant. 4 A tree, (Galedupa arborea.) f. (-घ्री) A prickly sort of nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) E. वि and आङ् before घ्रा to smell, Uṇādi aff. क.
व्याघ्रचर्मन्: व्याघ्रचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) A tiger's skin. E. व्याघ्र, and चर्म्मन् skin.
व्याघ्रचर्म्मन्: व्याघ्रचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) A tiger's skin. E. व्याघ्र, and चर्म्मन् skin.
व्याघ्रदल: व्याघ्रदल m. (-लः) A red variety of the castor oil tree.
व्याघ्रनख: व्याघ्रनख nf. (-खं-खी) 1 A tiger's claw. 2 A sort of perfume. n. (-स्वं) 1 A kind of root. 2 A scratch or impression of the finger nails. E. व्याघ्र tiger, and नख a nail.
व्याघ्रनखक: व्याघ्रनखक n. (-कं) A scratch, the impression of a finger nail. E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and नख a nail, कन् added.
व्याघ्रनायक: व्याघ्रनायक m. (-कः) A jackal. E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and नायक leader.
व्याघ्रपाद: व्याघ्रपाद m. (-दः) 1 A plant, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) 2 A saint and lawgiver, so named from having feet like those of a tiger. E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and पाद the foot or paw.
व्याघ्रपुच्छ: व्याघ्रपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) The castor oil tree, (Palma Christi, or Ricinus communis.) E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and पुच्छ a tail.
व्याघ्राट: व्याघ्राट m. (-टः) A skylark. E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and अट what goes.
व्याघ्रास्य: व्याघ्रास्य m. (-स्यः) A cat. E. व्याघ्र a tiger, and आस्य the face.
व्याज: व्याज m. (-जः) 1 Deceit, fraud, craft, cunning. 2 Disguise, either of purpose or person. 3 Wickedness. E. वि before अज to go, aff. घञ्.
व्याजनिन्दा: व्याजनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Apparent censure, but covert praise, a figure of rhetoric. E. व्याज disguise, and निन्दा censure.
व्याजस्तुति: व्याजस्तुति f. (-तिः) Praise or censure, conveyed in language that expresses the contrary, affected reproach or ironical commendation. E. व्याज disguise, and स्तुति praise.
व्याजोक्ति: व्याजोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Covert expression of any thing so as to mislead others from its real cause. E. व्याज craft or disguise, and उक्ति saying.
व्याड: व्याड m. (-डः) 1 A snake. 2 A carnivorous animal or beast of prey. 3 INDRA. 4 A villain, a rogue. E. वि before अड to make effort, aff. अण्.
व्याडि: व्याडि m. (-डिः) The name of a celebrated grammarian.
व्यात्त: व्यात्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Vast, expanded. E. वि and आङ् before अत to go, क्त aff.
व्यात्युक्षी: व्यात्युक्षी f. (-क्षी) Bathing for amusement, sporting in water. E. वि, आङ् and अति before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. अच् and ङीष्.
व्यादान: व्यादान n. (-नं) Opening, setting open or ajar. E. वि and आङ् before दा to give, ल्युट् aff.
व्याध: व्याध m. (-धः) 1 A hunter, one who lives by killing deer, &c. 2 A low or wicked man. E. व्यध to pierce, ण aff.
व्याधभीत: व्याधभीत m. (-तः) A deer. E. व्याध a hunter, and भीत afraid of.
व्याधाम: व्याधाम m. (-मः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. वि and आङ् before घा to have, मन् aff.
व्याधाव: व्याधाव m. (-वः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. वि and आङ् before घू to tremble, causal form, aff. अच्.
व्याधि: व्याधि m. (-धिः) 1 Sickness, disease in general. 2 Leprosy. E. वि and आङ् before घा to have, कि aff.
व्याधिकर: व्याधिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Causing sickness. E. व्याधि, and कर what makes.
व्याधिघात: व्याधिघात m. (-तः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. व्याघि disease, हन to destroy, aff. अण्.
व्याधिघ्न: व्याधिघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Causing or removing disease. E. व्याघि, and घ्न what destroys.
व्याधित: व्याधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sick, ill, diseased. E. व्याघि sickness, and इतच् aff.
व्याधियुक्त: व्याधियुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sick, diseased. E. व्याघि, and युक्त joined.
व्याधिरहित: व्याधिरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Free from disease, convalescent. E. व्याघि, and रहित left.
व्याधुत: व्याधुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, shaking, trembling, tremulous. E. वि and आङ् before घु to shake, aff. क्त; also from घू with क्त, व्याधूत.
व्याध्युपशम: व्याध्युपशम m. (-मः) Allaying or curing disease. E. व्याघि, and उपशम allaying.
व्यान: व्यान m. (-नः) One of the five vital airs, that which is diffused throughout the body. E. वि before अन to breathe, aff. घञ्.
व्यापक: व्यापक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Diffusive, comprehensive, spreading or extending widely. 2 (In law,) Comprehending all the points of an argument, pervading the whole plea. 3 (In logic,) Embracing the whole of an argument or objection. n. (-कं) Essential and inherent property. E. वि before अप to pervade, ण्वुल् aff. implying the agent.
व्यापकत्व: व्यापकत्व n. (-त्वं) Diffusion, pervadence. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, व्यापकता.
व्यापद्: व्यापद् f. (-पद्) 1 Death, decease. 2 Calamity. 3 Derangement. 4 Disease. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, aff. क्विप्.
व्यापन: व्यापन n. (-नं) Spreading through or throughout, pervading, penetrating. E. वि before आप to obtain, ल्युट् aff.
व्यापन्न: व्यापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Dead, deceased, expired. 2 Hurt, injured, killed. 3 Deranged, disordered. 4 Vitiated, diseased. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, aff. क्त.
व्यापाद: व्यापाद m. (-दः) Evil design, malice prepense, the wish or project to injure another person. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, causal form, aff. घञ्.
व्यापादन: व्यापादन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaying. 2 Wishing or seeking to injure any one, ill-will, malice. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
व्यापादयितव्य: व्यापादयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be killed, what may or ought to be put to death. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, causal v., तव्य aff.; also व्यापादनीय and व्यापाद्य.
व्यापादित: व्यापादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hurt, injured. 2 Slain, killed. E. वि and आङ् before पद to go, causal form, aff. क्त.
व्यापादितवत्: व्यापादितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having killed, killing. E. वि and आङ before पद to go, causal v., क्तवतु aff.
व्यापिन्: व्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Diffusive, comprehensive. m. (-पी) The pervading property or power, &c. E. वि and आप to pervade, णिनि aff.
व्यापार: व्यापार m. (-रः) 1 Occupation, business, trade, profession. 2 Exercise, practice. E. वि and आङ् before पृ to be busy, aff. घञ्.
व्यापारयत्: व्यापारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Setting to work, employing. E. वि and आङ् before पृ to be busy, causal v., शतृ aff.
व्यापारिन्: व्यापारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Motor, motive, the cause or agent of motion or occupation. 2 Busy, occupied. 3 Exercising, practising. E. वि and आङ् before पृ to be busy, causal form, aff. णिनि or व्यापार business, इनि aff.
व्यापृत: व्यापृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Engaged, occupied, busy. m. (-तः) A minister, a member of royal government. E. वि and आङ् before पृ to be busy, aff. क्त.
व्याप्त: व्याप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Pervaded, occupied or penetrated by) thoroughly and essentially, (as the universe by spirit, &c., 2 Celebrated, famous. 3 Filled, full. 4 Placed, fixed. 5 Obtained. 6 Encircled, encompassed, surrounded. 7 Open, apart, outspread, expanded. E. वि before आप to pervade, aff. क्त.
व्याप्ति: व्याप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Pervading, inherence, the inherent and essential presence of any one thing or property in another, as of oil in the sesamum seed, heat in fire, or the Deity in the universe, &c. 2 Getting, obtaining, gain. 3 Universal permeation, omnipresence, as one of ŚIVA'S superhuman properties. E. वि and आप to pervade, aff. क्तिन्.
व्याप्तिज्ञान: व्याप्तिज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge of the existence of a substance from observation of the presence of its inherent properties. E. व्याप्ति, and ज्ञान knowledge.
व्याप्तिमत्: व्याप्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Diffusive, pervading. E. व्याप्ति, and मतुप् aff.
व्याप्तिलक्षण: व्याप्तिलक्षण n. (-णं) Sign or proof of the existence or non-existence of an inherent property or attribute. E. व्याप्ति, and लक्षण indication.
व्याप्य: व्याप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 Permeable, penetrable. 2 Capable of containing any inherent property. n. (-प्यं) 1 An instrument or agent. 2 The thing or substance which may be the site or subject of attributes or inherent properties. 3 The subject of an inference, as fire inferred from the presence of smoke, &c. 4 A drug, (Costus speciosus.) E. वि before आप to pervade, aff. यत्.
व्याप्यत्व: व्याप्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Capacity of being penetrated or essentially affected by. E. व्याप्य, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, व्याप्यता.
व्याप्यत्वासिद्धि: व्याप्यत्वासिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) (In logic,) Imperfect conclusion, one not comprehending all the points of the argument. E. व्याप्यत्व, and असिद्धि nonconclusion.
व्याभ्युक्षी: व्याभ्युक्षी f. (-क्षी) Gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure. E. वि, आङ् and अभि before उक्ष to sprinkle, aff. अच् and ङीष्.
व्याम: व्याम m. (-मः) 1 A fathom, or the space between the tips of the fingers of either hand when the arms are extended. 2 Disregard, disrespect (?) 3 Smoke. E. वि before अम to go, with आङ् pref. and aff. अच्.
व्यामन: व्यामन n. (-नं) Disregard, disrespect. E. वि before अम to go, with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् aff. or वि privative, म्ना to mind, आङ् pref. and अच् aff.
व्यामर्ष: व्यामर्ष m. (-र्षः) 1 Rubbing out, erasure. 2 Impatience. E. वि and आङ् before मृष to rub, &c., घञ् aff.
व्यामिल्य: व्यामिल्य ind. Having closed and opened, having twinkled, &c. E. वि and आङ् before मिल to twinkle, ल्यप् aff.
व्यामिश्र: व्यामिश्र mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं) Mixed, blended, mingled. E. वि and आङ् before मिश्र mixed.
व्यामृष्ट: व्यामृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Rubbed, rubbed out, effaced. E. वि and आङ् before मृष to rub, aff. क्त.
व्यायच्छमान: व्यायछमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Quarrelling. E. वि and आङ् before इण् to go, शानच् aff.
व्यायछमान: व्यायछमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Quarrelling. E. वि and आङ् before इण् to go, शानच् aff.
व्यायत: व्यायत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Busy, occupied. 2 Long. 3 Hard, firm. 4 Much, excessive. E. वि and आङ् before यम to stop, aff. क्त.
व्यायाम: व्यायाम m. (-मः) 1 Fatigue, labour. 2 A fathom, measured by the distance to which both arms extended reach. 3 Gymnastics,  athletic exercise, as playing with heavy clubs, wielding a bow with a chain in place of a string, alternate rising and falling at full length on the ground, &c. 4 Manhood, manliness. 5 A difficulty. 6 A difficult or impassable defile, &c. 7 Business, occupation. E. वि and आङ् before यम to refrain, aff. घञ्.
