व्यायामशील: व्यायामशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Active, robust, athletic, taking exercise. E. व्यायाम, and शील practising.
व्यायामिन्: व्यायामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Taking exercise, undergoing fatigue, active, athletic. E. व्यायाम, and इनि aff.
व्यायाम्य: व्यायाम्य ind. Having exercised, practised as gymnastics, &c. disciplined as troops. E. वि and आङ् before यम to restrain, ण्यत् aff.
व्यायोग: व्यायोग m. (-गः) A kind of dramatic exhibition or composition in one act, the subject of which is some contest or war of a heroic kind, and of which woman is not the cause. E. वि and आङ् before युज to unite, aff. घञ्; in which the valiant are associated.
व्याल: व्याल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Wicked, villainous, bad. 2 Cruel, fierce. m. (-लः) 1 A snake. 2 A beast of prey. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A vicious elephant. 5 A king. 6 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. वि and आङ् before अल to adorn, or अड to make effort, aff. अच्; also व्याड.
व्यालक: व्यालक m. (-कः) A vicious elephant. E. कन् added to the last.
व्यालग्राह: व्यालग्राह m. (-हः) A snake-catcher. E. व्याल a snake, and ग्रह to seize, aff. अण्.
व्यालग्राहिन्: व्यालग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A snake-catcher, one who lives by catching and exhibiting snakes. E. व्याल a snake, and ग्राहिन् who takes.
व्यालतम: व्यालतम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Very injurious, cruel or fierce. E. व्याल and तमप् aff.
व्यालमृग: व्यालमृग m. (-गः) A fierce or wild stag. E. व्याल, and मृग a deer.
व्यालायुध: व्यालायुध n. (-धं) A sort of perfume; see नखी. E. व्याल a beast of prey (a tiger), and आयुध a weapon; compared to the claw of the animal.
व्यालिखत्: व्यालिखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खत्) 1 Drawing lines, delineating, scratching, piercing. 2 Extending to, in contact with. E. वि and आङ् before लिख to write, शतृ aff.
व्यालीन: व्यालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, clustering. E. वि and आङ् before ली to waste, क्त aff.
व्यालोल: व्यालोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tremulous, shaking, waving. E. वि and आङ् before लोल to shake, अच् aff.
व्यावकलन: व्यावकलन n. (-नं) Subtraction, (in arithmetic.) E. वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. ल्युट्.
व्यावकलित: व्यावकलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Subtracted. E. वि with आङ् and अव before कल to count, aff. क्त.
व्यावक्रोशी: व्यावक्रोशी f. (-शी) Mutual imprecation. E. वि with आङ् and अव before क्रुश to cry out, aff. णच् and ङीप्.
व्यावभाषी: व्यावभाषी f. (-षी) Mutual abuse or imprecation. E. वि implying reciprocity, and अव depreciation, भाष to speak, affs. णच् and ङीप्.
व्यावर्त: व्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Going round, revolving. 2 Encompassing. 3 Choosing, appointing. 4 Ruptured navel, (umbilical hernia.) E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, घञ् aff.
व्यावर्त्त: व्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 Going round, revolving. 2 Encompassing. 3 Choosing, appointing. 4 Ruptured navel, (umbilical hernia.) E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, घञ् aff.
व्यावर्तन: व्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Rolling round, revolving. 2 A volute, a fold, a band. 3 Encompassing, surrounding. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
व्यावर्त्तन: व्यावर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Rolling round, revolving. 2 A volute, a fold, a band. 3 Encompassing, surrounding. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
व्यावहारिक: व्यावहारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Usual, customary. 2 Juridical, judicial, legal, relative or referring to judicial procedure. m. (-कः) A counsellor, a minister. E. व्यवहार litigation, ठञ् aff.
व्यावहासी: व्यावहासी f. (-सी) Mutual or reciprocal laughter. E. वि and आङ् before हस to laugh, णच् and ङीप् aff.
व्याविध: व्याविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Of various kinds or sorts. E. वि and आङ् before विघ sort.
व्यावृत: व्यावृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Covered, screened. 2 Removed, excepted. E. वि and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्त aff.
व्यावृति: व्यावृति f. (-तिः) 1 Exception, exclusion. 2 Covering, screening. E. वि and आङ् before वृ to choose, क्तिन् aff.
व्यावृत्त: व्यावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Chosen, appointed. 2 Encompassed, surrounded. 3 Fenced, screened. 4 Removed, uncovered. 5 Excepted, excluded. 6 Praised, hymned. 7 Rolled backwards. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, &c., aff. क्त.
व्यावृत्ति: व्यावृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Rejection, exception, exclusion. 3 Choice, selection. 4 Screening, surrounding. 5 Rolling back. E. वि and आङ् before वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्.
व्यास: व्यास m. (-सः) 1 A celebrated saint and author, the supposed original compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas; also the founder of the Vedānta philosophy. 2 Diffusion, extension. 3 Detail, distinction, severalty. 4 A measure. n. (-सं) The diameter of a circle. E. वि and आङ् before अस to pervade, aff. घञ्.
व्यासक्त: व्यासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Bewildered, confused. 2 Connected with, attached or devoted to. 3 Detached, separated. E. वि before आसक्त attentive.
व्यासङ्ग: व्यासङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Confusion, perplexity. 2 Separation, detachment. 3 Attachment, addition. E. वि and आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, घञ् aff.
व्यासिद्ध: व्यासिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Prohibited, forbidden. 2 Contraband, not allowed to be sold but to particular persons or in certain places. E. वि privative, and आसिद्ध perfected, accomplished.
व्याहत: व्याहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Confused, alarmed. 2 Repelled, repulsed. 3 Driven out, expelled. 4 Disappointed. E. वि and आङ् before हन to strike, &c., aff. क्त.
व्याहार: व्याहार m. (-रः) 1 Voice, speech. 2 A word, an articulate sound. 3 Jest, joke, humorous speech. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, aff. घञ्.
व्याहरण: व्याहरण n. (-णं) Uttering, pronouncing. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.
व्याहरत्: व्याहरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Speaking, uttering, pronouncing. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, शतृ aff.
व्याहृत: व्याहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered, pronounced, said. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
व्याहृति: व्याहृति f. (-तिः) 1 Voice, speech. 2 A word, an articulate sound. 3 A mystical word or sound, as Om, Svar, Bhūr, Bhuvas, &c., which are the Mahā Vyāhṛtis, and commence the daily prayers of the Brahman. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, aff. क्तिन्.
व्याहृत्य: व्याहृत्य ind. Having said or uttered. E. वि and आङ् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
व्युत: व्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sewn, woven. E. वि before उत woven; also व्यूत.
व्युति: व्युति f. (-तिः) Sewing, weaving. E. वि before ऊय to weave, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.; also व्यूति.
व्युत्क्रम: व्युत्क्रम m. (-मः) Inverted order, irregular arrangement. E. वि and उत् before क्रम order.
व्युत्थान: व्युत्थान n. (-नं) 1 Independence, following one's own inclination. 2 Opposition, contradiction, doing that which is prohibited. 3 Obstruction, prohibition, hindering or opposing any one. 4 Completion of religious contemplation, the end. of a period of abstraction. E. वि and उत् before स्था to stay or be, aff. ल्युट्.
व्युत्पत्ति: व्युत्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Science, learning, conversancy with or proficience in literature or science. 2 Formation of words, derivation, etymology. E. वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
व्युत्पन्न: व्युत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Learned, studied, conversant or proficient in literature. 2 Completed, finished. 3 Derived, formed as a derivative word. 4 Generated, begotten. E. वि and उत् before पद to go, aff. क्त.
व्युदस्त: व्युदस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Put off, thrown aside, (especially as feeling or affection.) E. वि and उट् before अस to throw, क्त aff.
व्युदस्य: व्युदस्य ind. Having thrown off or put away, (as desire, feeling, &c.) E. वि and उद before अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.
व्युदास: व्युदास m. (-सः) 1 Indifference to, disregard for. 2 Making ill or unprofitable use of any thing, throwing away. E. वि and उद before अस to throw, घञ् aff.
व्युपदेश: व्युपदेश m. (-शः) Pretext, deception, plausible but false council. E. वि priv., उपदेश advice.
व्युष: व्युष r. 10th cl. (व्युषयति) To abandon, to reject.
व्युष्ट: व्युष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Burned. 2 Dawned, become daylight or dawn. n. (-ष्टं) 1 Dawn, break of day. 2 Day. 3 Fruit, consequence. E. वि before वस to abide, aff. क्त, and व changed to उ, or व्युष to burn, when it is more properly read व्युष्ट.
व्युष्टि: व्युष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Fruit, consequence. 2 Increase, prosperity. 3 Praise. E. वि and वस to abide, aff. क्तिन्, and व changed to उ.
व्युस: व्युस(इर)व्युसिर r. 4th cl. (व्युस्यति) To leave, to abandon.
व्यूढ: व्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Arranged, arrayed, placed in order or array. 2 Compact, firm, well-knit. 3 Large, great. E. वि before वह to bear, &c., aff. क्त.
व्यूढकङ्कट: व्यूढकङ्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Armed, mailed. E. व्यूढ arranged, and कङ्कट mail.
व्यूढोरस्क: व्यूढोरस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Broad-chested. E. व्यूढ, उरस् the breast, कन् added.
व्यूढि: व्यूढि f. (-ढिः) Array, orderly arrangement or disposition. E. वि before वह to bear, or ऊह to reason, aff. क्तिन्.
व्यूत: व्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Woven. E. वि before ऊत the same.
व्यूति: व्यूति f. (-तिः) 1 Weaving. E. वि before वेञ् to weave, aff. क्तिन् and व changed to ऊ.
व्यूह: व्यूह m. (-हः) 1 Military array, the arrangement of troops in various positions; as दण्डव्यूहः the array in line, भोगव्यूहः in column, मण्डलव्यूहः in circle, असंहतव्यूहः in mixed order; also various fanciful forms, as the शकटः or car-shape, मकरः or marine monster-like, पताका flag-shape, &c. 2 A flock, a multitude. 3 Logic, reasoning. 4 Making, manufacture. 5 The body. E. वि before ऊह to reason, aff. घञ्.
व्यूहन: व्यूहन n. (-नं) 1 Arraying, array, arrangement. 2 Structure of the body, disposition of the members. E. वि before ऊह to reason, ल्युट् aff.
व्यूहपार्ष्णि: व्यूहपार्ष्णि m. (-र्ष्णिः) The rear of an army. E. व्यूह array, and पार्ष्णि the heel or back.
व्यूहभङ्ग: व्यूहभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Throwing into disorder, breaking an array. E. व्यूह, and भङ्ग breaking.
व्यूहभेद: व्यूहभेद m. (-दः) Piercing or breaking an array. E. व्यूह, and भेद breaking.
व्योकार: व्योकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith. E. व्यो an imitative sound, and कार who makes.
व्योमकेश: व्योमकेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA. E. वोम heaven, and केश hair; also with इनि poss. aff. added व्योमकेशिन् (-शी).
व्योमचारिन्: व्योमचारिन् m. (-री) 1 A god. 2 A bird. A saint. 3 A Brahman. E. व्योम heaven, and चारिन् who goes.
व्योमचारिपुर: व्योमचारिपुर n. (-रं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended midway between heaven and earth. E. व्योम heaven, चारि going, पुर a city.
व्योमधूम: व्योमधूम m. (-मः) A cloud. E. व्योम heaven, and घूम smoke.
व्योमन्: व्योमन् n. (-म) 1 Sky, heaven, atmosphere. 2 Water. 3 A temple, sacred to the sun, or place where he is especially worshipped. E. व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्, form irr.
व्योमनासिका: व्योमनासिका f. (-का) A sort of quail. E. व्योम heaven, and नासिका the nose.
व्योममञ्जर: व्योममञ्जर n. (-रं) A flag, a banner. E. व्योम the sky, and मञ्जर a stalk.
व्योममण्डल: व्योममण्डल n. (-लं) A flag, a banner. E. व्योम sky, and मण्डल place.
व्योममुद्गर: व्योममुद्गर m. (-रः) A gust of wind. E. व्योम the sky, and मुद्गर a club.
व्योममाय: व्योममाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measuring the sky, high as the heavens. E. व्योम, and माय what measures.
व्योमयान: व्योमयान n. (-नं) A carriage of the gods. E. व्योम the sky, and यान a vehicle.
व्योमविस्तृत: व्योमविस्तृत n. (-तं) The expanse or firmament. E. व्योम, and विल्तृत spread.
व्योमसद्: व्योमसद् m. (-सद्) A spirit of heaven, a divinity. E. व्योम, and सद् who goes.
व्योमस्थली: व्योमस्थली f. (-ली) The earth. E. व्योम the sky, and स्थली base or site.
व्योमस्पृश्: व्योमस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Sky-touching, lofty. E. व्योम, and स्पृश् what touches.
व्योमाभ: व्योमाभ m. (-भः) A Jaina deified saint. E. व्योम sky, and आभ shining.
व्योष: व्योष n. (-षं) The aggregate of three spices, or black-pepper, longpepper, and dry ginger. E. वि variously, उष to burn, aff. अच्.
व्रज: व्रज r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रजति व्राजयति) To go, to travel. With परि prefixed, To wander about, as a mendicant. r. 10th cl. To prepare, to perfect.

व्रज m. (-जः) 1 A cow-pen, a station of cowherds. 2 A road. 3 A flock, a herd, a multitude. 4 The district about Agra and  Mathurā, the scene of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile adventures. n. (-जं) Wandering, roaming. E. व्रज to go, aff. घ.
व्रजत्: व्रजत् mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्) Going, roaming. E. व्रज to go, शतृ aff.
व्रजन: व्रजन n. (-नं) Going, roaming. E. व्रज to go, ल्युट् aff.
व्रजभू: व्रजभू m. (-भूः) A tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. व्रज a cow-pen, and भू being.
व्रजाजिर: व्रजाजिर n. (-रं) A cow-yard, a cattle fold or pen. E. व्रज, and अजिर a yard.
व्रजित: व्रजित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Gone, going. n. (-तं) Roaming. E. व्रज to go, क्त aff.
व्रज्या: व्रज्या f. (-ज्या) 1 Wandering about, either as an act of religious austerity or in quest of alms. 2 March of an assailant, attack, invasion. 3 March in general. 4 A class, a flock, a tribe. 5 A theatre. E. व्रज to go, क्यप् aff.
व्रज्यावत्: व्रज्यावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Wandering, roaming. 2 Going gracefully. E. व्रज्या, and मतुप् aff.
व्रण: व्रण r. 1st cl. (व्रणति) To sound. r. 10th cl. (व्रणयति) To wound.
व्रण mn. (-णः-णं) A tumor, a boil; an ulcer, a wound. E. व्रण to wound, an abscess, aff. अच्.
व्रणकृत्: व्रणकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Making a sore, wounding, ulcerating, corroding, &c. m. (-कृत्) Marking-nut plant, (Semecarpus anacardium.) E. व्रण a sore, and कृत् what makes.
व्रणद्विष्: व्रणद्विष् m. (-द्विट्) A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) E. वृण a sore, and द्विष् hostile to, healing.
व्रणधूपन: व्रणधूपन n. (-नं) Fumigating a sore. E. व्रण, and धूपन burning incense.
व्रणवस्तु: व्रणवस्तु n. (-स्तुः) Part liable to ulcerate, as skin, flesh, &c. E. व्रण, and वस्तु substance.
व्रणवेदना: व्रणवेदना f. (-ना) Pain of a wound or sore. E. व्रण, and वेदना pain.
व्रणशोधन: व्रणशोधन n. (-नं) Cleaning or cicatrising a sore. E. व्रण, and शोधन cleaning.
व्रणह: व्रणह m. (-हः) The castor oil tree. f. (-हा) A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. व्रण a sore, and हन to destroy, aff. क.
व्रणिन्: व्रणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Having a boil, a sore or wound. E. व्रण, and इनि aff.
व्रत: व्रत mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Any meritorious act of devotion, the voluntary or vowed observance, or imposition of any penance, austerity, or privation, as fasting, continence, exposure to heat and cold, &c. 2 Eating. E. वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, र substituted for the vowel, or व्रज to go, (to heaven by it,) घ aff. and the form irr.
व्रतति: व्रतति f. (-तिः-ती) 1 Expansion, spreading. 2 A creeper. E. वृत to abide, अति aff., the vowel changed to its congener.
व्रतभिक्षा: व्रतभिक्षा f. (-क्षा) Soliciting alms, as one of the ceremonies accompanying investiture. E. व्रत the observance of investiture, and भिक्षा begging.
व्रतलोपन: व्रतलोपन n. (-नं) Violating a religious vow or obligation. E. व्रत, and लोपन cutting off.
व्रतसंग्रह: व्रतसंग्रह m. (-हः) Engaging in any act of devotion, taking on one's self some voluntary religious obligation. E. व्रत a vow, and संग्रह taking.
व्रतस्नातक: व्रतस्नातक m. (-कः) The Brahman who has completed his term of studentship. E. व्रत, and स्नातक a householder.
व्रताचरण: व्रताचरण n. (-णं) Observing a religious obligation, especially continence, as the duty of the student. E. व्रत, and आचरण going.
व्रतादेश: व्रतादेश m. (-शः) Investiture of a youth of either of the first three classes with the characteristic cord. E. व्रत the observance, and आदेश pointing out.
व्रतिन्: व्रतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Engaged in or observing a religious vow or obligation. m. (-ती) 1 An employer of priests. 2 An ascetic, a devotee, one engaged in the observance of a vow or penance. 3 The religious student. E. व्रत a vow, and इनि aff.
व्रतोपवास: व्रतोपवास m. (-सः) Fasting, a fast, (as a religious penance or obligation.) E. व्रत, and उपवास fasting.
व्रश्च: व्रश्च(ओ उ)ओव्रश्चु r. 6th cl. (वृश्चति) To cut.
व्रश्चन: व्रश्चन m. (-नः) A small saw or chisel. n. (-नं) Cutting. E. व्रश्च to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
व्राजि: व्राजि f. (-जिः) A gale of wind. E. व्रज to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.
व्रात: व्रात m. (-तः) 1 A multitude, an assemblage. 2 The descendant of an outcaste Brahman, &c. 3 The company and attendants at a marriage feast. n. (-तं) 1 Manual or bodily labour. 2 Day labour, employment of a precarious kind. E. वृ to choose, aff. अतच्, and the vowel made long; or व्रत a religious observance, or व्रात्य an outcaste, aff. अण्.
व्रातीन: व्रातीन m. (-नः) 1 A cooly, a hired porter or labourer. 2 One who has no fixed or stated employment. E. व्रात bodily labour, and ख aff.
व्रात्य: व्रात्य m. (-त्यः) A Brahman, or man of the three first classes, in whose youth the customary observances have been omitted, and who has not received his investiture with the sacred thread. f. (-त्या) A female of a fallen Brahman, &c. E. व्रात, and य aff.
व्रात्यता: व्रात्यता f. (ता) The condition of one who has lost caste by neglect of the initiatory observances. E. व्रात्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, व्रात्यत्वं.
व्रात्यस्तोम: व्रात्यस्तोम m. (-मः) A particular sacrifice performed to recover the rights forfeited by an improper delay of the ceremony of investiture. E. व्रात्य one not invested, &c., and स्तोम a sacrifice.
व्री: व्री r. 4th cl. (व्रीयते) r. 9th cl. (व्रीणाति or व्रीणीते) 1 To choose or elect. 2 To cover or screen.
व्रीड: व्रीड r. 4th cl. (व्रीडयति) 1 To be modest, to be bashful or ashamed. 2 To throw, to direct or send.
व्रीड mf. (-डः-डा) Shame, bashfulness. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
व्रीडन: व्रीडन n. (-नं) Bashfulness, modesty. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, and ल्युट् aff.
व्रीडानत: व्रीडानत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, hanging down the head with shame. E. व्रीडा, and आनत bowed.
व्रीडान्वित: व्रीडान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Modest. E. व्रीडा, and अन्वित possessed of.
व्रीडित: व्रीडित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest. E. व्रीड to be ashamed, क्त aff.
व्रीस: व्रीस r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रीसति व्रीसयति) To hurt or injure, to kill or wound.
व्रीहि: व्रीहि m. (-हिः) 1 Rice of various kinds: eight principal sorts are enumerated by native authorities, but the varieties are more numerous. 2 Rice ripening in the rainy season. E. व्री to choose. हि aff.
व्रीहिक: व्रीहिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having rice, bearing rice, &c. E. व्रीहि rice, and ठन् aff.
व्रीहिकाञ्चन: व्रीहिकाञ्चन m. (-नः) A sort of pulse, (Ervum lens or hirsutum, &c.)
व्रीहिन्: व्रीहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Having rice, (a field, &c.) E. व्रीहि rice, इनि aff.
व्रीहिभेद: व्रीहिभेद m. (-दः) A sort of grain, (Panicum miliaceum.) E. व्रीहि rice, and भेद sort.
व्रीहिमय: व्रीहिमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made or consisting of rice. m. (-यः) A rice cake offered with ghee as an oblation. E. व्रीहि rice, and मयट् aff.
व्रीहिराजिक: व्रीहिराजिक m. (-कः) 1 Panic seed, (Panicum italicum.) 2 Another species, (Panicum miliaceum.) E. व्रीहि rice, राजिक shining, excelling.
व्रीह्यगार: व्रीह्यगार n. (-रं) A granary, a shed where rice or other grain is stored. E. व्रीहि rice, अगार a house.
व्रुड: व्रुड r. 6th cl. (व्रुडति) 1 To cover. 2 To heap. 3 To sink.
व्रूस: व्रूस r. 1st and 10th cls. (व्रूसति व्रूसयति) To hurt or kill.
व्रैह: व्रैह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Made of or with rice. E. व्रीहि rice, and अण् aff.
व्रैहेय: व्रैहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for or sown with rice, (a field, &c.) E. व्रीहि rice, ढक् aff.
व्ली: व्ली r. 9th cl. (व्लीणाति or व्लीणीते) 1 To choose or select. 2 To cover, to screen. 3 To go, to move.
व्लेक्ष: व्लेक्ष r. 10th cl. (व्लेक्षयति) To see. श
